deb brgya dang gcig pa'i dkar chag :rnying rgyud/ (k+ṣi (1༷ 1)1112 chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 3dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ chos nyid mngon du phyung nas bstan pa'i le'u/ 5gsum pa/ ji ltar byung ba'i khungs bstan pa'i le'u/ 7bzhi pa/ nga nyid kyi mtshan bshad pa'i le'u/ 10lnga pa/ don gyi 'grel pa'i le'u/ 12drug pa/ rtsa ba gcig pa'i le'u/ 13bdun pa/ rnam grangs bsdus pa'i le'u/ 19brgyad pa/ chos nyid kyi rang bzhin las chos nyid kyi yul kun la bkod pa'i le'u/ 22dgu pa/ gol sgrib skyon sel gyi le'u/ 26bcu pa/ phun sum tshogs pa shin tu dkon pa'i le'u/ 31bcu gcig pa/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems kun byed

bka' 'gyur/rgyal po nyid kho nar 'dus pa'i le'u/ 39bcu gnyis pa/ nges par lung khungs bstan pa'i le'u/ 41bcu gsum pa/ sems kyi bshad lugs kyi le'u/ 43bcu bzhi pa/ skal med la gsang ba'i le'u/ 47bcwa lnga pa/ rang bzhin rnam pa gsum mngon du phyung ba'i le'u/ 48bcu drug sems dpa' rdo rje la gdams ngag phog pa'i le'u/ 55bcu bdun pa/ sku gdung gtad pa'i le'u/ 56bcwa brgyad/ btsal bas mi 'grub pa'i le'u/ 57bcu dgu pa/ ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa'i le'u/ 58nyi shu pa/ chos thams cad byang chub sems kun byed las byung ba'i khungs kyi le'u/ 59nyer gcig pa/ gtan tshigs bshad lugs kyi le'u/ 61nyer gnyis pa/ bya med rdzogs pa'i lung bcu las mi gnas yul med kyi le'u/ 63nyer gsum pa/ bya med rdzogs pa las lta ba yul med kyi nam mkha'i dgongs pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 67nyer bzhi pa/ bya med rdzogs pa phyag rgya 'gyur med kyi lung gi le'u/ 67nyer lnga pa/ rang sems ston par phyung ba'i le'u/ 68nyer drug pa/ bya med rdzogs pa bsgom du med pa'i le'u/ 70nyer bdun pa/ bya med rdzogs pa rnam dag dbyings kyi lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 72nyer brgyad pa/ bya med rdzogs pa 'gyur med btsal mi rnyed pa'i le'u/ 73nyer dgu pa/ dgongs pa rnal du bzhag pa'i le'u/ 75sum cu pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi le'u/ medaso gcig pa/ rdo rje tshig drug gi le'u/ 83so gnyis pa/ nges pa tshig bzhi'i le'u/ 842

deb brgya dang gcig pa'i dkar chag so gsum pa/ nges pa'i lung dang drang ba'i lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 84so bzhi pa/ dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lung gi le'u/ 87so lnga pa/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 90so drug pa/ sku gsung thugs su 'dus pa'i le'u/ 91so bdun pa/ bsgom du med pa'i mdo lung gi le'u/ 93so brgyad pa/ lta spyod kyi gol sgrib bstan pa'i le'u/ 95so dgu pa/ rgyal ba'i snying po'i le'u/ 98bzhi bcu pa/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'i le'u/ 100zhe gcig pa/ ngo bo gcig pa'i le'u/ 102zhe gnyis pa/ bcos su med pa'i le'u/ 104zhe gsum pa/ ston par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i le'u/ 105zhe bzhi pa/ rdzogs chen skal med don med kyi le'u/ 107zhe lnga pa/ lta ba bsgom med kyi le'u/ 110zhe drug pa/ dam tshig bsrung du med pa'i le'u/ 113zhe bdun pa/ phrin las btsal du med pa'i le'u/ 117zhe brgyad pa/ chos thams cad kyi gzhi ma kun byed nyid yin par bstan pa'i le'u/ 119zhe dgu pa/ rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la sbyang du med pa'i le'u/ 122lnga bcu pa/ rang 'byung ye shes bstan pa'i le'u/ 124nga gcig pa/ lam la bgrod du med pa'i le'u/ 126nga gnyis pa/ ma g.yos 'dod pa med pa'i le'u/ 129nga gsum pa/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin g.yos pa med pa'i le'u/ 131nga bzhi pa/ mdo lung thams cad kun byed nyid kyi rang bzhin du bsdus nas bstan pa'i le'u/ 1343

4 bka' 'gyur/nga lnga pa/ chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems las med pa'i le'u/ 138nga drug pa/ sems dpa' rdo rjes kun byed kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i sgo nas bsgrags pa'i le'u/ 140nga bdun pa/ mdo las bstan pa gtad pa'i le'u/ 141rgya gar gyi mkhas pa shrī sau ha pra bhā dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba pa gor be+e ro tsa nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/nga brgyad pa/ rtogs pa gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 142nga dgu pa/ skye ba med pa'i le'u/ 144drug cu pa/ bsrung med dam tshig gi le'u/ 146re gcig pa/ sgo gsum bya ba med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 148re gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor bskyed du med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 1gare gsum pa/ rang 'byung rtogs pa'i dbang gi le'u/ 151re bzhi pa/ lam la bgrod du med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 152re lnga pa/ sa la sbyang du med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 154re drug pa/ spyod pa blang dor med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 155re bdun pa/ ye shes bsgrib pa med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 157re brgyad pa/ lhun grub btsal du med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 159re dgu pa/ rtogs pa bsgrags shing bstod pa'i le'u/ 160bdun cu pa/ bsgom du yod med bstan pa'i le'u/ 162don gcig pa/ lta sgom dbyer med pa'i le'u/ 164don gnyis pa/ lta sgom 'dar med pa'i le'u/ 166don gsum pa/ ji bzhin pa la bya rtsol dang bral bar gnas pa'i le'u/ ri 167don bzhi pa/ snying po don la gnas pa'i le'u/ 169don lnga pa/ rig pa dbang sgyur la gnas pa'i le'u/ 1704

deb brgya dang gcig pa'i dkar chag radon drug pa/ snying po lam la gnas pa'i le'u/ 172don bdun pa/ don la sbyang med kyi le'u/ 174don brgyad pa/ mnyam pa la blang dor med par bstan pa'i le'u/ 175don dgu pa/ mi sgrib pa'i le'u/ 177brgyad cu pa/ lhun grub re dogs bcad pa'i le'u/ 178gya gcig pa/ dgongs don lde mig gi le'u/ 180gya gnyis pa/ rjes su bstod pa'i le'u/ 183gya gsum pa/ bstan pa gang la gzhag pa'i le'u/ 185gya bzhi pa/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs bstan pa'i le'u/ 186rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal gyi seng ge mgon po dang dge slong be+e ro tsa nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(189) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(218)1119 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa chos kyi rnam grangs rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 219byung tshul bstan pa dang po/ 219dang po/ thun mong bca' gzhi'i le'u/ 219gnyis pa/ gdams ngag nges par gzhag pa'i le'u/ 224gsum pa/ thog mar dam pas gdung ba bton pa'i le'u/ 228bzhi pa/ gang gi gdung ba sel bar bgros pa'i le'u/ 2305

6 bka' 'gyur/lnga pa/ lung dam pa bgro bar gsol ba btab pa'i le'u/ 232drug pa/ gang rmongs pa gdung ba sel ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 237byung tshul bstan pa gnyis pa/ 240bdun pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cho 'phrul yongs su bkod pa'i le'u/ 240brgyad pa/ gsang sngags rang gi ngo bo bstan pa'i le'u/ 253byung tshul bstan pa gsum pa/ 258dgu pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i de kho na nyid ston pa'i le'u/ 258bcu pa/ khyad par dam pa'i le'u/ 267bcu gcig pa/ rgyud dag pa'i skye rgyud bstan pa'i le'u/ 270bcu gnyis pa/ dbugs chen po yongs su phyin pa'i le'u/ 276bcu gsum pa/ skyes bu dam pa dbang thob pa'i le'u/ 282bcu bzhi pa/ skyes bu dam pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 286byung tshul bstan pa bzhi pa/ 291bcwa lnga pa/ gsang ba dam pa de kho na nyid du nges pa'i le'u/ 291byung tshul bstan pa lnga pa/ 301bcu drug pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul bstan pa'i le'u/ 301bcu bdun pa/ chos snang ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i le'u/ 311bcwa brgyad pa/ kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 316bcu dgu pa/ gang yongs su rdzogs par 'grel ba'i le'u/ 320byung tshul bstan pa drug pa/ 327nyi shu pa/ gang yongs su ma dag pa'i skye rgyud bstan pa'i le'u/ 327nyer gcig pa/ 'das pa sngon byung ba'i le'u/ 335nyer gnyis pa/ ru tra nag po'i spyod yul bstan pa'i le'u/ 338nyer gsum pa/ gang gi cho 'phrul bskul ba'i le'u/ 3436

deb brgya dang gcig pa'i dkar chag 7nyer bzhi pa/ 'dus pa chen pos rnam par bgros pa'i le'u/ 348nyer lnga pa/ bka' bgros dam pa bcad pa'i le'u/ 350nyer drug pa/ las bzhi rdo rje skos kyi le'u/ 357nyer bdun pa/ bdud yongs su btul ba'i le'u/ 361nyer brgyad pa/ tha ma dman pa'i gdung ba bton pa'i le'u/ 371nyer dgu pa/ rgyud yongs su sbyangs pa'i le'u/ 375sum cu pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa bskul ba'i le'u/ 377so gcig pa/ thar pa nag po gol ba la ma gol bar lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 380byung tshul bstan pa bdun pa/ 393so gnyis pa/ thugs ye shes snang ba dam pa'i rgyan bkod pa'i le'u/ 393so gsum pa/ sku yongs su snang ba dam pa'i rgyan bkod pa'i le'u/ 403so bzhi pa/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bkod pa'i le'u/ 410so lnga pa/ spyod pa mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bkod pa'i le'u/ 425byung tshul bstan pa brgyad pa/ 428so drug pa/ rmongs pa'i sel ba spyod mthun dgrol ba'i le'u/ 428so bdun pa/ gang gi dri ba the tshom bcad pa'i le'u/ 440so brgyad pa/ sngon du byung ba gtam rgyud yongs su brjod pa'i le'u/ 4gabyung tshul bstan pa dgu pa/ 460so dgu pa/ thugs kyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u/ 460bzhi bcu pa/ gsung gi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u/ 463zhe gcig pa/ thabs kyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u/ 466zhe gnyis pa/ sku'i mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u/ 468byung tshul bstan pa bcu pa/ 469zhe gsum pa/ rjes su byung bar lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 4697

8 bka' 'gyur/byung tshul bstan pa bcu gcig pa/ 473zhe bzhi pa/ cho 'phrul sngon byung gi le'u/ 473byung tshul bstan pa bcu gnyis pa/ 478zhe lnga pa/ bkod pa rnam par 'grel pa'i le'u/ 478zhe drug pa/ bsdu ba rnam par 'grel pa'i le'u/ ga0zhe bdun pa/ gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa bstan pa'i le'u/ go1zhe brgyad pa/ rtsa ba sbyor ba'i yan lag bstan pa'i le'u/ ga7zhe dgu pa/ 'brel pa dgos ched kyi yan lag bstan pa'i le'u/ 503lnga bcu pa/ yongs su 'dren pa'i yan lag rnam par bgros pa'i le'u/ 507nga gcig pa/ nges pa dam pa'i yan lag bgros pa'i le'u/ 509nga gnyis pa/ 'jug pa thabs kyi yan lag las thabs rnam par 'grel pa'i le'u/ 509nga gsum pa/ mdo rgya cher 'grel pa'i le'u/ 511nga bzhi pa/ chos thams cad kyi me long bstan pa'i le'u/ 512nga lnga pa/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gang gi mun pa'i spyod yul bstan pa'i le'u/ 523nga drug pa/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gang snang ba dag pa'i spyod yul bstan pa'i le'u/ 543nga bdun pa/ rnal 'byor rang bzhin gyi le'u/ 548nga brgyad pa/ de kho na nyid gsang ba'i dam pa ljon shing bskyed pa'i le'u/ 553nga dgu pa/ rnal 'byor rjes 'jug gi le'u/ 556drug cu pa/ rnal 'byor mig gi sgron ma bstan pa'i le'u/ 562re gcig pa/ rnal 'byor sa'i sgron ma bstan pa'i le'u/ 565re gnyis pa/ yul dam pa la 'jug pa'i le'u/ 5698

deb brgya dang gcig pa'i dkar chag 9re gsum pa/ nye bar mtshon pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 573re bzhi pa/ sgyu ma rol pas rnam par rol pas rnam par grol ba'i le'u/ 577re lnga pa/ rang 'byung bdud rtsi'i le'u/ 581re drug pa/ dam tshig gsang ba'i mchog gi le'u/ 586re bdun pa/ bsnyen bkur dam pa mchog gi le'u/ 598re brgyad pa/ chos thams cad kyi sgo rab tu dbye ba'i le'u/ 609re dgu pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 613bdun cu pa/ rnal 'byor dam pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 616don gcig pa/ rnal 'byor spyod 'jug gi le'u/ 618don gnyis pa/ the tshom yongs su gcod pa'i le'u/ 638don gsum pa/ rnal 'byor dbang sgyur gyi le'u/ 640don bzhi pa/ don nges par bsgrub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 651don lnga pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i le'u/ 653rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma bo rnyi dang / ring lugs chen po dā na rak+ṣi ta dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba che btsan skyes kyis bru sha'i yi ge las bru sha'i yul gyi khrom du bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(673) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(748)1120 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba/ gsang ba'i mdzod chen po mi zad pa gter gyi sgron ma/ brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 7gdang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 7ga9

10 bka' 'gyur/gnyis pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rim par phye ba'i sgo nas gleng bslang ba dang sngags kyi spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 755gsum pa/ sngags kyi mdo bstan pa'i le'u/ 769bzhi pa/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i le'u/ 771lnga pa/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi mdo bstan pa'i le'u/ 774drug pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba'i le'u/ 785bdun pa/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 789brgyad pa/ phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid bshad pa'i le'u/ 795dgu pa/ 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u/ 800bcu pa/ 'jigs byed rnams kyi phyag rgya bstan pa'i le'u/ 808bcu gcig pa/ bsnyen bsgrub rnam bzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 812bcu gnyis pa/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rnam grangs bshad pa'i le'u/ 817bcu gsum pa/ dam tshig rnam par bkod pa'i le'u/ 844bcu bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi le'u/ 852bcwa lnga pa/ las kyi rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 854bcu drug pa/ nan tur gyi las rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 860rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra be+e shwa mi tra dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba pa gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bcu bdun pa/ gsang ba phyi ma rnam par bkod pa'i le'u/ 865bsdur mchan/(898) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(936) ri:dkar chag gi zur ma na/ chos tshan (1119)pa dang (1120)gnyis kyi mtshan byang rgyas drag pas thod yig tu bsdus te bkod yod/10

khog /chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/hu)༄༅ga /rgya gar skad du/ sarba dharma ma hā sarnyi ②bo dhi tsit+ta (8)ku la ya rā dzāli / bod skad du/ chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bshad pa'i dus na/ 'og min gyi gnas chos nyid kyi mkha' dbyings nyid kyi klong sems nyid kyi gnas ye shes sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i gzhal yas khang na nyid kyi rang bzhin dang / nyid kyi ngo bo dang / nyid kyi thugs rje ye shes mngon du phyung ba'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi 'khor chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'i (5)'khor dang / nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sa zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku chu zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku me zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod 101 —3

4 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101 rdzogs pa'i sku rlung zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / gzhan yang thugs rje ye shes mngon du phyung ba'i sprul pa'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi sems can zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / gzugs kyi khams kyi sems can zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / gzugs med pa'i khams kyi sems can zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /gzhan yang nyid kyi rang bzhin la lta ba'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi 'di lta ste/ shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / yongs su rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang ske/ rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang / nyid kyi rang bzhin dang / nyid kyi ngo bo dang /nyid kyi thugs rje rang bzhin 'byed pa mi mnga' bas thabs cig 6)go/ /gzhan yang nyid kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la gnas pa'i 'khor dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis don mdzad pa'i 'khor dang / slad nas byon (0pa'i sangs rgyas nyid las 'byung ba'i 'khor dang / 'byed pa mi mnga' ba'i rang bzhin gyis thabs cig ①par bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des 'khor thams cad nyid kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab gi)pa'i phyir 'khor thams cad nyid kyi sems nyid kyi thugs la thim par mdzad do/ /rang 'byung gi ye shes gsal bar mdzad do/ /de nas thams cad chos nyid du ldan par bya ba'i phyir thams cad bsdus nas thig le chen po gcig tu (5)bzhugs so/ /de nas sems dpa' de nyid kyi rang bzhin thig le chen po gcig tu bzhugs pa de las byung nas/ byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po'i spyan sngar dga' ba'i sems kyis dang ba'i 101—4

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 5mdangs phyung ste 'khod pas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos sems dpa' rdo rje la smras pa/ sems dpa' rdo rje e ma ho/ /dga' ba'i sems skyes e ma ho / /dang ba'i mdangs phyung e ma ho/ /nga las byung ba e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/ kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyas po lags/ /ston pa nyid kyang thig le spros med dam/ /'khor rnams kun kyang thig le spros med dam/ /bstan pa kun kyang thig le spros med dam/ /dus dang gnas kyang thig le spros med dam/ /thams cad kun kyang thig le'i rang bzhin na/ /ston pa'i ston pas ci zhig ston par mdzad/ /'khor du 'khor ba'i don ni ci la 'khor/ /'khor la bstan 0)pa ci zhig ston par byed/ /dus dang gnas ni gcig pa ji lta bu zhes zhus so/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des sems dpa' rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po yid sgra la chug cig(gyi /ngas don sgrar bshad kyis(mi/ kye sems dpa' chen po/ sems nyid kun byed rgyal po nga ④nyid ni/ /chos rnams thams cad kun gyi snying po ste/ /snying po ma spros ye nas thig le yin/ /thig le ye nas spros pa med pa'i don/ /ston pa dang ni bstan pa 'khor dus gnas/ /nga las byung bas ye nas thig le ste/ /nga yi rang bzhin thig le bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las gleng gzhi'i (gele'u ste dang po'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad nyid las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba la gnas par mdzad do/ /de nas 'khor gyi 101—5

6 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101rang bzhin las sems dpa' rdo rje langs nas ston pa byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po'i 91)zhal du mdangs phyung ste 'khod nas/ zhus pa/ kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /khyod kyi 'khor du bdag 'dus 'khod pa stephyi/ /bdag ni 'tshal ba'i don ni ci zhig mchis/ /bdag 'tshal don ni khyod kyis bstan du gsol ri/ /zhes zhus so4)/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi rang bzhin dang / nyid kyi ngo bo dang / nyid kyi thugs rje las chos thams cad bkod pa ni nyid kyi rang 'byung gi ye shes chen po gcig las rang 'byung gi ye shes chen po lnga byung rdzu ba ni 'di lta ste/ zhe sdang rang 'byung 6)ye shes chen po dang / 'dod chags rang 'byung ye shes chen po dang / gti mug rang 'byung ye shes chen po dang / phrag dog rang 'byung ye shes chen po dang / nga rgyal rang 'byung ye shes chen po dang / rang 'byung gi ye shes lnga po des ⑦rgyan gyi rgyu 8chen po lnga ni phyung she/ 'jig cing brten 7pa'i khams chen po gsum ni bkod de/ rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus lnga gcig tu blangs pa 'di lta ste/ rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus sa zhes bya ba'i lus dang / rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus 11chu zhes bya ba'i lus dang /rgyan gyi 12rgyu'i lus me zhes bya ba'i lus dang / rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus rlung zhes bya ba'i lus dang / rgyan gyi rgyu'i lus nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i lus la gcig tu lus thams cad blangs/ ye shes lnga'i rigs so sor phye ste/ rang 'byung ye shes zhe sdang gi rigs dang / rang 'byung ye shes 'dod chags kyi rigs dang / rang 'byung ye shes gti mug gi rigs dang / rang 'byung ye shes phrag dog gi rigs dang / rang 'byung ye shes nga rgyal gyi rigs dang / rang 'byung ye shes lnga'i rigs lus rgyan gyi lus can gyi chos nyid bkod do/ /byang chub kyi sems kun 101—6

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 7byed rgyal po de nyid kyang nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi chos nyid bkod pa de bzhin du bzhugs so/ /de nas sems dpa' rdo rje de byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po'i spyan sngar yang 'dug nas/ kye ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /nyid kyi thugs gcig rang 'byung ye shes las/ /rang 'byung ye shes rnam pa lnga byung nas//de las rgyan gyi rgyu lnga byung nas ni/ /ye shes lnga yi 6)lus lnga blangs pa 'dis/ /kun byed rgyal po'i dgos pa ci zhig ②che/ /zhes zhus so/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des slar gsungs pa/ kye sems dpa' chen po dgos pa ni / /kun byed rgyal po byed mkhan nga las ni/ /ma gtogs pa yi byed mkhan gzhan na med/ /chos nyid byed pa yang ni nga las med/ /ston pa gsum yang 'god pa nga las med/ /'khor gyi tshogs yang ①'god pa nga las med/ /de bzhin chos nyid 'god pa nga las med/ /sems dpa' rdo rje khyod la nga yis ni/ /nga yi rang bzhin khyod la bstan par bya/ /nga la rang bzhin rnam pa gsum yod de / /nga yi rang bzhin byang chub sems yin no/ /byang ba dag gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /phun sum tshogs pa rnam gsum chos nyid byang ④/ /chub pa dag gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /dgos pa tshogs pa rnam pa gsum gyis ni/ /nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab par gnas/ /sems zhes (gebya ba'i rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /mi 'gag ma lus kun byed rgyal po ste/ /kun byas byang chub sems su ma lus byas/ /zhes (6)gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos nyid mngon du phyung nas bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi sngon rol 101—7

8 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101du byed pa po nga byung ba 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po yid rna ①dbang la zhugs cig② /rna sridabang sgra la rtogs shig /kye nga ni kun byed rgyal po ste/ /nga ni kun byed byang chub sems/ /nga med pa yi sngon rol na/ /chos rnams 'byung ba'i snying po med/ /nga med pa yi sngon rol na/ /chos kun byed pa'i rgyal po med/ /nga med pa yi sngon rol na/ /ston pa bya ba ye nas med/ /nga med pa yi sngon rol na/ /bstan pa bya ba ye nas med/ /nga med pa yi sngon rol na④/ /'khor zhes bya ba ye nas med/ /sems dpa' rdo rje rtog ma skyephyi/ /sems dpa' chen po khyod nyid kyang / /nga yi ngo bo sprul pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po la zhus pa/kye kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems/ /khyod ni ye nas chen po yin/ /ston pa dang ni bstan pa dang / /'khor la sogs pa'i chos rnams kun/ /byed mkhan khyod kyis byas pas na/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /byed mkhan khyod kyis byas par snang / /ston pa gcig gam rnam pa du ru yod/ /bstan pa gcig gam rnam pa du ru yod/ /'khor rnams gcig gam rnam pa du ru yod/ /ces zhus so/ /de nas byang chub kyi 6)sems kun byed rgyal pos slar gsungs pa/kye rang 'byung ye shes kun gyi ston par gcig /nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum snang ba la/ /ston pa'i grangs ni rnam pa gsum du byung / /nga ni de bzhin nyid du gcig pa las/ /chos rnams kun gyi chos nyid de bzhin nyid/ /nga nyid byang chub sems las gzhan med do/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /'khor la bstan pa rnam pa gsum du bstan/ /nga yi ngo bo gcig tu phyung nas ni/ /nga yi rang bzhin gcig (7)tu bstan pa'i phyir/ /kun byed nga yi 'khor du kun 101—8

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 9kyang gcig /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /'khor gyi bye brag rnam pa gsum du yod/ /ces gsungs so/ /sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/ kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /khyod las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum la①//khyod sar 'gro ba'i lam ni yod dam med/ /med na khyod kyis sa ru phyin mi phyin/ /yod na bgrod nas phyin nam ②ma bgrod phyin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum la/ /nga yi sa ru bgrod pa'i lam med de/ /nga yi rang byung ④ye shes bstan pa yin/ /sku gsum ston pa de yi 'khor rnams la/ /rnam par thar pa'i lam ni rnam lnga ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi lam du bstan/ /rang 'byung ye shes lnga yi lam lnga ni/ /'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal dang ni phrag dog rnam lnga ste/ /rang 'byung ye shes rnam lnga kun gyi lam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /rang 'byung ⑤yi shes lam lnga bstan pa de/ /rang 'byung zhes ni ji ltar byung ba lags/ /ye shes bya ba'i gtan (nyutshigs ci la gdags(7ske/ /lam zhes bgyi ba'i don ni gang la bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang / /phrag dog la sogs rnam pa lnga po de/ /lam lnga yin pa'i don ni bshad du gsol/ /zhes zhus so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ rang 'byung ye shes rnam pa lnga lam ni/ /rang 'byung rgyu rkyen med par byung ba yin/ /ye shes 'gag pa med par gsal ba yin/ /lam ni rgyu rkyen med pas bgrod mi dgos / /mi bgrod rang 'byung lnga la lam lngar bshad/ /'dod pa chos rnams bdag tu 'dod pa yin/ /chags pa bdag tu 'dod pa de la chags/ / zhe ba ( naraskye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /sdang ba cho 'phrul sna tshogs de la sdang / /gti 101—9

10 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101mug mi rtog pa yi ting hu)'dzin gyis/ /chos nyid mnyam ②pa nyid la dbye bsal ①med / /nga ni ma nor ba yi byang chub sems/ /de bzhin nyid du ye nas rgyal bar byed/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid du gcig pa la④/ /yin min ༅sgro skur 'debs la 4)phrag dog byed/ /bgrod du med pa'i lam lnga bstan pa yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /rang 'byung ye shes lam lnga 'di las byung / /'dod pa'i khams kyang rang 'byung ye shes yin/ /gzugs kyi khams kyang rang 'byung ye shes yin/ /gzugs med khams kyang rang 'byung ye shes yin/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yis byas pa'i phyir/ /ngas byas thams cad ye shes ngo bor bshad/ /khams gsum sems can rgyud ⑦ drug thams cad kun/ /rang 'byung ye shes min ⑧par ngas ma bshad/ /de las ma gtogs 9pa yi byang chub sems/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mes po ngas ma bshad / /kun byed rgyal po nga yi rang bzhin la/ /chos nyid rnam pa gsum du bstan pa ste/ /ma skyes pa yi chos nyid dngos mi snang / /de ni gzugs med khams su bstan pa yin/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul gzugs su snang ba ni/ /de ni gzugs kyi khams su bstan pa yin/ /thugs rje ye shes ngo bo mngon 'ophyung nas/ /bde sdug las de thugs rjes zad bya'i phyir/ /'dod pa'i khams ni thugs rjes phyung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos thams cad kun byed rgyal pos byas pa las ji ltar byung ba'i khungs bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi rang bzhin mtshan gyi 101—10

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 11chos bshad pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khyod nyon cig /nga ni ye nas rang 'byung ye shes te①/ /nga ni ye nas chos kun snying po yin/ /nga ni kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems/ /nga yi ②mtshan 'di sems dpa' rtogs par gyis/ /nga yi mtshan 'di sems dpas rtogs 'gyur na/ /chos rnams thams cad ma lus rtogs 'gyur gyisal/ /nga zhes bya ba'i snying po ste/ /chos rnams kun gyi snying po yin/ /rang 'byung zhes ④ni bya ba ni/ /rgyu rkyen med pa'i snying po pas/ /rtsol sgrub kun las 'das pa yin/ /ye shes zhes ni bya ba ni / /'gag pa med cing ma bsgribs ①pas/ /chos kun ma lus ston par byed/ /nga ni byang chub sems la bya/ /ye nas bya ba'i don 'di ni/ /thog ma nyid nas gnas pa'i don/ /chos kun zhes ni bya ba ni/ /ston pa kun kyang chos nyid la/ /bstan pa kun kyang chos nyid yin/ /'khor gnas dus kyang chos nyid de/ /chos nyid ma yin gcig khyikyang med/ /snying po bya ba'i don 'di ni/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po ste/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las/ /ston pa gsum 9)yang de las byung / /bstan pa gsum yang de las byung / /'khor gnas dus kyang de las byung / /thams cad 'byung ba'i snying por bshad/ /nga ni snying po sems nyid kyis/ /chos rnams ma lus kun byed de/ /kun zhes bya ba'i chos rnams kun/ /chos kun gang dang gang zhe na/ /ston pa dang ni bstan (shepa dang / /'khor gnas dus ni thams cad kun/ /byed ces bya ba mkhan po ste / /ston pa dang ni bstan pa dang / /'khor gnas dus ni kun byed pas/ /rang 'byung ye shes mkhan po yin/ /rgyal po zhes ni bya ba ni/ /snying po rang 'byung ye shes de/ /byed pa'i mkhan po kun las rgyal/ /chos rnams byed 101—11

1 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101mkhan kun las rgyal/ /byang ba'i don ni 'di lta ste/ /snying po byang chub sems de ni/ /rang 'byung ye nas rnam dag pas/ /kun byed rgyal pos byas pa kun/ /kun bzang nyid du rnam dag pas/ /byang zhes bya bar bshad pa yin/ /chub ces bya ba 'di lta ste/ /snying po rang 'byung ye shes des/ /snang ba dang ni srid pa dang / /snod dang bcud kyis bsdus pa dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /khams gsum rgyud drug sems can dang / /de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ /kun la chub ste khyab par gnas/ /des na chub ces bya bar bshad / /sems kyi don ni 'di lta ste/ /snying po rang 'byung ye shes des/ /snang srid snod ①bcud thams cad la/ /'jug cing dbang sgyur gsal bar gcod / /des na sems zhes bya bar bshad/ /rgyu rkyen med pa'i snying po des/ /kun la dbang sgyur thams cad byed/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga yi rang bzhin rtogs gyur na/ /ston pa kun kyang rtogs 'gyur la/ /bstan pa kun kyang rtogs par 'gyur/ /'khor gyi bsam pa rig 'gyur tshul/ /dus gnas kun kyang gcig 'gyur rig /chos rnams thams cad nga yin pas/ /nga yi rang bzhin 'di rig na/ /chos rnams thams cad rig 'gyur bas/ /bya byed rtsol sgrub kun las 'das/ /mi rtsol lhun gyis grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las nga ③nyid kyi mtshan bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos sems dpa' rdo rje la nyid kyi ④rang bzhin bstan pa'i mdo 'dus pa'i don 'di bstan to/ /kye (5)sems dpa' 101—12

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 13chen po nyon cig /nga yi rang bzhin 'di lta ste/ /yod ni gcig las med pa ste / /bstan ni rnam pa gnyis su bstan/ /byung ni theg pa dgu ru byung / /'dus ni rdzogs pa chen por 'dus/ /yin ni byang chub sems yin te/ /gnas ni chos nyid dbyings la gnas/ /gsal ni rig ①pa mkha' la gsal/ /khyab ni snod bcud kun la khyab/ /byung ni snang srid kun du byung / /bstan du mtshan ma'i dngos po med/ /mthong du dmigs pa'i yul dang bral/ /shes su tshig tu brjod du med/ /rgyu las ma byung snying ①po 'di/ /sgros kyis chabatags pa kun dang bral/ /don 'di nges par rtogs 'dod na/ /dpe ni nam mkha' lta bur brtag /don ni chos nyid skye ba med/ /rtags ni sems nyid 'gag pa med / /nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid la/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon/ /dmigs su med pa'i chos nyid la/ /dmigs su med par mtshon te bstan/ /tshig tu brjod ④du med pa la/ /brjod du med pa'i tshig brjod de/ /dmigs med don gyi ngo bor bstan/ /bsdus te bstan pa'i don 'di ni/ /don gyi ngo bo 'grel pa ste/ /'di yis nga don rtogs par gyis/ /'di yis nga don rtogs par byed/ /'di yis nga don ma rtogs na/ /don gyi sgra tshig ci bstan kyang / /nga dang phrad par mi 'gyur te/ /nga las gol la nga bsgribs pas/ /chos kyi snying po mthong mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las don gyi 'grel pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad nyid kyi rang bzhin la rdzogs pa chen po (9de bstan pa'i tshig gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' 101—13

14 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101 rdo rje tshig ①'di nyon/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni/ /nga yi chos rnams dang por bkod/ /nga yi chos rnams mngon ②du phyung ②/ /nga yi ngo bo khyod la bstan//nga yi rang bzhin bstan ④nas ni/ /tshig dang sgras kyang don mtshon nas/ /ngo bo bstan pas khyod kyis mthong / /rang bzhin bstan pas a de rig /tshig tu brjod pas don (5)sgrar thos/ /zhes ⑥gsungs nas cang mi gsung bar chos thams cad kyi ngo bor bzhugs so/ /sems dpa' rdo rje 'khor gyi nang nas langs nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po'i zhal du ⑦mdangs phyung ste 'khod pas kun (8)byed rgyal pos/ kye sems dpa' chen po khyod nga la mdangs kyis 'khod pa de khyod kyis don ci 'dod pa gsol cigayo) /ces gsungs so/ /de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/ kye 0ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags / /chos rnams thams cad khyod kyi rang bzhin na/ /khyod kyi (1ston pa bstan pa 'khor bkod ci zhig lags/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dgos pa ci zhig lags / /zhes zhus so/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cigatso /chos rnams phun sum tshogs par bkod pa ni/ /nga nyid phun sum (nyetshogs pa'i rang bzhin te/ /nga yi rang bzhin khyod la bstan par bya/ /nga yi rang bzhin spros bral mi phyed pas / /chos dbyings gnas 'di nga yis byas pa yin/ /byang chub nyid las de na gzhan mi bzhugs/ /nga yi rang bzhin ma bsgribs 7kun khyab pas/ /gsal ba'i nam mkha' ye shes gzhal yas khang / /rang 'byung ye shes nyid las gzhan mi bzhugs/ /nga pani thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po bas/ /chen po lnga dang khams gsum rgyud drug rnams/ /nga yi sku gsung thugs las gzhan med pas/ /101—14

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 15nga yi rang bzhin nga yis bkod pa yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas khams gsum sems can yang / /nga yi rang bzhin khyed la bstan pa yin/ /nga yi rang bzhin ma skyes spros 6)bral phyir/ /mi gnas spyod yul kun ②las 'das pa yin/ /mi snang ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i yul las 'das/ /nga yi rang bzhin khyed la mi snang yang —/ /nga yi ngo bo khyod la snang byas pas/ /khams gsum chen po lnga dang rgyud drug rnams/ /snang ba'i rang bzhin byang chub sems lnga las/ /rang 'byung snying po ye shes lnga byung ①bas/ /ye ④zhes lnga yi yul lnga gsal byung bas/ /'dod pa lnga byung chags pa lnga byung nas/ /chags lnga so sor smin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /'gro ba drug gi khyad par so sor snang / /'di ltar snang ba nga yis khyed la bstan pa yin / /sku gsum theg pa rnam pa drug bstan pa/ /nga yis bstan na khyed kyis ma mthong ste/ / de re nga yi rang bzhin re re la/ /(gede re nga yi ngo bo re re ste/ /sku re dang ni gsung re thugs re dang / /kun gyis mthong ba'i ngo bo re re'o /de yang nga yi rang bzhin bstan pa yin/ /yang dag kun gyi ngo bo byang chub ngas(6)ske/ /spros med dbyings kyi ngo bo nga yin la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas chen nga yin pas/ /rol pa khams gsum rgyud drug nga las shar/ /bde dang sdug bsngal las kyi khyad par te/ /yang dag ma nor nga yi thugs rje bstan/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa can rnams la/ /kun byed nga yi lung 'di bstan mi bya/ /nga yi lung 'di nges par bstan byas na/ /dge sdig las la rgyu 'bras yod zer nasal/ /yang dag nga la sgro dang skur btab (7)pas/ /yang dag nga dang yun du phrad mi 'gyur/ /nga ni ston pa kun byed byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems ni kun byed rgyal po ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas byang chub sems kyis byas/ /101—15

16 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101khams gsum sems can byang chub sems kyis byas/ /snang srid snod bcud byang chub sems kyis byas/ /rgyu 'bras dpe don gtan ⑦tshigs mthun ②par byas/ /rgyu yi dus na 'byung chen lnga byas la/ /'bras bu'i dus na khams gsum sems can byas/ /dpe yi dus na kun dpe nam mkha' byedadu/ /don gyi dus na kun don skye med byed/ /rtags kyi dus na kun byed byang chub sems/ /gtan tshigs dus na rang 'byung ye shes ston/ /rgyu 'bras dpe don gtan tshigs mthun ①par byas / /byang chub sems kyis kun byas gcig ma byas/ /kun byas byang chub nyid kyi rang bzhin byas/ /gcig (nyam byas pa nyid la bya mi dgos/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin ma brtags ⑥par/ /nga yis ⑨byas pa'i chos la nges (kyebartags pas / /brkam zhing chags pa'i dbang gis snang ba 'grub/ /mi rtag sgyu yo)ma'i rang bzhin 'jig par 'gyur/ /cha med dmu 7long lta bu'i rang bzhin no/ /kun byed rgyal pos byas par mi cha bar/ /dbang po drug la yul drug snang ba la/ /sdug bsngal mthong nas dbang po 'gegs par byed/ /des ni kun byed byas pa mi cha bas/ /skye 'gag med pa'i 'bras bu de la med/ /nges pa gcig yil bden pa gnyis byung nas/ /kun byed nga yis byas pa'i chos nyid la/ /don dam kun rdzob bden pa gnyis byung bas/ /bden pa gnyis kyi rgyu 'bras yong (stemi mnga'/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i 'bras bu de la med/ /med par tshol ba dag pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /mi 'byung cho 'phrul yan lag bsgom (nyamanga' bas/ /blang dor 7med pa'i 'bras bu thob pa med/ /don gcig ting 'dzin rnam gsum sgom 7byed pas/ /bsnyen sgrub 7rnam bzhi yi rim par sgom (nyabyed pas/ /rtsol (7sgrub 'das pa'i 'bras bu de la med/ /lhun gyis grub pas bya byed kun dang bral//101—16

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 17skye med mtshon med gdags ①med de brjod ②pas/ /sgros ①skur bral ba'i brjod med de rig byed/ /chos kun byang chub sems yin ④de dpe ni/ /kun dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin du/ /byang chub sems kyi don yang de bzhin no/ /nam mkha' rlung chu sa me snang ba lnga/ /byang chub sems las rmad byung mngon sangs rgyas/ /srid gsum lam lnga 'gro drug snang ba yang / /rnam smin dulas kyis mi bskyod ⑥mngon sangs rgyas/ /khams gsum ye nas byang chub sku gsung sgyuthugs / /de bas snang srid snod bcud thams cad kun/ /nam mkha'i ngang na mi gnas med pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems kyi klong chen yul che bas/ /sangs rgyas sems can snod bcud kun kyang gnas/ /thams cad rnam 6)par dag pa'i chos nyid la/ /gnyis su med de sgro skur ⑧kun dang bral/ /gang gis ⑨med pa'i snying po sems ma mthong / /bskal pa du mar don dang phrad mi 'gyur/ /chos kun rtsa ⑩ba byang chub sems su gcig /sangs rgyas sems can snang srid snod bcud kun/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i byang chub snying po la/ /gcig 7tu med las bgrangs na brjod mi lang / /sangs rgyas sku gsung sems can lus ngag 7kyang / /byang chub sems yin ye nas gzung 'dzin bral/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba gang gis grub pa de/ /des ni kun grub chos kyi rtsa ba grub/ /byang chub sems kyi mdo rtsa gcig pu la/ /sems shing nyunyertog la dga' bas rnam par bgrangasayi / /gnyis dang grangs la dga' la ling yis bstan/ /ji bzhin rang bzhin chos nyid sems gcig la/ /sems la rang bzhin rnam pa gsum sasnang bas / /rang bzhin gsum ni bkod pa'i mchog gsum ste/ /de ni phun sum tshogs pa'i chos nyid do/ /gnyis med gcig gi rang bzhin kun 'brel bas/ /101—17

18 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101rnal ma gcig la 'byor pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi yi ①yul du bstan / /sems nyid gcig la che ba lngar bstan pa/ /sems kyi rang bzhin yon tan ②lnga ldan pas/ /rang bzhin lnga la che lngar ming du btagasal/ /nges pa gcig la yin min sgros byung bas/ /gol sgrib the tshom ④rtog pa bsam yas ni/ /kun byed rtsol sgrub rtog 'das sel bar byed/ /yod med sgro (9skur the tshom bsal (6)ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin nyid kyi byang chub mi rtog pas/ /ma nor nges pa'i lung de gtan stil 'bebs/ /de nyid yid ches mngon du bstan pa'i phyir/ /la dor yid ches pa yi lung bcu yis/ /rtsol sgrub bya med don bstan de yid ches / /med par bden pa'i tshig dgu smras pa ni/ /snying po gcig la mthong ba'i yul dgu byung / /rang res mthong ba'i bden pa'i tshig dgu smras/ /kun byed nga la thams cad rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems kyi don 'di che bar gyis / /chos kun rtsa ba kun byed byang chub sems/ /ji ltar snang ba nga yi ngo bo yin / /ji ltar byung ba nga yi cho 'phrul yin/ /sgra tshig ji ltar byung ba thams cad kun/ /nga yi don nyid tshig sgrar phyung (nyab yin/ /sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes yon tan dang / /sems can lus dang bag chags la sogs pa/ /snang srid snod 9bcud bsdus pa thams cad kun/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ye nas yin / /sems las ma gtogs 7pa yi chos rnams ni/ /nga las byung ba'i sangs rgyas sngar 1lha'adas la/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yis lung ma bstan/ /da ltar bzhugs dang slad kyis byon 12pa la/ /kun byed rgyal po byang chub lung mi ston/— /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rtsa ba gcig pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //101 —18

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 19de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos nyid kyis byas pa las byung ba'i chos rnam par dbye ba 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ sems ni ji bzhin pa yi ngo bo ste/ /ji bzhin gnyis med bde ba chen po la/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa yongs kyis med/ /spros bral nam mkha' bzhin du ye gnas la//dmigs pa'i yul 'das gcig ces bgrang du med/ /byang chub sems la bgrang zhing mtshon med na/ /sems kyis byas pa'i chos la rnam grangs byung / /sems kyis byas pa gang dang 6)gang zhe na/ /snang srid snod bcud sangs rgyas sems can rnams/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ngo bo de las byas/ /byas nas mngon du phyung (geste bstan pa ni/ /chen po lnga dang rigs (7drug snang ba dang / /de yi don mdzad gzugs sku rnam gnyis ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dag tu phyung nas bgrangs / /zhes (gebaka' stsal to/ /de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/ kye kun byed rgyal po e ma ho/ /kun du bzang po e ma ho/ /byang chub sems khyod e ma ho/ /dang por byang chub sems langs nas/ /rang dang chos rnams ma 5shes nas/ /kun mkhyen khyed (7kyi 'khor du 'dus/ /zhu ba'i dmigs ni mi cha bas / /kun mkhyen khyod kyis (7)bka' stsal pa/ /chos rnams gcig tu 'dus par ni/ /byang chub sems mdo bka' stsal na/ /gcig la gnyis su bstan pa yi / /rnam grangs don 'di ji ltar lags/ /zhes zhus so/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ kye (ming ni ye nas lhun gyis grub/ /nga ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i snying po yin/ /nga ni thugs rje'i ngo bo ste/ /gang la dga' ba'i dus su ni/ /smyogang dga' ba yi 'i101—19

0 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101don bya'i phyir/ /nga yis ①byas pa'i don bstan gyis/ /sems dpa' rdo rje khyod nyon cig /gcig la dga' ba de la ni/ /chos rnams phyigacig tu 'dus pa'i phyir / /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ste / /sems kyi ngo bo kun byed bstan/ /mtshan ma grangs la dga' ④ba la/ /kun byed rgyal pos byas pa yi/ /sna tshogs brjod kyis ⑤mi lang bstan/ /de stiyang nga yi rang bzhin bstan/ /gcig ni nga nyid snying po ste/ /gnyis byung nga yis byas pa ste/ /byas pa'i chos la bgrangs pa yin / /grangs kyi don ni ⑦gcig dang gnyis/ /grangs kyi mtha' ni brjod du med / /brjod med chos ⑤kyi snying po yin/ /brjod med snying po gcig tu bstan / /gcig ni kun byed byang chub sems/ /byas pa'i chos ni rnam pa gnyis / /rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam gnyis las/ /don dam kun rdzob rnam gnyis kyis / /dpe don rtags dang gtan 6)tshigs su/ /nges lung drang lung gnyis su bshad / /rgyu ni 'byung chen rnam lnga la/ /'bras bu khams gsum sems can yin / /khams gsum sems can rgyu 7byas nas/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas ming btags te/ /rgyu 'bras dpe don de ru bstan/ /rgyu ni khams gsum sems can la/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas lung bstan 7pa/ /de ni drang ba'i lung du bshad / /rnam pa gnyis su dbye bar bya/ /rgyu ni 'byung chen rnam dhilnga yin/ /byas pa'i chos ni thams cad kun/ /sems nyid mngon du phyung ba yin/ /de bzhin nyid du ma gtogs 6)par/ /ma rig log rtog gzung ⑨'dzin gyis/ /yul drug chos la bonges brtags pas/ /'jig pa drug dang brten pa drug /'jig rten zhes su bshad pa yin/ /yul drug chags pa drug brten nas/ /chags drug sdug bsngal ya nga la/ /mya ngan mya ngan zhes su bshad/ /mya ngan mya 101—20

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 1ngan 'das zhes ①pa/ /yul drug chos la mi rtog pas/ /skye drug gnas su mi skye ste / /sdug bsngal drug las 'das pa'i phyir②/ /mya ngan 'das zhes ③de la bya/ /ji bzhin snying po byang chub las/ /ma btsal rang bzhin shar ba yi/ /'byung ba chen po lnga po yang / /rang gi mtshan nyid rang 'dzin la/ /thams cad snying po byang chub kyang / /dmigs su med pa'i ngo bo 'dzin/ /mtshan nyid mtshan nyid zhes ④su bshad/ /rang bzhin shar ba'i chen po lngas/ /chos kun bskyed ⑤pa'i snying po yin⑥/ /de yis bskyed ⑦pa'i sems can rnams/ /rang 'byung yin par mi rtog par/ /spyod pa'i lam de rgyur bltas dunas/ /rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung 'dod pas/ /rgyu zhes ming du btags yo)pa yin/ /'bras bu gang thob theg par bshad/ /spong 'gegs sbyong ba rnams su bstan/ /'bras bu zhes su btags ⑩pa ni/ /snying po rgyu las 'bras bur bshad/ /snying po'i rang bzhin de la ni/ /skye 'jig med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /rdo rje zhes su bshad pa yin/ /rdo rje de sgrub phyi pa gnyis/ /sku dang gsung thugs ye shes ni/ /blang dor byas pa'i sgo nas ni/ /chu zla bzhin du grub ⑩par 'dod/ /blang dor 7med pa'i nang pa ni / /rim pa gsum dang snying po yis/ /bdag nyid dbyings dang ye shes lta(nye/ /gang la'ang mi brten bya med 'di/ /kun gyi snying por gyur pas na/ /bya ba med pa'i phrin las 'das/ /bya med bde ba spong byed pa/ /mi rtsol tsobade ba'i lung bstan bkod/ /bskal pa gsum dang mi tshe bdun/ /zla drug lo gcig zla bcu drug /rtsol bar byed pa'i theg pa can/ /bya med ngo bo 'di bstan pas/ /mi rtsol lhun grub bde la 8gnas/ /'di la ma rdzogs gang yang med/ /gcig rdzogs gnyis rdzogs kun rdzogs pasatshu/ /bya ba phun sum tshogs par bde/ /101—21

bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 7) 101gcig rdzogs byang chub sems su rdzogs/ /gnyis rdzogs sems kyis byas par rdzogasal/ /kun rdzogs phun sum tshogs par rdzogs/ /gcig la rdzogs pa'i lung 'di yis/ /zhirasangs rgyas dgongs pa 'di chal gnas/ / kun rdzogs ①pa yi don 'di yis/ /thams cad phun sum tshogs par byed/ /bya med 'di la gang gnas pa/ /lus 'di gang zag lha mi yang / /dgongs pa chos nyid sangs rgyas yin / /'di yis sems can don byas na/ /rtsol ④sgrub mi byed bde bar 'gyur / /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rnam grangs bsdus pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos byas pa'i chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du gcig pa las de bzhin nyid la rang bzhin gsum snang bar 'gyur ba de so sor snang ba 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga yi de bzhin nyid gcig ni/ /phun sum tshogs pa gsum du snang / /de bzhin ma skyes rang bzhin ni/ /de bzhin nyid de yul du snang / /yul de kun gyi de bzhin nyid / /de la kun kyang brtags ( byas nas/ /de bzhin nyid la lta byed pa/ /ma bsgribs tshonerang 'byung ye shes ni/ /rgyu 'bras ston pa sku gsum snang / /la la rgyu yi ston par snang / /la la 'brel (7ba'i ston par snang / /la la 'bras bu'i ston par snang / /thugs rje mngon du phyung ba yi/ /rang 'byung ye shes rnam lnga las / /byung ba'i sangs rgyas sems can rnams/ /bstan pa'i yul dang (nya'akhor du snang / /de lta bu 9yi 'khor tshogs la/ /rgyu 'bras ston pa sku gsum gyis / /de bzhin nyid kyi yul gcig la7/ /'khor gyi lta ba so so bas la la 101—22

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 3spong 'gegs ①yul du bstan/ /la lar ②sbyong zhing bgrod par bstan/ /la lar byin rlabs sridag par bstan④/ /la lar blang dor gyis grub bstan/ /la lar rang rgyud dag pa ste/ /btsal zhing bsgrub ⑤tu yod par bstan/ /de ltar ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /rgyu dang 'bras la dgongs nas bstan/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam gnyis kyang / /de bzhin nyid las g.yos pa med/ /kun byed nga yis yilung bstan to/ /de bzhin nyid ni 'di lta ④ste/ /kun byed nga yang de bzhin nyid/ /ngas byas kun kyang de bzhin nyid/ /yul drug nga yis byas pa yin / /dbang drug nga yi rig pa yin/ /rnam par shes pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /nga yi rang 'byung ⑧yi shes yin/ /'byung chen lnga yang rgyu lnga ste/ /kun gyi rgyu lnga de bzhin nyid/ /thugs rje rang 'byung ye shes lnga/ /khams gsum 0rgyud drug phyung ba yang / /de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bor bshad/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin te⑩ / /ngo bo gnyis su med pa ste/ /rang bzhin gcig tu gnas pa la/ /rnal 'byor bzhag pa bzhi phyung ba/ /rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi las byung / /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cigatunya /kun gyi snying po byang chub sems 'di ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rnal ma'i ngo bo ste/ /ji bzhin de bzhin nyid du ye nas gnas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor yongs su rnal 'byor dang / /rnal 'byor chen po sems dpa'i rnal 'byor bzhis/ /snying po don gyi rnal ma bya med la/ /bltas pas mthong ba'i yul ni rnam pa bzhi/ /sems dpa'i 7rnal 'byor yul dang dbang por mthong / /byang chub lnga dang cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhis/ /byin gyis brlabs tshonanas sems dpa'i lha gnyis lta/ /snying po don gyi rnal ma mthong ba med/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid du sems dpa' zhog /don gyi snying po rnal skem bya med la//101—23

4 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101rnal 'byor chen po rnams kyis mthong ba ni/ /ye nas rang rgyud dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rgyu las 'bras bu lha yi 6)dkyil 'khor te②/ /bsnyen bsgrub bzhi yi ①yan lag rdzogs byas nas/ /'phro ④'du bdag nyid lhun gyis grub par lta8//don gyi snying po rnal ma mthong ba med/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid du chen po zhog /don gyi snying po rnal ma bya med la/ /yongs su rnal 'byor rnams kyis mthong ba ni / /dbyings ni snying po rnal ma'i rgyur mthong la/ /ye shes chen po rnal ma'i 'bras bur mthong / /snying po gcig la rgyu 'bras gnyis mthong bas rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i rnal ma mthong ba med/ /ma bcos de bzhin yongs su rnal 'byor zhog /don gyi snying po rnal ma bya med la/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rdzogs chen lta mthong ba/ /byang chub sems ni kun gyi snying por mthong / /de nyid ma bcos don gyi rnal mar 6)mthong / /lta ba ye nas bsgom du med par gzhag⑦ /dam tshig ye nas bsrung du med par gzhag /phrin (kyilas ye nas btsal du med par gzhag(9) /bzhag pas de bzhin nyid la rnal du 'byor/ /rnal 'byor rnam bzhi lta ba'i bye brag ni/ /yul gcig re re la yang bzhir dbye ba/ /sems dpa'i rnal 'byor bye brag bzhir dbye ba/ /yul dang dbang po rnam par mi rtog sems / /des na sems dpa'i rnal 'byor nyid du bshad/ /byang chub byin rlabs kyicho 'phrul 'byin pa ni/ /de ni rnal 'byor chen po zhes su bshad/ /phyag rgya 11chen po bzhi dang ldan pa ni/ /yongs su rnal 'byor zhes su bshad pa yin / /ye shes dam tshig rang bzhin med lta ba/ /shin tu rnal 'byor dgongs par sems dpa' bzhed/ /blang dor med pa'i rnal 'byor de ma mthong / /rnal 'byor chen po bye brag bzhir dbye ba/ /dang por ting 'dzin rnam gsum 101—24

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 5sems pa ①ni/ /sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /rang rgyud dag pas ye shes lta ②byed pa/ /rnal 'byor chen po zhes su bshad pa yin/ /bsnyen sgrub ①rnam bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ /yongs su rnal 'byor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /thams cad bdag nyid chen por lta dub ni/ /shin tu rnal 'byor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /rtsol sgrub 'das pa'i rnal ma mthong ba min/ /yongs su rnal 'byor bye brag bzhir lta dub/ /ting 'dzin rim pas bdag skur mi ⑥bskyed par/ /chos nyid rang rgyud dag par sems pa'i ⑦phyir/ /sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /yab yum thabs dang shes rab mi ltos par/ /snying po tsam ④gyis dkyil 'khor rtogs yo)pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i dgongs par bshad pa yin/ /snang ba rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid du / /spyod pas yongs su rnal 'byor nyid du bshad/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /rgyu dbyings 'bras bu ye shes lta ba'i phyir/ /shin tu rnal 'byor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i rnal ma mthong ba min / /shin tu rnal 'byor bye brag rnam bzhi ni/ /blang dor 7med pa'i byang chub sems de ni/ /sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /rtsol sgrub (nye'adas pa'i byang chub sems de ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po zhes su bshad pa yin / /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i byang chub sems de ni/ /yongs su rnal 'byor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /yin min sgro dang skur pa 'das pa'i phyir/ /shin tu rnal 'byor zhes su nga yis bshad/ /yongs su rnal 'byor la sogs gsum po la(nya / /rang 'byung ye shes che dang mi ldan pas/ /lam la bgrod cing sa la sbyong /rtebar byed/ /dam tshig tshul bsrung ④lta ba sgom byed pas/ /gom 8pa drag dal lta 101—25

6 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101spyod yod ma yin/ /de bas shin tu rnal 'byor lta spyod ni/ /ye nas kun byed nyid kyis byas pa'i phyir/ /lam la mi bgrod sa la spyod ①mi byed/ /dam tshig mi srung ②lta ba sgom mi byed/ /byang chub chen po'i lam nas kun 'byung phyir/ /byang chub nyid la byang chub nyid mi bgrod/ /bgrod sa byang chub nyid las med pa'i phyir/ —/byang chub nyid la byang chub nyid mi spyod①/ /dam tshig rang bzhin byang chub nyid yin pas/ /byang chub nyid la byang chub nyid mi srung ④/ /bsgom ⑤pa'i rang bzhin byang chub nyid yin pas/ /byang chub nyid kyis nyid la bsgom ⑥du med/ /lta ba'i yul ni byang chub nyid yin pas/ /byang chub nyid kyis nyid la bltar med phyir/ /shin tu rnal 'byor lta 9)spyod bya med 'di(nya/ /rang 'byung ye shes gom 6)pa drag dal can/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yi gom kyipa yin / /rgyu 'bras theg pa can gyi spyod yul min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos nyid kyi rang bzhin las chos nyid kyi yul kun la bkod pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po (1des rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa bgrod (gelam nor bas rdzogs pa chen po las gol 6nyes dang sgrib par gyur pa 'di gsungs so / /kye sems dpa' chen po/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin 'di nyid ni/ /chos kun ma lus pa yi snying po ste/ /ma skyes rnam par dag pas sgrib pa med/ /bgrod pa'i lam dang bral bas gol sa med/ /ye nas lhun gyis grub pas btsal 7du med/ /chos kun snying po byang chub sems su gcig /gcig la rnam par bgrangs pas gol sasgrib byung / /bgrod du med la bgrod pas gol sa byung / /101—26

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 7dmigs med bltas ①pas ma mthong sgrib pa byung / /de bzhin nyid du thams cad gcig pa la/ /rgyu spyad 'bras bu phyi mar 'dod pa ni/ /pha rol phyin bcu sa bcu thob 'dod pa/ /bskal ②pa gsum gyi bar du gol (minas bsgribs④/ /phyi nang rtog ⑤pa dag pa rnam gsum gyis/ /byang chub lnga dang cho 'phrul yan lag giXske/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin dag na yang / /mi tshe bdun gyi bar du gol zhing bsgribs④/ /rgyu la spyod cing 'bras bu lta ba ni/ /lta spyod so so gnyis su bltas pa yisani/ /gnyis su med la mi tshe gsum bsgribs gol/ /snying 0po gcig la blang ⑩dor byed pa de/ /gcig tu ma mthong gnyis su mthong bas na/ /blang dor ma bral bar du grol zhing bsgribs/ /rang 'byung gcig la yin pa gsum bsgoms pas/ /rtsol bral lung las gol zhes lung ston cig /ji ltar snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams la/ /snying po de bzhin nyid du ma rtogs par/ /dbyings dang ye shes rgyu 'bras bltas pa'i tunyephyir/ /rgyu yi sgros tsodang 'bras bu'i skur yin pas/ /sgro skur gnyis bral yid ches bar du sgribatunye/ /med pa'i 'bras bu 'dod pa rnam drug ni/ /rgyu la bden pa gnyis kyis thob byed dang / /dag gsum spyad pas 'bras bu thob byed dang / /lta spyod yiso sos thob par 'dod pa dang / /blang dor spyad pas thob par 'dod pa dang / /rig pa gsum bsgoms thob par 'dod pa dang / /rgyu 'bras dbyings nyid ye shes bltas pa yis/ /thob par 'dod pa'i nges thob rnam pa drug /gol sa drug dang sgrib pa drug drug ste / /byang chub sems las 'gol sgrib skyon yin pas/ /nges thob drug gi skyon yon gsal yibar gsung / / rtog dpyod lto gnyis kyang gol sa sgrib pa la/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyang gol sa sgrib par bshad/ /lta spyod gnyis kyang gol sa 101—27

8 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101 sgrib par bshad/ /lta spyod blang dor rtsol phyisgrub rgyu 'bras 'das②/ /mi rtsol bde ba che la kun gol bsgribs③/ /byang chub sems ni nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /nam mkha' lta bu sems nyid chos nyid la/ /lta bas bsgom rtsimed dam tshig bsrung dudu med / /phrin las btsal med ye shes sgrib pa med/ /sa la sbyang ⑥med bgrod pa'i lam yang med/ /phra ba chos med gnyis med 'brel pa med/ /sems las nges ( )lung gtan (nyal 'bebs pa med/ /sgro skur 'das pas man ngag la bzlar yo)med / /rdzogs chen byang chub sems kyi lta ba'o/ /ltar med gcig la sgom byed drug byung tshubs/ /la gol la bsgribs ()lta ba'i gol sgrib 'byung / /bsrung med gcig tshul sdom pa drug bsrungs pas/ /la gol la bsgribs tsodam tshig gol sgrib byung ske/ /btsal med gcig la phrin kyilas drug rtsol ⑩bas/ /la gol la bsgribs ⑩phrin las gol sgrib byung / /bsgribs med gcig la ye shes drug byung bas/ /la gol la bsgribs tho)ye shes gol sgrib byung / /sbyangs med gcig la sbyangs tu)thob drug byung bas/ /la gol la bsgribs kyis yi gol sgrib byung / /bgrod med gcig 2stol lam bgrod drug byung bas/ /la gol la bsgribs (nyalam gyi gol sgrib byung / /gzung med gcig la 'dzin byed drug byung bas/ /la gol la bsgribs ( stechos kyi 8lhagol sgrib byung / /gnyis med gcig la 'brel pa drug byung bas/ /la gol la bsgribs (ste'abrel pa'i gol sgrib byung / /bden pa gcig la nges pa drug byung bas/ /la gol la bsgribs 69lung gi gol sgrib so byung / /brjod med gcig ( shel rjod ( 7byed drug byung bas/ /la gol la bsgribs 6 )man ngag gol sgrib byung / /kun gyi snying po byang chub sems 'di ni/ /ye nas rang gi rang bzhin lhun grub pas / /rang bzhin bcu yis btsal stezhing bsgrub ce)mi dgos/ /nga yi rang 101—28

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 9bzhin kun dpe nam mkha' 'dra/ /nam mkha' dag la kun kyang rtsol ①mi byed/ /nam mkha' dag la kun gyis ①rtsol bya ru/ /nam mkha' ①kun byas rtsol ④sgrub kun las 'das/ /de bzhin kun byed snying po byang chub sems/ /nga nyid spyod yul kun las 'das pa'i phyir/ /nga la ltar med bsgom dudu ye nas med/ /de bzhin rang bzhin bcu po des kyang ni/ /'das pa nga la bya ru yod ⑥ma yin/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa can rnams kyis/ /rang bzhin bcu yis nga la btsal ⑦byas nas/ /nga dang nga yi ⑧rang bzhin mthong 'dod pas/ /mkha' la gom bor sa la ltung khyab bzhin/ /rang bzhin bcu pos bgrod pas ltung ⑩bar 'gyur/ /nga yi rang bzhin nges par ⑩khungs bstan pa/ /nga ni 8spyod yul kun las 'das pa'i phyir/ /lta ba bsgom 'du med pa de bzhin du/ /rang bzhin bcu la de bzhin don med kyis/ /rang bzhin bcu la don yod ma rtogs ④shig /nga ni bltas pas mthong ba'i yul med pas/ /lta 8bar ma byed de bzhin nyid du zhog /spros bral ma skyes bral tsoba'i rgyu med pas/ /sdom pa dang ni tshul khrims bsrung tu tshomi dgos/ /snying por ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ /rtsol ba dang ni bsgrub (shepa bya mi dgos/ /rang 'byung ye shes sgrib ()pa med pa'i phyir/ /rig pa'i ye shes gsal bar bskyed du med/ /thams cad nga yi sa ru gnas pa'i phyir/ /sbyangs nas bgrod pa'i sa ni yod ma yin/ /nga yis kun la khyab par gnas pa'i phyir / /nga la bgrod par bya ba'i lam yod min/ /nga ni ye nas gzung khri )'dzin bral ba'i phyir/ /phra ba zhes ni ming du gdags su med/ /nga yi gzugs kyis kun la khyab pa'i phyir( gnya/ /gnyis shes ( nyabya ba ye nas yod ma yin/ /nga ni ye nas rang 'byung ye shes la/ /nga la gzhan gyis gtan la dbab ( stetu med/ /nga khri 101—29

30 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 'od 101ni kun gyi byang chub snying po bas/ / gsang ba'i yo)man ngag gzhan na yod ma yin / /sgro dang skur pa kun las 'das pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams kun gyi la ni nga yis ②bzlas/ /nga med pa yi yul ni gzhan med pas/ /lta ba bsgom du med par la yang bzlas/ /nga las gzhan du bsrung du med pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig bsrung du med par la yang bzlas/ /nga las gzhan du btsal du med pa'i phyir/ /phrin las btsal du med par la yang bzlas③/ /nga las gzhan du gnas pa med pa'i phyir/ /sa la 4)sbyang du med par la yang bzlas/ /nga la sgrib pa ye nas med pa'i phyir/ /rang 'byung ye shes yin par la yang bzlas6)/ /nga ni ma skyes chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ /phra ba chos nyid yin par la yang bzlas/ /nga las gzhan du bgrod du med pa'i phyir/ /lam la bgrod du med par la yang bzlas/ /sangs rgyas sems can snang srid snod bcud kun/ /snying po byang chub nga las byung ba'i phyir/ /ye nas gnyis su med par la yang bzlas/ /rang 'byung ye shes gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ /lung chen thog yi'abebs yin par la yang bzlas / /chos rnams thams cad nga las med pa'i phyir/ /kun byed nga ni kun gyi la bzla'o/ /nga ma shes pas sgrib pa'i ngo bor bshad/ /nga las gzhan btsal gol sa byung ba yin/ /las dang shes bya rnam pa gnyis su bstan/ /ma mthong ba ni las kyi sgrib pa yin/ /ma shes pa ni shes bya'i sgrib pa yin/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /snying po byang chub sems kyi ngo bo bas ma rig ma (7shes sgrib gnyis ngo bor (8)bshad/ /btsal zhing bsgrub (9)pa gol kyisar ngas bshad do/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig11 /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad ni/ /rang yin gzhan min 12de la rang rtog na/ /de ni rang 101—30

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 31la rang gis bsgribs pa ste/ /rang gi rang bzhin de yis shes pa min0)/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams ②thams cad kun/ /sems dpa' nyid yin zhunyid las gzhan min rjogyis/ /mi rtog mnyam pa nyid du bde bar mnos6)/ /de la bde ba'i don ni 'di lta ste/ /rang bzhin chen po bcu la rtsol (7mi dgos/ /rang bzhin chen po bcu la ma btsal phyabs/ /gol sa sgrib pa drug drug bcu po yichane/ /sum brgya drug cu ①gol sgrib mtha' yas med/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /rang gi snying po byang chub mngon byung gis/ /'di ma yin gyi chos ni gzhan ma bshad/ /'di la ma rtog shig tri par nga lung ston/ /sems dpa' khyod kyis 'khor gyi tshogs rnams la/ /ngas bstan bzhin du tshogs la lung ston cig /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las gol sgrib skyon sel gyi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos nyid kyi rang bzhin phun sum tshogs pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /kun byed nga la (1thams cad tshogs pa'i phyir/ /de phyir phun sum tshogs zhes yi bya bar bshad//kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum las/ /ston pa bstan pa 'khor rnams byung ba'i phyir/ /kun byed ces ni de la btags tsho pa yin/ /dang por ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ /kun byed nga yi rang 'byung ye shes las/ /rang bzhin rnam pa gsum du byung ba de/ /sku gsum ston pa gsum du bstan pa yin/ /chos kyi 7sku dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /sprul pa'i sku dang rnam pa gsum du bstan / /sku gsum de yi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /chos kyi sku yi rang bzhin 101—31

3 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101bstan pa ni/ /ma skyes gzung ①'dzin bral ba'i rang bzhin bzhugs/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yi rang bzhin ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod rdzogs par bzhugs/ /sprul pa'i sku yi rang bzhin bstan ②pa ni/ /ji ltar 'dul ba'i sku ru sprul nas bzhugs/ /sku gsum ston ②pa de yi bstan 0pa ni/ /phyi nang gsang ba rnam pa gsum du bstan/ /ston pa chos sku'i bstan pa 'di lta ste/ /gsang ba gsum gyi rang bzhin bstan pa ste/ /gzhi dum chos nyid dag gi rang bzhin las/ /gsang ba bskyed yidang gsang ⑦ba rdzogs pa dang / /gsang ba rdzogs pa chen po'i rang bzhin gsum/ /kun gyi spyod yul ma yin gsang bar bshad / /med pa'i rim pa gsum skyed nigasang ston pa⑨/ /de ni gsang ⑩ba bskyed pa zhes su bshad/ /gsang 67ba rdzogs pa zhes su bstan pa ni/ /nang gi shes rab ting 'dzin gsum mi tu rtogs/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad la/ /nang gi ting 'dzin shes rab snying po brjod/ /rang rgyud dag pa ye nas lhar byas nas/ /rang gi lus kyi rdo rje skye mched rnams/ /lta spyod blang dor gnyis med bdag nyid 'dod/ /de ni nang gi gsang 8ba rdzogs par bshad / /gsang ba rdzogs pa chen po bstan pa ni/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad ni/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyis byang chub sems ma bskyed/ /snying po yig 'bru brjod nas rdzogs ma byas/ /kun byed nga ni rdzogs pa chen po ste / /nga la ma rdzogs pa ni gang yang med/ /nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum bstan pa ni/ /rdzogs chen byang chub sems gsum bstan pa yin/ /de ni gsang chab rdzogs pa chen por bshad/ /de ni ston pa chos sku'i bstan par bshad/ /ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bstan pa ni/ /bya ba byed pa'i phyi pa sde snyigasum ste/ /101 —32

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 33bya ba byed pa'i rtog can sde pa ni/ /dang por rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyi nang rtog pa dag pa gsum bsgoms ①pas/ /rtog pa'i gza' (gyeskar ②dus tshod sgo nas 'jug /byang chub dang ni cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag dang ye shes lha ni rje khol tshul/ /dag pa gsum gyi mchod pa de byas nas/ /med par sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'dodabya/ /don dam kun (snyerdzob gnyis ka sgyu 6stemar bshad/ /lta ba spyod pa gnyis su 'byed pa yi/ /gnyis la brten nas don gcig sgrub byed pa/ /yod pa'i spyod pas med pa'i don sgrub pas/ /rten med mkha' la spyang ⑦mo nyug pa 'dra/ /blang dor byed ⑧pa'i phyi pa'i gsang ba ni/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin byin rlabs 0cho 'phrul gyis/ /thams cad byin rlabs ⑩le shes sems dpar ⑩byas/ /mchod pa phyi nang gsang ba gsum mchod nas/ /sku gsung thugs dang phyag rgya 8bzhi ldan pa'i/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob re ba/ /chags med re ba 'jog 8pa'i ting 'dzin 'di/ /lta spyod blang dor byed pas grub pa med/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yi bstan par bshad/ /ston pa sprul pa'i sku yi bstan pa ni/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen mdo sde gsum / /phyi zhes mtshan nyid phyi pa ④zhes su bshad/ /kun byed nga yi ngo bo 'dod yon lnga/ /ye shes lnga yi ngo bor phyung ba la/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug gsum byung ste/ /de 'dul ba yi gnyen por gsungs pa ni/ /chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong ste/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga byung ba/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro reg las/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnam gsum byung / /de dag 'dul ba'i gnyen por sde snod gsum/ /'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs 8pa ni/ /'dul ba nyi khri chig 8stong gsungs 5 pa yin//101—33

34 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa ni/ /mdo sde'i sde snod nyi khri tshig ①stong gsungs/ /zhe sdang 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa ni/ /mngon pa'i sde snod ②nyi khri tshig ③stong gsungs/ /dug gsum cha mnyam ④'dul ba'i gnyen po ru / /sde snod gsum las nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /spyi ru brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs ⑤pa yang / /dug gsum gnyen 0pos 'dul phyir gsungs pa yin/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa rnam gsum ste/ /sgo ni mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa gsum / /de ni bsdus ⑦pa'i don zhes bstan pa yin/ /mdo sde la yang bshad lugs bcu dang gnyis/ /so sor dbye ba'i don du ⑧bstan pa yin/ /dug gsum rgyu las 'bras bu ngan song gsum/ /sems can rgyu la las spyod dge sdig gnyis / /'bras bu mtho ris ngan song rnam gnyis so/ /mtshan nyid rgyu las rab tu bsgrags ⑨pa yin/ /'di ni sngar gsungs da gsung phyis gsung 'gyur⑩/ /'di don brjod du med pa'i don 'di ni/ /snga ma ma gsungs da ltar mi gsung ste / /sprul pa'i sku yis phyis kyang gsung mi 'gyur/ /de bas ⑩sprul pa'i sku yi ⑫bstan par bshad/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum la/ /'khor gyi dang po ston pa sku gsum shar/ /sku gsum ston pa gsum gyi 'khor bstan pa/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /ston pa chos kyi sku yi 6)'khor bstan 7pa/ /nga yis byas pa'i 'khor ni thams cad kun/ /nga yi rang bzhin chos kyi sku 'khor yin/ /sangs rgyas sems can snang srid snod bcud kun / /chos kyi sku yi 'khor du ma 'dus med/ /ces gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yi 'khor bstan pa/ /mos spyod bzhi yi sa la 'das pa yi/ /dang po rab tu dga' ba'i sa mnan nas/ /101—34

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 35sa bcu chos kyi sprin gyi sa pa rnams/ /de ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yi 'khor du bstan6)/ /ston pa sprul pa'i ②sku yi 'khor bstan pa/ /mu stegs mur thug rgyang 'phen (kyephyal ba bzhi/ /bla med byang chub lam la ④gtan gol bas/ /dbang po sems bsgyur ⑤thugs rje byin brlabs 6)nas/ /dge slong pho mo dge bsnyen pho mo bzhi/ /ston pa sprul pa'i sku yi 'khor du bstan/ /zhes gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyi/ /sku gsum so so rang re gnas bstan pa/ /ston pa chos sku'i gnas ni 'di lta ste/ /'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang ste/ /yang dag don gyi 'og min de ru bshad / /ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gnas bstan pa/ /'jig rten mtshan ma kun gyi steng gyur pa/ /gnas kyi 'og min khang bu brtsegs pa yi/ /gzhal yas khang de gnas kyi 'og min bshad/ /ston pa sprul pa'i sku yi gnas bstan 'byepa / /sprul pa'i sku ni rabs ⑧bdun shākya (9)thub/ /gnas ni kyibya rgod phung po'i gnas bstan 41)te/ /yang dag thugs rje sprul pa nges med gnas/ /zhes tsogasungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga las byung ba'i sku gsum ston pa yi/ /'dul ba'i zhing khams khyad par bstan pa ni/ /chos sku ston pa'i 'dul ba'i zhing khams ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' yis klas pa dang / /nam mkha'i khams kyis ji ltar khyab pa de/ /chos kyi sku yi 4)'dul ba'i zhing khams yin/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i pa'adul ba'i zhing khams ni/ /nga las byung ba'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg /ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pas 'dul / /sprul pa'i sku yi 8'dul ba'i zhing khams ni/ / 'dzam bu'i 7gling ni bye ba phrag brgya las/ /rang 'byung ye shes thugs rjes rgyud drug 'dul/ /de ni 101—35

36 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101mthun ①pa'i bye brag bstan pa yin/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum de/ /rgyu mthun ②'bras bu mthun sril rang bzhin gcig /rgyu ni byang chub sems su kun mthun ④la/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas yin par kun kyang mthun⑤/ /rang bzhin chos nyid ngo bo gcig par bstan/ /'dul ba'i dus la snga phyi phye ba med/ /ces gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po yang nyon ducig /kun byed rgyal po nga las byung ba yi/ /sku gsum ston pa de yi bshad lugs ni/ /ston pa chos skus byin gyis brlabs (3)kyis bshad/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa rang gi ngo bos bshad / /sprul pa'i sku ni tshig dang don bsdebs ⑧nas/ /gang zag rna ba'i dbang por tshig don ston/ /chos sku byin gyis brlabs 0kyis bshad pa ni/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin bstan pa ste0/ /skye ba med las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du/ /ji ltar snang srid snod 7bcud thams cad kun/ /ngo bo thugs rje cho 'phrul phyung ba ste/ /rang bzhin byin gyis brlabs kyis bshad ces bya/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku rang gi ngo bo ston/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs pa yi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad rdzogs par ston/ /rang gi ngo bos bshad ces nga yis bstan/ /sprul skus tshig dang yi shes bsdebs 7bshad pa/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun / /ston pa'i ngo bor ston pas ma rig ste/ /bstan tshupa zhes pa'i khyad par 'dod sprul pas/ /don rnams tshig dang yi ger sgra brjod pas/ /tshig gi sgra des don de go byas nas/ /don de tshig sgra de yis bshad pa yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /kun byed nga dhini sku gsum ngo bo ste/ /mi rtog mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa de pa/ /spros bral chos kyi sku yi ngo bo yin/ /rang bzhin 101—36

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 37'byung ba'i skye ba'i cho 'phrul de/ /'dod pa 'byung ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku yin / /thugs rjes ji ltar 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /de ①ni sprul pa'i sku yi ngo bo yin/ /kun byed rgyal po'i rang bzhin rnam gsum gyis/ /gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i skur ston mdzad/ /bstan pa'i rang bzhin brjod (midu med pa'i don / /gang la gang 'tsham ②de yis don mdzad pa/ /de ni bstan pa phun sum tshogs par gsungs/ /'khor gyi rang bzhin gang la gang 'dus nas/ /de la 'dus nas de yi gdung 'tshob 'dzin/ /de la phun sum tshogs pa'i 'khor zhes byam/ /nga ni ston pa kun byed byang chub sems/ /kun byed gcig ④la rnam pa gsum bgrangs pa/ /kun byed nga dang nga yi rang bzhin dang / /nga yis byas pa'i chos dang rnam pa gsum/ /nga ni ston pa kun byed kun gyi mes/ /nga yi rang bzhin rnam pa bcur bstan ⑤pa/ /de ni bstan pa kun gyi snying por bshad/ /kun byed nga yis byas pa'i chos rnams ni/ /dus gsum gcig 6)na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /khams gsum gnas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kun/ /dbye ba med par 'khor gyi dam par byas/ /kun byed gcig gis phun sum tshogs byas pas/ /sems kyi dgos pa kun byas phun sum tshogs/ /gang la gang dgos dgos pa tshogs pa la/ /kun byed nga yis (7)phun sum tshogs par bshad/ /ston pa'i rang bzhin rnam pa gsum bstan pa/ /'khor gyi dang po ston pa sku gsum shar/ /ma skyes gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang /zhin de/ /'khor gyi dang po ston pa chos skur shar/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul kun bzang ( rol pa de/ /'dod spyod longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru shar/ /sna tshogs ji ltar 'dod pa byung nas ni//de dang mthun 5)par kun kyang tshim byed pa/ /de ni sna tshogs sprul sku zhes su 101—37

38 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101bshad / /sku gsum ston pa grags phyogs mthong ba ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bzod thob gsum/ /gang 'thad 6)ston pa'i sku la de 'dus nas/ /de dang mthun (gepa'i gnas su don ston bzhugs/ /bstan pa'i rang bzhin yang ni de 'dra ste/ /sku gsum gang gis 'khor la gang ston pa/ /gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i don rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas lha mi 'jig rten las dag la/ /bstan pas 'dul phyir phun sum tshogs zhes ①bshad/ /mi gnas chos sku dbyings na bzhugs pa yis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas khams gsum sems can la / /spros med byang chub sems ni chos skus libastan/ /ye shes longs spyod 'og min bzhugs pa yis/ /sa bcu pa yi byang chub sems dpa' la/ /byang chub sems de sku dang ye shes bshad/ /thugs rje sna tshogs nges med sprul pa yis/ /bzod thob gang na 'dus pa'i 'khor de la/ /ma nges gang gis 'dul ba'i don yang bstan/ /smon lam las bzang rkyen gyis bar ma chod/ /nga yi thugs rje sems dpa'i dus la bab/ /ngas bstan 'khor gyi nang nas khyod sdud dang / /gnyis med don nyid nga yis bstan pa gsum/ /tshogs pas dus gnas rang bzhin de la tshang 95/ /phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa gsum po de/ /ye nas dkon pa'i dkon mchog gsum du bstan/ /kun byed nga yi sku gsung thugs su bshad/ /ston pa dkon pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni/ /chos sku longs spyod sku dang sprul sku ste6/ /bstan pa dam chos dkon gepa'i gsung mchog ni/ /brjod du med pa'i kun byed gsung mchog gsum/ /'khor gyi dge 'dun thugs mchog de la ni/ /gang la gang dgos gang 'tsham 8)ston par byed/ /nga ni ston pa kun byed byang chub sems/ /sku gsum byed pa'i ston pa ngas byas nas/ /bstan pa 101—38

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 39dam chos gsum du bkod pa ni/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang 6)ba gsum du bkod / /de la rnam pa gsum gsum dgur ①grags pa/ /sprul sku thugs rjes ji ltar 'dul gsum bsgrags/ /longs spyod bya byed phyi nang gsum du sgrogs/ /chos sku gsang ba'i mngon pa gsum sgrogs pa/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba gsum po de/ /lus dang ngag dang yid dang sku gsung thugs/ /de las 'phros pas rnam pa dgur byung ba/ /la dgu lung dgu lam dgu bgrod pa yis/ /theg gcig kun byed byang chub sa la bgrodag/ /kun byed bya byed med par rtsol ④sgrub 'das / /bgrod pa med par byang chub sa la phyin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las phun sum tshogs pa shin tu dkon (5)pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba bsdus 56pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang rtsa ba ni 'di lta ste/ nga ni chos kun rang bzhin yin pa ste/ /nga yi rang bzhin las ni chos gzhan med/ /ston pa sku gsum nga yi rang bzhin yin / /dus gsum sangs rgyas nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /rnal 'byor rnam bzhi (7nang yi rang bzhin yin/ /'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams gsum yang / /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin bstan pa yin(8)/ /'byung chen lnga yang nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /rgyud drug sems can nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /snang ba thams cad nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /srid pa thams cad nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud bsdus pa nga yi rang 101—39

40 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101bzhin yin/ /nga yi rang bzhin las ni gzhan med pas/ /chos rnams kun gyi ①rtsa ba nga la (mi'adus/ /nga las ma 'dus pa ni gcig kyang med/ /ma skyes pa dang skye ba'i cho 'phrul dang / /thugs rje'i rang bzhin rnam pa gsum byung ba/ /de ni ston pa gsum gyi rang bzhin yin/ /snga pa da lta phyi pa dus gsum yang / /nga nyid gcig tu gnas pa'i rang bzhin las/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu gnas pa'i phyir/ /de yang nga yi rang bzhin bstan pa yin/ /nga nyid gzung 'dzin bral bas byang ba dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab pa dang / /chos rnams kun gyi snying po byed pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems kyang nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /kun byed nga ni gcig tu gnas pa la/ /nga yi rang bzhin de bzhin rnal ma la/ /rnam bzhi 'byor pa rnal ma gcig tu 'byor/ /des na nga yi rang bzhin yin par bshad/ /kun byed nga yi lus ngag yid gsum las/ /'byung yang nga yi rang bzhin de las 'byung / /'dus kyang nga yi rang bzhin de la 'dusam/ /yin yang nga yi ngo bo de yin pas/ /khams gsum nga yi rang bzhin yin par bshad/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rnam lnga ni/ /nga yi ngo bo rnam lnga phyung ba ste/ /nam mkha' rlung chu sa me snang ba lnga/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin bstan pa yin/ /kun byed nga yi thugs rjes mngon phyung nas/ /rang 'byung ye shes rnam lnga bstan pa ni/ /'gro ba rigs drug sems can snang ba yang / /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin bstan pa yin/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yi rang bzhin las/ /snang srid snod bcud bsdus (5)pa thams cad kun/ /thams cad ngas byas nga las byung ba'i phyir/ /ngar (47ma 'dus pa'i chos ni gcig kyang med/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum yang / /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum ston/ /snga 101—40

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 41pa da lta phyi pa dus gsum gyi/ /rnam gsum gcig tu gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyang ske/ /snga phyi med par kun byed rang bzhin gnas/ /gzung 6)'dzin bral ba'i byang chub sems dpa' yang / /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin sems dpar byed/ /rnal 'byor rnam bzhi rnal mar 'jog pa yang / /kun byed nga la rnal ②du 'jog par byed/ /kun byed rgyal pos thams cad byas pa bzhin/ /thams cad kun byed rgyal po nyid du 'dus/ /zhes zhugasungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po nyid kho nar 'dus pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po nga ④yis chos thams cad kyi khungs kyi mdo 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga ni kun gyi lung khungs yin pa ste/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /thams cad nga las byung bar shes par gyis/ /chos kyi spyi khungs chen po 'di nyon la/ /chos rnams thams cad 'di ltar lung ston cig /kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems nga ni/ /lung chen kun gyi rgyal po nga yin pas/ /ston pa gsum yang dang po nga las phyibyung / /lung zhes bya ba ston pa'i bka' la gdagasayi/ /man ngag kun gyi rtsa ba nga yin pas/ /sems las ma gtogs tso)pa yi chos nyid ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas khams gsum sems can la/ /kun byed nga yis yang dag bstan pa med/ /rgyud dang mdo sde kun gyi spyi 'grel yin/ /rgyud dang mdo sde ston pa'i ston pa yang / /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin phyung ba yin/ /ston pa dang ni bstan pa gnyis ka 'grel(she/ /kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems nga ni/ /101—41

4 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101bstan pa kun gyi yang rtse yin par bshad/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis / /bstan zhi)pa'i 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa dang / /tan tra so so'i sde ni 'bum sde dang / /bskyed (7rdzogs gsang ba la sogs rtsol phyisgrub can/ /kun kyang rtsol sgrub 'das pa nga la bgrod/ /rtsol sgrub nyid kyis 'das pa nga mi ④mthong ske/ /des na bstan pa kun gyi yang rtse yin par bshad/ /kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems nga ni/ /theg pa kun gyi nying khu (7yin par bshad/ /ston pa gsum gyi gnas (6)pa'i theg pa gsum/ /nges par gnas ⑦pa theg pa gcig las med / /gcig ni kun theg (8)byang chub sems kyi sa/ /de ni theg pa kun gyi nying khur bshad/ /kye nga ni ma rig pa yi mun bsal nas/ /ye shes chen po'i snang ba mched smyo par byed/ /de yang ji lta bu zhes bstan zhe na/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /byang chub de bzhin nyid du ma rig ste/ /ma rig rtog pa'i mun par 'thibs pa la/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun / /kun byed byang 7chub sems kyis byas pa'i phyir/ /kun byed byang chub sems su rig byas nas/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /so sor rtog 11pa'i mun pa bsal nas kyang / /rang 'byung ye shes chen po snang ba mched / /des na ma rig mun sel (/rnyesnang ba mched yi ces bya/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ /rnam par rtog pa'i dra ba dral nas ni/ /nyon mongs pa yi phreng thag gcod sapar byed/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos 'di thams cad la/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa can rnams kyis/ /la las dug mthong (7sgong ba'i rtog pa byed/ rī /la las sems chags pa yi yul mthong nas/ /bden gnyis ma chags pa yi rtog pa sabyed/ /la las rnam dag bya ba'i yul mthong nas/ /dag pa gsum dang 101—42

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 43byin rlabs 6)cho 'phrul gyis/ /rje dang khol gyi tshul du rtog par byed/ /la las rang dag pa yi rang bzhin la/ /bsnyen sgrub ②rnam bzhis sgrub (5)'dod rtog byed pa / /thams cad kun byed byang chub sems nga yis④/ /sems las gzhan (5)ma yin rtog (6)dral nas ni/ /so sor rtog pa'i nyon mongs phreng thag gcod/ /ces gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems nga ni / khyod kyis nga yi rang bzhin 'di rtogs la/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /nga las gzhan med pa ru lung ston cig /khyod kyis nga yi lung 'di bstan ⑦'gyur na/ /khyod (kyel 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad kyis/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rtogs gyur kyi)nas/ /kun kyang nga yi rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur/ /kun kyang nga yi rang bzhin gyur pa na/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams 7thams cad la/ /kun kyang spong 'gegs (1bden gnyis sbyong tsomi byed/ /gtsang spras dag gsum byin gyis rlob mi byed/ /ting 'dzin sems bskyed rtsol yi dang sgrub 8mi byed/ /thams cad kun byed nga ru byas zin pas/ /kun byed nga ru thams cad mnyam pa nyid/ /mnyam nyid nga yis mnyam nyid bya mi dgos/ /mnyam nyid bya mi dgos par sngar lung bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las nges par lung khungs bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des lung thams cad kyi rgyal po yin pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad kyi spyi lung bshad pa'i bshad lugs 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' mchen po nyon cig /nga ni chos kyi spyi lung yin 101—43

44 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101pa'i phyir/ /gtan 6)tshigs don gyi bshad lugs rnam lnga ni/ /spyi don rnam pa lnga yis bshad pa ste/ /lo rgyus don gyi bshad lugs bstan pa dang / /rtsa ②ba don gyi bshad lugs bstan pa dang / /yo ga don gyi bshad lugs bstan pa dang —/ /dgos pa don gyi bshad lugs bstan pa dang / /tshig gi don gyi bshad lugs bstan ①pa'o/ /dang po yid ches pa yi khungs bstan ④phyir/ /lo rgyus don gyi bshad lugs bstan par bya/ /chos kun rtsa ba sems su 'dus pa'i phyir/ /des na rtsa (geba'i don de bstan (7par bya/ /theg pa'i khyad par so sor dbye ba'i phyir / /yo ga don gyi rtsa ba bstan par bya/ /rtsol sgrub ①bya mi dgos par bstan pa'i phyir/ /dgos ched ⑧don gyi dgos pa de ru bstan/ /mi rtogs don de rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /tshig gi don de sgra ru brjod par bya/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ lo rgyus don gyi yo)dgos pa bstan pa ni/ /dang por yid ches pa yi khungs bstan phyir/ /lo rgyus don gyi bshad lugs bstan pa ni/ /rang bzhin byin gyis brlabs kyis bshad lugs dang / /rang gi ngo bo bstan pa'i bshad lugs dang / /don gyi sgra tshig bsdebs pa'i bshad lugs so/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum las/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis//rang bzhin dang ni ngo bo sgra tshig gis/ /ji ltar byung ba'i khungs des yid kyang ches / /kye sems dpa' 7chen po nyon cig /rtsa ba don gyi dgos pa bstan pa ni / /snang srid snod bcud bsdus pa thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas sems can bsdus 11pa thams cad kun/ /kun byed byang chub nga yis byas pa'i phyir/ /thams cad byang chub sems las ma gtogs 7pa/ /gzhan zhes bya ba ye nas med pa'i phyir/ /kun kyang byang chub sems su bstan pa'i phyir/ /rtsa ba don gyi 101—44
