chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 45dgos ched ①bstan pa yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /yo ga don gyi dgos ched bstan pa ni/ /kun byed nga las byung ba'i sku gsum gyis/ /longs spyod sku dang chos sku'i bstan pa yi③/ /tan tra la sogs yo ga sde rnams la/ /so so'i khyad par bye brag yod kyis kyang / /rgyu 'bras 'das pa nga yi bstan pa ni/ /rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i don 'di ni/ /theg pa shan 'byed rdzogs pa'i lung zhes bshad / /des na yo ga'i don gyi dgos pa bstan ①pa yin zhes bya/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /dgos ched ④don gyi dgos pa bstan pa ni/ /bskal ⑤pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon ⑥rol nas/ /kun byed byang chub nga la dad pa yi/ /las dang skal ldan shin tu rnal 'byor pa/ /lta ba bsgom 7med dam tshig bsrung ⑧tu med/ /phrin las btsal med lam ⑨la bgrod du med/ /sa la sbyang med rgyu dang 'bras bu med/ /don dam dang ni kun rdzob rnam gnyis med/ /bsgom zhing bsgrub botu med par mthong ba dang / /sems bskyed 7med cing gnyen 8po med mthong ba/ /kun byed sems kyi rang bzhin mthong ba yi/ /de lta bu yi (nyedagos ched bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /tshig gi don gyi dgos pa bstan pa ni/ /kun byed byang chub sems nga de bzhin nyid/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams bstan pa ni/ /kun byed de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin te/ /tshig dang yi ge sgra 8ru ma bsgrags yin/ /gang zag yid kyi dbang po rig pa yis/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin gab ⑩mi snang / /des na tshig dang yi ge sgra ru bsgrags/zhe/ /des na tshig gi don gyi dgos par bshad / /kye sems dpa' chen po/ gang dang gang gi lo rgyus bshad pa ni/ /ston pa bstan pa 'khor gyi lo rgyus te/ /ston pa kun byed rang bzhin rnam gsum 101—45

46 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101las / /'khor gyi rang bzhin sku gsum ston pa byung / /sku gsum ston pa'i bshad lugs rnam gsum ni/ /ston pa bstan pa gsum gyi lo rgyus yin/ /gang dang gang gi rtsa ba bshad pa ni/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku ①gsum gyis/ /ji skad bstan pa'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /rtsa ba byang chub sems su bstan pa'i phyir/ /ston pa dang ni bstan pa 'khor rnams kyi/ /rtsa ba don gyi gtan ②tshigs bstan pa yin/ /nga yi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid gcig la/ /rnal 'byor rnam bzhi yo ga'i bye brag ni/ /lta ba spyod pa dam tshig sgrub ①pa dang / /mi mthun khyad par so so'i bye brag de/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rtsol sgrub ④'das pas 'byed/ /des na yo ga'i don gyi gtan phyitshigs bstan⑥/ /dgos rtsiched don gyi nges tshig bstan (8)pa ni/ /dgos ni khams gsum sems can thams cad kun / /rang sems de bzhin nyid de mthong 'gyur na/ /sangs rgyas tshig gi sa la mi gnas te/ /da lta nyid nas shin tu rnal 'byor thob/ /las med skal ba chung ba rnams la ni/ /ma gab mngon du phyung yang mi rtogs te/ /gang zhig nor bu rin chen 'dod pa de/ /shing la byi dor byas pas mi 'gyur bzhin/ /las bzang skal (15ldan shin tu rnal 'byor la/ /lta ba dam tshig phrin 7las sa lam dang ske/ /sems bskyed rgyu 'bras sgom sgrub kyilhaganyen po med/ /don dam kun rdzob rnam gnyis med yi mthong ba/ /des na sems kyi de bzhin nyid mthong bas / /de lta bu la dgos pa'i dgos ched yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /tshig gi don gyi dgos pa'i nges tshig ni/ /med pa'i don bcu med pa'i sgra dang tshig /tshig tu brjod pas bya med don mthong nas/ /bya mi dgos pa'i kun byed de thob pas / /tshig gi don gyi dgos pa bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /101 —46

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 47byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las sems kyi bshad lugs kyi le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos nyid kyi gsang 6)ba dam pa'i gdams ngag 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ kun byed nga ni kun tu gsang ⑤ba'o/ /nga las byung ba'i sku gsum ston pa la/ /nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum mi bstan gsang ①/ /nga la gnas pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /nga yi rang bzhin mi bstan gsang bar bya/ /nga la 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad la/ /nga yi rang bzhin mi bstan gsang rgyabar bya/ /nga yis byas pa'i khams gsum sems can la/ /nga yi rang bzhin mi bstan gsang 55nyebar bya/ /nga yi rang bzhin ma gsang 6)bstan byas nas(7)/ /sku gsum ston pa (8)nga las 'byung mi 'gyur/ /sku gsum ston pa nga las ma byung na/ /bstan tsanogasum theg gsum 'khor gsum tshogs mi 'gyur/ /bstan gsum theg gsum 'khor gsum ma tshogs na/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum/ /bla med byang chub kun gyi rig pa med/ /nga las byung ba'i dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /nga yi rang bzhin ma gsang tsobastan gyur tsho na/ /sku gsum ston gsum med pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /nga la 'dus pa 'khor gyi tshogs rnams la/ /nga yi rang bzhin ma gsang bstan gyur /den/ /ston gsum theg pa khyad par phyed mi 'gyur/ /nga yis byas pa'i khams gsum sems can la/ /nga yi rang bzhin thugs rjes bstan gyur yi na/ /ston pa gsum gyis bstan pa'i gnas yo)med 'gyur/ /ston pa gsum gyi skabastan pa'i gnas med na/ /kun byed nga yis byas pa'i chos rnams 101—47

48 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101la / /phun sum tshogs pa zhes su su zhig 'dogs/ /des na kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni/ /nga yi rang bzhin nga yis phyung nas ni/ /nga la nga yi rang bzhin nga yis 0)bstan/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa 'khor rnams la/ /bstan pa'i lung ni kun byed ngas ma phog /shin tu rnal 'byor kun byed nga yin pas/ /de la kun byed rang bzhin bstan par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las skal med ②la gsang ①ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos nyid kyi lung chen po mngon du phyung ba'i lung 'di bstan to/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig④ /kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni/ /mngon du phyung ba gsum bstan te(5ni/ /nga yi durang bzhin rnam gsum ngas bstan pa/ /don rnams ston pa'i ston pa dang / /don rig ⑦'dod pa'i 'khor rnams dang / /ma nor nges pa'i don dang gsum/ /kun ⑧byed lho)nga yis mngon du phyung / /don ston mngon du phyung ba ni/ /chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /sprul pa'i sku dang rnam pa gsum/ /'khor gyi dang po ston pa sku gsum ste7/ /don ston pa yi ston pa de/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang bzhin dang / /nga yi ngo bo (7ston pa dang / /thugs rje'i rang bzhin don mdzad gsum / /rang bzhin gsum las mngon du phyung / /ston pa gsum yang mngon phyung ba'o/ /don rig kyi'adod pa mngon phyung ba/ /ston pa gsum gyi 'khor gsum ste/ /nga 7bstan pa yi bye brag ni/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang ske/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can kun/ /mi rtog mnyam nyid ski gnas pa de/ /kun byed nga yis snyimangon phyung 'khor/ /dbang po yul gyi rnam 101—48

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 49pa la/ /nyon mongs mi skye rnam mi rtog /rang gi byang chub sems nyid la/ /chos dang chos nyid rtog byed pa/ /dang po sa nas bcu par bsgribs6)/ /sa bcu byang chub sems dpa' dang / /longs spyod 'dod yon rnam pa lngar/ /mthong ba'i ston 'khor rnam gnyis kyang / /nga yi ngo bor mngon phyung yin/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin la/ /rig pa yid kyi (midabang po des/ /brtags pas mthong ba'i shes pa de③/ /la las rtag pa nyid du mthong / /la las stong pa chad par mthong / /rgyu 'bras log par mthong ba yi/ /mu stegs rnam bzhis byin brlabs skyinas/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu lung bstan pa'i/ /sdig spong sems dge rnam bzhi ni/ /bskal pa chen po gsum bar du/ /gnas (snyepa'i 'khor dang ston pa yang / /nga yis mngon du phyung ba yin/ /ye shes rig pa'i yul can la/ /yang dag nges par mngon du phyung / /kye sems dpa' chen po/ mngon du phyung ba zhes bya ba/ /gang gis gang mngon phyung ba ni/ /gang gis nga yis mngon du phyung / /gang zhig mngon du phyung ba ni/ /sems de nyid de mngon du phyung / /gang gi don du mngon phyung na/ /yul la so sor lta ba yi/ /'khor gyi don du mngon phyung yin/ /la la spong ba'i don du phyung / /la la 'gegs pa'i don du phyung / /la la spyod (5)pa'i don du phyung / /la la dag byed don du phyung / /la lar (peblang dor don du phyung / /la lar bdag nyid don du phyung / /la las spang ba'i yul du mthong / /la las dgag ( pa'i yul du mthong / /la las spyod kyis pa'i yul du mthong / /la las dag bya'i yul du mthong / /la las blang dor yul du mthong / /la las dbang bsdu'i 7yul du mthong / /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ston pa yi/ /'khor tshogs rnams kyis de ltar mthong / /sems dpa' chen po/101—49

50 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101nga yi rang bzhin mngon phyung ba/ /'di ni nges par lung ston cig /nga ni khyed kyi ngo bo ste/ /nga yi rang bzhin phyung ba de6)/ /khyed kyi rang bzhin phyung ba yin/ /khyed kyi rang bzhin phyung ba des/ /rang gi rang bzhin shes par gyis/ /rang gi ngo bo shes par gyis/ /rgyu 'bras 'khor la lung ston cig /ces gsungs so/ /de nas sems dpa' rdo rje des rgyu 'bras kyi (gu'akhor la 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ston 'khor rnams/ /ston pa'i ston pa kun byed kyis/ /kun byas phun sum tshogs par byas/ /phun sum tshogs pa mngon phyung ba/ /rang gi rang bzhin mngon phyung bas/ /rang gi rang bzhin yin par rtogs/ /rang gi ngo bo yin par rtogs/ /de la gzhan yin (5)ma rtogs (gepar/ /rang nyid yin par kun gyis rtogs/ /rang nyid yin par ma rtogs te/ /yul de ⑤rang du ma rtogs par/ /yul de dgra (6)dang tsher (7)brtags (nyanas/ /rang gi rang bzhin de spangs nas/ /bskal pa brgya phrag yun rings suyo)/ /chos nyid rang gi sems mi mthong / /rang sems chos nyid ma mthong na/ /bskal pa brgya phrag yun rings su / /rang gi byang chub de spong 'gyur/ /bya med bde chen de mi thob11/ /yul de rang du ma rtogs par/ /yul de rkyen gyis dgrar brtags ( gyenas / /rang gi rang bzhin de bkag na/ /bskal pa brgya phrag yun rings suyiste/ /chos nyid rang gi sems mi mthong / /rang sems chos nyid ma mthong na/ /bskal pa brgya phrag yun rings sung / /rang gi byang chub de 'gegs yipas/ /bya med bde chen de mi thobs/ /yul de rang du ma rtogs par/ /yul de sbyangs pa'i yul mthong nas/ /rang gi rang bzhin sbyong 1 byed na/ /bskal pa chen po gsum bar du/ /chos nyid rang gi sems mi mthong / /rang sems chos nyid ma 1631—5()

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 51mthong ste/ /rang sems sbyang med gding 0)dang bral/ /yul de byang chub rang dag la/ /gzung ⑧'dzin dri ma yod ①mthong nas/ /phyi nang rtog pa dag gsum gyis / /khrus dang gtsang gosbra dag byed pa/ /dag pa'i rang sems ma mthong ba/ /rang sems dag pa de dang bral/ /mi yi skye ba tshe bdun du/ /rang sems chos nyid de mi mthong / /blang dor med pa'i byang chub la/ /blang dang dor ba'i yul mthong nas/ /rang 'byung nyid la blang dor byas/ /rang gis rang la blang dor byas / /bar ma chod kyis tshe gsum du/ /rang sems gnyis med de mi mthong / /lhun gyis grub pa'i byang chub la/ /btsal zhing bsgrub zhenapa'i yul mthong nas/ /sems bskyed ting 'dzin rnam gsum gyis/ /thams cad dbang sdud bdag tu byed / /rang gi byang chub btsal med la/ /btsal bas grub par 'dod pa'i phyir / /bcu drug zla bas tshes bsgrubs (6nyenas/ /stong dang brgya drug lo yis ni/ /cha lugs longs sku bzung nas ni/ /rang sems lhun grub bzod (7)rtog byed/ /rang sems chos nyid mngon phyung 'di/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu rtog byed pa'i/ /rtsol ji sgrub can la phan med kyang / /las dang skal (9ribar ldan pa yi/ /dgos ched don du phyung ba yinayi/ /zhes sems dpa' rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de nas kun byed rgyal po nyu1)nyid kyis / lung bstan pa/ kye sems dpa' chen po/ chos nyid mngon du phyung ba rang sems yin/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu 51 theg pa can rnams kyis / /rang sems mngon du phyung ba ma rtogs tsho te /spong zhing 'gegs pas bskal pa yun rings geganas/ / sbyongs shing 7bgrod la bskal 1 pa gsum du gnas / /dag byed khrus dang gtsang 18spras mi tshe bdun/ /byin rlobs 19blang dor can ni 2 )mi tshe gsum/ /dbang sdud na bdag 'dod lo stong brgya drug tu/ /101—51

5 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101longs sku cha lugs de yi ①rang sems rtogs②/ / nam rtogs ③dus na mi rtsol bde chen thob/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig④ /rgyu 'bras theg chen bzhin du ma yin gyis6)/ /kun byed nga yi lung 'di nges par zung rjo/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad dang / /rang sems chos nyid ye nas gcig yin pas/ /rgyu 'bras lugs bzhin 'di la rtog ma byed/ /rang sems de bzhin nyid la rtog ma byed/ /rang sems de bzhin nyid la brtag ⑨bya ru/ /rang gi byang chub ngo bo ⑤snang ba yin/ /'di las ma rtogs so sos ming btags 6)pa / /kun rdzob snang la don dam mi snang 'dogs/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyis med bden pa gcigatso /bden pa yang dag nges par yod ma yin/ /yang dag 'dogs (1pa nga yang 'khrul pa yin/ /bde ba 'dod pa chags pa'i nad yin pas / /'dod pa med pas bde ba len par byed/ /sangs rgyas bsgrubs pas grub pa ma yin te/ /ma btsal rang bzhin gnas pas lhun gyis grub/ /ma btsal rang bzhin gnas la mi rtog zhog /sangs rgyas don gyi 7bla dgas ming 'di la/ /sangs rgyas yang dag yod par nga mi ston/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas yod par mthong ba ni/ /chos nyid dbyings las sangs rgyas mi rnyed de/ /sangs rgyas ma lta rang sems byar yi med rtogs/ /brtags na med de rang sems ye nas gsal / /dngos su mi snang rang sems kun la khyab/ /yin pa'i ngo bo snang ba 'di yin te/ /'di min snyam skipa'i rgyu 'bras theg chen la/ /spong 'gegs sbyong ba 7byin brlabs 7sna tshogs kyis/ /rang sems chos nyid bya med de las gol/ /rang gam bzhag (snyenas gzhan ma rgyang 67du tshol/ /bya med bde bor rtsol ni tshob dang du len/ /tshi ( nyachad pa yi nad du de las med/ /ma yengs 101—52

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 53ting 'dzin 'dzin pa'i rtod phur yin/ /ye nas yin la yengs pa'i shor ba med//ma yengs ting 'dzin re ba'i slu mkhan des/ /rgyu 'bras theg chen drang ba'i lung bstan yin/ /ye nas yin la yengs med shor med de/ /rtsol 0sgrub kun gyi gnyen po phyi'ajoms byed de/ /rgyu 'bras ston pa'i ston pa 'khor rnams la/ /kun byed nga yi lung 'di bstan gyur na/ /rgyu las ⑧'bras bu 'byung zhes sgro skur 'debs / /sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor ting 'dzin can/ /ting 'dzin 'dod pa'i ma bcos rnal 'byor spangs/ /ma bcos rnal ma kun gyi chos nyid yin / /chos nyid las ni sangs rgyas gud na med/ /sangs rgyas ming du btags ④pa bla dgas (geyin/ /chos nyid bya ba gzhan med rang sems te/ /rang sems ma bcos chos kyi sku ru bshad/ /ma bcos ⑥pa la ye nas skye med pas / /skye med don la btsal gzhing bsgrub (nyetu med/ /btsal zhing bsgrubs ⑨pas bya med ⑩'grub mi 'gyur/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / /sprul pa'i sku dang ston pa rnam pa gsum/ /theg gcig theg gnyis theg pa rnam yigasum gyi/ /ston pa kun byed rgyal po nga yis phyung / /nga ni ston pa kun gyi 'byung gnas yin/ /nga yi 8rang bzhin rnam pa 8gsum las phyung / /spros bral skye med dga' ba'i 'khor rnams la/ /nga yi rang bzhin gzung yi'adzin bral ba las/ /mi rtog mnyam pa nyid kyi chos sku byung / /chos sku'i 'khor ni phye ba med pa ste/ /ma skyes mnyam pa nyid kyi don bstan pa/ /de ni lhag ma med pa'i theg par bshad/ /nga yi rang bzhin kun du snang ba la/ /'dod spyod lidag pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs rnams la/ /nga yi ngo bo longs spyod rdzogs par phyung / /ngo bo de la lta spyod rdzogs byed ston/ /de ni 101—53

54 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101thun mong min lho)pa'i theg pa ste/ /nga yi rol pa'i ngo bo phyung ba yin/ /nga yi rang bzhin thugs rjer 'byung ba las/ /ji ltar 'dul bar sprul nas don mdzad pa'i / /sprul pa'i sku dang 'khor tshogs rnam bzhi la/ /rgyu 'bras 'tsham pa'i ②thugs rje (na phyung ba yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ mdor phyin mngon du phyung ba'i lung zhes pa/ /nga yi rang bzhin 'di ltar bstan pa la/ /mngon du phyung ba'i lung zhes bstan pa yin/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin gcig pu la/ /snang ba'i yul ni rnam (5)pa gsum snang la/ /de las byung ba'i chos ni 'di lta ste/ /sangs rgyas sems can snang srid snod (6)bcud kun/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin mngon phyung yin/ /'di las gzhan yin pa ru rtog byed pa/ /kun byed nga dang phrad pa'i skal med pas/ /'khor gyi dang po ston pa sku gsum (7)gyi/ /rim pas sbyangs pa'i rgyu 'bras theg 'khor yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga yis mngon du phyung ba 'di/ /gzhan ma mngon du phyung ba yin(8)/ /nga nyid mngon du phyung ba yin/ /chos nyid mngon du phyung ba yin/ /rang sems mngon du phyung ba yin / /ma nor mngon du phyung ba yin/ /nges pa mngon du phyung ba yin/ /de bzhin mngon du phyung ba yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga yi rang bzhin mngon du phyung ba 'dis/ /che ba lnga yi sangs rgyas mngon du phyung ba yin/ /che ba lnga yi sangs rgyas 'di lta ste/ /nga yi ngo bo mngon du phyung ba ni/ /snang srid snod bcud nga yi 9chos nyid 'di/ /kun la snang 7bas mngon par phyung ba yin/ /bya mi dgos pas ye nas sangs rgyas yin/ /rtsol grub 0lhamed pas ye nas che bar bshad / /mngon par sangs rgyas zhes su bshad pa yin/ /nga yi rang sems mngon du phyung ba 'di/ /snying por gyur pas kun gyi bdag nyid yinas/ /bya mi 101 wa 54

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 55dgos pas ye nas sangs rgyas yin/ /rtsol lasgrub med pas ②ye nas che bar bshad / /bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas che bar bshad/ /ma skyes spros bral mngon du phyung ba 'di / /ye nas gzung 'dzin bral bas chos kyi dbyings/ /bya mi dgos pas ye nas sangs rgyas yin/ /rtsol ④sgrub mi dgos ye nas che bar bshad / /chos dbyings sangs rgyas che ba yin par bshad/ /nga yis nges par mngon du phyung (geb 'di/ /dpe don rtags ni rnam pa gsum bstan (7te/ /chos nyid don la nam mkha'i dpe bstan ⑦te/ /byang chub sems kyi rtags kyis nges (shepa ru/ /the tshom za ba rnams dzinal mngon pa ru/ /dpe don rtags kyis de yin tsosangs rgyas bstan/ /nga yi rang bzhin ma nor nyid 'di ni/ /su la mngon du phyung yang mi snang bas/ /de ni ma nor ba yi rang bzhin la/ /bzhin ni bcos pa med pa'i rang bzhin te/ /nyid ni ngo bo nyid la btags pa yin/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin de nyid la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas yod pa'i sgros tu )mi 'dogs / /khams gsum sems can med pa'i skur mi 'debs/ /rtog dpyod bsam pa cir yang dgongs med pas/ /sangs rgyas med pa'i che bar nga yis bshad / /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rang bzhin rnam pa gsum mngon du phyung ba'i le'u ste bcwa tsho lnga pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des sems dpa' rdo rje la gdams 12ngag phog pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' rdo rje chen po 'di nyon cig /nga ni ye nas kun byed rgyal po yin/ /ston pa bstan pa 'khor dus ngas byas nas/ /ston pa'i ston 7pa yang ni nga yis byed/ /bstan pa nga yi rang 101—55

56 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101bzhin de ston ①la/ /'khor yang nga yi ngo bo de phyung ②nas/ /dus gnas nga yi rang bzhin de ru ni/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin bstan ②pa las/ /nga min chos ni gcig ①kyang bstan pa med/ /sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khyod nyid kyang //kun byed nga yi rang bzhin bstan pa'i phyir/ /khyod kyang nga las nga yis khruphyung ba yin / / kun byed nga ni chos kyi snying por zhog /⑥kun byed nga ni ye nas byas zin gyisaX/ /da gdod bya dgos kun la lung ma ston/ /da gdod bya dgos 'khor la lung bstan na/ /'khor rnams rtsol ba'i nad kyis zin par 'gyur/ /rang 'byung ye shes med pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /byang chub sems la 'chos pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyid la 'chos pa'i skyon ⑧du 'gyur/ /skyon gyis yon tan khyad du gsod 6)par 'gyur/ /brdzun 7gyis bden pa bslus pas bslad (nyapas na/ /min pa'i rtsol tsobs bya med yin ma sgrub/ /sems dpa' khyod kyis kun byed nga rig gis/ /nga yis byas pa'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /ye nas rang 'byung ye shes de bzhin nyid/ /ston gsum nga yi rang 'byung ye shes yin / /bstan pa gsum yang nga yi de bzhin nyid/ /'khor rnams kun kyang sems dpa' rdo rje'i tshul/ /dus gnas 4)phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kun/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yin yibyang chub sems/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las/ sems dpa' rdo rje la gdams ngag phog pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// // cide nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi sku gdung 'di zung shig (6par gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po 'di zung zhigatso /sku gdung 101—56

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 57ring bsrel ①rtag 'chang na/ /rgyal ba'i ②yang ③mes kun byed nga dang mnyam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/ kye dus gsum sangs rgyas kun ④kyi yang mes ⑤ngo/ /ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /sku gdung ring bsrel nyurtag tu zung zhig ⑦pa/ /sku ni rgyal ba gang dang gang gi sku/ /gdung ni sangs rgyas gang dang gang gi gdung / /ring bsrel zhes ni ji lta bu la bgyi / /zhes zhus so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /sku ni nga sras rgyal ba gsum gyi sku/ /gdung ni dus gsum rgyal ba nga yi sems/ /dus ⑧med rtag tu sems dpa' 'di 'chang na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi skyumachod pa'i rten / /sku gdung ring bsrel ⑩zhes ni de la bya/ /kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /sku gdung ring bsrel tunyede ltar lags na yang / /de la dus gsum sangs rgyas ji ltar mchod/ /mchod pa la ni yon tan ci zhig mchis/ /zhes zhus so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po khyod nyon cig /nga yi sku gdung ring bsrel 8de la ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rtag tu sems ltas 4)mchod/ /de yi yon tan tsomi 'bral de thob nas/ /chos rnams kun byed rgyal po nus par 'gyur / /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las sku gdung gtad 8pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des 8chos thams cad kyi chos nyid nga nyid yin pa'i lung 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /snang srid snod bcud thams cad kun/ /snang ni nga yi ngo bor 0snang / /dag ni chos nyid dbyings su dag /'dul ba rnam pa sna tshogs ston/ /sku gsum sna 101—57

58 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101tshogs byung nas ni/ /theg pa gsum ni ngo yang ston/ /rgyu 'bras can ni des tshim byed/ /'das pa yul la mi ltos hu)pas/ /rgyu la mi bsgrub ②'bras mi 'dod / /'dod pa med pa'i dgongs pa dang / /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub par 'gyur/ /ye nas yin ③la bya mi dgos/ /don rnams ji bzhin bskyod med pas / /ji bzhin pa la bsgrub ④mi dgos/ /chos kun rang bzhin lhun grub phyir / /dus gsum sangs rgyas grub pas kyang / /rtsol zhing sgrub (5)pa'i lung mi 'bogs / /btsal na gang btsal (6)ting 'dzin des/ /mi grub (7)ting 'dzin nad du che/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga min ston pa thams cad kyis/ /bya ba'i phrin las sna tshogs dang / /bsam pa'i ting 'dzin rim pa dang / /'phro (kyeba'i 'od zer sna tshogs dang / /blta 5)ba'i yul ni ci dmigs kyang / /ji bzhin pa la 7g.yos pa med/ /bya ba'i las kyis 7grub pa med/ /bsam pa'i ting 'dzin yal bar 'gyur/ /'phro (nyaba'i 'od zer zhi 'gyur tson/ /blta yul gang yang mthong ba med/ /des na btsal ba'i las ma byed/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/yul las btsal bas grub pa'i lung de ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg can ston par byed/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg can chos nyid niyi/ /chos dang chos nyid rnam pa gnyis phye nas/ /chos kyis 7chos nyid tshol ba rnyed lung med/ /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las btsal bas mi 'grub pa'i le'u ste bcwa tshabargyad pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des ma kyi 7btsal bas grub pa/ le'u 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga las byung ba'i 101—58

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 59ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /bstan pa'i theg pa rnam gsum bstan pa ni0)/ /ston pa gsum gyis mi stsol ②phung ma bstan②/ /kun byed nga yis theg gcig ④bstan pa ni/ /btsal bas 2grub pa'i lung du ngas ma bstan/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /kun byed byang chub nga yi rang bzhin las/ /ma btsal rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi snying po sku gsum steyi/ /nga yi dzi)rang bzhin ma bcos chos skur 2grub/ /nga yi ngo bo ma bcos longs spyod rdzogs/ /nga yi thugs rje mngon phyung sprul sku gsum/ /btsal nas grub pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa med/ /ces gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /sku gsum kun byed nga ru 'dus pa ste/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun / /rang bzhin ngo bo thugs rjes ma bcos gsum/ /sku gsum nga yi de bzhin nyid du bstan/ /nga dang nga yi de bzhin nyid las ni/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya'i yon tan kyisgros yikyang med/ /sems can zhes bya'i skyon gyi rnam pa med/ /mi rtog mnyam pa nyid du de bzhin gnas/ /'di las ma gtogs lhonyepa ni gzhan med pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'di las lhag pa yi/ /kun byed nga la nges lung mnos yo pa med/ /byed mkhan kun byed rgyal po nga yis kyang / /mi rtog mnyam nyid de bzhin nyid 'di tunyelas/ /nyid la nyid kyis bstan pa rdul tsam med / /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi byung khungs nyid las byung ba 'di gsungs so/ /kye chos kun sdud pa'i rdo rje nyon/ /101—59

60 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems/ / nga ni chos kun snying po ste/ /①nga ni chos kun sa bon yin/ /nga ni chos kun rgyu yang yin/ /nga ni chos kun sdong po ste/ /nga ni chos kyi gzhi ②ma yin/ /nga ni chos kyi rtsa ba yin/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /'dus pa'i phyir na snying por bshad/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /skye ba'i phyir na sa bon yin/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun//'byung ba'i phyir na rgyu yang yin/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kyi/ /yan lag 'byung bas sdong po yin/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /nga la gnas pas gzhi ma yin/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /nga yin pas na rtsa ②bar bshad/ /kye sems dpa' chen po rdo rje nyon cig /kun byed byang chub sems nga ni/ /rang bzhin ma bcos rnam gsum las/ /ming tsam sku gsum byung tshul bstan/ /nges par sku gsum ston pa yang / /de bzhin nyid las g.yos pa med/ /kun byed byang chub sems nga ni/ /ma skyes gzung ④'dzin bral ba las/ /chos sku skye med ming tsam byung / /nges par chos sku duming tsam ste/ /de bzhin nyid las g.yos pa med/ /kun byed byang chub sems nga yi ngo bo ming tsam mngon phyung ba(6)/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku ming tsam tshul/ /nges par longs spyod rdzogs sku de/ /de bzhin nyid las g.yos pa med/ /kun byed byang chub sems nga ni(7)/ /thugs rje sprul sku mngon phyung ba/ /thugs rje ma bcos rang bzhin las/ /ming tsam sprul sku tshul byung (7ba/ /nges par sprul pa'i sku de yang / /de bzhin nyid las g.yos pa med/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin las / /sku gsum g.yos pa med pa bzhin/ /sku gsum bstan pa'i chos rnams dang / /sku gsum 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams dang / /chos rnams kun la'ang 101—60

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 61g.yos pa med/ /ma g.yos pa yi chos nyid la/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 6)btags ②byas nas/ /rtsol dang bsgrub ①pa byas nas ④ni/ /rgyu las ⑤'bras bu 'byung 'dod pa/ /kun byed nga las byas pa yi/ /rgyu 'bras 'das las gol ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po khyod ༅nyon cig /nga las byung ba'i sku gsum ston pa dang / /nga las byung ba'i dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /nga las byung ba'i 'khor gnas dus la sogs/ /kun kyang nga yi ④byang chub sems yin nal/ /sems dpa' rdo rje de la rtog mi rtog /sems dpa' rdo rje de la ma rtog shig6) /nga ni ye nas kun byed rgyal po 7byang chub sems/ /nga yis byas pa kun kyang byang chub sems/ /nga yi rang bzhin ye nas rnam dag byang / /nga yis kun la khyab pa ye nas chub/ /nga yis rang bzhin gsal 7bas ⑫ye nas sems/ /nga ni nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin gyis/ /ye nas yin pa'i byang chub sems kyis ni/ /'jig rten sgyu tunyemar snang ba'i chos bzhin du/ /sku gsum ston pa dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ /bu dang tsha bo 'khor gyi tshul byung nas / /ma nor bden pa'i gdams cingag 'bogs pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems ni nam mkha' bzhin bstan nas/ /kun byed byung tshul nam mkha' bzhin du bstan/ /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po'i mdo las chos thams cad byang chub sems kun byed las byung ba'i khungs kyi le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi khungs kyi rgyal po yin pa'i phyir nyid las byung ba'i tshig 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems 101—61

6 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101dpa' chen po rdo rje khyod nyon cig /nga ni chos rnams kun byed rgyal po ste/ /sku gsum ston pa'i pha ma nga yin la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi mes po yin/ /'khor gnas dus kyi ston pa'i sgron ma byed/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rnam hu)gsum las/ /sku gsum ston pa nga las phyung ⑤bas ni/ /sku gsum de yi bshad lugs rnam gsum gyis/ /chos kyi bshad lugs rnam pa gsum yang bstan/ /de yang kun byed nga yis bstan (kyepa yin/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yis rang bzhin 'di / /ston pa kun las khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir/ /gtan tshigs don gyi bshad lugs rnam pa lngas/ /ma nor nges pa'i gtan ④tshigs khungs (snyebastan to/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems ni ye nas rdzogs pa che/ /rdzogs pa chen po rgyu 'bras 'das/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i bshad lugs bstan (6)pa dang / /kun byed byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las / /sku gsum ston pa byung ba'i bshad lugs dang / /rnam pa gnyis kyi bshad lugs bstan pa'o/ /kun byed byang chub sems kyi bshad lugs ni/ /byang chub sems ni rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i phyir/ /gtan tshigs don gyi bshad lugs lnga yis bshad/ /sku gsum ston pa gsum gyi bshad lugs ni/ /phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga nang du/ /chos kyi sku ni byin gyis brlabs (7)kyis bshad//longs spyod rdzogs pa rang gi ngo bo ston/ /sprul pa'i sku ni don rnams tshig tu sdeb8 / /sku gsum ston pa'i bshad lugs rnam gsum ste/ /nga yis po)rang bzhin rnam gsum bshad lugs yin/ /kun byed nga ni rgyu 'bras 'das pa ste/ byu/rgyu 'bras 'das pas spyod yul kun las 'das/ /kun las 'das pa'i chos nyid byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems ni kun gyi snying po yin/ /snying po yin pas 101—62

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 63yid ches khungs kyang bstan/ /byang chub sems ni chos kun rtsa 0)ba ste/ /rtsa ba yin pas thams cad don yang 'dus/ /byang chub sems ni khyad par kun las 'phags / /khyad par 'phags pas ②theg pa'i shan yang 'byed/ /byang chub sems rtogs chos nyid kun sangs rgyas/ /des na skal ①ldan dgos ched ④bstan pa yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin tshig tu brjod med dephyi/ /ma brjod 6)sems kyi rang bzhin mi ⑦snang bas/ /mi snang mtshon du med ces ma brjod (nyan/ /kun kyang rang sems ma mthong rtsol 0sgrub byed/ /des na brjod med tshig gi don yang bshad/ /des na gtan tshigs don gyi bshad lugs lngas/ /kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems kyi don/ /ma nor nges par gtan ⑩la 'bebs par byed / /rgyu 'bras med par gtan la phab pa yin/ /thams cad byang chub sems yin yid kyang ches/ /byang chub sems yin ye nas yid ches pas /sems la btsal ba med par yid kyang ches/ /btsal du ye nas med par yid ches pas/ /mi rtsol ⑩bde ba chen po ngang la gnas snye/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin de ltar gnas/ /kun byed nga las nyunyesangs rgyas gzhan med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las gtan tshigs bshad lugs kyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des sems rnal du gzhag pa'i phyir bya med rdzogs pa'i lung khungs chen po 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po yirdo rje khyod nyon cig /kye bya med yul ni mi gnas nam mkha' 'dra/ /mi gnas dmigs pa'i yul med mi rtog 7chos kyi lam/ /bsngo 57ba'i cha shas phra 101—63

64 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101mo'i yul la byung ba ste/ /rtog sgom chos kyi sku ni khyad par don med pas/ /rang 'byung ye shes mi rtog kun tu ji bzhin gnas/ /bya bral yul la mi gnas gnyen pos bcos su med/ /yan lag chos kyi dbang gis snying po'i yul tshol zhing ske/ /rnam pa cir ①yang mi rtog thabs kyis de la rol/ /snying po rang bzhin 'byung bas chos sku gzhan na med/ /rdul phran gcig la gtses ②shing phyogs bcu kun dang bral/ /mi gnas don nyid legs pa'i ye shes rang 'byung ste/ /mngon sum ⑧kun la mi rtog yangs pa'i snying po la/ /rnam dag lam der zhugs nas mnyam pa'i rgyal po thob/ /mi 'gyur 'gyur ba med pas chags pa'i gnas med de/ /de bzhin bzung ④ba'i yul med sems kyi gnas kyang med/ /mngon sum (gethob par 'dod nas rgyu la rtag tu sgom/ /sgom ⑦chags bde ba de la mnyam pa'i don mi 'byung / /sku gcig kun la khyab pas bsnan ⑦pa'i chos med de / /mtha' la thug pa med pas dbyings la bri ba med/ /chos kyi rol pas nyams phag lhag pa'i gnas med de/ /rang 'byung che ba'i yul la kun du ji bzhin gnas/ /ngo mtshar mthong ba'i yul med de la mthong ba'i mig /gang la thos par mi rigs snyad (87pa kun dang bral/ /chos dang chos min rtag tu 'dres 6)shing mtshungs/ /don dam chos shes lhag pa'i gnas shes bshad pa'ang med/ /'khrul dang byang chub lam de (7rtog pas thob pa'ang med/ /rang 'byung ye shes nyid kyang tshig gi mtha' dang bral/ /ye nas rgyas pa'i (habadag nyid mngon sum (sheganas pa la/ /grib ma gzugs kyi dpe bzhin de la rtog pa 'byung / /medade med pa ma yin med pa'i snying po 'byung / /stong ste tu stong pa tsom yin stong pa'i yul la gnas/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin de la 'byung ba'i dran pa skye/ /bya bral 101—64

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 65zin pa'i bde ba 'dod pa med pas len/ /bza' ba'i yul med de la ye shes 'byung ba rtsomaphyi/ /sngon gyi drang srong rjes su chags pa'i yid kyang 'jog /rnam rtsol ②'bad pa'i gdung pas kun tu zin ta re/ /rang bzhin lam der zhugs pas thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /ji bzhin pa zhes rnam rtog de phyir rtog bsgom pa//bde ba chen po 'dod pas chags pa'i nad yin te/ /mi g.yo mnyam par gnas pas sman chen ma byas na/ /mtho ris bgrod pa'i rgyu des nyon mongs zin par 'gyur / /lam med lam du zhugs pa rnams kyi nad che ba/ /phyin par 'dod pas ri dgas nismig rgyu snyegs ④pa 'dra/ /rnyed (9pa'i yul med 'jig rten gsum du mi 'byung zhing / /sa bcur ltos pa'i gnas kyang byang chub sgrib pa yin//shin tu myur ba'i ye shes bsam pa kun dang bral/ /bshes 6)gnyen kun las 'byung ba'i nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /dmigs pa med cing 'gyur ba'i gnas la mi ltos par/ /rang gi rang bzhin legs pas chare ba thams cad skong / /brtags na med la bzhag (kyen legs pa po)'byung ba che/ /dngos su mi snang chags pa'i cha lugs kun la ston / /bdag dang gzhan du bral ba'i ston mkhan rin chen mdzod/ /thams cad grub pa'i yul zhes bdag med snying rjes bstan/ /nang nas ma g.yos nang du btsal ba'i gnas med de/ /yul phyir chags la yul la (nyebasngo ba'i dmigs pa med/ /mi 'byung mi 'jug bdag med snying rje de tu yis ni / /gzhan gyi nor tu min mi 'ong ye nas gnas pa yin/ /bde ba 'dod na bde la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /bde bas zin te bde bas bde ba tshol/ /byang chub 'khrul pa ye rngam chos la za/ /'di lta'i yul can sangs rgyas mthong ba med/ /sangs rgyas med pas khasangs rgyas ming yang med/ /sangs rgyas ston pas ming du 101—65

66 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (gyi 101btags 0)pa nor/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas thob byed nor ba'i lam /gzugs med chos kun bshad pa rdul tsam med/ /zin dang chags dang bral dang zhi / /dngos po med dang rnam par spong / /bdud rtsi chen po'i rang bzhin la/ /bza' ba'i thabs la rag ②pa med/ /yangs so che'o ②chos chen po/ /chung ngu rnams kyi gnyen ④po yin/ /che la dmigs pa'i cha bsnyams ⑤nas/ /chung che de rnams dmigs dang bral/ /gsung dang rgyas dang dmigs dang snang / /sgyu ⑥mkhan ri mo'i rnam pa bzhin/ /'byung 'jug ye shes rmugs ⑦pa yis/ /de yi dbang las skye bar 'gyur/ /'di ni theg pa kun gyi rgyal/ /btang ngo bzhag go rang bzhin te/ /'dod pa med cing len pa med/ /brod pa rdul tsam mi bskyed ⑧do / /khyung chen nam mkha' lding ba bzhin/ /spro 6)ba med cing bsdu ⑩ba med/ /stor bar mi dogs bza' ba med/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du ye gnas la/ /chos rnams sna tshogs 'byung bar byed/ /yon tan tunyanam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyamatso/ /bsdu nyageba'i gnas su nges pa med/ /byang chub snying por de ma thag /ting 'dzin rgyal po chen po 'byung / /snang ba rgya tsomatsho chen po bzhin/ /mi rtog 7nam mkha'i mtha' ltar yangs/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod yul la/ /skye zhing 'pho ba'i chos med de/ /rgyu rkyen yan lag bcu gnyis po/ /skur pas brtags yipas bshad pa yin/ /'khrul pa rnams kyi sgo tsam du/ /mkhas pas de bzhin shes par gyis/ /'gro ba rgyud drug snang ba yang / /dang po'i lam du shes par bya/ /'dod spyod snying rjes brlan pas na/ /gang du dga' bar byang chub spyod/ byu/shan 1 pa smad 'tshong mtshams med lnga/ /kha na ma tho 'jig rten spong / /yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi rtsis18/ /bde ba che las gzhan med do/ /yang tu chos thams 101 —66

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 67cad de bas na/ /chos kyi rang bzhin de yin 6)pas/ /chos kyis chos nyid btsal ②ba dang / /nam mkhas srinam mkha' stibatsal (snyeb dang / /gzhan la ltos pa'i chos nyid ni/ /me yis me gsod (6)pa 'dra ste/ /shin tu dka' ba'i las byed pa'o/ /rnam par mi rtog snying po 'di/ /yongs kyi rgyud la sbas pa med / /mi len byang chub spyod rnams la/ /rnam pa kun tu rang bzhin ⑦gnas/ /zhes (nyagasungs so/ /bya med rdzogs pa'i lung bcu las mi gnas yul med kyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des lta 59)ba yul med kyi lung 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams ni / /rang gi byang chub sems yin pas/ /de la blta ba'i yiyul ma mchis/ /mi rtog pas na mnyam pa nyid/ /de bzhin nam mkha'i dgongs pa ste517/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni de la bya/ /dbang po lnga la snang ba rnams/ /rang gsal nyu de la mi rtog tsho pas/ /de yang nam mkha'i dgongs pa gnas/ /rnal 'byor de bzhin nyid du gnas/ /tshig dang yi ge don brtags 8pas/ /tshig yig don la brtag med pas/ /rtog med mnyam pa de bzhin nyid/ /de yang nam mkha'i dgongs pa gnas/ /bsam du med pa'i don 'di ni/ /nam mkha' bzhin du ye gnas so / /zhes gsungs so/ /bya med rdzogs pa las lta ba yul med kyi nam mkha'i dgongs pa bstan pa'i le'u ste 'artsa gsum pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des bya med rdzogs pa'i lung 101—67

68 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101phyag rgya bzhugs 6)tshul gyi le'u 'di bstan lato/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /sems nyid kun du bzang po yi/ /bzhugs tshul bstan pa 'di lta ste/ /byang chub sems su bzhugs tsam na/ /chos rnams kun gyi snying por bzhugs/ /de rtogs kun byed rgyal po yin①/ /kun byed rgyal po 'gyur ba med/ /des na 'gyur ba med par bstanali/ /chos kyi sku ru bzhugs tsam ⑤na/ /gzung ⑥'dzin spros ⑦dang bral nas bzhugs/ /gzung (nya'adzin bral la 'gyur ba med/ /longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhugs tsam na/ /'dod pa'i yon tan ⑨lnga ldan pas/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs par bzhugs/ /sprul pa'i sku yiru bzhugs tsam na/ /gang gis 'dul ba'i dus tsam na/ /gang la gang dgos sku sprul nas/ /dgos pa phun sum tshogs par bzhugs/ /dus gsum 'gyur ba med par bzhugs/ /chos kun phyag rgya (7nam mkha'i 7mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de bzhin nyid/ /sku gsum mtshan nyid de bzhin gnas/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid du gnas(nya/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos kun ni/ /ji bzhin pa la bcos su med / /btsal zhing bsgrub yipa thams cad kyis/ /snga pa bgrod pas phyin pa gcig 7kyang med/ /snga ma 7byas pas zin pa gcig 7kyang med/ /bsgrubs (nyashing 37btsal bas snga ma ( )grub pa med/ /thams cad ji bzhin pa la 'gyur ba med / /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las bya med rdzogs pa phyag rgya ( nya'agyur med kyi lung gi le'u ste ( nyartsa bzhi pa'o// // byude nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des khams gsum gyi sems can la rang gi sems ston pa yin par bstan pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye khams gsum 101wa 68

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 69sems can thams cad kun/ /rang gi byang chub sems de ni/ /ston pa yin par ①mngon bstan na②/ /bskal pa brgya phrag stong du ni/ /rang sems ston par ma mthong bas/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni/ /rang sems ston pa mngon phyung bas/ /rang sems ston pa'i chos nyon cig① /kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni / /kun rgyu byang chub sems las ni/ /sems kyi ngo bo 'byung chen lnga/ /ston pa byang chub sems lnga phyung / /sku ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /chos ni rang gi ngo bos 'chad/ /ston ni rang gi rang bzhin ston/ /ston pa longs spyod rdzogs sku de/ /dgongs pa nyid la nyid mi rtog /yul chos gzhan la'ang rtog mi byed/ /byang chub sems kyi ston pa lngas/ /kun kyang chos nyid de bzhin ston//byang chub sems kyi ye shes des/ /ston pa sa yi skur byung nas/ /tshig dang yi ges mi ston te④/ /rang gi rang bzhin ston byed pa/ /bdag tu mi rtog gzhan mi rtog /mi rtog mnyam ⑤pa'i dgongs pa stonayi/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis/ /de rtogs sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam / /rtsol ⑧ba'i chos nyid ma btsal 'grubayonye/ /byang chub sems kyi ye shes des/ /ston pa chu yi skur byung nas/ /tshig dang yi ges mi ston te/ /rang gi ngo bos ston byed pa/ /bdag tu mi rtog gzhan mi rtog /mi rtog mnyam pa'i dgongs pa ston/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis/ /de rtogs tsosangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rtsol (7ba'i chos ni ma btsal grub8/ /byang chub sems kyi ye shes des/ /ston pa me yi 'o skur byung nas/ /tshig dang yi shes mi yiston teyi/ /rang gi ngo bos chos ston pa/ /bdag tu mi rtog gzhan mi rtog /mi rtog mnyam pa'i dgongs pa ston/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis/ /de rtogs sangs rgyas 101—69

70 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101kun dang mnyam/ /rtsol ①ba'i chos nyid ma btsal grub/ /byang chub sems kyi ye shes des/ /ston pa rlung gi skur byung nas/ /tshig dang yi ges mi ston par/ /rang gi ngo bos chos ston pa/ /bdag gzhan gnyis su mi rtog par/ /mi rtog mnyam pa'i dgongs pa ②ston/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis/ /de rtogs sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rtsol ba'i chos ni ma btsal grub/ /byang chub sems kyi ye shes des/ /ston pa nam mkha'i skur byung nas/ /tshig dang yi shes mi ston te/ /rang gi ngo bos chos ston pa/ /bdag gzhan chaganyis su mi rtog par/ /mi 'byed pa yi dgongs pa ston/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis/ /mngon (gaphyung ston pa de rnams kyis/ /rang gi ngo bos chos 'chad pa/ /'di yis kun kyang rig par gyis/ /kye khams gsum sems can thams cad kun/ /kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni/ /khyed rnams nga yis byas pa'i phyir / /nga yi sras yin nga dang mnyam(5)/ /nga dang mi gnyis nga yin phyir/ /nga yis khyed la mngon phyung ba/ /nga yi ngo bo ston pa lngas/ /rang bzhin rnam lnga gcig tu bstan/ /gcig ni kun byed nga yin gyis(6)/ /de bzhin khyed kyang yid ches gyis/ /kye khams gsum sems can ma lus kun/ /nga med tsam na khyed kyang med/ /khyed med tsam gyi dus tsam na/ /ston pa lnga yang 'byung mi 'gyur / /mi rtog chos kyang ston mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rang sems ston (7)par phyung ba'i le'u ste (8)rtsa lnga pa'o// // chode nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos sems las byung ba'i chos chen 101 —70

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 71po lnga 6)ston par byung ②ba'i rtags su ma skyes pa'i byang chub sems ston par zhal gyis bzhes ①pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po 0nyon cig /bsam 'das brjod ⑤du med pa'i byang chub sems/ /ston pa'i sgron mar gyur pas yon tan skyorab bsngags ⑦pa/ /chos kyi snying por gyur pas 'jam dpal gzhon nu nyid / /bya nibral lhun rdzogs bde ba'i lhun la gnas/ /tshul khrims la sogs spyod pa rgya ⑨mtsho'i gzhir ⑩gyur pa'i/ /ji snyed rnam par grol ba'i lam bstan ⑩pa / /bde gshegs yum 'gyur kun gyi mtshungs tsolam de/ /de med mi 'byung de phyir de ni rnam grol mchog gi lam/ /phra zhing shes dka' kun gyi lam ste mi rtog rtog las 'das/ /mi gnas mi dmigs spros med bsam pa kun dang bral/ /tshig gis mi phebs dbyibs dang kha dog spyod yul med/ /bstan cing brtag ⑫par dka' la brjod du rdul tsam med/ /sngon gyi drang srong lam du gang zhugs ④pa / /bsgom chags lam gyi nad kyis zin ta re/ /ston 8pa'i lung bzhin tshig gi mtha' spyod lam du de mthong na/ /de ni rtog pa'i rgyun 'brangs tsomig rgyu snyegs ⑪pa 'dra/ /yang dag lam ni tshig gis mtshon du med/ /yang dag nyid du bstan tsopa nga yis 'khrul/ /dag dang ma dag gnyis med 'dres ()shing mtshungs/ / rnam pa ru )cir ( nyayang mi 'byed ye shes gti mug dang / /thogs med gsal ba'i mar me bsam pa kun dang bral/ /ngang gis mi g.yo rmugs shing ting 'dzin rgyal por gnas / /mngon sum mthong bas mthong med mngon sum mthong ba'i mig /de phyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ()zhes de la bya/ /mtha' dang dbus med yangs zhunyepa'i snying po la/ /mi len mi 'dor mnyam pa'i rgyal por gnas/ /sems dang bag chags gnyis med 'dres ( steshing mtshungs/ /'dzin pas brtags (nyeshing snang 101—71

7 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101ba'i chos rnams ni/ /rang gi rgyan du snang bas mi 'dor spong mi byed/ /cir yang mi dgongs thabs kyis de la rol/ /kun dang mi mthun yongs kyis spong ba'i chos/ /nyon mongs lnga dang mtshams med lnga po yi/ /rnam dag lam der zhugs nas mnyam pa'i rgyal po thob/ /bud med la sogs kun kyang spong mi byed/ /lo ①rgyus don gnyis tshad ma'i blor bzhag nas/ /ting 'dzin gsum po brten ②nas grub pa'i mtha' spyod pa/ /rtsod bral lung las gol zhes 'khrul pa yin/ /bya bral lhun rdzogs bde ba'i lhun la gnas/ /ye shes rang 'byung che ba'i snying po nyid / /mi g.yo mi 'gyur bsnyad ②pa kun dang bral/ /zin ④pa'i bdud rtsis rtsol ⑤ba'i sdug bsngal 'joms/ /bya bral zin pa'i yul la ji bzhin gnas/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig⑥ /chos rnams thams cad thig le chen po'i rang bzhin yin pas na/ /spros pa med cing bsdus ⑦pa med/ /skye ba med cing 'gag ⑧pa med/ /'gog pa med par de bzhin gnas/ /rnam par mi rtog snying po 'di/ /nam mkha' bzhin du ye gnas pas/ /rtog 6)pa'i smra kyibasam yul las 'das/ /zhes (nyugasungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las bya med rdzogs pa 7bsgom ()du med pa'i le'u ste 8rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi gdams snyingag phog pa dang mthun ⑩pa'i lung chen po rim gyis bstan te/ kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /chos rnams thams cad nga las byung ba (men/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /ye nas rnam dag dbyings kyi lung du bstan/ /phyi dang nang kun (3ye nas chos kyi dbyings/ /ye nas rnam par dag pa'i spyod yul 101—72

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 73la / /sangs rgyas dang ni sems can gnyis su med/ /lam dang gnyen pos bcos su ga la yod/ /bsgrub med rtsal sprugs smon pa med pas na/ /bya med lhun rdzogs snga ①ma de nyid don/ /rtog spyod rnam dag gnyis med chos dbyings la / /log rtog byis pa'i spyod ②pas ci zhig bslus/ /gnyis med bde chen sems can kun spyod la/ /'khrul pas nor ba'i lam du brtags ①pa yang / /gong du bstan pa'i lam chen de la mi gnyis pas/ /mnyam par shes pas sangs rgyas kun gyi rje/ /nga dang bdag tu rtog ④pa mu stegs ⑤'khrul ba'i lam/ /byis pas bslus pas 0chos spyod rtog pa'i lam la btsud pa ni/ /phyin pa'i dus med rtogs pa'i dus med pas/ /chos nyid chos tshol rnyed par ga la 'gyur/ /tshad mar ma gyur slob ⑦dpon spre 'dra'i lung / /bstan dang lam nor rtog pas zin ta re/ /de bas gser la nag tshur gtong ⑧ba yi/ /slob ⑨dpon yang dag ston pa'i rin chen mdzodakyi/ /rin tsothang dpag tu med pas blu tsobar 'os/ /zhes ⑫gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las bya med rdzogs pa rnam dag dbyings kyi lung bstan 8pa'i le'u ste tsom bdun pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos nyid kyi rang bzhin 'gyur med 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga yi rang bzhin dbyings la 'gyur ba med/ /nga yi ye shes nam mkha' 'gyur ba med/ /nga yi chos nyid rang bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /nga sems chos kyi snying po 'gyur ba med/ /de bzhin thams cad 'gyur ba med pa la/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis / /rgyu dang 'bras bur chos la ming btags ⑩nas/ /sprul pas lung bstan 101—73

74 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101dbang po yul spong 'gyur/ /rang rkyen chos lnga 'chang ba'i ①sems can la/ /rang 'byung chos nyid yin par lung ma bstan/ /ngan 'gro sdig sgrib che zhes lung bstan nas/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig spong dge bcu spyod/ /rang 'byung chos la blang dor spyad pa'i phyir/ /rang 'byung ye shes bskal mang ②phyad mi 'gyur/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /sprul pa rang las 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs la / /rang 'byung ye shes lnga yi chos spangs la/ /ye shes lnga spong sridagra lnga choms lung bstan/ /dgra lnga rang 'byung ye shes ma rtogs te④/ /rang sems spong 'gyur nga yis lung ma bstan/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /rang gi sems las byung ba'i chos nyid la/ /don dam kun rdzob bden pa rnam gnyis kyis / /sbyangs nas rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung zer nas/ /bskal pa gsum gyi bar du sbyong byed pa/ /sdom (5)dang pha rol phyin bcus rang mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid 'gyur bar nga yis lung ma bstan(6)/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /rang sems chos nyid ting 'dzin byin brlabs gnas/ /dag pas chu zla bzhin du gsal (8)byas nas/ /rjer ltas de la mnyes pa'i mchod phul bas/ /de la re 'dod grub pa thob re (9)ba/ /chu zla med de rang sems ma rtogs 7pas/ /skye ba bdun gyi bar du rang 'byung gi/ /ye shes med yonyeces nga yis lung ma bstanakyi/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /rang sems byin brlabs cho 'phrul bsgoms (stepa yi/ /ting 'dzin ye shes sems dpa' grogs mnyam des/ /bdag 'dod pa yi dngos grub ster re ba/ /rang 'byung chos nyid de la 'dod len med/ /rang sems bya med mi tshe gsum mi phrad/ /kun byed nga yis lung bstan yim yin no/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /ngang kyilas byung ba'i chos nyid lhar 7byas 101 —74

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 75nas / /phyag rgya ①bzhi dang snying po 'phro 'du yis/ /mi 'gyur ba yi chos nyid rgyur lasgrub byed/ /sems kyi ting 'dzin dbang gis thob sems pa / /des kyang thob par nga yis lung ma bstan④/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /gzhi ma dbyings la 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ /dbyings de 'gyur bar nga yis lung ma bstan/ /dbyings la dbang sgyur dubyed pa'i sku gsum gyis/ /rang 'khor zhi gnas tshol ba'i ting 'dzin bstan/ /des na 'dren pa'i lung du bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin nam mkha' 'gyur ba med pa de⑥/ /rang nyid nam mkha' du nam mkha' 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa de(nya/ /rang nyid chos kyis chos nyid 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin sems nyid 'gyur ba med pa deṇi/ /sems nyid rang gis sems nyid 'grub mi 'gyur/ /mi 'gyur sgyur bar byed pa'i ting 'dzin ni/ /dus dang smon tshulam re ba 'jog pa yi/ /dus la ltos pas ting 'dzin tshi chad 'gyur/ /kun byed nga yis nges 7lung bstan pa med / /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las bya med rdzogs pa 'gyur med btsal mi rnyed pa'i le'u ste 8rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des sems rnal du bzhag pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga ni kun byed byang chub sems / /chos rnams thams cad nga yin te(nye/ /nga yi rang bzhin thams cad ni / /ye nas rnal du bzhag 8pa yin/ /nga yi rang bzhin bstan 8pa nitshu/ /rnam pa lnga ru shes par bya/ /ston pa bstan pa 'khor gnas dus/ /rnam lnga rang bzhin rnal du bzhagatu tsho /ston pa'i rang bzhin 'di ltar bzhag(nye /chos sku ma 101—75

76 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101bcos ①rnal du bzhag /rang nga'i rang bzhin de bzhag ②yin/ /longs spyod ma bcos ngo bo bzhag /nga yi rang bzhin bzhag ①pa yin/ /sprul pa ma bcos thugs rje bzhagadu /nga yi rang bzhin bzhag ①pa ste/ /rang 'byung ye shes bzhag pa yin/ /gnas ni gang na gnas pa'i gnas/ /de yang rnal du bzhag pa yin/ /dus ni snga phyi gang tshogs dus/ /rnal bzhag dus su tshogs pa yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po da ༷nyon cig /phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga/ /ma bcos rnal du bzhag ⑦pa las/ /chos zhes bya ba gzhan yod med/ /kye sems dpa' chen pophyi/ phun sum tshogs par ma 'dus ⑨pa'i/ /chos ni gcig 0kyang yod ma gsungs/ /kye nga ni rnal du bzhag pa yis/ /thams cad chos nyid grol ba yin/ /ston pa ma bcos 0chos nyid grol ba yin/ /bstan pa ma bcos chos nyid grol ba yin/ /'khor yang ma bcos chos nyid grol ba yin/ /kye thams cad grol bar bshad pas na/ /rang lus ma bcos lha ma bsgomatso/ /smra ba'i tshig dang ngag ma 'chos8/ /ting 'dzin ma byed sems ma 'chos bcos pas rnal du 'byor med pas/ /rnal du ma 'byor grol mi 'gyur/ /ma grol chos nyid mnyam mi thob/ /kye sems dpa' chen po 'di lta ste/ /byang chub sems kyi kun byed rgyal po ni/ /ye nas 'das pa'i rnal du bzhag pa la/ /lta ba rnams kyis rnal du 'jog mi shes/ /rdzogs chen kun byed ye nas rnal bzhag la/ /nyan thos rang rgyal rnams kyis thos mthong na/ /dug skye zer nas rang sems spong 'gegs 'gyur/ /des kyang lta ba rnal du 'jog ma 7shes/ /bskal snyipa grangs med 'jog mi shes la gnas/ /theg chen mdo sdes rdzogs chen thos 'gyur na/ /rang sems de bzhin nyid du ma rtogs te/ /ji bzhin nyid du 'jog pa ma shes 101—76

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 77te / /bgrod cing sbyong ①la bskal ②pa gsum du gnas/ /rjes su rnal 'byor sems dpas ⑧thos 'gyur na/ /'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams de bzhin la/ /rang sems de bzhin nyid du ma rtogs par/ /ji ④bzhin rnal du 'jog pa ma dushes pas/ /byang chub yan lag cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyis/ /byin rlobs sems la mi tshe bdun par gnas/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnams kyis thos 'gyur na/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bdag nyid yin pas na/ /ye nas yin la gdod rtsol dusgrub par ⑦byed/ /stong phrag gnyis dang brgya phrag drug tu ni/ /ji bzhin rnal du 'jog pa mi shes te/ /niting 'dzin gsum gyi sa la gnas par byed/ /yongs su rnal 6)'byor rnams kyis ⑩thos 'gyur na/ /ye nas yin la rgyu 'bras ming btags yinas/ /ji bzhin rnal du 'jog pa ma shes te/ /rgyu ni dag pa chos kyi dbyings su grub/ /'bras bu dag pa ye shes dkyil 'khor grubatso/ /bar ma chod kyis 8mi tshe gcig tu gnas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnams kyis thos 'gyur tson/ /ye nas sangs rgyas sa la gnas par 'gyur/ /bya med bde ba chen po 'di yis thob / /bsgrub pa med par ye nas sangs rgyas thob/ /lha mi sems can dbang po mi mthun 8te/ /la la dbang po sbyangs pa'i 'phro can yod/ /la la dbang po ye nas tshig 8chod yod/ /des na dgos ched don zhes bstan pa yin/ /a ti yo ga rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ba/ /a ti zhes ni sgra yi tshig tu bstan/ /a ni ma skyes chos nyid rnal du bzhag⑩ /ti yini ma btsal lhun gyis 'grub yipar bstan6)la/ /yo ga shin tu rnal 'byor rdzogs chen la/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu yod zer smra byed pa/ /de ni rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i don mi ldan/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyis su smra byed na/ /sgro dang skur pa 'debs pa'i tshig yin te/ /de yis 101—77

78 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101gnyis su med pa rtogs pa med/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi rtogs pa yang / /gnyis su ma mthong rnal bzhag nyid du 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las dgongs pa rnal du bzhag pa'i le'u ste ①rtsa dgu ②pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi snying po sems dpa' rdo rje la sems dpa' rdo rje nyid kyi rang bzhin bya med rdzogs pa'i lung mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'di gsungs gso/ /kye sems dpa' rdo rje khyod nyon cig /sems dpa' rdo rje khyod nyid la/ /nyid kyi rang bzhin bstan par bya/ /nyid ni kun byed nga yin te/ /nga ni ye nas byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems ni 'di lta'o / /des na byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' che 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che/ /kun bzang yangs pa (gechos kyi dbyings/ /rnam dag lam (nyachen kun sgrol phyir/ /mi skye mi 'gag cir mi dgongs/ /byams pas don nyid rnam sbyangs phyir/ /snying rje chen po cir mi mdzad/ /che bas che ba'i zab mo yi4)/ /yon tan gcir yang bsngags (8)pa med/ /don rnams ji bzhin mi bskyod 6)de/ /bya ba med pas grol bas grol/ /rang ⑩'byung ye shes btsal med pas/ /grol na grol ba'i lam yang ston / /'byung ba chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /'gro 41ba kun la rang bzhin gnas / /phyin ci log tu kyirnam brtags kyang / /grol ba rang 'byung gzhan las minas / /che ba'i ye shes rnyed dka' skib/ /shes rab thabs la brten 7pas 'grub / /ming tsam gzhan la brten 7'dra yang / /mngon sum bde ba rang las 101—78

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 79'byung —/ /cho 'phrul chen po dka' ba min/ /yon tan kun dang ②stobs kyi rnams / /ji bzhin rtogs ②pa phra ba yis/ /de ma thag tu rang las 'byung / /snang ba med pa'i chos nyid ni/ /ma btsal bzhag pas bsgoms ①pa yin/ /de dang der ni rnam btsal na④/ /de las de bzhin de mi 'byung ⑤/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i chos nyid ni/ /rna dbang gzhan dulas thos mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin lce yi ⑦dbang pos kyang / /de la brjod du rdul tsam ⑧med/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ⑨byang chub sems/ /kun du chub pas rnam par rol7/ /de la bskyod ⑪pa med bzhin du/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ⑩ltar mnyam par gnas/ /khyad par cir ()yang mtshungs pa la/ /las so zhes ni rnam par brtags/ /ci ④ste las kyi dbang 'gyur na/ /rang 'byung ye shes yod ma yin/ /rgyu nyid rdo rje rkyen dang 'dra / /ma skyes pas na 'jig pa med/ /gdod tsonas snying po byang chub la/ /btsal ba'i bsam pas dbyings mi bskyod/ /yon tan chen po'i bsam gtan ⑩ni / /bsam gtan 0nyid pas bsam du med/ /ma bsams tsom sbyangs chos bzhin du/ /rnam rtog nyid las ye shes skye()/ /phra ba'i sgo mor ming btags zhu te / /sems kyi dben pa lam tshol zhing / /dgon 0pa'i rgyud du dben 'dzin cing / /brtags na rnam par rtog 'gyur bsgomaso)/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur ming dubatags ( gete/ /dge sdig gnyis ka rnam par sel/ /'jig rten 'di la bya'abyung ngo zhes/ /blang dor brod ( nyepa mchog tu bskyedabya/ /chags dang ma chags tshig gi lam/ /dbu ma bzhin te brag ca du'adra/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rgyu mthun ( nyezhes/ /'gro ba'i mgon po sems dpas ru )gsungs/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti zhistemug kyang / /byang chub chen po'i lam las byung / /kun spyod yon 101—79

80 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101tan rnam lnga yang / /chos nyid dbyings kyi rgyan zhes gsungs/ /nam mkha' rtog 6)pa skye med cing / /rtog pa de nyid nam mkha' 'dra/ /mi chags nam mkha'i bsngo ②ba las/ /rang don chen po nam mkha' 'byung / /rtog med mnyam nyid chos kyi sku/ /bzung ①bas mi zin chu zla 'dra/ /kun du bzang po'i rol pa yis / /ā li kā li zab tu bstan/ /'di ni a dang mdzes ①pa'i ta/ /pa dang yan lag spros pa bzhin/ /'jig rten yongs kyi spyod yul la/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi zab mo 'byung / /e ma'o dusangs rgyas spyod yul 'di/ /btsal bas rnyed pa'i gnas med de/ /drug gi chos bzhin yul med pas/ /sdongs dupas nam mkha' bsnyabs ⑦pa bzhin/ /gong nas gong du tshangs pa'i lam/ /bya bral chos dang mthun ⑧pa min/ /ci ste lam la bgrod 'egyur na/ /nam mkha'i mtha' bzhin thob pa med/ /de ltar de bzhin de yi phyir/ /de la de bstan de yang thob / /de ni snying po de bas na/ /de las de byung ①ngo mtshar 0che/ /sngon gyi de dang da ltar de/ /de bzhin de yi gnas su che/ /de ltar de yi lam 'dra ba/ /de ni de yi rang bzhin no/ /de dang 'dra ba yongs kyi lam/ /zla ba las byung rten dang bcas/ /kun gyi mnyam (1nyid yin pa la/ /phyogs su bltas pas grub pa med/ /de 7ltar bde dang phyi mar bde/ /mngon sum 8pa dang rgyab nas 'byung —/ /de yang rnam pa'i skyon yin pas/ /de la brten 8par mi bya'o/ /dus gsum gcig ste khyad par med/ /sngon med phyis med gdod nas 'byung / /chos skus khyab pas gcig pa'i phyir/ /che ba'i chen po charang bzhin gnas/ byu /srid pa gsum na sbyor ba yang / /ming tsam sgyu tsomar snang ba ste7/ /'khor los sgyur tsho1 ba'i gnas chen yang / /sgyu 67ma sbyong ba'i bsti gnas yin/ /rnam spyod 101—80

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 81dus la ltos pa rnams/ /dus de 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ /ma bral smon pa spyod pas na/ /stong pa'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa bzhin/ /gcig ①ste rnam pa yongs kyis ②med/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bya lam gnas/ /ma byung ma skyes snying po la / /sgros btags chos kun ga la yod/ /phyi nang gnyis ka phyi nyid nang / /zab mo cha shas ③rtogs yul med/ /srid pa ming tsam log ①pa'i stobs/ /de bas ting 'dzin mnyam dang bral/ /de la tha tshig ⑤phyi dang nang / /rang bzhin phung po khams bzhin gnas/ /dus gsum 'di dang mi 'bral bas/ /tha tshig duming du btags ⑦pa med/ /mi g.yo ⑧ba ni sku ⑨yi rgya0/ /mi bskyod ⑩pas ni ye shes te/ /mi len pa ni bdag med cing / /mi 'dor tshig bral mnyam nyid do/ /gang dang gang gi gang du yang / /kun 'khol kun spyod bdag las byung / /'di la skyes pa bud med ces/ /mnyam pa'i rgyal pos yod tsom gsungs/ /'di la brtul zhugs drag shul gyis/ /gnas su bya ba'i ming med de/ /a dang par ni rnam ldan na/ /sgyu tsoma'i bde ba 'byung bar 'dod/ /rang bzhin gcig 8tu ma nges pas/ /ji ltar bltas pa de ltar snang / /snang 'dod rtsol sems bde ba yang glu/ /de ni de sgrib skyon chen yin/ /byang chub yan lag kun gyi sgo/ /cha lugs bsgoms pas chu zla bzhin/ /ma gos ma chags 'byung 'gyur yang / /bsgoms 8pas byis pa'i spyod yul bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor khro gnyer cha lugs kyis / /khro bdag chen po'i lus bzung tsonas/ /yi ge mngon du byung na yang / /zhi ba de nyid mthong ba min/ /nyon mongs pa yi dbang gis na/ /ta la'i mgo bo bcad pa dang / /sa bon me yis bsregs pa dang / /de yi dbang du mi 'gyur ston/ /rnam grangs brgya stong phrag yas pa/ /gang ltar spyad kyang me tog 101—81

8 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101skye / /mtshan ma med pa'i dbang gis na①/ /bsti gnas de las 'byung mi 'gyur / /gleng bral 'di la gnas pa ni/ /rnal 'byor de ni skal ②ba bzang / /bdag dang gzhan don mi 'byed pas/ /sgyu ①ma lhun grub yul la rol/ /lhag ma med pas yongs su rdzogs/ /'gyur ba ma yin drang por gnas/ /nam mkha' bzhin te mtha' mnyam ④zhing / /gzhan la ltos 'gyur chos ma yin/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i bde chen de/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes kyis⑤/ /rang gi mthu yi rig pa las/ /chos ni gzhan las 'byung mi 'gyur/ /sla duzhing dka' ⑦la sla phyir dka'/ /mngon sum mi gnas kun du khyab/ /ming tsam 'di zhes bstan par ni/ /rdo rje sems dpas mtshon du med/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung rol pa 'di/ /bya bral nam mkha' bzhin du gnas/ /cir yang mi dmigs gti nimug las/ /de ma thag tu rang las byung / /'di ni thams cad mtshungs pa'i lam/ /'gro ba kun gyi rang bzhin gnas/ /bus pas bslad pas 'khrul pa'i phyir/ /sman nyid sman pa tshol ba bzhin⑨/ /go ba'i yul na bde ba che/ /'di ni rnam dag 'jig rten yin/ /de la phyogs kyi 'od 'dus pas/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams dang bla 'og 'grub/ /ma nges 'ja' tshon kha dog las/ /rigs kyi khyad par mngon 7par snang / /de bzhin g.yo rdul mi g.yo ba/ /'byung ba lnga bas gtso hu7chen yin7/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /tha snyad ming la mi gnas te/ /skye 'gag med par rnam brtags shing / /de nyid dus gsum chen por sbyor/ /mnyam pas rim par bkod pa med/ /gcig pas phyogs bcu bsngo dang bral/ /tshogs kyi rgyan hu rnams bkram pa yang / /rang bzhin gnas pas 'grim mipa med/ /lhun gyis gnas pas mi bsngo zhing / /gdod nas dag pas 101—82

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 83bdud rtsi yin/ /'du mched bcu gnyis khyad par du/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas bzung ba med/ /yid kyis bsam pas yon bdag stenyu/ /bltas pas tshogs ni bkram pa'o/ /mthong bar gyur pas dngos grub la/ /de nyid mnyam bzhag rdzogs pa'o/ /yud tsam bzung bas sbyor ba yin/ /dga' bar gyur pas dam tshig ste/ /thabs kyis gar thabs bskyod pa yis/ /gnyis med sbyor ba phul ba yin / /mi bzung gtong bas gtong ②ma yin/ /bya ba med pa'i las rnams te/ /mi rtog ye shes bgegs bsal nas/ /ma gsungs ③mnyam bzhag sngags dutshig go / /bla ma mchod dang gtong ba dang / /de bzhin bsod nams thams cad kyang / /ma chags mi g.yo'i stobs med na/ /byas na 'ching ba chen por 'gyur//de bas de lung de nyid la/ /de la de sbyar sgrib ⑤par 'gyur/ /de ltar de la de rtog na/ /de la de nyid grub pa med/ /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi le'u ste sum cu ⑥pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des kun byed kyi rang bzhin bya med rdzogs pa lhun gyis grub pa 'di gsungs sog/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /sna tshogs rang bzhin mi gnyis kyang / /cha shas nyid du spros dang bral / /ji bzhin pa zhes mi rtog kyang / /rnam par snang mdzad kun du bzang / /zin pas rtsol (0ba'i nad spangs te/ /lhun gyis gnas pas gzhag kyi)pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rdo rje tshig drug gi le'u ste sum cu 7rtsa (stegacig pa'o// //101—83

84 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des sems dpa' rdo rje la ma byas don grub kyi lung nges pa tshig bzhi'i le'u 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po 'di ltar don rig gis/ /ji ltar snang ba de bzhin nyid du gcig /'di la su yang 'chos par ma byed cig /ma bcos mnyam pa'i rgyal po de la ni/ /mi rtog chos sku'i ①dgongs pa de la gnasal/ /zhes dugasungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las nges pa tshig bzhi'i le'u ste sum cu ④tsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des dunyid las byung ba'i chos nyid de nyid kyi rig pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje zhes bya ba/ chos thams cad rig par byed pa'i rgyal po rang 'byung gi ye shes de la nyid kyi rang bzhin rtogs par dka' ba 'di bstan stito/ /kye sems dpa' chen po yid kyi dbang pos sgra rtogs shig /sgra yis don de rtogs rig byos(pe/ /kun gyi gnas ni chos kyi dbyings yin na/ /dbyings kyi sgra (kyedon ji ltar rig par byed/ /kun gyi lta kyi)yul nam mkha'i khams 'di la/ /nam mkha'i sgra don ji ltar rig par byed/ /mngon du gsal 7ba 'byung ba lnga yin na/ /mngon du snang ba'i don ni ji ltar rig /de las byung ba'i khams gsum sems can ni/ /de yi don ni ji ltar rig par byed/ /rig pa'i rgyal pos nyid phyir nga la nyon/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /khyod kyi rang bzhin shin tu rtogaso dka' ba/ /rnam bzhi bstan pa'i sgra yis bdag gis rtogs/ /dbyings kyi sgra yis 'byed pa med par rtogs/ /nam mkha'i sgra yis ma bsgribs gsal (1bar 101—84

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 85rtogs / /'byung ba'i sgra yis kun gyi snying por rtogs/ /sems can sems kyis sgra don de rig byed/ /de rigs ①kun byed shin tu rtogs dka' ②rig /kun byed nyid las gzhan zhes bstan pa ⑧med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas kun byed rgyal pos rig pa'i rgyal po la slar gsungs pa/ nga yi rang bzhin rtogs dka' du'adi rig na/ /chos kyi mdo rtsa duyan lag kun rig gis/ /rig pa'i rgyal po zhes su mtshan yang btagasayi/ /kye byed pa'i rgyal po kun byed byang chub sems / /khyod kyi rang bzhin 'di ltar ④chos nyid 'di/ /sems dang ye shes chos nyid rig pa ste/ /de yi rang bzhin bdag gis 'di ltar mthong sems nyid spros bral sgra (nyeni chos nyid sgra/ /sems nyid ma bsgribs 6)sgra ni nam mkha'i khams / /sems nyid ngo bo snying po 'byung ba'i sgra/ /rig pa so sor rtog pa sems can sems/ /sems kyi rang bzhin las ni gzhan med de/ /kun byed rgyal po sems las gzhan med do/ /ces ⑩gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po / nga yi rang bzhin de rig na/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rig pa yin/ /nga rig gcig yirig kun rig thams cad rig /sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khyod la ni/ /rig pa'i rgyal po zhes su ming btags so/ /kye rig pa'i rgyal pos de ltar rig gyur na/ /nga tsolas byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /bstan pa'i theg pa rnam pa gsum byung nas/ /rgyu las 'bras bu 'dod pa gsum gyis ni/ /bya ba'i las ni ⑩lta spyod sna tshogs kyis/ /'bras bu gsum ni gang dang gang sgrub tsopa / /rig pa'i rgyal pos chos de ji ltar rig /ces gsungs so/ /rig pa'i rgyal pos slar cigasungs pa/ kye kun byed rgyal po khyod las byung ba yi/ /sku gsum ston pa khyod kyi ngo bo gsum/ /de gsum bstan pa rnam gsum khyod kyi ldem 101—85

86 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101dgongs te/ /rig pa so so'i sems la ldem dgongs bstan/ /de dag gang la dgongs nas ldem pa bstan①/ /mi 'phro zhi gnas tshol la dgongs pa'i phyir/ /rang re gang 'thad ②yul la ldem du gzhug /sku gsum ston pa drang lung ston pa des / /la las sa dang lam gyi 'bras bu bstan/ /la las dngos min ②chu zla'i 'bras bu bstan④/ /la las nyid kyis nyid bsgrub 'bras bu bstan/ /sku gsum bstan pa ldem dgongs lung bstan te/ /nges par ma bstan drang ba'i 0lung bstan te/ /mi 'phro zhi gnas tshol ba'i ting 'dzin yin/ /rgyu 'bras theg chen drang ba'i lung du 6)bstan/ /ces phyagasungs so/ /kye rig pa'i rgyal po sems dpa' rdo rje nyon/ /don dam nges pa'i lung zhes bstan pa ni/ /rig pa'i rgyal pos rig gam bstan du med/ /mi gnas dmigs par bya ba'i yul ma yin/ /mi rtog rtog las 'das pa'i rang bzhin la/ /ting 'dzin mi bsgom (kyebasam pa'i yul dang bral/ /'dod pa'i sems med blang ba'i 'bras bu ⑨med⑩/ /mi rtog ji bzhin pa ru gnas pa des/ /lam la ma bgrod sangs rgyas sa ru phyin/ /rig pa ma sbyangs rang 'byung ye shes rnyed/ /phrin las ma btsal rang bzhin lhun gyis grubate/ /dam tshig mi sdom rang bzhin rnam par dag /yul dang dbang po de bzhin nyid du gsal6nya/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su ma mthong stesnyi/ /de bzhin nyid du thams cad gcig par mthong / /de bzhin nyid la gcig dang du ma med/ /ma byung ma skyes pa yi snying po la/ /sgros kyis btags pa'i tha snyad ga la yod/ /kye sems dpa' chen po (nyarig pa'i rgyal/ /sangs rgyas yisems can snang srid snod bcud kun/ /kun 7byed nga yi rang bzhin sgros 7skur bral/ /nga yi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid gcig 1rtel/ /sku gsum ston pas so sor bstan 101 —86

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 87pa yang / /de bzhin nyid la drang ba'i lung bstan yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las nges pa'i lung dang drang ba'i lung bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu ①ma gsum pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa nyid la 'dus pa'i mdo 'di gsungs so/ /kye rtogs pa'i rgyal po sgra nyon cig /kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /dgongs pa'i don ni nga la 'dus/ / nga yi (gurang bzhin 'di la ni/ /sku 'dus gsung 'dus dgongs pa 'dus/ /nga yi sgra nyon dgongs 'dus gyis/ /ces zhi)gsungs so/ /kye ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rnam gzigs gtsug tor (4)la sogs te(ge/ /rabs (7bdun shākya thub pa dang / /stong rtsa gnyis kyi sangs rgyas dang / /lhun gyis grub dang rdul snyed kyi(7)/ /dgongs pa khyod la 'dus lags (gusam/ /zhes zhus so/ /de nas kun byed rgyal pos yin pa'i sgra brjod pa/ kye rtogs pa'i rgyal po da (9)nyon cig /ho ho yin pa'i sgra brjod de/ /dpe dang don dang rtog gsum gyis/ /dgongs pa 'dus pa'i don bstan pa/ /nga yi rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ /nga yi don ni chos nyid yin/ /nga yi ngo bo byang chub sems/ /kye nga ni ma bsgribs rtog 7pa med/ /rtog med nam mkha' chos kyi sku/ /nga ni mi rtog (steblang dor med/ /blang dor 8med de nam mkha' 'dra/ /nam mkha' blang dor med pa bzhin/ /kun du bzang la blang dor med/ /blang dor med pa nga las 'dus/ /kye sems dpa' chen po 101—87

88 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101nyon cig /kye nga ni ma skyes nam mkha' 'dra/ /ma skyes pa yi nam mkha' bzhin//rdo rje sems la skye ba med/ /skye med dgongs pa nga la ①'dus/ /rnam gzigs rabs khyabadun shākya thub/ /stong rtsa gnyis dang rdul snyed dang / /lhun grub sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /dgongs pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin te/ /skye med mi rtog blang dor med/ /dpe yis nga la 'dus par bstan/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /kye gong bshad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dgongs pa don gyis 'dus pa ni / /kun byed rgyal po'i rang bzhin ni/ /skye ba med par bstan pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas kun la skye med pas/ /skye dumed chos nyid 'dus par bstan/ /kun byed rgyal po'i rang bzhin la/ /chos nyid 'gag pa med pa bzhin/ /gong bshad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /chos nyid la ni 'gag pa med/ /des na chos nyid 'dus par bstan/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /rtags kyis 'dus par bstan pa ni/ /rtags ni kun rtags byang chub sems/ /kun byed rgyal po sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi sku dang kun du bzang ske/ /rdo rje sems la sogs pa yi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i/ /snying po rtags ni sems su 'dus/ /des na dpe don gsum du 'dus/ /kye kun byed rgyal po nga la ni/ /spyi 'dus sgo 'dus dgongs pa 'dus/ /spyi 'dus dpe don rtogs 'dus la/ /sgo 'dus (9rnam pa lnga 'dus te/ /chos sku dgongs pa 'dus pa ni/ /mi rtog mnyam (7pa nyid 'dus la/ /mi g.yo cho 'phrul 'byin par nus/ /longs spyod sku yi dgongs 'dus pa/ /mngon sum rang bzhin snang ba dang / /'dod pa tshogs pas 'byin par 'dus/ /kun bzang dgongs pa 'dus pa ni/ /ji ltar snang ba thams cad kun/ /bzang ngan 7blang dor med 101—88

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 89pa ru/ /kun byed mngon du phyung bar 'dus/ /rdo rje sems dgongs 'dus pa ni / /mi ②skye mi 'gag dgongs pa 'dus/ /rabs bdun shākya thub pa dang / /stong rtsa gnyis dang rdul snyed dang / /sku gsung thugs kyis don mdzad pa'i/ /byung yang sku gsung thugs las byung / /sku gsung thugs kyi chos nyid la/ /sku gsung thugs kyis ②don mdzad tshul/ /de yang kun byed nyid du 'dus/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na/ /nga ru ma 'dus gcig kyang med/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi gzhal yas na/ /nga ru ma 'dus gcig kyang med/ /ces gsungs pas der sems dpa' rdo rje sngangs ①te brgyal 8lo/ /der brgyal ba ⑤sangs nas zhus pa/ kye 'dus pa'i rgyal po de nyon cig /byas pa'i chos dang kun 'dus na/ /ma byas pa yang kun 'dus sam/ /ma byung ba yang kun 'dus sam//chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i khams/ /mu stegs phyin ci log lta ba/ /rtag chad gnyis su lta ba yang / /khyod kyis ⑥ma nor dgongs yin na/ /sangs rgyas sems can ci la gdagasaskyo/ /mu stegs sangs rgyas ci la rgya/ /ces ⑧gsungs sol/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyal po des bka' stsal pa/ kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga yi rang bzhin rtogs 'gyur na/ /kun kyang 'dus par yid ches na/ /sems dpa' chen po khyod kyis ni/ /nga yi rang bzhin rtogs mi 'dra/ /rtogs mi 'dra bas yid mi chesal/ /kun byed byang chub sems rtogs shig /kun byed byang chub sems rtogs na/ /rang 'byung byang chub sems de yis/ /rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' bsal te/ /ma skyes gzung kyi'adzin bral ba yis/ /rtag ⑩pa'i dngos po mtha' bsal la/ /rang 'byung ye shes 'gyur med pas/ /med pa chad pa'i mtha' 101—89

90 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101yang bsal4)/ /mu zhes bya ba chos kyi dbyings/ /stegs zhes bya ba rtogs pa'i gnas / /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis mthong ba/ /kun byed byang chub sems ma mthong / /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lung gi le'u ste sum cu ②rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos nyid kyi bstan ③pa gzhan ④gyi spyod yul ma yin pa rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung rgyu 'bras rtsol sgrub ⑤las 'das pa 'di bstan yite/ kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga yi spyod yul 'di ⑦ni dka' ba ste/ /sgo dang lta ba dang ni dam tshig dang / /phrin las dang ni bgrod (kyilam gnas pa dang / /ye shes chos nyid rnam pa brgyad po 'di/ /sku gsum theg pa rnam pa lnga po yi/ /theg pa gzhan dang lta spyod mi mthun 6)te/ /sgo ni btsal kyidu med pa'i sgo nas 'jug /lta ba bsgom (1du med par bstan pa yin/ /dam tshig bsrung 7du med par bstan pa yin/ /phrin las btsal du med par bstan pa yinam/ /lam la bgrod du med par bstan pa yin/ /gnas sa sbyang du med par bstan pa yin/ /ye shes mi rtog bskyod (nyapa med pa yin/ /chos nyid ji bzhin bcos su med pa yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po don 'di ni/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa can la bstan 1 )'gyur na/ /'jig rten rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos bzhin du/ /rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung bas mi rigs zer/ /rgyu ni khams gsum sems can las bsgrubs snyinas/ /'bras bu dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung bar 'dod / /rgyu ni lta ba bsgom (7pa byas pa yis/ /gang bsgoms li'abras bu de thob 'dod pa ni/ /bsgom 18pa de yis 'bras bu thob pa med/ /thams cad ji 101wa 90

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 91bzhin pa yi chos yin pas/ /ji bzhin pa la 'chos par byed pa ni/ /brdzun ①gyis bden pa bslus ②pa sdig re che/ /lta bsgom dam tshig la sogs rtsol sgrub rmikyis / /dbang po yul la yengs ④pa phral nas ni/ /dben pa'i yul la thabs kyis khrid nas ni/ /rtog med mnyam pa'i thabs ⑤kyis bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rdzogs pa chen po'i lung bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu stim lnga pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nyid kyi sku gsung spyithugs kyi rang bzhin du 'dus pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga yi rang bzhin 'di rtogs shig /nga ni byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin te/ /byang chub sems ni kun byed rgyal po yin/ /kun byed rgyal po'i rang bzhin sku gsung thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyis ma byas gcig kyang med/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs kyis byas/ /khams gsum sems can lus ngag yid gsum yang (8)/ /kun byed nga yi sku gsung thugs kyis byas / /snang srid snod (9)bcud bsdus ⑩pa thams cad kyang / /ji bzhin ma bcos pa yi chos nyid du/ /kun byed nga yi sku gsung thugs kyis byas/ /zhes 41 gsungs pa dang / sems dpa' rdo rjes slar tsozhus pa/ kye kun byed rgyal po byed pa'i bdag po lags/ /ma rig ma rtogs don 'di bshad du gsol/ /ji ltar byas pa bdag la bshad du gsol/ /zhes zhus pas/ kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga ni sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin te/ /sku ni chos nyid mngon du phyung ba des/ /kun bzang rol pa rmad 5nyedu 'byung 8ba byas/ /gsung gi sgra 101—91

9 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101tshig mngon ①du bsgrags ②nas ni/ /don gyi chos nyid tshig gis go bar bstan/ /thugs ni rang 'byung ye shes 'gag med kyis/ /ston pa ye shes sgron ma byas nas ni / /chos nyid don gyi ngo bo ma nor ston/ /kye sems dpa' chen pos don 'di rtogs par gyis/ /snang srid snod dubacud de ltar snang ba las/ /nga la sku ①yi ngo bo gzhan med pas/ /rang gi ngo bos 'chad 0cing ston pa yin/ /sems dpa' chen po khyod kyis kyang / /ma rtogs gzhan la khyod kyis lung ston cig /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i sgra grag dang / /rgyud drug sems can rnams kyi sgra tshig 'di/ /kun byed nga yi gsung las gzhan med pas/ /tshig sgra don gyis bsdebs dubashad de la bya/ /kye sems dpa' rdo rje khyod kyis kyang / /ma rtogs gzhan la khyod kyis lung ston cig⑦ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /khams gsum rgyud drug sems can thams cad dang / /'byung chen lnga yi mi rtog mnyam nyid dang / /chos nyid mi skye mi ⑤rtog mi 'gag ste / /kun byed nga yi thugs su de las med/ /sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khyod kyis ni/ /ma rtogs gzhan la khyod kyis lung ston cig /sems dpa' chen pos 'di lung ma bstan stin/ /nga yi rang bzhin shin tu mi rtogs te/ /ma rtogs nga dang phrad par mi 'gyur nakyi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi gdung 'tshob pa / /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can thams cad dang / /la dgu lung dgu rgal ba'i sa bcu dang / /tshe la dbang sgyur ()phyag rgya 7lhun gyis grub pa dang ske/ /rig 7'dzin gsum la sogs pa'i gdung 'tshob kyis/ /kun byed nga dang yun du phrad mi 'gyur/ /kun byed nga dang yun du ma phrad na/ /khams gsum rgyud drug gnas pa'i sems can gyis/ /rang gi rang bzhin rang gis ngo 101—92

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 93mi shes/ /sa bcu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /grangs med pa yi bskal pa gsum bgrangs kyang / /kun byed nga dang phrad par yang ①mi 'gyur/ /des kyang rang gi rang bzhin shes mi 'gyur/ /lus la dbang sgyur rig ②'dzin gsum gyis kyang / /lus kyis sangs rgyas longs spyod sku bzung nas/ /yid kyi dbang po rang sems mthong med lta/ /des kyang kun byed rgyal po nga dudang ni/ /rang gi rang bsnyen gnyis med de mi mthong / /ma mthong bar du tshi duchad nad kyis zin⑤/ /de bas nga yi rang bzhin lung ston cig /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las sku gsung thugs su 'dus pa'i le'u ste sum cu 0rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des rdzogs pa chen po'i chos nyid bsgom ⑦du med pa 'di bstan nito/ /kye sems dpa' chen po rdo rje la sogs te/ /rig ⑨'dzin gyi ni sa la gnas pa dang / /sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / /khams gsum sems can dus la bab pa yi/ /kun gyi don chen kun byed nga yin gyis7/ /nga yi rang bzhin chos nyid byang chub sems/ /chos nyid sems la bsgom med rtogs par gyisayi/ /rgyu 'bras ston pa'i sku gsum ston pas ni/ /nga yi rang bzhin chos nyid bsgom 8med la8/ /'jig rten rgyu 'bras chos dang don mthun paratso/ /rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung bar lung bstan nas/ /bsgom byapa'i lung ni 'di ltar so sor bstan/ /chos nyid byang chub sems gcig ngo bo la/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung bden pa rnam pa bzhisatso/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ngan 0song rgyu zer nas(she/ /chos nyid byang chub sems de spong bar byed/ /101—93

94 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101de yis chos nyid mi mthong spangs pa yin/ /chos nyid byang chub sems kyi ngo bo la / /don dam kun rdzob bden pa rnam ①gnyis kyis/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa bcus/ /sa bcu lam la sbyangs te bgrod pa yis/ /chos nyid ma mthong sbyong ba'i sa la gnas/ /chos nyid byang chub sems kyi ngo bo tshul/ /gza' dang rgyu skar gdus tshigs bzang sgo nas/ /byang chub lnga dang cho 'phrul chen po bzhis/ /'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad la/ /byin gyis brlabs (genas lha yi ①skur bsgom ⑥pa/ /de yis rang sems bsgom med mthong ba min/ /chos gcig byang chub sems kyi ngo bo la/ /ting 'dzin gsum dang cho ga rnam pa lngas/ /rang rgyud dag pa'i rdo rje phung po la/ /bsnyen sgrub rnam pa bzhi yi lha bsgoms (7)nas/ /snang la rang bzhin med par (nyebyed pa ni/ /btsal zhing bsgrubs 6)nas rang sems lhar bcos pas/ /des yikyang rang sems bya med mthong ba min/ /rang gi chos nyid byang chub sems la ni/ /kun byed rgyal po ston 11pa'i ston pas kyang / /rang sems ye nas chos nyid grol ba la/ /ston pa gsum la bsgom 12pa'i lung ma bstan/ /sgom (stesgrub btsal na rang sems spangs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po rang sems grub 'dod na/ /'dod pa med pas grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ /rtog med mnyam pa nyid la gnas yimi byed/ /blang dang dor med yul la rang bzhin gnas/ /g.yos pa med pa'i ngang la ngang gis gnas/ /sems ni ji bzhin pa yi ngo bo de(lo / /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin nyid du grub/ /ji bzhin pa la 'chos par ma byed cigs /ngo bo nyid las gzhan du ma sgrubs shigayi 7 /rang nyid yin gyis gzhan du ma tshol cig /btsal na rgyal bas dbyings nas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /101—94
