chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 95sngar byas ①zin pas zhung ①ni byed mi bdog /sngar grub zin pas da grub mi byed par / /mi rtog cir mi dgongs la mnyam par zhog④ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / /rang gi sems las gzhan du chos btsal med/ /ji bzhin pa la 'chos par byed ma myong —/ /ting 'dzin rnam par rtog pa bsgom ⑤ma myong / /rang sems mi rtog pa yis grub pa yin/ /da ⑥ltar bzhugs dang slad kyis byon ⑦pa yang / /rtog med mnyam pa nyid kyis grub ⑧par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las bsgom du med pa'i mdo lung gi le'u ste sum cu 6)rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des 'khor gyi ston pa'i bstan pa gol sa dang sgrib par gyur pa 'di bstan 7to/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /'khor gyi ston pa rnam gsum gyi/ /bstan pa gsum ni gol sgrib ste/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /nges pa thob pa'i theg pa drug /rdzogs pa chen po'i gol sar bstan/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mdo sde ni/ /kun du 'od kyi sa 'dod pa/ /bden pa gnyis kyi rtog dpyod 47kyis/ /chos nyid stong 7pa nam mkhar 'dod/ /a ti yo ga'i bde chen ni/ /rtog dpyod 'das pa'i byang chub sems/ /rtog dpyod dzi 'das la mdo sdes bsgribasa' / /rdzogs chen rtog dang dpyod pa ni/ /mdo sde dag tu gol bar bshad/ /kri ya rdo rje 'dzin 'dod pa/ /dag pa rnam gsum sgor skezhugs nas/ /gzung 8'dzin dag pa'i yul la gnas/ /a ti yo ga'i bde chen ni/ /gzung tshona'adzin 'das 101—95

96 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101pa'i byang chub sems/ /gzung ①'dzin 'das la kri yas bsgribs②/ /rdzogs chen gzung sridang 'dzin byed pa/ /kri ya dag tu gol bar bshad/ /u pa ya yi lta spyod ni/ /kri ya spyod ༷cing yo ga sgrub/ /lta spyod 'brel pa'i don med pas/ /gnyis su med pa'i don ma rtogs/ /a ti yo ga'i bde chen ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i byang chub sems/ /gnyis su med la 0u pas bsgribasaX/ /rdzogs chen gnyis su 'byed pa ni/ /u pa ya ru gol bar bshad/ /yo ga stug ①po bkod ⑧'dod pa/ /mtshan ma yod med sgor zhugs nas/ / phyag rgya bzhi ⑨la gtsor byed de/ /blang dor med la 'jug mi nus/ /a ti yo ga'i bde chen ni/ /blang dor med pa'i byang chub sems/ /blang dor med la yo gas bsgribs/ /rdzogs chen blang dang dor byed pa/ /yo ga dag tu gol bar bshad/ /ma hā rdo rje 'chang 'dod pa/ /thabs dang shes rab sgor zhugs nas/ /rang rgyud dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi sgrub par byed/ /a ti yo ga bde chen ni/ /rtsol 0sgrub 'das pa'i byang chub sems/ /rtsol 0sgrub 'das la ma hās bsgribs8/ /rdzogs chen rtsol 8sgrub byed pa ni/ /ma hā yo gar gol bar bshad / /a nu dbye med sa 'dod pa/ /dbyings dang ye shes sgor tsozhugs nas / /'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams la/ /rgyu ni dag pa'i dbyings lta ba/ /'bras bu ye shes dkyil 'khor lta/ /a ti yo ga'i bde chen ni/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i byang chub sems/ /rgyu 'bras 'das la a nus tsobasgribs/ /rdzogs chen rgyu 'bras gnyis lta na/ /a nu yo gar gol bar bshad/ /lta spyod gnyis kyi gol sgrib ⑩bstan/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta spyod ni/ /rgyu 'bras sgrub dang mi 'dra ste/ /lta spyod byang chub sems de ni/ /nam mkha' lta 101—96

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 97bu'i rang bzhin te/ /nam mkha' la ni rtog dpyod ①'das/ /gang zhig rtog dpyod ②byed pa ①des/ /byang chub nam mkha' bzhin du 'grub/ /rtog dpyod gnyis byung 0gol sgrib po/ /lta spyod ⑤nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /gang zhig gzung rjodang 'dzin byed pas/ /byang chub nam mkha' de mi 'grub/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis byung gol sgrib ①po/ /lta spyod rnam pa gnyis byung nas/ /nam mkha' gnyis su med pa bzhin/ /byang chub la ni gnyis su med/ /gang zhig gnyis su byed ⑧pa des/ /byang chub nam mkha' de mi 'grub/ /lta spyod gnyis byung gol sgrib 0po/ /byang chub nam mkha'i rang bzhin de/ /nam mkha' la ni blang dor med/ /gang zhig blang dor byed pa des/ /byang chub nam mkha' de mi 'grub / /blang zhing dor ba gol sgrib po/ /byang chub nam mkha'i rang bzhin de/ /nam mkha' la ni rtsol 0sgrub med/ /gang zhig rtsol 0sgrub byed pa des/ /byang chub nam mkha' de mi 'grub/ /rtsol ⑩zhing sgrub pa gol sgrib po/ /byang chub nam mkha'i rang bzhin de/ /nam mkha' la ni rgyu 'bras med/ /gang zhig rgyu 'bras gnyis lta bas/ /byang chub nam mkha' de mi 'grub/ /rgyu 'bras lta ba gol sgrib tsopo/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ chos kun nam mkha'i rang bzhin te//nam mkha' la ni rang bzhin med/ /nam mkha' la ni dpe tsoyang med/ /nam mkha' la ni tshad kyang med/ /chos rnams thams cad ma lus pa'i/ /don ni 'di ltar shes par bya/ /kye sems dpa' chen po 'di rtogs 8shig /theg pa re la lta ba re/ /lta ba'i yul ni gzhan med de/ /chos nyid byang chub sems 'di la / /gzhan du lta ba'i yul med pas8/ /lta ba zhes lta nor bar bshad/ /theg pa re la dam tshig re/ /byang chub lam gyi skyel ma byed/ /byang chub gzung ⑩101—97

98 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101'dzin med pa'i phyir/ /gzhan du bsrung du med pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig la yang bsrung du med/ /theg pa re la phrin las re/ /byang chub lam gyi stong 0)grogs byed / /byang chub lhun gyis 2grub pa'i phyir/ /phrin las btsal du med pa yin/ /las kyis lhun gyis 2grub 'gyur med/ /theg pa re la gnas sa re/ /byang chub lam gyi gzhi ④ten byed/ /rdzogs chen byang chub sems sa la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sku gsum ston pa bzhugs pa dang / /khams gsum sems can ma lus dang / /snang srid snod bcud gnas pa'i phyir/ /sa la sbyangs shing bgrod du med/ /theg pa re la chos nyid re/ /rdzogs chen chos nyid byang chub sems/ /sems las ma gtogs chos ⑤med pas/ /theg pa'i chos kun byang chub sems/ /rdzogs chen rang 'byung yiye shes ni/ /yul la rtog par mi byed de/ /mi rtog mi bskyod ye shes so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las lta spyod kyi gol sgrib bstan (7pa'i le'u ste sum cu (kyirtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi rang bzhin thams cad la gol sa dang sgrib pa med pa rgyal ba'i snying po yin pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga ni kun gyi byang chub sems/ /des na kun gyi snying por bshad/ /sku gsum ston pa rnam gsum dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs pa dang / /khams gsum sems can thams cad dang / /snang srid snod bcud thams cad la/ /'byung ba'i snying po nga las med/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /mi rtog mnyam pa de nyid las/ /skye ba med pa'i (19)chos sku 101—98

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 99byung / /rang gi ngo bo de nyid las/ /'dod pa longs spyod rdzogs sku byung / /thugs rje byang chub chen po las/ /sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad byung / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sngar 'das pa yi sangs rgyas kyis/ /rang 'byung 6)ye shes sems nyid de/ /mi rtog rtogs nas sngar sangs rgyas/ /da ②ltar mi rtog ngang la bzhugs/ /da ②ltar bzhugs ④pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /rang 'byung ye shes sems nyid de⑥/ /mi rtog pas ni ⑥'gro don mdzad/ /slad nas byon ⑦pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /byang chub rang 'byung ye shes de/ /mi rtog pa yi (kyelung bstan ⑨nas/ /'gro ba'i don la 'byung bar nges rig 'dzin dang ni sa pa rnams/ /rang 'byung byang chub sems de ni/ /bltas ⑩pas mthong ba ma yin na/ /rang sems snying po de ru phrad/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /rang 'byung ye shes bkag med pas/ /dbang po yul la rig gsal ba/ /ma bcos pa yi byang chub sems/ /de nyid snying po yang dag bshad / /snang srid snod tunyebacud thams cad kyang / /nga yis ma bskyed tunyegacig kyang med/ /kun rgyu nga las ma byung med/ /des na kun gyi snying por ()bshad/ /nga ni kun las rgyal ba ste/ /sku gsum 8las kyang nga rgyal la/ /sangs rgyas gsum las nga rgyal lo/ /rig 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' dang / /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can dang / /snang srid snod yibacud thams cad kun/ /byed pa nga yin kun las yirgyal/ /kun byed byang chub sems nga yonayis/ /bstan (shepa kun gyi sngon rol du/ /byang chub sems kyi bstan pa bkod/ /byang chub sems kyi bstan pa 'di/ /kun gyis dgod 19par mi nus te( )/ /de yang ji ltar dgod ce na/ /chos la bya ru med pa'i phyir/ /btsal ba med pa'i sgo nas 101—99

100 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101'jug /byang chub sems las med pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems kyi chos nyid la / /sems kyis bsgom ①du med pa'i phyir/ /lta ba bsgom du med pa bkod/ /gzung ②'dzin 'das pa'i chos nyid la/ /dam tshig bsrung du med pa dgod / /ye nas lhun gyis grub pas na/ / phrin las btsal du med pa bkod/ /byang chub sems la kun gnas pas/ /dus la sbyang ⑤du med pa bkod/ /byang chub sems ni bgrod pa'i gnas/ /sems kyi sa la bgrod med pas/ /lam la bgrod du med par bstan/ /chos nyid byang chub sems yin pas/ /chos nyid gzhan du lta mi byed/ /ye shes rang 'byung ye shes te/ /yul la rtog pa'i ye shes min/ /kun byed byang chub sems nga ni/ /lta spyod kun las rgyal ba dang / /byed pa'i snying po yin pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i snying po zhes su bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rgyal ba'i snying po'i le'u ste 0sum cu ༷rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des byang chub kyi sems nyid kyi rang bzhin bstan pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /bdag gi bstan pa 'di bkod pas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rig 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' dang / /khams gsum sems can thams cad kun / /rtsol (snyedang sgrub pa ma byas par/ /ye nas sangs rgyas lung bstan pas/ /'khor gyi ston pa rnam 6)gsum gyi/ /rtsol kyisgrub byed pa'i brtan yipa gsum/ —/gol sa sgrib pas zhig par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes 7slar zhus pa/ kye ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /khyod kyi bstan 8pa 101—100

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 101byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems 'di sangs rgyas na/ /khams gsum sems can sangs rgyas sam/ /khams gsum sems can sangs rgyas na/ /khams gsum gnas su ci ste 'khor/ /zhes zhus so/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos slar gsungs pa/ kye sems dpa' chen po 'di nyon cig /byang chub sems las byung ba yiX/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /chos nyid mngon du byung ba ste/ /de bzhin nyid du gcig pa yi/ /chos nyid yul ni lnga snang la/ /'dod mi 'dod ni lnga lnga las/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal skye zer nas//chos nyid yul lnga spong byed pa/ /rang 'byung ye shes snang ba de/ /bskal pa gsum du mi spong bas②/ /khams gsum gnas su 'khor ba yin/ /de bzhin nyid du gcig pa yi/ /chos nyid yul ni lnga nisnang la/ /'dod dang mi 'dod lnga snang la/ /'khor ba'i rgyu ni yin zer nas/ /chos nyid lnga po 'gegs par byed//rang 'byung ye shes snang ba de/ /bskal pa du mar mi khegs ④pas/ /khams gsum gnas su 'khor ba yin/ /de bzhin nyid du gcig pa yi/ /chos nyid yul ni lnga snang la/ /'dod dang mi 'dod lnga yul byung / /chags pa'i gnas ni yin zer nas/ /chos nyid lnga po sbyong bar dubyed/ /rang 'byung ye shes snang ba de / /bskal pa yun du mi spyod pasadu/ /khams gsum gnas su 'khor ba yin/ /chos nyid mngon du byung ba yi/ /de bzhin nyid du gcig pa yi/ /chos nyid yul ni lnga snang la/ /'dod dang mi 'dod lnga byung bas/ /byin brlabs gnas ni yin gzer nas/ /phyi nang dag par byin gyis rlob/ /chos nyid lnga po dag par byed / /rang 'byung ye shes snang ba de/ /mi tshe bdun du byin mi rlobazhu/ /khams gsum gnas su 'khor ba yin/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /101—101

10 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101chos nyid mngon du phyung ba yi/ /de bzhin nyid du gcig ①pa las/ /chos nyid yul ni lnga snang las/ /'dod dang mi 'dod lnga 'byung ste/ /mtho ris ngan song rgyu zer nas/ /de bzhin nyid la blang dor byed/ /rang 'byung ye shes snang ba de / /rang gi rkyen ②gyis dor mi btubasri/ /mi btub dor bar byed pas 'khor//byang chub sems las byung ba yiX/ /mngon du phyung ⑤ba'i chos nyid de/ /de bzhin nyid du gcig pa las/ /chos nyid yul ni lnga snang ste6)/ /'dod dang mi 'dod yul lnga ste/ /sku gsung thugs su shes byas nas/ /sku gsung thugs su gdod sgrub byed/ /ye nas yin la sgrub byed pas/ /sgrub pa nyid kyis 'khor ba yin / /kye sems dpa' chen po de bas na/ /byang chub sems spangs pha rol na//rang 'byung ye shes ye nas med/ /'khor ba spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /mya ngan 'das zhes ④bya ba med/ /chos can spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /chos nyid bya ba ye nas med/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid du gcig /de bzhin nyid du gcig pa la / /de bzhin nyid la bcos pas (minor/ /de ni ma nor ba yi ming / /bzhin ni bcos su med pa'i don/ /nyid ni rang gi mtshan nyid bstan/ /de bzhin nyid la 'chos ma byed/ /de bzhin nyid la 'chos byed pa/ /byang chub sems la su 'chos pa/ /des ni 'khor ba'i snying po bsgrub/ /ces 6)gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o// // stade nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nga khoyin pa 'di bstan to/ /kye sems dpa' dam pa rdo rje khyod/ /nga 101—102

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 103yi rang bzhin 'di ltar shes par gyis/ /nga ni ston pa'i sgron ma byang chub sems//dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po yin/ /khams gsum sems can kun gyi pha dang ma/ /snang srid snod bcud kun gyi rgyu yang yin/ /nga las ma byung ba ni gcig ①kyang med/ /nga ni mi gnas kun du khyab pa'i phyir/ /nga ni ye nas dus gsum sangs rgyas yin/ /nga ni mi rtog mnyam par gnas pa'i phyir/ /rtog med mnyam nyid chos sku ye sangs rgyas/ /nga yi ngo bo kun du longs spyod phyir/ /nga nyid longs spyod rdzogs skur ye sangs rgyas/ /nga nyid rang 'byung ye shes snang ba'i phyir/ /nga nyid thugs rje sprul skur mngon sangs rgyas/ /des na dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi snying por bshad/ /nga yi ye shes byang chub sems snang ba / /rang 'byung ye shes lnga po rgyud drug sems/ /des na khams gsum sems can pha dang ma/ /snang srid snod (mibacud kun gyi ngo bo yang / /nga yi ngo bor byung ba snang ba sazhi)/ /nga nyid ye nas snang ba sangs rgyas yin/ /nga la gnyis med gcig ⑤tu 'dus pa chu/ /sdud par byed pas (gesems nyid chu yin no/ /nga ni thams cad mnyam ⑥pa drod snyoms (7me/ /kun la mnyam par gnas pas me sangs rgyas/ /nga ni thogs med yang zhing g.yo ba yin/ /thogs med g.yo bas rlung du mngon sangs rgyas/ /nga ni ma bsgribs 58)kun khyab gsal kyi)ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha' zhes ni ming btags sangs rgyas yin/ /nga las ma byas pa yi sangs rgyas ni/ /'byung chen srid pas bsdus dzopa'i chos la med/ /'byung lta (nyang yi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /gcig la nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rang bzhin tshang / /snang ba sa la sdud 7pa chu yin te/ /mnyam pa me la g.yo ba rlung du gsal4nye/ /ma bsgribs gsal skibs nam mkha'i rang bzhin te/ /gcig la nyi shu rtsa lnga tshang ba 101—103

104 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 'a 101ni / /byang chub sems kyi che ba'i yon tan bstan①/ /chos la gnyis med byang chub sems su gcirgol /gcig gis kun byas kun byed rgyal pos byas/ /zhes ②gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las ngo bo gcig pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu zhe gcig pa'o// // de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems kho nar sangs rgyas pa 'di gsungs ④so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po ⑤nyon cig /kye chos kyi sku ni byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems las chos kyi sku//rdul tsam dusus kyang bcos pa med/ /des na sangs rgyas sems las med/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems la longs spyod sku/ /sems las byung ba'i gzugs rnams las/ /longs spyod rdzogs las sku gzhan med / /sprul pa'i sku ni byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems kyi sprul pa las /'gro ba'i don mdzad gzhan na ④med/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang ske/ /byang chub sems las gzhan med de/ /snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rang sems ma bcos sngar mthong rtogs/ /da ltar bzhugs nipa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /ma bcos pa yi rang sems des/ /ma bcos ji bzhin rtogs gyur nas/ /da ltar 'gro ba'i don yang mdzad/ /slad nas byon ⑨pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rang 'byung sems nyid 'di la ni/ /snga ⑩bar 'chos par lung ma bstan(nya/ /da ltar ting 'dzin sems mi 'chos/ /ma bcos lam du zhugs yinas byon/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams la/ /byang chub sems su ma rtogs te/ /bcos shing bsgrubs (nyapas 'grub yimi 'gyur/ /ma rtogs bcos 101—104

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 105pas grub par byed/ /bskal pa du ma'i grangs bgrangs kyang / /mi rtsol ①bde ba phrad mi 'gyur/ /kye sku gsum sems las ma bcos phyir/ /sku gsum ston pa'i mdo lung las/ /'chos par byed pa'i don 'byung ba/ /de ni ston pa sku gsum yang / /nyid kyi ston pa rang bzhin ston pa min/ /de bzhin 'chos ②par byed pa yi/ /ston pas bden tshul ji bstan ③yang / /nges ༷lung ma yin drang lung yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las bcos su med pa'i le'u ste zhe ⑤gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi ston pa nyid yin par zhal gyis bzhes pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga ni chos rnams kun gyi ston pa ste/ /nga yi rang bzhin rnam pa gsum las ni/ /ston pa yang ni rnam pa gsum du bstan/ /bstan pa yang ni rnam dugasum nga yis bstan/ /de 'dzin 'khor tshogs gsum yang nga yis bstan//ston pa gsum yang gang dang gang zhe na/ /chos kyi rang bzhin ston pa'i ston pa dang ske/ /chos kyi ngo bo ston pa'i ston pa dang / /don gyi sgra tshig ston pa'i ston pa'ol/ /chos kyi rang bzhin ston pa'i ston pa ni/ /skye ba med las ①byin gyis brlabs 2phyung ste/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /chos kyi de bzhin nyid du ston par byed/ /chos kyi ngo bo ston pa'i ston pa ni/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /ston pa nyid kyi sku ru phyung nas ni/ /chos kyi ngo bor de las med par ston/ /chos kyi sgra tshig ston pa'i ston pas ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi don 6)ni sgra bsdus nas/ /ma rig kyimi shes khams gsum 101—105

106 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101sems can la/ /don de sgra dang tshig gis bsdebs ①nas ston/ /des na ston pa'i rang bzhin bstan par bshad/ /de 'dzin 'khor ni rnam pa gsum bstan te / /shin tu rnal 'byor rtsol 0sgrub 'das pa'i 'khor/ /sgor ⑧zhugs yid ches sangs rgyas sa la gnas/ /rig ④'dzin sa dang dang po dubacu pa'i 'khor/ / ma thob ⑥nye reg bsgom pa'i sa la gnas/ /sems bskyed ⑦mos pa spyod pa'i ⑧'khor rnams ni/ /rgyu dge ⑨'bras bu dug 'joms sa la gnas/ /de ni ston pa gsum gyi 'khor du bstan/ /kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /ston pa gsum dang 'khor tshogs de ltar na/ /bstan pa rnam yigasum ji ltar bstan par bgyi/ /zhes zhus pas/ kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /chos kyi sku yi 41bstan pa de bzhin nyid bstan te/ /de bzhin nyid la rnam pa dbye ru ⑫med / /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /sems kyi ngo bo yin ⑫pas de bzhin nyid/ /de la gang su sgom zhing 'chos byed pa/ /de yis chos sku bstan pa rtogs pa med/ /snang ba med pa'i chos nyid byang chub la/ /ma nor de bzhin nyid du ma rtogs yite/ /de la gang su 'chos shing sgom byed pa/ /de yis rang sems bcos med de mi rig /snang srid chos med byang chub sems/ /sems kyi de bzhin nyid 'byung de bzhin nyid/ /de bzhin nyid du ma rtogs so sor mthong / /de bzhin nyid ni dbyings nas tshol byed pa/ /dus snyigasum rgyal bas btsal yang mi brnyes soyi/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /longs spyod rdzogs pa 11bstan pa longs spyod de/ /longs spyod lnga ni chos nyid longs spyod gcig1snye /gzugs la sogs pa'i longs spyod lnga la tu)ni/ /gcig la'ang lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga spyod/ /rtsa lnga longs spyod de ni sku lnga'i ( — )tshul/ /tshul ni chos 101 —106

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 107nyid don gyi ngo bo nyid du bshad/ /sangs rgyas sems can kun gyi longs ①spyod du / /longs sku nga yi gzugs la spyad du med/ /rig ②'dzin sa bcu rnams la nga yis bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /sprul sku bstan pa thugs rjes don 'tsham ③ste/ /khams gsum sems can bsam pa tha dad la/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs ④ni rnam gsum gyis/ /bsam pa tha dad sku gsung thugs rjes bzlog /dbang po yul la zhen pa de bzlog nas/ /dben pa'i yul ni gang 'thad ⑤de bstan yinas/ /des ni nga yi thugs rje 'dren lung byed/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga ni chos rnams kun gyi ston yin phyir/ /sangs rgyas la yang ⑦nga yi rang bzhin bstan/ /sems can la yang nga yi rang bzhin bstan/ /rang bzhin bstan pas ston par zhal gyis bzhes/ /nga yi rang bzhin 'di ltar rig ⑧par gyis/ /ston pa dang ni bstan pa 'khor rnams ni/ /nga yi rang bzhin gsum las gzhan med de6)/ /ston pa rang 'byung ye shes 'gag med yin⑩/ /bstan pa nga yi rang bzhin ma bcos yin/ /de 'dzin 'khor ni nga yi ngo bos 'dzin/ /ces ⑩gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las ston par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i le'u ste zhe gsum pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos nyid la bya ba med pa'i don 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ bya ba med pa'i don 'di ni/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin te/ /nga la bya ba med pa ni/ /nga ni ye nas byas zin pas / /bya ba med pa'i chos nyid yin/ /chos nyid nga yi rang bzhin las/ /101—107

108 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101rang bzhin de la bya ru ①med/ /rang bzhin rang bzhin bya ba de/ /bcos su med pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /bcos med byang chub de la ni/ /sems dpa' rdo rje khyod ma 'chosal/ /sems dpa' rdo rjes ②de 'chos na/ /kun byed nga la bcos ④pa yin/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po khyod nyon cig /nga yi rang bzhin 'gyur med la/ /bsgoms na 'chos dushing bsgyur byab yin/ /nga ni ye nas lhun grub la / /bsgrubs na nga la bcos ⑦pa yin/ /nga la bgrod pas phyin pa med/ /nga la btsal bas grub pa med/ /nga la sbyangs pas byang ba med/ /nga la ma lta yul med kyis/ /nga la ma bgrod ⑧lam med kyis/ /nga la ma sbyongs sgrib med kyis/ /mi gnas dmigs pa'i yul dang bral/ /spros med bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ /'dzin pas brtags pa'i chos rnams ni/ /nga yi ngo bo bstan pa yin/ /de la spong 'gegs ⑨su byed pa/ /bskal pa gsum gyi bar du ni/ /kun byed nga dang phrad mi 'gyur/ /spang bar bya ba'i chos de ni/ /rang gi ngo bo yin par bshad/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ byang chub sems ni kun byed rgyal po ste/ /kun byed byang chub sems kyis byas pa ni/ /byang chub sems 'a ru gzhan du byas pa med/ /byang chub sems ni ye nas ma nor yin/ /ye nas yin pas ye nas nor ba med/ /nor ba med la ⑩bden brdzun 0sgros mi 'dogs/ /rgyu bden 'bras bu rtsol sgrub 8kun las 'das/ /byas zin rtsol sgrub 8'das pa ma rig nas/ /rtsol sgrub tsobya byed bsgoms nas grub lta na/ /byang chub gegs 8su de las che ba med/ /mi gnas mi rtog cir tsoyang dgongs med pas/ /mi rtog ⑩mnyam pa'i yul la rang bzhin gnas/ /ye nas byas zin rtsol (nyaba'i sems mi 'byung / /bde chen de 101—108

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 109la gang su gnas pa ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi snying por de 'gyur ro/ /de yis bdag gzhan kun gyi don mi byed/ /gcig 'dus thams cad 'dus pa'i snying po des / /ma bltas ①dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs kyang gsal②/ /ma bsgribs ②sems can kun gyi sems kyang snang / /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /kun byed nga yis sems can don byas zin/ /nga yis ④don byas gzhan gyis bya mi dgos/ /gzhan la ltos pa'i chos ni nga lung min/ /nga la kun rdzogs ye nas byas zin rdzogs/ /ye nas byas zin lta ba bsgom dumi dgos/ /ye nas rnam dag dam tshig srung ⑥mi dgos/ /ye nas byang chub sa la kun gnas pas/ /rig 'dzin sa dang sa bcu sbyang ⑦mi dgos/ /ma btsal ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ /btsal ba'i phrin las ye nas bya mi dgos/ /rang 'byung ye shes yul la mi rtog ⑧pas/ /rig pa'i ye shes yul gyis bsal ①mi dgos/ /bde chen chos sku sems kyis gcig pa'i phyir/ /snga phyi dus gsum med de khyad par gcig⑩ /phun sum tshogs dang dus gnas kun gcig yidang / /thams cad gcig tsophyir nga la kun rdzogs te/ /rdzogs pa chen po nga la kun rdzogs pas/ /lta spyod 0phrin las dam tshig sa lam ④ni/ /gong bshad bzhin du btsal zhing bsgrub mi dgos/ /de ltar ma rig rtsol sgrub 8byas 'gyur tson/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i don dang 'gal 'gyur ⑩nas/ /bya med bde chen de dang mi phrad de/ / rtsol sgrub tsond kyis ma rig de zin 'gyur/ /de bas rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i rdzogs chen la/ /skal med rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pas/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos la spyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rdzogs chen skal med don med kyi le'u ste zhe bzhi pa'o// //101—109

de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos rdzogs pa chen po la lta ba bsgom med kyi mdo lung 'di bstan to/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ rang gi lta ba bsgom hu)med ni/ /kun byed nga yin nga la bsgom ②du med/ /kun byed nga ni bsgom ①pa'i yul ma yin/ /nga ni ma bcos kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i (gebasgom du med pa de/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis / /nga las mngon du phyung ba'i chos nyid la/ /brkam ⑤chags lnga yi sdug bsngal yin zer nas/ /ma bcos mi 'jog (6)brtul zhugs spong 'gegs ⑦bsgom / /de lung bstan pas (kyem bcos don dang 'gal/ /mu stegs sde bzhi sprul pa'i thugs rje yis/ /byin brlabs 'khor du bkod nas lung bstan pas/ /bya bral bde ba de nyid thob mi 'gyur/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga las mngon du phyung ba'i chos nyid la/ /brkam po)chags lnga yis 0sdug bsngal skye zer nas / /dang po sa nas bcu par sems dpa' la/ /bden pa rnam pa gnyis kyi rtog dpyod (11kyis/ /don dam med la kun rdzob yod pa ru/ /sprul pas lung bstan rtog dpyod sgom pa byed/ /ma bcos ji bzhin nga yi don dang 'gal/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ nga las mngon du phyung ba'i chos nyid de/ /ma bcos ji bzhin pa yi chos nyid la/ /longs spyod rdzogs pas 'khor la lung bstan pa/ /ji bzhin bcos pa med par ma rtogs te/ /phyi nang snod bcud dag par byin brlabs te/ /byang chub yan lag cho ga kun sgo nas/ /bsgom yo pa'i ye shes elha ni snang bar byed/ /skad cig mchod nas (7)gshegs gsol ting 'dzin bshig /yang bsgoms 7yang bshig byis pa'i 'dag 7khang 'dra/ /ji bzhin ma bcos nga 101—110

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 111yi don dang 'gal/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga las byung ba'i ston pa lung ston gyis①/ /nga yis byung chaba'i chos nyid mngon phyung la/ /ting 'dzin mtshan ma yod med sgor zhugs nas/ /chos nyid gcig dul blang dor byas nas ni/ /ye shes dam tshig so sor bsgoms nas ni/ /grogs po dag gis dngos grub ster re ba/ /gcig la gnyis su ltas ④pa'i bsgom ⑤pa nor/ /ngo bo gcig la gnyis kyis ༅thob pa med/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga yi rang bzhin mngon du phyung ⑦ba la(mi/ /phung po 'byung ba rnam shes dbang po yula'o//rang rgyud dag pa rdo rje ltar kyibyas te/ /bsnyen bsgrub lhonyarnam bzhi cho ga bsgom (shebyas nas/ /sems kyi 'phro ()'dus 'phags mchod 'gro don byed/ / 'phro 'du ④bsdus nas dngos grub thob 'tshal skyebs/ /rang gis rang gi tsodangos grub thob par bsgomadhi/ /de yang sems kyi ting 'dzin tshi (nyechad 'gyur/ /rdzogs chen lta ba bsgom 4)du med pa ni/ /kun byed nga yi sems kyi yon tan ( )te/ /byang chub sems kyi che ba'i yon tan gyis/ /btsal zhing bsgrubs pu nyepa'i dka' dub spyad ( nyemi dgos(ste/ /rgyu rkyen med pas btsal ba'i las mi dgos/ /'bras bu'i rang bzhin gzhan nas bsgrub sonyemi dgos/ /chos nyid rang yin bsgom (nyepa bya mi dgos / /ma skyes pas na 'jig pa'i gnyen po med/ /gzhan la ma ltos bsgom ( spreganas tshol mi byed/ /nga la gang zhig sgom par byed pa des/ /bsgoms (nyepa nyid kyis nga dang phrad mi 'gyur/ /chos nyid mngon du phyung ba nga yin pas/ /sdug bsngal mi skye rnam par spang mi dgos/ /rang 'byung yin pas skye 'jig med pa'i phyir/ /ma rig rten 'brel dbang po dgag mi dgos/ /rang 'byung rnam dag chos nyid sbyang ( )mi dgos/ /ye nas dag pas gtsang zhi )sbra bya mi dgos/ /ye 101—111

11 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101nas lhun grub rtsol sgrub ①bya mi dgos/ /bltas pas ma dag pa yi ②chos med de / /de bzhin nyid dang rnam snang kun du bzang / /dbang po drug la snang ba'i chos rnams kyang / /ye nas de yin de las gzhan ma med/ /de la gang ②zhig bsgom ④dang sgrub ⑤byed pa/ /de ni mdongs pas nam mkha' snyegs ①pa 'dra/ /nga yi rang bzhin spyod yul kun las 'das/ /nga yis mngon du phyung ba'i chos rnams ni/ /nga yi ngo bo kun gyis ⑦mthong bya'i phyir/ /sna tshogs dbang po ningo ⑨la bstan pa yin/ /de la nga yi rang bzhin kun rtogs shig /de la nga yi rang bzhin ma mthong ⑩na/ /kun byed nga yi theg pa bstan mi bya/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i don dang skal med pas/ /rgyu 'bras theg ⑩pa drang ba'i lung la gzudakyi/ /nga ni ye nas spyod yul 'das pa 'di/ /rgyu 'bras dga' ba'i skal ba med rnams la / /bstan na sgro dang skur pa 'ong ba'i phyir/ /bstan na rang gi sems la skur ⑫btab pas/ /drug tu skye zhing gtan tsodu 'khor bar ti'akhyam/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nga don rtogs/ /de ⑩ni spyod yul kun las 'das pa'i phyir/ /tshig gis mi phebs dbang po'i spyod yul 'das/ /nga yi rang bzhin bsdus te thig ler gnas/ /ma spros gnyis med ye nas gcig tu bstan/ /dam tshig bsrung ba'i bsgom ⑩pa bya mi dgos/ /phrin tsolas btsal ba'i bsgom yipa bya mi dgos / /lam la mi bgrod sa la mi sbyong stebya/ /rang las (nyagazhan du chos nyid tshol mi byed/ /rang 'byung ye shes mi rtog g.yos pa med/ /gzhan gyis (nyelung min kun byed nga yi lung / /rgyu 'bras 'das pas rtsol dudang sgrub mi byed/ /ma byung bas na dngos po sgom mi byed/ /ma skyes pas na 'jig pa'i dogs pa med/ /nga mi snang bas dmigs pa bsgom 69dang bral/ /bde chen bdal duba'i klong ⑩101—112

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 113dkyil na/ /mi rtog mnyam pa'i rang bzhin gnas/ /chos nyid snang ba med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /rig pas mi rtog ting 'dzin ma byed cig /kye sems dpa' chen po/ bsgoms na gang bsgom nyung yi nad ②yin gyisani/ /kun gyi snying po byang chub sems yin na/ /byang chub sems ni gzung du'adzin bral ba'i phyir / /bsgom ⑤par bya ba rdul tsam yod ma yin/ /gong bshad bsgoms pas 'bras bu ma thob bzhin/ /nga yang bsgoms ①pas thob par lung mi ston/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nga la ltos/ /nga ni kun byed byang chub sems yin te/ /kun byed byas pas kun byas nyid du byas/ /kun ni ma lus pa yi ④sgrar bshad de / /byed pa'i snying po de yis thams cad byed/ /byang ba gzung ⑧du yod pa ma yin la/ /chub pa kun gyi snying pos snying por chub/ /sems ni rang 'byung ye shes kun du sems/ /zhes ⑨gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las lta ba bsgom tshumed kyi le'u ste zhe lnga pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des 7rdzogs pa chen po'i dam tshig bsrung tsodu med pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /rdzogs chen dam tshig bsrung du med bstan 8pa/ /kun byed byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ /ma skyes spros dang bral ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /skye tsoba'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs yul byung nas/ /yul de rang gi rang bzhin yin zhes byas/ /de la mi rtog rtog pa'i yul las 'das/ /yul la mi 'dzin spong dang len med pas / /med pa phyal 'ab gcig ⑩phu lhun grub ste/ /bsrung bar bya ba'i sdom khrims kun dang bral/ /bsrung 0med nga las byung ba'i ston gsum gyis/ /mu 101—113

114 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ la 101stegs sde ①bzhi thugs rjes byin brlabs nas/ /'dul ba ②log pa'i 'khor ni sde ①bzhi la/ /bsrung bar bya ba'i khrims ni 'di lta ste/ /rtsa ba dang ni yan lag bsrung ba'i ④gangs/ /nyis ⑤brgya lnga bcu lnga brgya lnga bcu khrims/ /bsrung ba'i dus na grangs dang don mi shes/ /des na sdom pa mi thub bsrung thabs med/ /rdzogs chen ci spyod rtog pa kun las 'das/ /sdom pa rgya nyamatsho mtha' yas grangs mang ba⑦/ /lus ngag yid la bsdus ⑧pa rnam pa gsum/ /dbang po yul las sdug bsngal byung nas ni/ /lus kyis ⑨'gro 'dug gom pa bor sa med/ /ngag gis tshig brjod don gyis bden par dka'acha/ /yid kyis bsam pa bden pa kun las 'gal/ /ma nor bsam pa kun kyang bsgrub tu med/ /lus ngag sdom ⑩pa rgya mdud tsodam po des/ /bden nyid don dang phrad pa shin tu dka'/ /bsrung med nyams pa med dang phrad ⑩mi 'gyur/ /bsrung med nyams pa med pa kun byed lung / /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga las byung ba'i ston pas lung phog pa/ /gza' dang rgyu skar 'dus tshigs 8bzang sgo nas/ /phyi nang gtsang ma'i khrus kyis dag byas te/ /sdom pa tshul khrims 'gro don zhal 'ches ⑩pa / /gang yang dam bcas tshul bzhin mi 'grub ste/ /dam bcas ma grub bshags pas sems mi 'dag /bsrung med nga dang yun du thag ring tunyenyams/ /kye rdo rje gsang 1steb gsum gyi dam tshig ni/ /rtsa ba gsum dang yan lag lnga rnams te / /rtsa ba gsum ni sku gsung ()thugs 'dus te/ /sku ni lha yi 6 )skur bsgom (nyalus kyang 'ching / /ngag ni 'dzab dang ting 'dzin zhi ba min/ /yid kyi ting 'dzin 'phro ce 'dus bzung nas ni/ /rtsa ba mi rtog dam tshig bde dang bral/ /yan lag rnam pa lnga ni 'di lta ste/ /dang por shes par bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ /101—114

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 115phung po lnga dang 'byung ba rnam pa lnga/ /rnam shes dbang po yul la sogs pa rnamasal/ /lha dang dkyil 'khor rang bzhin shes par bya/ /shes bya shes byed med pa des ma mthong / / spyad par 6)bya ba'i dam tshig rnam lnga ni/ / sta na ga ②na ma byin blangs pa dang / /mi tshangs spyod dang brdzun ①du smra ba dang / /rnam pa lnga ni thabs mkhas spyod dubyed pa/ /ma spyad ⑤nyams mthong rtog dang bcas nas spyod/ /de yang mi rtog mnyam dang bral ba yin/ /dang du blang ba'i dam tshig rnam lnga ni/ /dri chen dri chu ⑥la sogs dam rdzas lngas/ /rgyal ba'i sku lnga 'di las 'grub zer nas/ /dpa' bo 'bru lngas 'phro 'du byas nas ni/ /rgyal ba'i sku lnga dang du len byed pa/ /dang du ma blangs ④sku lnga mi grub ③rtog /blang dor bral ba'i rtog 'das de ma grub/ /mi spong ⑨ba yi dam rdzas rnam lnga ni/ /'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs dug lnga po/ /gsang ba rdo rje'i dam tshig chen po ru/ /nyon mongs lnga bsgyur kyiye shes rnam pa lngar/ /dug lnga mi spong ye shes rnam lngar len / /blang dor med pa'i bde ba des ma grub/ /grub par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam lnga ni/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga rnams yidang / /rnam shes yul rnams dkyil 'khor grub byed pa/ /ting 'dzin gsum dang cho ga lnga rdzogs nas/ /rgyal ba'i rigs 8lnga'i dkyil 'khor grub byed pa/ /ting 'dzin cho ga lnga yis sems rtsol byed/ /mi rtog ma btsal lhun gyis grub dang 'gal/ /bsgom pa'i sku ni mi rtog 'ja' tunyetshon 'dra/ /cho ga bzlas brjod 'dzab kyang rtsi skya ④'dra/ /rtsol 8sgrub spyod pas lhun gyis grub mi 'gyur/ /med par bsgrub 7pas shin tu grub pa med/ /kun byed nga la bsrung ba'i dam tshig med/ /rgyu rkyen med pas rtsol yizhing bsgrub (nyami dgos/ /lhun gyis grub pas spyad par bya mi dgos/ /ye 101—115

116 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101shes yin pas shes par bya mi dgos/ /rang 'byung yin pas rgyu dang rkyen mi dgos / /bzang ngan med pas blang dor bya mi dgos/ /dngos po med pas med pa zhes su bshad/ /dngos su mi spyod ①ye shes ma 'gags pas/ /de la phyal ba zhes su btags pa yin/ /sems su kun gcig gcig ②phur btags pa yin / /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /yid ches byang chub sems su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /lhun gyis rdzogs pa zhes su nga yis ①bshad/ /tsha grang bkres skom blun lkugs chos nyid la/ /sku gsum 'khor sngangs 'bros pa'i cho ga drug /gong bshad bzhin du btsal zhing bsgrub ④mi dgos/ /rgyu nyid rang 'byung ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ /las kyi rkyen gyi dbang du de mi 'gyuradu/ /chos nyid rang bzhin cir yang 'gyur med pas/ /btsal bas grub par nga yis lung ma bstan/ /rang 'byung ye shes kun dang mtshungs med pas/ /rgyu rkyen las kyis rang 'byung de mi 'grub/ /bden pa gnyis kyis gtan tshul dbab tu med/ /nges pa gcig ⑦la bden pa rnam pa gnyis/ /ma nges the tshom can gyi lung de la/ /nges pa gcig ⑧ku bstan pa ga la yod/ /rnal 'byor gang zag chos la rlom byed ni / /ston gsum rgyu 'bras lung la brten ⑨smra ba/ /de la bden gnyis tshad ma bzhi ⑩yang dgos/ /kun byed nga yis chos kun byas pa'i phyir/ /ngas byas chos la bden pa gnyis mi dgos/ /ngas byas chos la bden pa gnyis dgos su/ /ngas byas thams cad byang chub sems su byas/ /byang chub sems la don dam kun rdzob med/ /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po la'i dam tshig bsrung du med pa'i le'u ste zhe drug pa'o// //101—116

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 117de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des rdzogs pa chen po la phrin ①las btsal du med pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /kun byed nga ni rdzogs pa chen po ste/ /rdzogs pa chen po lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ /phrin las ye nas btsal du med par bstan / /phrin las btsal du yod par lung ston pa/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /rang re 'khor la btsal ba'i las phog pa/ /btsal ba'i las ni rang res so sor phog /sprul pas btsal ba'i rgyu la las phog pa/ /lus ngag yid gsum tshad med sgor nizhugs nas/ /lus kyi sdom pa srog gcod ⑦rku g.yem spang / /ngag gi sdom pa ngag khyal sritshig rtsub rjodang / /brdzun dang phra ma la sogs ngag gis spang / /yid kyis mnab ⑦sems gnod sems log lta spang / /dge bcu spyod pa'i las de rgyur bkod nas/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin bcu las/ /spyad nas ⑧sa dang kun 'od thob 'dod pa/ / tshi chad ⑨las ni bskal pa gsum du spyod/ /de yang kun byed nga yis lung phog min/ /7longs spyod rdzogs pas 0'khor la lung phog pa/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas las 8log pa/ /sems can ting 'dzin las ni 'di lta ste/ /khrus dang gtsang yisbrar phyi nang dag byas te/ /cho 'phrul las kyis byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /ye shes sems dang dam tshig gnyis ltas tsonas/ /ting 'dzin las kyis mchod cing gshegs gsol byed/ /las des mi tshe bdun du tshi chad kyi'agyur/ /chos kyi sku las longs spyod skur ⑫bzhengs nas/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i 'khor la lung phog pa/ /bdag nyid chen po yin par lung bstan nas/ /rang rgyud dag pa'i dkyil 'khor de rnams la/ /kha dog rigs dang sbyar ba'i lha bsgoms tsonas/ /zhi lhas zhi bar byed pa'i las 101—117

118 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101byed pa/ /rgyas lhas rgyas par byed pa'i las byed pa/ /dbang lhas dbang du sdud pa'i las kyang byed/ /drag lhas stongs par byed pa'i las kyang byed/ /tshe la gnas dang phyag rgya ①rig 'dzin 'grub/ /phrin las rnam bzhis tshi chad lagrub pa med/ /mi rtsol ①bya med las ni de ma grub④/ /rdzogs chen rgyu 'bras ye nas 'das pa'i phyir/ /btsal zhing bsgrubs ⑤pas bya med grub pa med/ /rgyu 'bras lta ba'i ston pas lung bstan ⑥pa/ /'jig rten mtshan ma'i chos la tshod btsugs ⑦nas / /rgyu las btsal nas 'bras bu grub byed pa/ /sems la rgyu med ye nas 'bras bu med/ /byang chub sems la niskye ba med pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten skye ba'i chos la dpe blangs nas/ /skye las 'jig pa 'byung bar sgros mi gdags/ /rang 'byung rgyu 'bras 'das pa ma brtags 6)par/ /'jig rten mtshan ma'i chos la tshod btsugs nas/ /rgyu las btsal bas 'bras bu 'byung zer ba/ /de ni rgyu 'bras theg pa drang lung yin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /ye shes ye shes zhes su bstan pa ni/ /rang 'byung ye shes ma 'gags kun dang mtshungs/ /rgyu las ma byung mtshungs med ye shes de/ /thams cad bskyed pas gzhan nas chos 'byung med/ /'jig rten rgyu 'bras chos la tshod btsugs nas/ /btsal ba med pa'i 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni rgyu rkyen med pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten skye 'gag chos la tshod 7mi gzugs/ /byang chub sems ni rkyen gyis ma 11bskyed pas/ /'jig rten rkyen bskyed chos la dpe ma len/ /kye sems dpa' chen 7po/ che ba 'dod nas bsgom (nyebasgrub rtsol 8byed pa/ /bsgom bsgrub 7btsal bas che ba de mi 'grub/ /che yib rang 'byung ye nas che ba yin/ /bsgoms na sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'chos pa yin/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa gang 101—118

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 119zhig 'chos byed pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas thams cad spangs pa yin/ /de yis sangs rgyas spangs ①pa ma yin te/ /de yis rang gi byang chub sems spangs pas/ /rang gi rang bzhin bskal ⑧par phrad mi 'gyur/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/sems kyis ting 'dzin sgom pa ma byed cig /ye shes yul la rtog par ma byed cig /ngag gis 'dzab dang snying po bzla mi dgos/ /lag gis 'du ①byed phyag rgya bca' dumi dgos/ /sems kyis dzubating 'dzin 'phro 'du las ma byed/ /ngang la gnas pas g.yos med lhun gyis grub/ /rang bzhin gnas pas sus kyang bcos su med/ /ma btsal ji bzhin pa ru gnas pa des/ /bya ba med pa las kyi mchog tu bstan/ /don de rtogs pas las rnams mi byed de/ /las ma byas pas de bzhin nyid du gnas/ /de bzhin nyid la gang zhig su gnas pa/ /de yis ma nor ma bcos 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ni ma nor bzhin ni ma bcos yin//nyid ni ma nor ngo bo nyid la bya/ /de bzhin nyid las sangs rgyas chos med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las phrin las btsal du med pa'i le'u ste zhe bdun pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des/ chos thams cad gzhi ma kun byed nyid yin par zhal gyis bzhes (6)pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /kun byed nga ni kun gyi byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems ni chos kun gzhi (7ma ste/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum las/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dgos pa kun kyang tshang / /rang bzhin gsum ni 'di ltar shes par bya/ /skye ba med dang 'gag pa med pa dang / /mi 'gag skye ba'i cho 'phrul 101—119

1 0 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101'byung ba gsum/ /gsum ni phun sum tshogs par bstan pa yin/ /ma skyes skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin las/ /chos kyi gzhi ①ma bstan pa phun sum tshogs/ /ma bsgribs ②ma bkag pa yi rang bzhin las/ /ston pa gsum gyi rang bzhin phun sum tshogs/ /ma skyes skye ba'i cho 'phrul ngo bo las/ /'khor gyi rang bzhin rnam gsum phun sum tshogs/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga yi rang bzhin chos nyid gcig dupu la/ /nga ma 'gags dupa'i ston pa rnam gsum gyis/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i 'khor gsum las/ /nga yi chos nyid de bzhin nyid gcig dul/ /rtogs par bya ba'i thabs kyi gzhi dum drug /lta ba chos nyid mthong ba'i gzhi ⑦ma byed/ /des ni mthong bar bya ba'i thabs yin te/ /ma skyes dmigs par bya ba'i yul med pas/ /bltas pas de bzhin nyid la mthong ba med/ /dam tshig rang skyon sel ba'i gzhi ⑧ma byed/ /des ni bar chad med pa'i thabs yin te/ /de bzhin nyid la bsrung ba'i yul med pas/ / bsrungs pas ⑨de bzhin nyid la thub pa med/ /las ni grub par byed pa'i gzhi ⑩ma byed/ /btsal bas grub par byed pa'i thabs yin te/ /de bzhin nyid la btsal ba'i yul med pas/ /de bzhin nyid la las kyi grub pa med/ /lam gyis bgrod (nyapas 8phyin pa'i gzhi snyim byed/ /des ni gnas su phyin pa'i thabs yin te/ /de bzhin nyid la lam gyis bgrod med phyir/ /bgrod pas phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid ma yin/ /sa ni gnas par byed pa'i gzhi tsom byed/ /des ni sbyang mi dgos pa'i thabs yin te/ /de bzhin nyid la thams cad kun gnas pas/ /gnasi par bya ba'i sa la sbyang du med/ /ye shes rtogs par byed pa'i gzhi snyim byed/ /des ni chos nyid rig pa'i thabs yin te/ /de bzhin nyid la rtogs pa'i yul 101—120

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 1 1med pas/ /rang 'byung ye shes yul la rtog pa med/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /byang chub sems ni chos kyi gzhi ①yin pas/ /theg pa so so lta spyod drug drug gis/ /rgyu 'bras ltos pa'i 'khor la de bstan pas/ /de re rang 'thad ②bsam pa re re yis/ /lta spyod gzhi dum drug la byabatsal byas kyang / /de bzhin nyid la btsal ba'i yul med pas/ /btsal bas de bzhin nyid la bcos pa'i phyir/ /rang sems gzhi ⑤ma bcos med de mi phrad/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cigadu /lta ba bsgom ⑦du med ces bstan pa ni/ /chos kyi rtsa ⑧ba rang las med pa'i phyir/ /rang gis ⑨rang la blta tiru med pa'i phyir/ /rang med yul ni nga yis bstan pa med/ /des na lta ba bsgom du med ces bstan/ /dam tshig bsrung du med ces bstan pa ni/ /bsrung bas mi thub rang gi sems mi khegs / /rang 'byung ye shes yin pas hubasrung du med/ /kye phrin las btsal du med ces bstan pa ni/ /rdzogs chen rgyu ti'abras ye nas 'das pa'i phyir/ /phrin las rgyu las bsgrubs nas 'bras bur 'dod/ /rdzogs chen 'bras bu 'dod pa med pa ni/ / phrin las btsal ba med pa'i phyir/ /4)phrin las btsal du med ces bstan pa yin/ /lam la bgrod du med ces bstan pa ni/ /kye dus gsum sangs rgyas khams gsum sems can la/ /bgrod pa byang chub sems kyi lam la bgrod / /sems su sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med/ /des na sems kyis sems la lam bgrod med/ /sa la sbyang du med ces bstan pa ni/ /chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi sa ④'di la/ /sbyangs pas thob par 'dod pa rgyu 'bras can/ /chos nyid byang chub sems kyi sa 'di la/ /sbyangs bcos byas grub lung ni ngas ma bstanatso/ /ye shes yul la mi rtog zhes ⑩bstan pa/ /yul 101—121

1 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101de ye nas ①rang 'byung ye shes te②/ /ye shes la ni ye shes yul ma mchis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos thams cad kyi gzhi nim kun byed nyid yin par bstan pa'i le'u ste zhe brgyad pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des thams cad nga la gnas pa'i sa 'di bstan to/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ kun byed rgyal po nga nyid ni/ /kun gyi byang chub snying por gnas/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /khams gsum sems can thams cad kun/ /klong chen sems kyi gnas de na/ /mi gnas pa ni gcig kyang med/ /kun gyi gnas dang sa yin te/ /'du 'bral med par de na bzhugs/ /de la sbyang ④zhing bgrod mi dgos/ /de la sbyangs te bgrod 'gyur na/ /rang gi sems de 'chos pa stephyi/ /bcos pas rang sems 'byongs mi 'gyur/ /de ni spyi sa kun gyi gnas/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /rgyu 'bras dga' ba'i 'khor rnams la/ /sa mdo rnam pa gsum bstan te/ /bskyed pa'i sa dang spyod 6)pa'i sa / /bsgrub pa'i sa dang gsum bstan te/ /bskyed pa'i sa ru sems bzhi bskyed / /spyod pa'i sa ru sems spyod bcus/ /bsgrub pa'i sa ru grub 'dod pas / /de ni drang ba'i lung du bstan pa'i phyir/ /yang dag nges par yod par (pelung ma bstan(4// /yang dag nges par nga yi lung 'di nyon/ byang chub sems la rgyu rkyen med pa'i phyir/ /bskyed pa'i sa ru byang chub sems mi bskyed/ /bskyed 6)pa'i sa ru byang chub sems bskyed na/ /chos dbyings nam mkha' byang chub sems 101—122

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 1 3mi shong / /dge sdig las la dran pa dbang bsgyur6)bas/ /phyi yul chos nyid spangs pas ma spongs te/ /rang 'byung ye shes mi khegs bzhin du 'gegs/ /rang 'byung ye shes yul la mi rtog bzhin/ /gzung phyidang 'dzin pa yod ces 'joms par byed/ /des na byang chub sems la skyes pa med/ /spyod pa'i sa ru byang chub bcu spyad pas/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /byang chub sems la g.yos pa med pa ni/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid snang bar zad / /nam mkha' la ni g.yos pa rdul tsam med/ /de bzhin byang chub sems la g.yos pa med/ /grub pa'i sa ru byang chub grub 'dod pa/ /kun du 'od dang ma chags pad+ma'i spyan/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang stug ③po bkod pa dang / /'khor lo tshogs chen rdo rje 'chang ba dang / /rgyu 'bras kun bzang dbye ba med sa drug④ /byang chub bsgrub (snyepa'i sa ru ming btags pa/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rgyu rkyen ⑥bral ba'i phyir/ /bsgrubs pas grub pa'i 'bras bu ngas ma bstan/ /sems kyi rang bzhin drug snang bstan ⑦pa yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin drug ni 'di lta ste/ /rang 'byung ye shes ma 'gags pa yi rtags(8)/ /dbang po sgo lnga kun du gsal ⑨ba la/ /kun du 'od kyi sa zhes btags ⑩pa yin/ /yul la mi rtog chags pa med pa la/ /ma chags pad+ma spyan tunyedu btags pa yin/ /skye 'jig med pa'i byang chub sems de la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes su nga yis btagasa'i/ /rang gi rang bzhin chos nyid dpag med la/ /rang 'byung ye shes mi rtog mnyam par bkod / /stug yipo bkod pa'i sa zhes btags skipa yin/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor de/ /rang la gnas pa'i chos rnams thams cad la/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen sa rnams te/ /sku gsung thugs la skye dang 'jig med 101—123

1 4 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101pasal/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sa zhes bshad pa yin/ /byang chub sems la rgyu 'bras gnyis med de①/ /sems las byung ba'i chos rnams thams cad la/ /bzang ngan blang dor ye nas med pa'i phyir/ /dbye ②ba med pa'i sa zhes nga ②yis bshad / /des na byang chub sems kyi chos dbyings la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas khams gsum sems can kun/ /de nas 'byung ④zhing de ru gnas pa'i phyir/ /chos dbyings byang chub sems ni kun spyod sa/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i sa zhes ⑤btags pa de/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin de las ni/ /gong bshad bzhin du byang chub sems la gnas/ /zhes ༅sbyang du med pa'i sa bstan to/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la sbyang du med pa'i le'u ste zhe dgu pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des byang chub kyi sems rang byung ba'i ye shes la sgrib pa med pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /ye shes ye shes zhes bya ba/ /ye shes ye nas shes pa yin/ /rang byung ⑦ye shes ye nas shes/ /yul la rtog pa'i ye shes de/ /yul las byung bas rang byung (nyamin/ /yul med tsam yo)na gsal mi byed/ /des na rang byung 0ye shes de / /ye nas shes pa'i ye shes yin/ /ye shes zhes ni de la bya/ /'khor gyi ston pa'i ye shes ni/ /yul la brtags ⑩pa'i ye shes de/ /gang su yul la rtog byed pa/ /de ni rig byed ye shes yin/ /rig par bya ba'i yul de ni/ /rgyang chub sems las byung ba'i phyir/ /de ni yul med byang chub sems/ /ye shes rang las byung ba'i phyir/ /de la ting 'dzin sgom mi byed/ /ting 'dzin sgom ⑫101—124

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 1 5pa mi byed pas①/ /ting 'dzin bag chags sog ②mi 'gyur/ /bag chags med pa'i chos nyid de/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs par bshad/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dgongs pa'i yul la mi rtog ste / /mnyam pa nyid du ye nas gnas/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyikhyo/ /rang byung ⑤yi shes thugs de la/ /ye nas rtog 0pa med pa'i phyir / /sangs rgyas dgongs pa mi mdzad de/ /rtog pa'i yul ni kun dang bral/ /shin tu rnal 'byor gang zag gang / /su yang rung ba de yis ni/ /rtog pa med la gnas gyur na/ /de ni sangs rgyas dgongs pa mdzad/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /rang 'byung ⑦ye shes sangs rgyas dgongs pa mdzad/ /rang 'byung ye shes yul la mi rtog pas/ /rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags gos mi 'gyural / /las ni ting 'dzin brtags ⑨pa'i bag chags yin/ /mi rtog pa la bag chags yod ma gsungs/ /mi rtog pa yi rang 'byung ye shes lnga/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dbang po sgo lngar bshad/ /rang 'byung ye shes 0de la 'gag pa med/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo mngon snang la/ /rang 'byung ye shes mi 'gag so sor gsaladhi / /rang gi rkyen gyis snang bas dor mi byed/ /ting 'dzin mi rtog bag chags sog kyimi 'gyur/ /'di yang dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa ste0/ /gang du mi rtog 'di la su gnas la/ /nga la mi gnas 'gro ba'i don mi gnas/ /chos sku byang chub sems la 'di gnas te/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ⑫dgongs pa 'dus/ /kye sems dpa' chen po tshig don 'di/ /rig pa nyams su mngon sum rtogs 8par gyis/ /rang 'byung ye shes yul la tsolngar gnas pa/ /ye shes lnga ni yul lnga 'dod ma yin/ /yul 'dod lnga ni ye shes lnga la snang / /101—125

1 6 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101yul de ye nas ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ /yul dang ye shes gnyis su ngas ma bstan / /des na yul yang rang 'byung ye shes yin/ /rang 'byung ye shes gcig ①las med pa la/ /nga ②las byung ba'i 'khor gyi ston pa yin/ /yul la brten gonas ye shes ming btags 0pa/ /rnam pa grangs kyi ye shes byung ba ni/ /rnam brtags ⑤pa yi ye shes gcig gis ni/ /yul gcig gyurang bzhin so sor snang ba la/ /yul can la ni yul gyi ming btags pa/ /de ni nges pa ma yin 'khrul pas brtagasal/ /kun byed nga yi rang 'byung ye shes min⑧/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin gcig pu 6)la/ /'khor gyi 'dod pa rnams kyis ming btags ⑩pa / /la las byang chub sems su ming btags la/ /la las chos kyi dbyings su ming yang btags/ /la las nam mkha'i khams su ming yang btags/ /la las rang 'byung ye shes ming (meyang btagasatso/ /la las chos kyi sku 0ru ming yang btagasal/ /la las longs spyod rdzogs par ming yang btags/ /la las sprul pa'i sku ru ming yang btags/ /la las sku gsung thugs su ming yang btags/ /la las thams cad mkhyen par ming yang btags/ /la las rnam pa thams cad ming yang btags/ /la las ye shes bzhi dang gsum du btags/ /la las ye shes lnga ru ming btags la/ /la las dbyings dang ye shes ming btags pa/ /rang 'byung byang chub sems ni gcig la btags/ /rang 'byung nga la mthong tshad smras pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rang 'byung ye shes bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu pa'o// // gyide nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des rdzogs pa chen po'i lam la 101—126

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 1 7bgrod du med pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig① /kun byed rgyal po nga ni byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems ni kun gyi lam chen te②/ /gnas dang yul dang sangs rgyas sa dang gsum/ /gzhan na med de 'di na rang bzhin gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings dang chos nyid 'di na gnas/ /nam ①mkha'i khams dang gzhal yas 'di na gnas/ /sangs rgyas sa dang yul ni byang chub sems / /gzhan du bgrod pa'i lam dang gnas med de/ /bgrod pas nam mkha'i lam la phyin pa med/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /lam la bgrod pa yod par lung ston pa/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /bgrod pa'i lam ni lnga dang gsum bstan te/ /de la bgrod pas phyin par 'dod pa ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu thob par 'dod yin na/ /rdzogs chen bgrod du med dang mi mthun te/ /tshogs dang sbyor ba sgom mthong thob pa lngar/ /tshogs gnyis bsags nas gzung (ge'adzin gnyis choms (gete/ /bsgoms (7pas chos mthong thob pa'i 'bras bu de/ /bgrod du med pa'i lam dang ma phrad pas/ /bde chen rtsol gasgrub 'das pa ming mi grag /'bras bu gsang bar bstan pa lam gsum ni/ /de bzhin nyid dang kun du snang la sogs/ /sku gsum lam (nyazhes goms 6)par bsgoms pa des/ /rang byung yichos la rgyu 'bras bsnyen sgrub bzhis / /bgrod 47pas rtsol tshesgrub 'das pa'i sar mi phyin/ /rang sems spros bral chos kyi dbyings yin pas/ /spros bral de na sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs / /de bas lam la bgrod par ma byed cig /rang sems ma bsgribs ⑫ nam mkha' bzhin du gsalas/ /de na dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs / /de bas lam la bgrod par ma byed cigasnyi /rang sems ma bcos 101—127

1 8 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101chos nyid ji bzhin pa①/ /de la dus gsum sangs rgyas lhun gyis grub/ /de bas lam la bgrod par ma byed cig② /gal te ma rig lam la bgrod gyur na/ /phyin pa'i dus med rtogs thob dus med de/ /bgrod pas sangs rgyas sa ru phyin pa med/ /sangs rgyas rang sems rtog pa bral ba yin/ /bgrod pas rang sems rtog bral der mi phyin/ /lta ba bsgoms ②pas ting 'dzin yul dang phrad/ /ting 'dzin de yis rtog bral mnyam dang bral/ /dam tshig bsrungs dupas ma nyams 'dzin la gnas/ /ma nyams 'dzin pas ⑤rtog med mnyam dang bral/ /phrin las btsal bas grub pa'i ting 'dzin byed/ /grub pa'i ting 'dzin mi rtog mnyam dang bral/ /sa la sbyangs pas gnas pa'i ting 'dzin byed/ /'byongs pa'i ting 'dzin rtog med mnyam dang bral/ /chos nyid brtags ⑥pas gsal ⑦ba'i ting 'dzin byed/ /ting 'dzin gsal ⑧bas rtog med mnyam dang bral/ /ye shes gsal khyabar rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin byed/ /gsal ⑩bar rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin mi rtog bral/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /'dod pa'i ting 'dzin ji ltar gsal skyob des/ /'dod pa med pa bde ba grub par byed/ /bya bral zin pa'i bde ba chen po de/ /mi rtog 'dod pa med pa de yis blangs/ /ting 'dzin mi byed bag chags mi sog pas/ /rang 'byung ye shes las kyi dbang mi 'gyur/ /rang 'byung ye shes chos sku'i snying po de/ /btsal bas mi 'grub rang bzhin gnas pas 'grub/ /grub par bya ba'i don rnams kun dang bral/ /don zhes bya ba'i ming tsam 8btags pa yin/ /yang dag nyid du sangs rgyas ming tsam yin/ /sangs rgyas ming du 'dogs par byed pa ni/ /nges pa'i lung min 7drang ba'i lung du bstan/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /101—128

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 1 9chos dang sangs rgyas dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum/ /yod par ming btags de gnyan ①bsgrub pa ru/ /nga las byung ba'i 'khor ni sems can la/ /bde 'o ②skyed do sdug bsngal de blangs dunas/ /'di las ma gtogs ①pa yi bde ba ni/ /gzhan med zer nas lta spyod sna tshogs pa/ /spyad pas grub pa'i lung 'di bstan pa yin/ /bya med kun byed nga yi lung ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las lam la bgrod du med pa'i le'u ste nga gcig pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des bya med rdzogs pa 'dod pa med pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ chos rnams thams cad grub 'dod na/ /'dod pa'i sa ni ma sgrub cig⑤ /'dod par byed pa'i sems de ni/ /mi len thams cad spong ba yin/ /'di ni rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i phyir/ /'bras bu 'dod nas rgyu mi sgrub/ /mi rtog rang bzhin gnas pas 'grub⑥/ /'dod pa'i ting 'dzin thams cad spongasal/ /'dod med thams cad len par byed / /ting nge 'dzin pas 'dod pa 'dzin/ /'dod pa de ni yang dag min/ /yang dag gzung ⑧du yod ma yin/ /byas pa'i las ni thams cad kyis/ /ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa sgrub/ /ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa de/ /byas pas grub pa ma yin te/ /ma byas ye nas lhun gyis grub/ /'dod pas thams cad kun spangs pas/ /grub par byed pa'i gegs su che/ /'dod pa'i ting 'dzin bag chags des/ /bag chags de yo)ni sems 'dzin yin/ /'dzin pas bde ba de spong byed/ /mi 'dzin bde ba kun len pas/ /ji bzhin pa yi rang bzhin no/ /101—129

130 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101ji bzhin bcos pa med pa de/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa gcig /bde ba che 6)las ma gtogs ②pa/ /'dod dang 'dzin pa ga la yod/ /mi gnas pa ②la dmigs pa med/ /mi rtog pa la 'dzin pa med/ /med pa don gyi snying po de/ /'dod pa med pas thob par 'gyur/ /gang la 'dzin chags med pa des/ /ting nge 'dzin te 'dzin pa'i mchog /kun zin ye nas grub zin pas/ /btang ④gzhag mi rtog grub pa'i rgyal/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ sna tshogs bsgoms dupas gcig mi gsalayi/ /gsal ba ting 'dzin gang byed pa/ /de la'ang ting 'dzin yod ma yin/ /de bzhin nyid du gcig pa la/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su phye/ /bde dang sdug bsngal gnyis phye nas/ /bde ba dang du blang lung bstan / /sdig pa rgyab tu bor lung bstan/ /de ni nges pa'i lung dang 'gal/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ gcig la gnyis su ma 'byed cig /bde ba sdug bsngal byang chub gcig⑦ /sangs rgyas sems can sems su gcig /snang srid snod bcud chos nyid gcig(gu /bden brdzun 6)gnyis kyang chos nyid mnyam/ /bde ba ma len sdug ma spong / /rang bzhin gnas pas kun kyang 'grub/ /bde la chags pa sdug bsngal yin/ /kun gsal de la rtog med pas/ /⑩de ni rang 'byung ye shes yin/ /ye shes bag chags mi sog (nyapas/ /las kyis gos par ga la 'gyur/ /rgyu 'bras ye shes ting 'dzin rtog /rtog pa'i ye shes bag chags can/ /ye shes bag chags dbang sgyur snyibs/ /rtog pa'i ye shes bsgom ⑫mi bya/ /rtog pa'i ye shes bsgom byas pas/ /mi rtog mnyam dang bral bar 'gyur / /ting 'dzin rtsol yiba'i nad kyis zin/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/kun byed nga ni byang chub sems/ /thams cad byang chub sems yin la/ /byang 101—130

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 131chub sems las thams cad med/ /sems las sprul pa'i chos ni sna tshogs te/ /sna tshogs sprul pa cir yang snang ba ni/ /sems can gzugs dang dbyibs dang kha dog dang / /ji ltar snang ba de la dad pa re/ /dad pa de yis 'thad pa'i chos ston pa/ /de ni ye shes thugs rje sprul par bshad/ /de yang rang bzhin chos la g.yos pa med/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin chos la g.yos ①med pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi chos nyid yin/ /chos nyid las ni sangs rgyas gud na med/ /sangs rgyas las ni sems can gud na med/ /sems can mi rtog sangs rgyas dgongs pa yin/ /byang chub sems ma byung gi bar ②du ni/ /sangs rgyas dang ni sems can gnyis ka ①med/ /de bas sangs rgyas kun pas sems nyid bsngags④/ /sems nyid mi 'gyur 'gyur ba ye nas med/ /chos nyid bsgyur ⑤bas g.yos pa rdul med par/ /gcig la rim pa dgu dang brgyad khri stong glu/ /'byed pa'i ston pas gcig gi don mi rtogs/ /gcig ma rtogs pas kun don rtogs mi 'gyur/ / des na yisems gcig don de rab tu rtogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las ma g.yos 'dod pa med pa'i le'u ste nga gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad g.yos pa med pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nga rtogs shig /nga rtogs chos rtogs g.yos pa med/ /kun byed rgyal po ston pa nga nyid ni/ /byang chub sems la g.yos pa med pa de/ /thams cad byang chub sems las g.yos med cing ske/ /rang 'byung ye shes rgyu rkyen med pa de/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu kun las 101—131

13 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 'a 101shin tu rgyal/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa can la shin tu gsang ①/ /ma skyes rdo rje chos kyi dbyings na rgyal/ /rgyu 'bras can la mi smra shin tu gsang ②/ /sems nyid ma 'gags nam mkha'i dbyings na rgyal/ /rgyu 'bras can la mi smra shin tu gsang / /snang srid snod bcud ma bcos ①chos nyid rgyal/ /rgyu 'bras can la mi smra shin tu gsang dhi/ /nam mkha' rlung chu sa me snang ba lnga/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bor shin tu rgyal/ /rgyu 'bras can la mi smra shin tu gsang ⑤/ /khams gsum dus rjogasum thugs rje ye shes rgyal/ /rgyu 'bras can la mi smra shin tu gsang ⑦/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin kun byed la/ /ma yal ma zhi rang bzhin zhi ba med/ /chos dbyings rang (nyebazhin spros med zhi ba del/ /ma yal ma zhi rang bzhin spros pa med/ /rang 'byung ye shes ma bsgribs gsal ⑩ba de/ /mkha' la ma yal ma zhi zhi ba med/ /snang srid snod bcud chos nyid rang bzhin te/ /ma yal ma zhi rang bzhin zhi ba med/ /chos rnams thams cad ma yal ma zhi ba/ /rang bzhin gsal 0te ngo bo g.yos pa med/ /g.yos med chos la rgyu 'bras sgrub byed pa/ /de ni nga yi lung min 'dod lung yinatso/ /nga ni 'dod pa med pas kun grub ste00/ /mi 'dod 8'dod pa med par rang bzhin 'grub/ /grub ces bya ba nga yis smras pa med/ /rgyu 'bras grub 'dod rnams kyi tshig tu'o/ /nga ni sgro dang skur pa'i sgra ru che/ /yod dang med dang grub dang ma grub dang / /sgro dang skur pa btab pa 7thams cad kun/ /mi rtog pas ni mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /mnyam pa nyid las ma gtogs ⑩gzhan pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mes po ngas ⑩ma gsungs/ /ma gsungs dgongs pa sangs rgyas kun mi ston4)/ /gsungs pa thams cad nga yi ngo bo gsungs/ /ngo bo rang bzhin chos rnams thams cad 101—132

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 133yin / /rang bzhin rnam dag mnyam pa'i rgyal po de/ /mi 'gyur rang bzhin chags pa kun dang bral/ /gzung ①ba'i yul med sems kyi gnas kyang med/ /de la mngon sum thob par su 'dod pa/ /'dod pa de ni chags pa'i gnas yin te / /de la mi rtog mnyam pa'i dgongs pa de/ /chos nyid ye nas rang bzhin gnas pa la/ /de btsal bsam pas 'dod sgrub ⑤byed pa ni/ /rang sems gzhan du tshol bar byed pa yin/ /de yis chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i khamasal/ /khams gsum gnas dang srid pa'i chos bshig kyang / /rang sems rang bzhin gnas pa de mi rnyed/ /rang gi sems ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin te/ /mtha' la thug pa med pas dbyings la bri ba med/ /rang sems nam mkha' rang bzhin de mi rig /chos kyi rang bzhin kun kyang de lta ste/ /ji bzhin pa la kun kyang bcos pa med/ /'chos pa rol pa'i ting 'dzin ci byas kyang / /ji bzhin pa la ngo bo 'gyur ba med/ /'gyur te lhag pa'i stobs gcig che 'gyur na / /ting 'dzin gcig ④gis 'khor ba lhag ma med/ /smra yang ji bzhin pa la 'gyur ba med/ /rang bzhin che ⑤ba'i yul la rang bzhin gnas/ /rang bzhin ma bcos pa yi ming yin la/ /che ba ma bcos pa la lam zhes brjod/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang ni/ /sems can rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la/ /bzang ngan che chung khyad par yod ma gsungs/ /mi rtog chos nyid mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /mnyam pas chos dang chos min gcig nyekyang med/ /sems can rgyu rtsimed sangs rgyas 'bras bu med/ /rgyu 'bras ston pa ston pa nyid lung nor/ /de bas nga las byung ba'i chos mnyam pas/ /nga las byung ba bzang ngan med mnyam gcig(kye /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed 101—133

134 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101rgyal po las chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin g.yos pa med pa'i le'u ste nga gsum pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi rang bzhin rang 'byung gi ye shes yin la/ rang 'byung gi ye shes de don gyi ngo bo lnga dang ldan te gang zhe na/ don chos thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po dang / don ma nor nges pa'i ngo bo dang / don rgyu 'bras 'das yo)pa'i ngo bo dang / don byar med pa'i ngo bo dang / don chos thams cad gtan tshil 'bebs pa'i ngo bo dang lnga'o/ /de la rang 'byung gi ye shes de la bsdus ⑧pa'i mdo lung ni lnga/ phye ba'i mdo lung ni lnga bcu rtsa bdun po ④'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po don 'di nyon cig /kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems nga ni/ /rang 'byung ye shes chen po gcig la ni/ /rang 'byung ye shes bsdus ⑤pa lnga las ni/ /phye ba'i mdo lung lnga bcu rtsa bdun te/ /nga yi ngo bo lnga bcu rtsa bdun yin/ /de yi ngo bo ji ltar yin zhe (6)na/ /ye shes ngo bo chos kyi snying po las/ /mngon du phyung ⑦ba'i mdo lung bcu yang bstan/ /ye shes ma nor nges pa'i ngo bo las/ /ma nor nges pa'i mdo lung bcu yang bstan/ /ye shes rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i ngo bo las rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i mdo lung bcu yang 'byung / /ye shes bya ba med pa'i ngo bo las / /bya med rdzogs pa'i mdo lung bcu yang 'byung / /ye shes gtan (nyal 'bebs pa'i ngo bo las/ ci /gtan la 'bebs pa'i mdo lung bcu yang 'byung /ci /sems nyid ye shes ngo bo rnam lnga las/ /mdo lung bcu tshan rnam pa lnga byung ni/ /rang bzhin ngo bo yid ches lnga bstan yin/ /bdun ni nges par bstan pa'i le'u 101—134

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 135bdun gyis/ /gcig gis gzhi ①bstan gcig gis gdams pa bstan②/ /lnga niyis so so dgos pa lnga yang bstan④/ /de yi don gyi bye brag bstan pa ni/ /dbang rgyapo chos nyid mthong bar bya ba'i phyir/ /mngon du phyung ba'i mdo lung bcu yang bstan/ /yin min ⑥yid ches ④rtog pa bsal niba'i phyir/ /ma nor ⑨nges pa'i mdo lung bcu yang bstan/ /kun byed rgyal po'i rang 'byung ye shes de//rgyu rkyen kyidag la rag ma las pa'i phyir/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i mdo lung bcu yang bstan/ /kun byed rgyal po'i rang 'byung ye shes des/ /bya byed rtsol 0sgrub bya mi dgos pa'i phyir/ /bya med rdzogs pa'i mdo lung bcu yang bstan/ /kun byed rgyal po'i rang 'byung ye shes des/ /nyid kyi rang bzhin gtan 8la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ /gtan la 'bebs pa'i mdo lung bcu yang bstan/ /de la don gyi dgos pa lnga yod de/ /chos nyid mngon du phyung ba'i mdo lung la/ /chos nyid mngon du mthong ba'i dgos pa yod/ /chos nyid ma nor mngon du mthong ba (nyedes / /lta spyod dam tshig lam la bgrod mi dgos/ /ma nor nges par ston ⑫pa'i mdo lung la/ /ma nor yid ches nges pa'i dgos pa yod/ /sems nyid ma nor yid ches mngon pa des/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub mi dgos pa'i dgos pa yod/ /rgyu rkyen tsorag ma lus 7pa'i mdo lung la/ /rtsol sgrub ⑩bya mi dgos pa'i yon tan (nyeyod/ /rtsol ()zhing sgrub ru )pa bya mi dgos pa des/ /mi rtsol 0bde la gnas pa'i dgos pa yod/ /bya med rdzogs pa'i mdo lung bstan pa la/ /ma byas rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i dgos pa yod/ /bya med rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i dgos pa des/ /ye nas lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i dgos pa yod/ /gtan la 'bebs pa'i mdo lung bstan pa las/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas khams gsum 101—135

136 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101sems can dang / /snang srid snod ①bcud ②bsdus ③pa thams cad kun/ /rgyu med stinges pa rang 'byung bya med par/ /mdo lung lnga dang mthun 0par gtan dul 'bebs/ /gtan la 'bebs pa'i mdo rtsa bstan pa ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dang por lung bstan pa/ /chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin la/ /snga ⑦phyi dus gsum lta ba'i sems can rnams/ /phyi pa dran med snga ⑧pa bag chags 'gags/ /sems can nam mkha'i khyachos nyid mi shes mthong sangs rgyas sangs rgyas zhes bya'i nges tshig ni/ /chos nyid byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin la7/ /spros med dbyibs dang dbang po'i spyod yul sangs/ /nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab cing rgyas/ /sangs rgyas ming du btags pa nga yis med / /khams zhes bya ba'i gtan yitshigs tsobastan pa ni/ /mang zhing rgya che ba yi tsomatshan nyid de/ /khams gsum sems can gcig ④gi dbang po yis/ /dpag gis mi lang bas na khams zhes 8btags0/ /yang dag nges par ming du btags pa med/ /sems zhes ⑩bya ba'i nges tshig bstan pa ni/ /rgyu rkyen med pa'i rang 'byung ye shes des/ /ma 'gags kun la dbang po sgo lngar gsal/ /de la sems zhes snyi/bya bar gsal bar bshad/ /snang srid snod bcud bsdus pa thams cad kun/ /skye ba med las cho 'phrul snang ba deyi/ /sna tshogs srid pas snang srid ces su btags/ /snod dang bcud ces bya bar bstan pa ni/ /'byung lnga snod (gekyi nang na rgyud drug bcud/ /gnas pas snod bcud ces su btags pa yin/ /kun byed bya ba lhag ma ma lus pa/ /bsdus pas kun byed rgyal po'i rang bzhin lngar/ /mdo lung lnga bcu rtsa bdun byung nas bsdus/ /kun byed rang bzhin lnga ru 'dus par bstan/ /snying po mngon du 'byin pa'i 101—136

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 137rang bzhin dang / /ma nor nges par ston pa'i rang bzhin dang / /rang 'byung rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i rang bzhin dang / /bya byed rtsol lasgrub 'das pa'i rang bzhin dang / /mthun ②par gtan ⑧la 'bebs pa'i rang bzhin dang lnga'o zhes gsungs so/ /kye ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /sems dpa' rdo rje bdag gi rig pa yis/ /kun byed rang 'byung ye shes gcig ngo ④la/ /dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa lnga byung ①ste/ /rang 'byung ye shes chos kyi snying po las/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ /mi snang ba la mngon du 'byin nus pas / /chos kyi snying po yin par yid kyang ches/ /rang 'byung ye shes gcig gi ngo bo de/ /don dam kun rdzob bden brdzun gnyis med par/ /ma nor nges pa'i byang chub sems ston pas/ /the tshom dusom nyi ⑨med par niyid kyang ches/ /rang 'byung ye shes gcig gi ngo bo de/ /rgyu la mi brten 6)rkyen la mi sgrub pas/ /gzhan la rag ma las pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rang 'byung ye shes yin ⑩par yid kyang ches/ /rang 'byung ye shes gcig yigi ngo bo de/ /rgyu rkyen med par ⑫lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ /phrin las btsal zhing bya byed bya mi dgos/ /ma btsal lhun gyis grub par yid kyang ches/ /rang 'byung ye shes gcig gi ngo bo de//rang 'byung ye shes ye nas ma bsgribs 4)pas/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad gsal/ /chos rnams thams cad gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i sgron ma yin par yid kyang ches/ /zhes chagasungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las mdo lung thams cad kun byed nyid kyi rang bzhin du bsdus nas bstan pa'i le'u ste nga bzhi pa'o// //101—137

138 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101de nas byang chub gyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad byang chub sems las gzhan med pa'i mdo 'di gsungs sol/ /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /ji ltar snang srid snod ②bcud bsdus pa dang / /don dang tshig tu brjod pa thams cad kun/ /byang chub sems yin pa ni 'di lta ste/ /chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i khams 'di yang / /ma spros ma bsgribs pa yi byang chub semasal/ /'di las gzhan yin bdag gis gsungs pa med/ /nam mkha' rlung chu sa me snang ba yang / /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo bstan pa yin/ /'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams gsum yang / /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo gsum snang yin/ /de ston pa yi ston pa sku gsum yang / /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rnam gsum yin/ /sems nyid ye shes ma 'gags 'dod khams snang ske/ /sems nyid ngo bo snang ba gzugs nikyi khams/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ma skyes gzugs med khams/ /rang bzhin ma skyes spros bral chos kyi sku/ /sems nyid nyid 4)la nyid spyod longs spyod rdzogs/ /sems las sems sprul sems kyi don mdzad sprul/ /dmyal ba la sogs 'gro ba ris 0drug gi/ /tsha grang bkres skom blun lkugs ltung 'gyur rnams/ /mi rtog mnyam pas ji bzhin chos nyid grol/ /rang 'byung ye shes yul la mi rtog pas/ /las kyi bag chags skyon yon kun dang bral/ /yon tan mi len skyon rnams mi dor bas/ /bde ba mi sgrub sdug bsngal spang du med/ /ji bzhin pa la ye nas g.yos pa med/ /de bzhin bsgyur bas 'gyur ba'i chos gang med/ /'dod pas len pas 6)thob 4pa'i chos kyang med/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sems las rang 'byung ye shes 'byung ba 'dra/ /'dra zhes ming btags rang 'byung ye 101—138

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 139shes yin/ /rang 'byung ye shes chos nyid yul gcig ①la/ /chos gzhan mthong nas ye shes de spong byed/ /rang 'byung ye shes de dang phrad mi 'gyur/ /spong 'gegs yul can dag la ming mi grag /don dam kun rdzob ②bden pa rnam gnyis kyis/ /sbyangs kyang bskal pa gsum gyi bar du thogs/ /dag ①gsum spyod dang mtshan med sgor zhugs nas/ /byang chub yan lag kun gyi sgor zhugs nas / /cho ga rdzogs pa'i ting 'dzin rim pa yis/ /rang 'byung ye shes tshe bdun bar du spangs/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sgor zhugs nas/ /skye ④med shes rab thabs kyis bskyod 'gyur phyinas/ /snang la rang bzhin med par rang bsgoms yinas/ /cho ga lnga dang yo byad yan lag dang / /dam tshig tshul dang rab tu brtson 'gyur na/ /rig 'dzin sa ste lo stong drug brgya ru/ /longs sku 'dod pa'i ting 'dzin yengs med byed/ /longs sku thob nas rang sems bzod tshol lta/ /stong phrag gcig ⑦na mi rtog mnyam bzod rnyedaX/ /kye sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khyod nyid kyang / /nga lung ma nor khyod kyis nga ston cig⑨ /kye sems can lha mi rnams ni shes pa cing ⑩/ /dbang po yul la yiyengs pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sems can mi shes gang bstan tshim pa la/ /ma nor nges pa'i lung chen ma bstan 8par/ /rgyu 'bras drang lung don dam kun rdzob bstan/ /bden brdzun yonaganyis kyis shes pa de tshim nas/ /bskal tshupa yun rings libaden brdzun ⑩gnyis la gnas/ /de bas dang por rang sems ma nor bstan/ /bstan pas 7ma nor btsal med lam phrad nas/ /da lta nyid nas mi rtsol tunyes la gnas / /btsal du med pa'i lam dang de phrad 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin bsgom mi dgos dang de phrad 'gyur(che/ /mi rtsol ru )bde la gnas pa de yis thob/ /ma nor 101—139

140 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101nges par rang sems de thob pas/ /ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan ①ni/ /sems bskyed mi dgos lam la bgrod mi dgos/ /sa la mi sbyong ②lta ba bsgom mi dgos / /sdom pa tshul khrims dam ②du gnyer mi dgos/ /kye sems dpa' chen po lung ston cig④ /'jig rten mtshan ma'i chos 'di bsgrub ⑤pa bzhin/ /lus kyi las dusu bya byed lha mi sgomacha/ /ngag gi las gsu sngags ⑨dang tshig mi brjod / /yid kyi las su ting 'dzin gsal mi sgomatshu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems las med pa'i le'u ste nga lnga pa'o// //de nas sems dpa' rdo rje des/ byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po de ⑫chos thams cad kyi ngo bo dang byed pa po yin par nyid kyi 'khor thams cad la tshig bsgrags ⑩pa dang rtogs pa phul ba 'di bsgrags so/ /kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags/ /bdag gis khyod kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa ni/ /chos rnams thams cad khyod kyi rang bzhin gcig /chos nyid chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang de/ /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi gzhal yas khang 'di yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /skye med chos kyi sku yoston pa yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /'dod spyod longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'di yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /thugs rje ye shes sprul pa'i sku 'di yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi 'dod chags khams 'di yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi nga rgyal khams 101 —140

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 141'di yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /gzugs med khams kyi yid kyi lus 'di yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la gnas pa yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /da ①ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas don mdzad kyang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /slad kyis byon ②pa'i nyid las byung ba yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /rnal 'byor rnam bzhi nyid la lta ba yang / /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags/ /snang srid snod ③bcud 'byung ba lnga bsdus ④pa/ /kun byed rgyal po yin par rab tu grags / /kun byed rgyal po las ni ma gtogs pa(nya/ /sangs rgyas sems can snang srid snod bcud dang / /chos su grags pas bsdus pa thams cad la/ /kun byed rgyal po las ni gzhan mi snang / /zhes sems dpa' rdo rjes bsgrags so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las sems dpa' rdo rjes kun byed kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i sgo nas bsgrags ⑥pa'i le'u ste nga drug pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las sems dpa' rdo rje la bstan pa gtad ⑦pa'i le'u 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' rdo rje 'di zung ⑧shig /khyod ni rang 'byung ye shes te/ /khyod ni nga yis snying po 'byung 5)/ /nga yi rang bzhin 'di zung shigayi /nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum las/ /sku gsum ston pa byung ba yang / /de yi rang bzhin khyod kyis zung (ste/ /de yi bstan pa rnam gsum yang glu/ /bstan 8pa smra ba'i seng ge gyis(3/ /dus gnas 'khor la sogs pa yang —/ /nyid kyis byas par lung ston cig /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin nam/ /101—141

14 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101kun byed nga yi mtshan bshad bzhin/ /khyod kyis nga yi rang bzhin zung ①/ /nga ni kun gyi rang bzhin yin/ /sangs rgyas mes po nga yin gyisal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mes po gyis/ /kun byed rgyal po nga nyid ni/ /sku gsum ston pa'i pha yin gyis③/ /khyod kyis sku gsum pha ma gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas mes po gyis / /sems can kun gyi yang ④mes po/ /smra ba'i duseng ge smra ba'i 0tshe ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /sems dpa' chen po nyid dang ni/ /kun byed rgyal po nga las ni/ /gzhan yin smra bar ma byed cig /sku gsum bstan pa'i nang nas ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam gnyis las/ /rgyu la bsgrubs nas 'bras bur 'dod/ /sems can sangs rgyas ming btags nas/ /sems kyis sangs rgyas 'bras bur sgrub⑦/ /'di ni ning yi bstan ⑨pa min/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis las 'das/ /sems can sangs rgyas gnyis med pas/ /sangs rgyas sems kyis 0sgrub ma yibyed/ /kun byed rgyal po nga nyid ni/ /sems nyid rang 'byung ye shes so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po'i mdo las bstan pa gtad 'o pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po rdzogs so'// //rgya gar gyi mkhas pa ༷shrī si ⑩ha pra bhā dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba pa gor bai yiro tsa nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'i de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po rang 'byung ye shes skye ba med par rtogs nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas sems dpa' rdo rje 101 —142

chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 143dam pa des 'di skad ces zhus so/ /kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lagasal/ /legs par gsungs pa'i yo)mdo dag mthar phyin nas②/ /ston pa gsum po nyid kyis ①ji ltar rtogs/ /bstan pa gsum po nyid kyis ji ltar rtogs / /'khor gnas ④dus kyi rang bzhin ji ltar rtogs/ /nyid kyis ji ltar rtogs pa'i dgongs pa'i don/ /bdag cag rnams la legs par bstan du gsol / /zhes zhus so/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos durtogs pa bshad pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud phyi ma 'di gsungs soX/ /kye sems dpa' rdo rje don 'di legs par nyon/ /ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po yi/ /nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis/ /so sor 'dul ba'i don du gang gsungs pa/ /ston pa re ⑦dang gnas dang 'khor dag dang / /bstan pa sdud ⑧pa so sor gnas par rtogs/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin rtogs pa min/ /kye kun ⑨byed nga yi rtogs tshul bstan pa ni/ /nga bonyid skye ⑩ba med pa'i tsorang bzhin te/ /de las byung ba'i chos ni thams cad kun/ /rang 'byung skye ba med pa'i dbyings su rtogs/ /kye sems dpa' chen po legs par da nyon cig /nga nyid skye ba med par ngas rtogs pas/ /ston pa gsum yang skye ba med par rtogs/ /bstan pa gsum yang skye ba med par rtogs/ /'khor gnas dus kyang skye ba med par rtogs/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba med par rtogs/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bzhugs pa yang / /skye ba med pa nyid du rab tu rtogs/ /ma byon slad kyis 'byung tiba'i sangs rgyas yang ski/ /skye ba med pa nyid du rab tu rtogs / /kye ston pa kun byed nyid kyis rtogs pa ltar/ /tsosems dpa' rdo rje khyod kyis rtogs par gyis/ /sems dpa' rdo rjes de ltar ma 8rtogs na/ /kun 101—143

144 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101byed nga yi rang bzhin rtogs mi 'gyur/ /nga yi rang bzhin khyod kyis ma rtogs na//snying po'i rang bzhin bcu dag rtogs mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin bcu yi ①don la rmongs pa yis/ /bsgom du med pa'i lung bcu ji ltar rtogs/ /kye nga yis chos rnams ji ltar bstan pa ltar/ /sems dpa' rdo rje khyod kyis rtogs par byos/ /nga yi ②rang bzhin skye med rtogs pa ltar/ /kun gyi rang bzhin skye med rtogs par gyis/ /ston pa gsum yang skye ①ba med par rtogs/ /bstan pa gsum yang skye ba med par rtogs/ /'khor gnas dus kyang skye ba med par rtogs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas skye ba med par rtogs/ /rgyud 0drug sems can skye ba med par rtogs/ /sa chu (mime rlung nam mkha' lnga po yang / /skye ba med pa'i ngang du rab tu rtogs/ /khams gsum srid gsum skye ba med par rtogs/ /'dod lnga yul lnga skye ba med par rtogs/ /des na chos kun ⑥byang chub sems nyid de/ /byang chub sems ni kun byed rgyal po nyid/ /kun byed rgyal po skye ba med par rtogs / /chos kun gartsa ba ⑧kun byed nga nyid 6)de/ /nga 7nyid ma skyes dbyings su rtogs pas tunyen/ /kun kyang skye med dbyings su rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las rtogs pa gleng gzhi'i tso le'u ste nga brgyad pa'o// //de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos lta ba bsgom ()du med pa rtogs pa 'di gsungs so/ /kye sems dpa' rdo rje legs par da rtogs yishig /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba kun byed la/ /lta dang blta 7bar byed pa ⑩yod ma yin / /gang la ⑩ltar med 6)snying po gang rtogs pa/ /kun byed nga yi rang bzhin 101—144
