de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/319rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /btang ①snyoms ma 'dres yangs pa nyid / /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na / /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /gzugs ni ma 'dres 'brel pa nyidaphyi/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /ting 'dzin ma 'dres mi g.yeng ①ba/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /ma 'dres pa nyid mi 'phrogs pa/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /kun grol ma 'dres mngon sum ④pa/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /chos can ma 'dres sna tshogs pa/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /ye shes kun mkhyen skye 'gag med/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na / /dbyings nyid med la mi zad pa/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /sprul pa med 'byung rgyun mi 'chad/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /rdzogs sku ma 'dres phun sum tshogs/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /chos sku rnam par dag pa'i (5)nyid/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres 101—319

3 0 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de 0)bzhin nyid kho na/ /thams cad ma 'dres tha dad pa/ /yongs su rdzogs pas stong bdag med/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs na/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid kho na/ /chos kun brjod pa'i cho ②'phrul lasal/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid snang ba/ /dbu mar mi dmigs gsang ba nyid/ /skyes bu dam pa'i spyod yul yin/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg chen 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gsal/ /ci phyir rdo rje gsang sngags dang / /sems can sangs rgyas tha dad min/ /gsang sngags rdo rje rnal 'byor pa/ /skyes bu thabs kyi pha rol phyin/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mi ldan na/ /de nyid thabs dang shes rab bral/ /de bas rnal 'byor chen po yis/ /rdo rje gsang sngags dam pa yi/ /cho 'phrul bzhi yi rang bzhin las/ /nam yang 'da' bar bya ba min/ /zhes smras pas/ ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos thams cad kun du bzang po ①nyid do zhes yongs su grag cing grags par gyur to(4kyi/ /lang ma'i bdag po de dag ni kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul te/ de dag kyang so sor ma 'dres par de kho na nyid gcig tu yongs su 'grel to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nya57dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcwa 6)brgyad pa'o// //lang ku'i bdag po de la rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gang zhe na/ zhi gnas yongs su rdzogs par 'grel pa ni 'di lta ste/ ji snyed pa thams cad ji bzhin pa nyid du yongs su rdzogs pa 'ba' zhig go/ /de ji lta zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de nyid mi g.yo nam mkha' la/ /g.yo rdul tha dad ji snyed pa/ /mi rtog ye shes rgya 101—320

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/ 3 1mtsho che/ /gcig las rnam pa yongs kyis ①med/ /rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor che/ /de na dman dang sems dpa' dang / /spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ming yang med/ /lhun mnyam byang chub snying po las/ /nges pa'i dgongs pa'i mnyam rnyed nas/ /ji bzhin ma bcos de kho na/ /zab mo dam pa nges pa'i don/ /ngo mtshar dam pa chen po yis/ /rdo rje snying po nyid la ②nyid/ /dgongs pa'i don la 'di skad 'grel/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes pa nyid na skye ba med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /'gag pa med las thams cad 'gag /'gag pa nyid na 'gag pa med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /dmigs pa med las thams cad dmigs/ /dmigs pa nyid na dmigs pa med//e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /mi gnas pa las thams cad gnas/ /gnas pa nyid na gnas pa med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /'gro 'ong med las 'gro 'ong nyid/ /'gro 'ong nyid na 'gro 'ong med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /ma bcos ma bslad ④byas pa med/ /ji bzhin rang bzhin rnam par dag /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin las/ /bde ba chen po lhun gyis /4)grub/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i 101—321

3 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /stong pa ma yin mi 6)stong min/ /dbu ma dmigs su yod ma yin/ /e ma'o ②ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /nges par brtags na rtag pa nyid/ /rtag chad de nyid gnyen po med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ske/ /nges par chad dun chad ④pa med/ /byang chub nyid de log rgyun chad/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /chos so cog gi rang bzhin ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi brnyes so/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /rab 'byam (5)mtha' yas gang nas kyang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yong (6)mi tshol ye ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /sems nyid rtog napa sangs rgyas te/ /de las gzhan du yod ma yin/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /srid gsum ye nas snying po nyid/ /ma nor ma bcos lhun gyis (81grub/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings/ /btsal 99 ba med par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /kun nas kun du ngang bzang po/ /thams cad ye ⑩'byam rmad du grags/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /snying po byang chub de nyid las//ma gtogs 1lhagang yang yod ma yin/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs 101—322

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/3 3pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /thams cad sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /rtog pas bsgribs pas de ma shes/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /rtog pa nyid na rtog med phyir/ /bde gshegs snying po gzhan nas min/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /kun gyi snying po byang chub la/ /ye nas dgongs pa lhun gyis grub/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ske/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i snying po la/ /sgrub dang bsgrub par bya ba med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /ye nyid 'bras bu dam pa la/ /thob par bya ba ga la yod/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chosal/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /gsang sngags gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ /sangs rgyas sems can kun gyi gsang / /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /'dus pa gsang ba rmad 'byung 0)ba/ /rdo rje snying po 'dus pa nyid/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /gsang ba dam pa'i snying po 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nges pa'o/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /zla ba gsang ba las byung ba'i/ /gsung gi thig le zab mo byung / /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /gzugs snang mkha' la 'ja' ltar gsal/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /snang srid sgyu ma'i ye shes las/ /sprul pa'i dra ba sprin phung byung / /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi 101—323

3 4 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101gsang ske/ /sprul pa thabs kyi dra ba las/ /mtha' gnyis 'dzin pa'i zhags pa byung —/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang —/ /bya 1)bral rnal 'byor mthun 'jug spyod/ /sbyor thabs bya ba las rgyud byung / /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ske/ /lhag par mthong dang zhi bar gnas/ /dag pa'i mtha' gnyis nges par byung / /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /sde mdzod dzo dam pa'i bka' lung rnams/ /'byung gnas gtan la nges par 'bebs/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /gdul bya'i yul ni ji snyed pa'i/ /gsung gi sgo yang de snyed 'byung —/ /e ma'o kyingo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang —/ /rab 'byam ( rmad du grags pa 'di/ /bka' yi rab (5)rgyud dam pa nyidarka/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos(6)/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ske/ /ji bzhin pa yi de kho na/ /bstan pa 'byung ba'i snying po mchog /e mtho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /zab mo 'dus pa'i gtan tshigs 'di/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i snying po'i yum/ /rnam pa sna tshogs snang bar mdzad/ /mi 'gyur mi 'jug rdo rje sems/ /dpag tu med pa gsung mtha' yas/ /yon tan rin chen sna tshogs 'byung / /mtha' dag lhun grub gdon mi za/ /rdo rje snying po nyid la nyid/ /nyi ma thugs kyi dkyil 'khor shar/ /bsam med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /dpag med brgyad khri bzhi stong sgo/ /grags pa'i rnam grangs bsam yas kyang / /nges pa'i theg pa gcig las med/ /gsang nyid ma nges 'jug bar 7du/ /theg pa'i 101 —324

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/ 3 5sgo yang bsam mi khyab/ /gsang nyid nges par snang ma thag /theg pa'i sgo yang de las med/ /brjod dang bstan pa'i rnam grangs 0)kun/ /bkri ba'i don de de nyid min/ /tshig brda ②brjod pas don rnyed ①pa/ /sgron mes mun khung gser tshol (4)ltar/ /gsang ba'i snying po'i mdzod brtol te/ /dam pa rnams kyi gter chen 'byin/ /thig le gcig gis kun la khyab/ /thams cad lung chen nges par bstan/ /de dag de nyid ngang (5)grol na/ /gsang sngags mthong ba sangs rgyas te/ /kun kyang bde chen byang chub sems/ /rtog bral dri med rnam par dag /bde chen nyid la bde chen rdzogs/ /ye shes nyi ma'i snying po shar/ /ma lus mtha' dag thig le'i rgya(5)/ /ye nas btsal (7med btsal (kyemi dgos/ /rgyu 'bras dbyer med de nyid de/ /mi g.yo mi rtog yul 'das la/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur rtog 'dzin gyis/ /thams cad sgyu ma 'khrul pas bcings/ /rang byung ye shes nyi ma nyid/ /ma bcos ji bzhin gnas pa na/ /snying po nyid du gol sa med / /thams cad byang chub snying po bas/ /kun kyang ma btsal bde bar gnos6) / /snang srid 'khor ba'i kha brgyud kyang / /snying po dbyings las gar mi phyin / /mtha' thug med pa'i gzhi bgrod kyang / /snying po de las g.yos pa med//dpag med rgyal ba kun bsgrun 7kyang / /snying po yongs su 'phel ba med/ /sems can mtha' /nyathug med 'byung yang / /de nyid de las 'grib pa med/ /skye bzhi rgyud 7lngar gang snang ba/ /sangs rgyas nyid de ye shes sku/ /thams cad de nyid de gcig pas/ /ye nas sangs rgyas bde chen nyid/ /skye 'gag med pa'i snying po yin/ /bya byed med pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ /ye nas bsgrubs zin lhun gyis grub/ /sgrub pa 'di la gang gnas pa/ /rnal 'byor de nyid skal nyu no101—325

3 6 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101ba bzang / /ji ltar bsgoms bsgrubs ①ci spyad kyang / /de nyid yin te don gyi mchog /rgyal ba kun gyi snying po nyid/ /byin brlabs ②ngo mtshar rgya cher 'byung ske/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi yum / /sangs rgyas bde chen de las byung //ma lus kun gyi snying po 'di/ /spros med thig ler gnas pa las/ /rgyal sras sems can kun gyi phyir/ /nyid la 'chad ④cing nyid la 'grel⑤/ /zhi gnas mi rtog mkha' khyab la/ /lhag mthong ma rmongs 'ja' tshon gsal/ /ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa las/ /dgongs pa nges par 'grel par bshad/ /lang ku'i bdag po stong (7pa nyid las de skad du sgra brnyan byung bas thams cad ma 'dres pa dang —/ yongs su rdzogs par 'grel pa ni kun du bzang po nyid do/ /lang ku'i bdag po de ltar na gang gi dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa de dag kyang gzhi dang /'jug pa dang / sbyor ⑦ba dang / rtsa ba dang / nges pa 'ba' zhig las gyur pa dang / snang ba dang / brjod pa dang / bstan par ris par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pas/ lang ma'i bdag po la sogs pa dman pa'i lus kyi sems dpa' rnams yi (gurangs te/ thams cad ma 'dres pa dang / yongs su rdzogs par thugs su chud nas mtha' dbus med par grol te dbugs phyin par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las gang yongs su rdzogs par 'grel pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //theg pa chen po nges par 'byung ba'i tshul las sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i gtam rgyud brjod (9)pa'i chos kyi phyag rgya ye shes rnam par bgros pa ste byung tshul bstan pa lnga pa'o⑩// //101—326

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo je bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor spub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/3 7de nas yang lang ma'i mnga' bdag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des gsang ba pa'i bdag po la sngon du byung ba'i tshig bcu gnyis pa'i drug pa gdul bya'i skabs la bab pa'i ched na byung ①zhes 'byung ②ba'i dri ba yongs su dris pa/ kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po nyid kyis theg pa chen po'i gsang ba dam pa ③'byung ba'i tshul ston pas lung bstan pa gtam du brjod pa'i skabs su/ gdul bya'i skabs la bab pa'i tshe na yang byung ④zhes bkod pa de 'jig rten pa gang zhig gdul bya'i 0skabs la bab nas yongs su btul ba grags pa lags/ smras pa/lang ku'i bdag po gsang sngags 'byung ba'i rgyu gdul bya khyad par can 'jig rten sreg ⑥par byed pa khro bo tshul rngam pa gdul bya'i dus la nges par bab pa'i tshe yongs su btul ⑦ba na phyogs dus kun gyi sangs rgyas thams cad snying po byang chub gang nas (kyeder 'dus nas skyes bu dam pa dag la rnam par bskul pas ji lta ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa'i sgron ma yongs su bkod pa lta bu'i khro bo'i sprin rnam 6)par 'jigs pa rdul snyed kyis btul ba de kho na'i tshe de kho na'i dus nyid du 'byung zhing grags so/ /smras pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po gdul bya de ⑩gang las byung / de las dang skye ba ji ltar lags/ gsang sngags 'byung ba'i rgyur ji ltar 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol ba las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ kye lang ku'i bdag po de ni 'di lta ste/ dran pa dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba ni yinasangs rgyas mi bskyod tu pa zhes bya ba bskal pa kun dga' zhes bya ba la zhing khams mngon par dga' ba zhes bya bar byung ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i dge slong thub dka' tshonagazhon nu zhes bya ba gang ji lta ba bzhin theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ thams cad nas thams 101—327

3 8 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (mi 101cad du ma bcos ma bslad 6)pa'i rnal 'byor du gnas pa/ skyes bu dam par chud pa zhig byung ba des (misems can thams cad rgyal ba'i sras su mthong zhing de dag yongs su bskul ①ba la brtson pa 'ba' zhig byed do/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor ba thog ma dang tha ma med par skye ba thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i las dang /skye ba dpag tu med pa'i brjod kyis mi rdzogs te/ las skabs gcig gis skye ba cha gcig la gzung 'a)na 'di lta ste/ nye 'khor du khyim bdag ke'u ka ya zhes bya ba la bu thar pa nag po zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ bu de la g.yog dan (sribag zhes bya ba zhig yod do/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na mi gang dag dge slong thub dka' (6)gzhon nu la rnal 'byor gyi lam bslabs te/ kun kyang rnal 'byor gyi lam la gnas shing rnal 'byor la spyod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na thar pa nag po de 'di ltar rtog go/ /dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu 'dis/ thams cad ji lta ba bzhin ston par thos nas thams cad ni dga' bar spyod pa bzhin du lam yod pa'i chos dag 'byung ngam zhes rtog la/ gang dag la yang dris pa las thams cad kyis de ltar 'byung bar smras so/ /de nas g.yog dang bcas pas dge slong 7ga la ba der zhugs te gnas su phyin nas 8)de 'dun pa legs par 'dun nas gsol pa/ dge slong chen po thams cad ji lta bar spyod pa bzhin du lam ston pa'i thabs la mkhas par thos na de de lta nyid du nges sam/ de skad ces gsol pa las 79smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de de lta nyid du 'byung ba dag yod par rung ngo / /de skad ces smras pas/ thar pa g.yog dang bcas pa dga' mgu yi tsharangs te/ bdag g.yog dang bcas pa 'di khyod nyid kyi bka' bar gzung du gsol/ bdag kyang khyod la thams cad mi 'gag pa'i lam blangs te 101—328

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/3 9rnal 'byor du gnas par 'tshal ①bas dam pa nyid du nges par gzung du gsol zhes 'dun pa las/ dge slong des smras pa/ yin no legs so/ /de ltar bya'o zhes legs pa ②byin nas thar pa nag po rab tu byung nas dam par bzung ①/dan bag ni dus 'dzin du bzung ste dge slong thar ④pa'i g.yog tu byas so/ /de nas thar pa dge slong gis gsol pa/ dge slong chen po thams cad ji lta ba'i lam dam pa de gang lags/ smras pa/ ji bzhin nyid de ma bcos na/ /dngos po bzhi 6)la gnas spyad kyang / /nam mkha' la ni dusprin bzhin te/ /'di ni rnal 'byor dam pa'i lam/ /de skad ces smras pas/ thar pa g.yog dang bcas pa yi ⑦rangs te/ e ma'o thabs la mkhas so/ /nges so/ /yin no/ /gtad (kyedo / /bdag thams cad du dzi)de la yongs su gnas so zhes gsol te/ sgra ji lta ba de bzhin du spyad pa las thar tunyepa dge slong ni blo gros kyi nges pa ma rnyed de(me/sgra 'ba' zhig la phyogs pas dngos po bzhi kho nas spyad de zhen nas lus dam pa'i cha byad du bcug nas sems ngan 'gro ba'i lam du zhugs so/ /g.yog dan bag tsoni sgra gzhi'i 7don gyi changes pa rnyed nas blo gros dam par 'brel te/ don 'ba' zhig la phyogs pas ji bzhin pa kho tsonar spyad ⑩de zhen nas yongs su rnal 'byor pas ()lus ma rabs kyi cha byad du bcug nas sems dam par nges pa'i lam du zhugs so/ /de nas thar pa g.yog dang lta ba ma mthun te/ smras pa/ bdag cag gnyis ni dpon gcig la sgra gcig tu byung ba 'di la so sor ma mthun pa 'di ji lta zhig /dan yi bag gis smras pa/ bdag gis ni da ltar nges par 'jog pa 'di kho na las gzhan ma thos lags so/ /smras pa/ bdag gis kyang da 0)ltar nges pa rnyed de ru spyod pa 'di kho na las gzhan ma thos so zhes smras pas/101—329

346 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101nas byung rdo rje snying po'i lus/ /mtha' yas rtog las yi ge sna tshogs sprul/ /sras kyi tshogs kyis mdzes par bskor ba'i dkyil/ /gzugs skur bstan nas nyon mongs sbyang du gsol/ /gang du dang po rdo rje snying po ni/ /khams gsum nas byung bde chen lhun gyis grub①/ /gtum thung gdug pa thabs kyis grol mdzad phyir/ /dri med sna tshogs blos ni hūm̐ du sprul/ /'od zer tshul gyi phreng bas bskor ba'i dkyil/ /sngon gyi thugs dam smon lam dbang gis na/ /cis kyang mi bskyod gzugs sku bstan du gsol/ /gang du dang po rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /khams gsum nas byung cir yang snang bar mdzad/ /rmongs byed mun pa thabs kyis grol mdzad phyir/ /rnam dag byang chub blos ni o du sprul/ /gzugs mang tshul gyis phreng bas bskor ba'i dkyil/ /sngon gyi smon lam thugs dam dbang gis na / /cir yang snang ba'i gzugs sku bstan du gsol/ /gang du dang po yon tan 'byung gnas ni/ /khams gsum nas byung yid bzhin rin po che/ /'dod pas rmongs pa thabs kyis grol mdzad phyir/ /rnam dag 'byung gnas blos ni swe du sprul/ /rin chen phreng bas mdzes par bskor ba'i dkyil/ /sngon gyi smon lam thugs dam dbang gis na/ /'dod pa kun 'byung gzugs sku bstan du gsol / /gang du dang po 'od dpag med pa ni/ /khams gsum nas byung gsung rab snang mtha' yas/ /chags pas rmongs pa thabs kyis grol mdzad phyir//rnam dag dri med blos ni i du sprul(mi/ /gsung (7snyan yi ge phreng bas bskor ba'i dkyil / /sngon gyi smon lam thugs dam dbang gis na/ /sna tshogs ston pa'i gzugs sku bstan du gsol/ /gang du dang po gdon mi za ba nisti/ /khams gsum nas byung sna tshogs cir yang mdzad/ /bya ba rmongs pa thabs kyis grol 101—346

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/347mdzad phyir/— /rnam dag nan tan blos ni haṃ du sprul/ /mdzad pa gar gyi phreng bas bskor ba'i dkyil/ /sngon gyi smon lam thugs dam dbang gis na/ /thams cad mdzad pa'i gzugs sku bstan du gsol/ /zhes bskul ba gnyis pa des yongs su rdzogs par bskul 6)bas chos nyid sgyu ma las ye shes sgyu ma'i sku snang ba ni ji lta ji ltar me long gi dbyings su bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor snang ba bzhin du ye shes rang snang bar gnas pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bskul ba gsum pa 'dis mngon du rdzogs pa longs spyod rdzogs par bskul ba ni 'di lta ste / de bzhin nyid du gshegs pa khyod/ /'jig rten mngon rdzogs rgyas mdzod la / /snying po byang chub ji bzhin pa/ /sems can don du snang bar mdzod/ /'jig rten khams ni dpag med du/ /ji snyed bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /sprul pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis kyang / /mtha' dag don du rnam snang mdzad/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i nad pa la/ /gzhan gyis phan pa'i sman ma mchis/ /yang dag bdud rtsi'i sman sbyar bas/ /'khor ba'i gcong durnying sbyang chamadzad pa/ /sdug bsngal zug rngu'i nad sel ba'i/ /sman pa che mchog gtso bor gshegs/ /nad do cog gi dgrar gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho yis/ /log pa'i nad dgras gzir ba yi/ /nad pa'i tshogs kun bslang ④bar mdzod/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i skyes bu (genyid/ /snying po byang chub la dgongs la/ /'od zer snang ba rgyas bkye 6)ste/ /mun pa bsal ba'i dgongs pa mdzod/ /kye ma skyes bu don grub pa/ /bya ba byas shing byed pa byas/ /khur bor bdag don rjes thob pa/ /gang 'dir 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ /gtsang (nyama'i gnas mchog 'og min gyi/ /chos kyis mtho (kyeba'i gzhal yas su/ /rdzogs longs spyod pa'i skur gshegs te/ /101—347

348 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 'a 101snying po bskul 6)ba'i bya ②ba mdzod/ /ces rnam par bskul bas/ ji lta ji ltar sprin mthongs nas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba ltar / /mi g.yo ba yi dbyings nyid las/ /gzugs sku nyi ma shar ba ste/ /chos kyi mtho ba zhes bya ba'i gzhal yas su rnam par snang bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las gang gi cho 'phrul bskul ba'i le'u ste nyi shu gsum pa'o/ / //de nas chos kyi rgyal po ④rdzogs longs spyod pa de rdo rje go 'byed yongs su bsdu ba'i mtshan ma mdzad pas mtha' thug pa med pa'i zhing khams stug po bkod pa nas dpag tu med pa'i rgyal ba kun nas yongs su 'dus par gyur to/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na sangs rgyas snying rje yongs su rol pa'i tshogs kyis gcig tu ⑤mthun par bgros pa/ kye kye sangs rgyas rnam pa mang po 'byung ba'i tshogs/ /snang ngo kun du rab tu 'dir 'byung ba/ /srid pa log pa'i gdug pa can/ /'khor ba'i sa bon rtsub mos 'phangs/ /sdug bsngal chen po'i yi dgas (6)rnams/ /las kyis 'jig rten khams 'dir byung ⑦/ /drag po log pa'i dka' thub kyis/ /srid pa gsum gyi bdag por smin/ /dregs pa ru tra'i gdug dudapal gyis/ /'gro rnams mthar rlog 'joms byed 'di/ /gdul ba'i zhing mchog rmad du byung / /snying rje'i bdag po kun 'dus nas/ /las ngan las kyi rgyun bcad de ṇa / /bde chen sa la gzhag par rigs/ /zhes bgros so/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i gdung 7dang sde'i tshogs kyis gcig par bgros pa/ /kye ma'o 'dus /nyapa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ltar/ /da ltar dus 'di 101—348

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/349nyid du byung / /lung log mngon pa'i ri bor bsregs/ /rang rgyud bsregs pa'i bslad pa can/ /bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /glang chen myos pa drag po che/ /shin tu mi bzad dug chen gyis/ / 'o dod ①'bod par gsad brlag (7pas/ /ro gling dur khrod mthar zhen pa/ /ji lta'i thabs kyis phan par 'gyur / /zhes bgros so/ /sangs rgyas nor bu'i gdung dang sde'i tshogs kyis gcig tu mthun par bgros pa/ nag po'i gdug pa smyon ①pa 'di/ /ji ltar de dgar (gebazhag 'gyur na/ /mi bzad dug mtsho chu rlabs kyis/ /nag po'i khams su rgyas 'gyur bas/ /dam pa rnams kyi rgyun gcod cing / /nyi ma sgron ma 'jig par 'gyur/ /de tshe las kyi mun pa yis/ /thams cad mun nag smag tu 'khyams / /zhes bgros so/ /sangs rgyas pad+mo'i ⑤gdung dang sde'i tshogs kyis mgrin gcig tu mthun par bgros pa/ gang yi'adas pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /las kyi 'khor los 'phangs pa yi/ /blo gros log pa'i ru tra ⑦de/ /snying po dbyings nas byung ba ni/ /skyes bu dam pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdud kyis bdud btul gnyer bkod ltar/ /da ltar 'di tshe byung ba ni/ /dug 'gyur brtsegs pa'i ri bo 'di/ /rdo rje khros pa'i tho chen gyis/ /brlag cing gzhom pa'i ⑧dus la bab/ /ces bgros so/ /sangs rgyas gzhon nu'i gdung dang sde'i tshogs kyis mgrin kyi)gcig tu mthun par bgros pa/ khong nas 'khyil yiba'i dug chen po/ /thar med mi bzad (stend kyis zin/ /rtag chad khams su shi ba'i ro/ /lam log lam stor dmus long 'di/ /ye shes khros pa'i cho 'phrul las/ /'bar 'phro 'khrug pa'i gzer chen gyis/ /smag chen mun nag gzhom 7pa'i phyir/ /ye shes can gyi spyod yul nas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun 'dus te/ /ye shes rdo rje 101—349

350 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101khros pa yi/ /cho 'phrul sprin phung gtibs pa'i sa①/ /mthun 'jug byis pa'i cha byad ②kyis/ /rnam par rol pa'i mngon spyod kyis/ /dug chen rgya mtsho ma bskams na/ /'dir ni snying rje rkyen 'tsham ③mam/ /chos nyid snying rje chen po yi / /gang 'dir dam tshig dam pa'i phyir/ /dngos po bzhi yi bstan pa mdzod/ /ces bgros so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las 'dus pa chen pos rnam par bgros pa'i le'u ste nyi shu bzhi pa'o// //de ltar 'dus pa chen po'i bka' ④bgros yongs su chad nas las rnam bzhi gang gis (5rigadul ba'i skabs la bab par dgongs pa yis gang de rnam par brtag ⑥pa'i phyir thub dka' chagazhon nu rdo rje snying por gnas gyur pa'i 'od zer las sprul pa thub pa'i dbang por byung nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis sprul pa de la bsgo ba/ thub pa'i dbang po dus 'di lagasal/ /ji bzhin bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /dngos po bzhi yi 6)me dpung bzlog /byang chub snying po ⑩bskul bar mdzod/ /ces yongs su bskul nas thub pa'i dbang po des dur khrod kyi bdag po de'i phru mar snang bar mdzad nas thams cad zhi ba'i smra bar ⑩smras pa las / dur khrod kyi bdag po des 0tha'i kha brdabs nas 'di skad du smras so/ /bu chung khyod kyis bdag thul tib ma yin te/ sngon nga yiganod sbyin gyi sde dpon drag po zhes bya bar gyur pa na kho na nyid lta bu mang po byung nas nga'i bstan pa la zhugs shig /nga'i bka' nyon cig zer ba las kyang ma mnyan na da 'khyod kyi dbang du bdag ga la jen go zu se mo dor gzod la rang gi dka' thub la bde bar mnos shig ces bsgo yinas bdud kyi dngos po bzhis yongs su zhams pas 101—350

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/351gtsang ma ris kyi 'phags pa rtog pa la zhugs nas phyir log go/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang sangs rgyas pad+ma'i gdung dang sde'i sprul pa kun du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la yongs su bsgo ba/ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gdung / /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul hri ①las rngam chen ston/ /ngag ②gi dbang phyug rta gdong zhal gyis gnon/ /zhes yongs su bskul bas sprul pa rdo rje rta gdong chen pos dur khrod kyi bdag po chen po'i gnas su snang bar mdzad nas ha ha hi hi gahri hu lu hu lu hu lu ④zhes lhang lhang tsher tsher rta skad drag po'i dbyangs phyung ba las/ srin po'i phru ma yongs su spa (gezhum zhing ⑥bag 'khums pa tsam du gyur yang dur khrod kyi bdag po kho na ngo bo des rang gi nga rgyal gtum skad du ru tra ⑦ma dutra 6)ma ra tra zhes bsgrags nas rnam par brjid phyung ste 'gyings pa las zil gyis ma non te slar kho na ngo bo des slar bsgo ba/ mgrin bu sngon yang khyod lta bus bdag ma non pas khyod kyis bdag rjen ⑩pa ma yin te nyid kyi gnas gang yin par bde bar nos (nyeshig ces tha'i kha brdab pa byas te/ yang bdud kyi dngos po bzhis yongs su zhams pas gtsang ma ris kyi 'phags pa rtog pa skyes nas phyir log snyam pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' lta bu la gtsang sme mi mnga' bas ma log tunyepar slar han tsopa las kho na ngo bo des thim par dzams nas de bzhin gshegs pa ngag gi dbang phyug des mthun 'jug tu kho na dga' lhar 8thim du han tsono/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa des dbu kho na'i gtsug tu phyung zhabs kho na'i mthil du byung nas rdo rje hūm̐ zhes rgyas pas 8lus kun du rgyas te tsokho na des ma bzod pa'i nga ro 'od kyi sgra mthar bton pa ni a tsa ma'o/ /ci mdzad myur bar mdzod ces bton (nye101—351

35 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101nol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa des kho na de'i sgrib pa sbyang ba mdzad nas bde ba kho nar kho na'i gtsug tu phyung ste nam mkha' la rta'i dbyangs phyung bas srin po'i tshogs bur mer 91)thor shug tu gyur te zil gyis non cing bag 'khums nas gsol pa / dpa' bo chen po'i 'bangs su mchi/ ji ltar bgyi ba bka' stsol cig ces zhus pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa des gsungs pa/ ngas ni khyod ma btul gyis ②khyod kyi gnyen po rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang gis dbang bskur ba shin tu gtum rngam 'khrug pa ma rungs shing mi bzad pa bdud kyi bdud chen po 'jigs byed 'bar ba zhig 'byung gis de la skyabs su dong cig 5)ces gsungs te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du mi dmigs par gshegs so/ /de nas gsang (geb 'dus pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'dus pa chen po rnam par bgros nas phrin (5)las bzhi yi sgo gang gis gdul ⑥ba'i skabs la bab pa brtags na/ gang zhi rgyas kyis 'dul ba mi 'dra nas dbang drag gis 'dul bar bka' (7bgros dam par nges par bcad pa'i mdo yongs su gsung ba ni 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam grol spyod pa'i tshogs kyis bka' bcad pa'i mdo gsungs pa/ shin tu 'gog (8)pas zhi ba la/ /khros pas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /rnal 'byor ma bcos nga)de nyid las/ /zhi bar de bzhin gshegs kun mdzod/ /rnal 'byor tshul can zhi bas kyang / /srid pa'i myu gu 'gag 7nus na(me/ /rnal 'byor yod med stong pa'i mthus/ /'gog pa bslang ba skosmos ci dgos/ /shin tu rdo skams kyi rlan pa la/ /gang du 'gog rnams mibaslang ba'i phyir/ /'gag 7med stong pa'i chos nyid las/ /sna tshogs mi 'gog ji bzhin mdzod/ /ces nges pa dam par bcad do/ /de nas 101—352

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/353de bzhin gshegs pa ngo bo nyid med pa'i tshogs kyis bka' ①bcad pa'i mdo gsungs pa/ shin tu stong pa rgyun chad la/ /dngos pos phan par mi 'gyur te/ /rgyun gyi byang chub stong nyid las/ /med 'gyur de bzhin gshegs kun mdzod/ /stong nyid tshul can stong pas kyang / /(7ci yang med par gnas 'gyur na/ /med pa las byung rnal 'byor mthus/ /mthar zad mu zlog smos ci dgos/ /shin tu rgyun chad bzlog pa dang / /gang du med las skyes pa'i phyir/ /rgyun dang bcas pa'i stong nyid la/ /che (gyiyon rgyun gyi 'chad par mdzod/ /ces nges pa dam par bcad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid mi 'gyur ba'i tshogs kyis bka' ④bcad pa'i mdo gsungs ⑤pa/ shin tu ther zug rtag pa la/ /med pas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /snying po byang chub de nyid las/ /bdag nyid chen por thams cad mdzod/ /mi 'gyur tshul can rtag pas kyang / /dngos po brtan g.yor byed nus na/ /bdag nyid chen por lhun grub mthus⑥/ /ther zug zlog pa smos ci dgos/ /bdag tu zhen pa zlog pa dang / /dngos 'dzin rka ⑦mgo bsgyur ba'i phyir/ /bdag med rtag pa chos nyid las/ /byed med rang bzhin nyid du mdzod/ /ces nges pa dam par bcad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i gdung dang sde'i tshogs kyis bka' (kyebacad pa'i mdo gsungs pa / shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi (9nyebs phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo las/ /khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzod/ /khro bo'i tshul can khros pas kyang / /'jig rten gsum dag yispag nus na/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje khros pa yis/ /khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ /gdul dka' ma lus gdul ba dang / /dam tshig la sdang rnam sbyang phyir/ /'bar ba chen po 101—353

354 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101gar dgu las/ /dur khrod gar gyi phyag rgyar mdzod/ /ces nges pa dam par bcad do①/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje snying po de kho na nyid nges pa zhes bya ba'i tshogs kyis bka' ②bcad pa'i mdo gsungs pa/ shin tu log par zhen pa la/ /bden pas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /gsang chen sbyor ba'i ldem dgongs las/ /thams cad mthun 'jug nyid du mdzod/ /mdzad spyod tshul can spyod pas kyang / /thams cad bka' zlog byed nus na/ /thugs rje mthun 'jug mdzad spyod kyis/ /lam log drang srong ⑤smos ci dgos/ /dngos pos dngos po dgrol ba dang / /dug gis dug nad bsal ba'i phyir/ /thabs mchog dpag gis mi lang ba'i/ /mdzad pa gar gyi phyag rgyar mdzod⑤/ /ces nges pa dam par bcad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu'i gdung dang sde'i tshogs kyis bka' bcad pa'i mdo gsungs pa/ shin tu 'jungs shing brkam 67pa la/ /btang ⑦bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /med la mi zad kun 'byung las/ /thams cad mi zad (nyanor bur mdzod/ /dka' thub tshul can 'gags pas kyang / /tshe gcig 'tsho bar byed nus na/ /med la 'dod dgur 'byung ba yis/ /khams gsum gdung ba smos ci dgos/ /'jungs pa tshim par bya ba dang / /yongs su gdung ba bsal ba'i phyir/ /theg chen gsang yi)ba'i longs spyod las/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyar mdzod/ /ces nges pa dam par bcad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzhon nu'i gdung dang sde'i tshogs kyis bka' 7bcad pa'i mdo gsungs pa/ shin tu le lo g.yeng (1ba lakyi/ /bskul bas brtson par mi 'gyur te/ /bya btsal yo med pa'i chos nyid las/ /thams cad bya ba med par mdzod/ /mi g.yo'i tshul can gnas pas kyang / /101wa 354

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/355dam pa'i las lam gcod byed na/ /bya bral mi g.yo bde chen pos/ /'jig rten g.yeng ba smos ci dgos/ /mi khom lam rgyud bcad pa dang / /le lo g.yeng ba'i dgra gzhom phyir/ /btang 6)snyoms rnal 'byor chen po las/ /bya med gnas par phyag rgyar mdzod/ /ces nges ②pa dam par bcad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glang po'i gdung dang sde'i tshogs kyis bka' ①bcad pa'i mdo gsungs pa/ shin tu gti mug rmongs pa la/ /bstan pas go bar mi 'gyur te / /khyad par cir yang mtshungs pa las/ /thams cad gti mug chen por mdzod / /gti mug tshul can rmongs pas kyang / /thams cad mun par byed nus na/ /mi 'byed blang dor med pa yis/ /khams gsum rmongs pa smos ci dgos / /mun pa'i skye mched gzhom pa dang / rmongs pa nam mkhar dubya ba'i phyir / /gti mug rnam dag ye shes las/ /ma 'dres yongs ⑤rdzogs phyag rgyar mdzod⑥ / /ces nges pa dam par bcad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo'i ⑦gdung dang sde'i tshogs kyis bkas ⑧bcad pa'i mdo gsungs pa/ shin tu chags shing zhen pa la/ /gnyen pos phan par mi 'gyur te/ /chags rab chen po'i ye shes las/ /thams cad chags pa chen por mdzod/ /chags pa'i tshul can spyad pas kyang / /khams gsum khrag tu byed nus na/ /'dod chags rnam dag chags spyad 5)pas/ /khams gsum zhen chags smos ci dgos/ /'dod chags khrag mtsho bskam pa dang / /chags pas chags pa gcad ⑩pa'i phyir / /'dod chags rnam dag ye 47shes las/ /'dod chags gar gyi phyag rgyar mdzodakyi / /ces nges pa dam par bcad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bkas tsobacad pa'i mdo gsungs pa/ shin tu dngos por zhen 101—355

356 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101pa la/ /bkag pas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo las/ /thams cad mthun 'jug 0)spyod par mdzod/ /mthun 'jug tshul can mthun pas kyang / /khams gsum log par byed nus na/ /thugs rje gar gyi mdzad spyod kyis/ /'jig rten blo log smos ci dgos/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas snyed / /'jig rten 'jig rten mtha' yas kun/ /'dul ba'i thabs ni sna tshogs kyis/ /drangs te yang dag gsang labar sbyor / /khro la byams dang khro tshul mdzod/ /zhi la zhi ba slong sbyong nyidago/ /drag shul can la drag po nyid/ /g.yem la g.yem dang gnyen por mdzod/ /chags la chags dang rnam spong nyid/ /g.yeng la sems sdud g.yeng ba nyid/ /rmongs la khyab par mnyam ⑤pa nyid/ /ri la ting 'dzin ri bo nyid/ /phrag dog can la phrag dog tshul/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas snyed/ /kun gzhi 6)mnyam dang mi stimanyam pa'i/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi mtha' klas par/ /khyad par 'dod pa'i lus can gyi(nya/ /kun gzhi kun gyi dbyings na dpa'/ /rdo rje snying po rab tu gnas/ /sems can sangs rgyas kun gyi dbyings/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin nyid/ /ye nas yin par nges pa na/ /mtha' 99)thug med pa'i sems can rnams/ /ji ltar dga' ba 'dod pa bzhin/ /ma bkag ma bcos ji bzhin par / /nges pa nyid du gyur pa yi/ /thabs mchog dpag gis mi lang ba'i/ /mdzad spyod gar thabs sprin phung gis me/ /ji ltar spyad kyang de nyid la(/snye/ /ma g.yos mi gos dbyings na dpa' / /nyid du nges pa'i ngo bo las/ /mtha' yas dpag tu med pa yi/ /sgo nas thams cad ma bkag par/ /ci dga' nyid du bde drangs te/ /dam pa rnams kyi nges par mdzod/ /'dir ni (1nyanan tan drag shul gyis/ /mi zad yi101—356

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/357'bar ba'i ye shes las/ /dur khrod bdag po rab 'jigs pa'i/ /che mchog 'bar ba'i phyag rgyar mdzod/ /ces nges pa dam par bcad do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las bka' bgros dam pa ①bcad pa'i le'u zhes bya ste nyi shu lnga pa'o// //lang ku'i bdag po de'i tshe de'i dus na kho bo 'khor ②de nyid du 'dus par gyur pa zhig gis shes bzhin du gang yongs su sad pa'i phyir yang 'khor der 'khod par gyur ⑧pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bskul ba'i go cha blo gros thabs ldan zhes bya ba zhig la yongs su dris pa/ kye sems dpa' chen po yi dgas byachen po 'di rgyu ni gang las byung / rkyen ni ci las byung / 'bras bu ni cir smin/rigs ni gar gtogs/ las skal gyi spyod (depa ni ci spyod/ ma btul na ci gnod / btul na ci zhig dgos/ de skad dris pa las/ bskul ba'i go cha chen po des smras pa/ sems dpa' chen po gsang ba (6)pa'i bdag po yi dgas ⑦chen po 'di gang legs pa'i rgyu rkyen las ni ma byung / nyes pa 'ba' zhig gi rgyu rkyen las byung ste/ rgyu ni mun pa'i ri bo las byung ngo / /rkyen ni bka' bsgo (kyilog pa'i dka' thub drag po las byung ngo / /'bras bu ni sdug bsngal gyi ri bor smin no/ /rigs ni dmangs 5)rigs 'khor ba gdol pa 'byung po yi dgas 7su gtogs so/ /las skal gyi spyod pa ni 'khor ba'i dngos po bzhi la 'jol nyog 4)tu spyod do/ /'di ma btul na lus can gyi byang chub snying po ring du nub pa'i skyon 7du 'gyur ro/ /btul na ni kun gyi snying po 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mngon du nye bar 'char bar sna 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang / kho bos de la 'di skad ces 101—357

358 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101smras so/ /e ma'o sems dpa' chen po 'o na dus 'di ni dus ①la bab pa'o /las 'di las kyi mchog go/ /gsang ba 'di ni gsang ba'i yang ②gsang ba dam pa'o / /thul kun du rab tu thul/ dus la bab pa'i skabs ③chen 'dir/ /las la bab pa'i sems can 'di/ /stongs la bab pa'i thugs rje yis/ /'du shes bsgyur ba thugs rje'i mchog /stong gsum ma lus ston ④pa pas/ /'bum gyi char yang mi phod do/ /zhes nye bar bskul lo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dan bag gnas gyur pa skyes bu dam pa rdo rje 'dzin du snang ba nyid la yongs su bsgo ba mdzad pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang (snyemadzod pa/ /thugs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /drag po brtul (7zhugs chen po can/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /sngon gyi go cha chen po'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis(7/ /gdul dka' ④drag po 'dul mdzad pa/ /bdud 6)kyi bdud de bdud rnams 'joms0/ /sems dpa' sngon po 'bar ba'i sku / /'jigs su rung ba'i dpa' byad yican/ /gtum rngam 'khrug pa'i ngo bo yis / /dur khrod bdag po rab tu 8chom zhes yongs su bskul bas/ skyes bu rdo rje 'dzin pa de/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /'byung po'i rgyal pos dbang du byas/ /shin tu gtum rngam 'khrug pa des/ /lha mi 'jig rten brlag ma khad/ /bzhin dang mdangs kyang mi gsal yi bar/ /kun du mog mog por gyur nas/ /dus cham yin pa'i mun pa yang / /mun nag smag tu gyur pas 'thibs / /tsha dang grang dang nad dang 7rims/ /mi ngas sna tshogs kun du rgyas / /rlung dmar 7'brug dang ser ba dang / /rnag khrag rdo dang mtshon cha'i char / /dus ma yin par kun du 'byung / /skye dman 'tsho ba'ang log par gyur//101—358

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyugarnal 'phyor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/35gdug pa sna tshogs sems can gyis①/ shin tu nyam ②thag gdungs 'gyur ba'i/ /mgon med pa yi ①'jig rten te/ /mkhyen te thugs rjes gdung ba ni/ /rab tu rngam pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /rdo rje chos kyi rta gdong la/ /rdo rje tshig tu 'di skad du/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rdo rje'i gdong / /lang ma'i yul gyi grong rdal gyi / /dbus kyi ri bo ma la ya/ /rko rka thang mar rgya mtsho'i dong du/ /drag shul yod pa'i rtse la dong ⑤/ /rdo rje thabs kyis blta ba'i yul/ /dur khrod bdag po tshogs dang bcas/ /mi ngam byaskyabs lings chen po la/ /khams gsum rdo rje bya sprin ⑦thong / /cis kyang mi bskyod mi 'khrugs ⑧pa'i/ /sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje snying po srid gsum mgon/ /stong pa chen po'i nam mkha' la/ /'bar ba chen po gar dgur mdzod/ /thugs rje sa la gshegs nas kyang / /mthun 'jug byis pa'i spyod pa mdzod/ /med la kun 'byung stong nyid las/ /ji bzhin pa yi rgyal ba dang —/ /stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams na/ /rnam dag lam gshegs rgyal ba rnams / /bdag ni bka' yi las mkhan te/ /bka' yi las kyi dus byung bas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gdul dka' 5)ba/ /de dag ma lus bdag gis btul/ /ma grol ba yang bdag gis dgrol/ /gang ma bsgral ba bdag gis bsgral/ /dbugs ma phyung ⑩ba dbugs phyung ste/ /yang dag nyid la dgod par bgyi/ /dgongs pa gsang ()ba kun 'dus la/ /rmad 'byung tsogasang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis / /mtha' thug med pa'i sems can rnams/ /snying po bskul ba'i byin brlabs tsomadzod/ /ces rdo rje 'dzin pa des drag tu bskul ba las/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ye shes chen po'i me dus 101—359

360 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101mtha'i 6)bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i thugs rje'i sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas par 'thibs nas 'bar ba ②chen po'i gar dgur nimangon spyod du mdzad nas rdo rje rta'i ④tshogs la bkas bsgo ba/ sod (7kun du rab tu sod⑥/ rta yi ⑦rdo rje stabs dgu yis/ /'jig rten blo dgu'i (nya'adod pa ston/ /'jig rten nag po gtum pa'i 6)tshogs/ /dur khrod skyabs lings spyod pa la/ /rdo rje rtog pa'i bya sgron gyis/ /'khor ba ma bsgral bar du 'di/ /dam bcas go cha gyon pa yi / /snying rje chen po'i rtog 'jug gi⑩/ /'khor ba'i so mtha' chod 'o1par gyis zhes drag tu bsgo bas/ rdo rje chos rab dga' 'khor lo/ /gzigs dbang rdo rje spyan rab ste/ /rdo rje pad+mo rab dga' ba/ /snang mdzad ngag 8gi dbang phyug tshogs / /byang chub chen po cang shes gtso/ /thabs chen dgu yi 'ardzu 'phrul gyis / /rdo rje rta gdong sprul pa'i tshogs/ /nam mkha'i khams kun yongs bkang yinas / /ma la ya yi rtse la lhags/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni/ /thugs rje ⑫dbang gis 7spyan ras gzigs/ /stug po bkod pa'i rgyal ba yang / /dgongs pa gsang ba gcig tu 'dus/ /khams gsum yo sgrol khosnying por dgongs/ /dus gsum gtan sprugs byin brlabs (nyamadzod/ /'khor ba chos nyid spyan ras gzigs / /sdug bsngal byang chub lam du mdzad/ /las nyid rang byung ye shes 'grel / /rnam smin sun 4)phyung rdo rje nyid/ /ye nas ji bzhin ma bcos pa'i/ /rang byung dkyil 'khor chen por dgongs/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa yang —/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje las/ /sprul pa'i sras mchog rdo rje 'dzin/ /rigazhon nu bye rmo mab sa yar mdzad/ /thams cad dbyar gyi sprin phung (1bzhin/ /nam mkha' 82dbyings kyi mthas ( 27sa par/ /ma la ya yi 'a rtse la lhags/ /101—360

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/361mthun 'jug thabs kyi cha byad du/ /gang 'dir byis ①pa'i spyod pa yis/ /bdud kyi spyod yul kun mdzad de/ /'jig rten khams su byis par bstan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las ②las bzhi rdo rje skos ③kyi le'u zhes bya ste nyi shu drug pa'o// //de nas mthun 'jug skyes bu des/ /mthun pa'i spyan gyis gang gzigs na④ / /las kyi yi dgas ⑤dag po de/ /dngos po bzhis ni dbang byas pa/ /rnam par smin pa'i dngos po ni/ /bam ri thod pa mkhar gyi rtsar/ /khrag dang bshang gci sha chen dang / /rkang dang klad ⑥pa klad ⑦rgyas dang / /rnag dang chu ser la sogs pa'i/ /'dam gyis phru ma yongs su bskor/ /'bu dang shin ②tu 'bu chen po/ /sbrang ma sbrang rgod bung ba dang / /sbrul dang sdig pa sdom la sogs / /gang ka khu sgeg 6)'ug pa'i tshogs/ /ce tispyang stag ⑩seng la sogs pa'i / /gdug pa can gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /lha yi sde dpon ka 8ru ni/ /bu mo chung ma ma sring tsodang / /'jig rten dbang phyug lha chen gyi/ / ma sring ⑫chung ma bu mo rnams/ /phrogs nas dbang du byas pa yi/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /bcu 8gnyis dang ni brgyad ⑩la sogs/ /ma mo phra 0men gnod sbyin mo/ /srin mo sha za khrag 'phrog ma/ /bdud kyi ming 'dzin bla rkun ma/ /blon mo dmag dpon sde dpon ma/ /ru (shedapon pho nya mngag par bcas/ /rang rang rten (pedang lag char bcas/ /ci bgyi bka' nyan bka' sdod 'khor/ /sbod sanyagatong rngam pa'i tshul du 'khod/ /srin po'i lustebu mo dri za brgyad/ /stag ()seng wa spyang bzhad tshogs dang / /dur bya bya rog lug pa'i tshogs/ /bstod tso101—361

36 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 'a 101cing rngam pa'i tshul du 'khod/ /srin po'i nye gnas chen mo brgyad/ /kau ①ri tso ②ri pra mo ha/ /bet+ta ③li dang puk+ka si/ /ghasma ④ri dang sma sha ni/ /tsaṇ+ḍa ⑤li la sogs pa yi/ /gtum zhing rngam pa'i ma tshogs ma/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs su 'khod/ /dur khrod sa yi sgo srung 0bzhi/ /brtson mo gdong mo gar log mo/ /de bzhin 'jug mo tshichen mo bzhi/ /gsang sgo 'dzin cing bka' sgo ⑧srung —/ /dur khrod bdag mo gru 'degs ma/ /brkam 6)pa shin tu brkam tsom dang ske/ /ra ro mo dang khrag 'thung ma/ /chags pas myos ⑩pa'i mdangs kyis 'khod / /bam ri thod pa brtsegs pa'i dbus/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzer chen gyis/ /brtan par btab pa'i nad bdag mo/ /nye gnas kro dhi shwa ri ma/ /thod skyogs khrag gis bkang ba dang / /'bru mar rdzas lnga chang sbyar ba/ /rtag par rang gi longs spyod 'dzin/ /chags pas myos 7shing brkam pas na/ /'dod pa'i dbang mo brkam par grags/ /ru tra'i phru ma grong rdal de/ /'bar ba chen po'i gar dgu yis/ /bcom ldan dbang du mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sde dpon btul ba'i 'khor 'dus pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mthu chen rnams/ /phal 7cher las la gram skabs su/ /dpal tsochen rdo rje 'dzin pa de'i/ /de nyid yang dag dngos min pa'i/ /gzhon nu snam nas bton pa'i sras/ /rdo rje gzhon nu sme ba brtsegs/ /mthing rmuganag khro gnyer ral pa can/ /'bar ba chen po'i gar dgur mdzad/ /dur khrod bdag po ji bzhin du/ /dbu dang phyag zhabs der mdzad ⑩de/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /bshung bob lnga ni ribadud rtsir bsgyur/ /thams cad stong nyid bdud rtsir sbyangs/ /nye gnas la (nyesogs 'khor mo rnams/ /spyod la ma chags ye shes dang / /byas la mi sogs 101—362

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/363phrin ①las kyis/ /mthun 'jug khrid pa'i sbyor thabs kyis/ /dbang bsdus ngad ②sbyangs sprul pa ni/ /sems dpa' ye shes sprul pa'i tshogs/ / kau tso la ②sogs ma tshogs dang / /seng stag dul sogs yul du snang ⑤/ /'dod pa'i dbang mo brkam ⑥pa des/ /chags pa'i dbang gis gang mthong ba/ /spyir ni rang gi khyo bdag lta/ /lhag pa'i gzi chen 'bar bar ⑦mthong / /snyam pa'i dbang gi the tshom skyes/ /e ma'o bdag gi bdag po bas/ /shin tu 'od 'bar gzi byin che/ /'di ji lta bar sprul pa zhig /snyam ⑧du yid gnyis rtog pa ⑨las / /thabs mchog rdo rje gzhon nu des/ /srin 0skad thang yigasum phyung ba las / /the tshom rtog pa chad par gyuratso/ /chags pa'i dbang gis sangs rgyas kyil/ /sku la nges par 'khril ba ni/ /tsan dan sprul 'gyi sdong tsopo la tshad pas bdas 8pa'i sbrul 'khril bas/ /mi rtog tshad tsoma'i gdung sel ltar/ /gang la chags pa mi mnga' b.ratso/ /gang gi gdung ba rnam par sel/ /de nas sme ba brtsegs pa des/ /thams cad ci dga' 'byung ba yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po de/ /nye ba'i rig pa 'di brjod pas/ /bya ba thams cad byed pa'i mchog /oṃ bhur /tso/ i tsiyi/ ki phi/ u tsusma gro dha dus phaṭa/ yang dag dngos min cho 'phrul 'dis/ /snang mdzad chen po'i cho 'phrul bsdus0/ /gang du dang por sprul pa yi/ /oṃ gyi 'od zer mngon phab nas/ /dbang dumo brkam pa'i lhums su bzhag /gsang sngags mngon pa'i mthu can 'disadu/ /srin po'i cha lugs cici 'dra bar/ /yi ge de yang ⑥der bsgyur te/ /gang de mngon sum lhums su bzhag /rdo rje lcags kyu 'od zer las/ /rak+ṣa shrī he ru gci /ru tra sh+yim tra ()ha ha ha ma/ bskyed rdzogs 'joms yibyed yi ge yi/ /mthu yis byin 101—363

364 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101brlabs brtan par byas/ /dngos min rig ①pa'i skyes bu de/ /rdo rje yab kyi sku la bsdus/ /drag shul stobs ldan ②skyes bu de①/ /sgyu ma rdo rje cho 'phrul gyis/ /sangs rgyas gdul ④dka' rnams btul dunas/ /bdud dang 'jig rten log pa'i cha/ /byis pa'i spyod pa de bor nas/ /thugs ni snying po byang chub la/ /dgongs pa nges par 'grel te bzhugs/ /sprul pa rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /sngar byung rgyal tshab 4)skyes bu yis/ /lha gnas gsum du grags pa yi/ /gsang mdzod chen po dam pa'i lung / /gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag po mdzad/ /de nas yi dgas ⑦drag po de/ /rang gi (7gnas su 'un pa las/ /rang gi gnas dang longs spyod dang / /'khor rnams mi snang mi 'dra ba/ /sngon ma mthong ba phal cher snang / /kho na shin tu ma rangs ①te/ /e ma'o bdag gi 0phru ma 'di/ /ji ltar 'gyur zhes rnam par rtog /de tshe nye gnas dbang 7mo yis/ /rang gi khyo bdag 8lon 'un te/ /e ma'o sgeg po dpa' bo khyod/ /gang 'dir ngan du rtog pa'i tshig /'khor gyi nang 'dir gsung ngam ci/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi dgongs pa gang / /deng 7tun han phan nyo 8pa ti/ /kho na 'am tsa sma ra tsa/ /dpa' bo sgeg 8po zhe 'am nyid/ /kun lan tra tsa pu thra tha/ /gang du de ci ji ltar 'khrul/ /de skad tshig tu hon ⑩pa las/ /mdangs la chags pas 'dun pa dang ske/ /kho na'i yirigs nyid nges 'dzin pa'i/ /snyam nas dga' ba'i (nyathabs su bzung / /de nas dbang mo brkam ()pa las/ /pu tra myu gu 'thon 'byung ba'i//thabs gsum grag pa'i sgra phyung bas(nya/ /dpal gyi rngam skad drag po yis/ /drag po drag mo la sogs brgyal/ /de las (7slar log mthong snang ba/ /'jigs byed chen po 9 ste'abar ba la/ /sngo gnag rngam pa'i ral pa can/ /dbu (nyadagu phyag ni 101—364

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/365brtswa ①brgyad pa/ /rdo rje gshog ⑧pas bar snang khebs/ /ba spu lcags kyu bsregs 'dra ba'i/ /sdom dang sdig dang smigs dang sbrul/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis sa gzhi nikhebs/ /thod skyogs ste ④ra rgyu zhags dang / /nyi zla khyung dang 'ug pa khra/ /rdo rje mdung rtse gsum pa dang / /za ma tog ⑤dang rdul yab rngam/ /ri rab spyi skor stong gsum 'phen/ /klu dbang 'bum gyis brgyan cing bklubs6)ske/ /dus mtha'i bskal pa me ltar 'bar/ /khro gnyer sdang mig 'bar ba yi/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun spyan ras gzigs/ /zhabs brgyad 'bar bas lha brgyad gnon/ /rdo rje srin po khro bor gyur/ /lha dang bdud las rnam par gragasal/ /de nas yi dgas drag rtsipo de/ /kho na'i sems rtog rtas nas kyang / /nga rgyal drag po'i gtum skad kyis/ /'khor gyi dbang phyug rnam par bskulani/ /ru tra (1)ma tra tsom ra tra(nya/ /'du 'du dbang phyug chen po'i tshogs/ /kun du rab tu dam la 'du/ /gram gram dbang phyug chen po'i tsotshogs/ /kun du rab tu las la gram/ /thud thud dbang phyug chen po'i tshogs/ /kun du rab tu 'di la thud/ /dbang phyug nga yi phru ma la/ /gang 'dir gdug pa chen po 'di/ /khyed dzi kyis brlag pa'i dus la bab/ /gang 'dir bya mi bya rtog tson/ /khyed 8ni shin tu brlag yim khad/ /mdza' bo gang la bya mi bya ba yi/ /yongs su rtog pa de dag med kyang bla/ /de 'dra'i mdza' bo sgyu ma yin pas na8/ /de la mdza' zhes su zhig zer/ /rgol ba gang la bya mi bya ba yi/ /yongs su rtog pa de dag med kyang bla/ /de 'dra'i rgol ba sgyu ma yin pas na/ /de la dpa' zhes su zhig zer / /dam tshig gang srung mi srung ba'i/ /yongs su rtog pa de dag med kyang bla / /de 'dra'i dam tshig sgyu ma yin pas na/ /de la nyunyedam par (7su zhig 101—365

366 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101'dogs / /thams cad bya mi ①bya ba yi/ /yongs su rtog pa de dag med kyang bla//de 'dra'i spyod pa sgyu ma yin pas na/ /de la byed ces su zhig zer/ /gang la gang 'dir gang gi las rnams dus la bab ces dbang phyug chen po rnams la bskul bas/ bdud kyi gzi byin ma bzod de bdud kyi cha 'dzin pa'i lha'i bu bye ba dung phyur gyi dmag tshogs dang dbang phyug chen po rnams shin tu dngangs ②'khrugs rngam nas rod rod por gyur te/ mya ngan gyi dug lo 'tshubs pa bzhin bdud kyi phru mar 'dus te bdud kyi ru mtshon phyar / mtshon cha'i sprin gtibs④ / bdud kyi sgyu 'phrul gyi dra ba bkram ste bso (snyedang cha'i 0sgra bsgrags nas spags ⑦pa las/ rdo rje rta'i tshogs kyis rdo rje stam pa na'i stobs kyis rdzu 'phrul myur ba'i 'dur ④shugs drag pos ①khro bo theg chen kun kyang 'dur 0thag gcod pa'i rta'i 'dur 0glu 'dis 8rnam par bskul ba/ hri 0sgeg po tsodapa' bo 'jigs su rung ba dang / /dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed pa dang / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa'i/ /sku yi dngos po shin tu bsgyur ba yi/ /gar gyi phyag rgya 'bar bas dbang phyug gnon/ /hri myos byed stong bas lhag par 'dod pa'i gzugs ston la/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis gshin rje stong bas lhag par 'jigs gzugs ston8/ /zhi ba'i skur yang tshangs pa stong bas lhag par rab tu ston/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor gsum du snang bar mdzod/ /hri rnam par 'dul ba'i ngo mthon thabs kyis gnon pas gnon/ /ho ho ha ha he he hi hi dgyes pa'i bzhad mos khong / /dbang phyug thams cad rab shig rab tu shig /rab kyi rtsal gyi stobs kyis ngo mthon dbang phyug gnon/ /hri 8rtsal chen hu lu hu lu mig gsum pa las gsum grub drongs/ /hri rab kyi rtsal gyi stobs kyis ngo 101—366

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/367mthon mthu chen gnon/ /ru tra ma tra'i snying las dpal mos drongs shig rab drongs shig /rab kyi 0rtsal gyi stobs kyis ngo mthon tshangs pa non/ /tshangs las sgrol ma drongs shig sma ra tha/ /hri rab kyi rtsal gyi stobs kyis ngo mthon dga' dbang non/ /sbyor chen kun ②gyi sa chabadag la dga' ④dongs shig /hri rab kyi rtsal gyi stobs kyis ngo mthon ru tra non/ /sbyor chen gro dhi rgyasha ri dbang mo drongs shig rab yidrongs shig /snying rje gang la bya mi 7bya ba yibya/ /yongs su rtog ⑨pa de dag med kyang bla/ /de 'dra'i snying rje sgyu ma yin pas na/ /de la su zhig snying rje zer/ /gdul bya gdul ⑩bar bya mi bya ba yi/ /yongs su rtog pa de dag med kyang bla/ /de 'dra'i gdul bya sgyu ma yin pas na/ /de la gdul bar su zhig zer/ /hri ⑩ha ha ho ho sprul rab tu sprul/ /kun du rab sprul snang bar mdzod / /gtum thung rngam 'khrug 'bar bar mdzod/ /rnam pa mang po sna tshogs khro bor log par lta ba yi/ /khro bo snang ba'i 'gro rnams rnam mang po/ /khro bo rgyud kyi ma lus lus pa med par 'dul tsomakhas par/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thabs mchog (stesgyu ma tsorab sprul rnam par sprul/ /khro la ma g.yos ye shes bzhi mchog kun du bzhengs shig bsnams/ /rnam pa mang po sna tshogs 'dod pa 8snang ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam pa mang po'i 'dod chags rgyud kyis ma lus lus pa med pa 'dul mkhas pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thabs mchog sgyu mar rab sprul rnam par sprul//spyod la ma chags ye shes bde mchog kun du myong mdzad bzhengs shing rol/ /rnam pa mang po sna tshogs rmongs par snang ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam pa mang po gti mug rgyud kyis ma lus tsolus 7par 'dul mkhas pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thabs mchog sgyu mas (nyerab sprul rnam par sprul/ /mnyam la ma rmongs ye shes ma 'dres 101—367

368 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 7) 101yongs rdzogs bzhengs shing 6)dgongs zhes khro mo (snyem rangs mi bsnyengs drag po dgyes pa'i sgra 'brug (mistong dir byab byung bas bdud kyi cha 'dzin pa'i bdud bye ba dung phyur rnams bag bzhi bskums te zil gyis non/ ru mtshon la sogs pa mtshon cha'i sprin phung ni stong pa nyid du sangs (shepar gyur/ mi snyan (7pa'i ngag rnams ni mngon du gyur te theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgra ni di ri ri 7sgrogs par gyur to/ /dur khrod kyi bdag po ru tra (2)nag po lta zhig rang gi 'khor gyis yongs su bor te rje btsan (9)dam pa de la skyabs su dong / blo gros kun gyi yul dang bral/ yi khos 7bsam pa chad cing thabs brlag (glenas kun nas 'khrugs te sna rnam par 'khams nas rang gi ru tra yi lnga yi sa bon mngon du phyung bas(ste/ru lu ru lu bh+yo zhes brjod/ /mgo gsum lag drug rkang bzhi pa/ /khros pa'i tshul du gyur pa las/ /rje btsan 7rdo rje srin po des/ /kho na nyid du der mdzad de/ /byin brlabs yi ge mi phyed pa'i/ /dbang du 'khor ba'i sa bon lnga/ /byas nas ngag gi sprul pa phrogs/ /kho na ngag gi dbang po nyams/ /de nas dur khrod bdag po des/ /ra la ra la bh+yo brjod pas/ /mgo dgu bcwa 'bargyad lag tu gyur / /gang der rje btsan bodam pa des/ /ngag gi sprul pa nges par bcad/ /yang der dur khrod bdag po des/ /hu lu hu lu bh+yo brjod pas/ /mgo brgyad bcu drug lag tu gyur/ /dpal chen yo rje btsan srin po des/ /kho na ci 'dra der mdzad de/ /der yang ngag gi brjod pa bcad/ /gang der ()dur khrod (lhabadag po des/ /ha la ha la bh+yo brjod pas/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig mgo bo la/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lag tu gyur/ /yang du rdo rje srin po des/ /de ci kho nar der mdzad nas/ /gang 'dir smra ba'i dbang po bcad/ /yang der kho nar de 101—368

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i rlu shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/369nyid kyis/ /ra li ra li bh+yo brjod pas/ /lus ni tshad med chen ①po la②/ /nad kyi bskal pa tshub mar gtong / /gdug pa'i mtshon cha lus las 'gyed / /rje btsan ④rdo rje srin po des/ /kho na de 'drar nyid mdzad de/ /ngag phrogs ngag ⑤gi sprul pa chad/ /dper na skyes bu gang la 0zhig /lce bcad khrag gis bor ba bzhin/ /shin tu myos te 'gyel bar gyur/ /kun gyi mnga' bdag chen po des/ /sa ma ya hūṃ gsung bsgrags pas/ /sngon byung dus na 'brel pa yis/ /srog gi dbang pos ma bzod ⑦de/ /gang der mdun gyis phyogs pa dang / /rtse gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ ⑧'bar ba yis/ /ru tra'i ri bo bcom dbang gi/ /phyag rgyas rol te phyal du sbyangs/ /nye gnas dbang gis mtshams sbyar ba'i/ /rang gi dam pa la 6)sogs pa'i/ /mtha' thug med pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /dpag tu med pa'i byang chub sems/ /stug po bkod pa'i mthong ba'i mthus/ /thog ma tshumed pa'i dus mtha' nas/ /zhen pa'i mun nag sangs gyur te/ /skye ba dus mtha' med rnyed ⑩du/ /lus blangs las ni ci spyad dran/ /snam du bton te zhabs drung 'khod / /rab dga' btud nas gnong 8tshul du/ /gang der shin tu dus ⑫nas smresadhi/ /e ma e ma'o e ma yang / /dpa' bo lha rje thugs rje chung / /shin tu bde ba'i gnas gcig nas/ /snam tsodu bton pa thugs rje chung / /da yang ⑩ci mdzad myur du mdzod/ /myur du bsgral na yun bde'o⑩/ /'bangs su mchi'o bdag lus 'bul/ /'bangs la nan tan ma chud cig(ste /deng nas slan chad bka' bzhin du/ /bka' yi lung bzhin rjes su sgrub/ /gal te bka' bzhin ma bgyis samatsho / /dam pa'i lung las 'gal gyur na/ /bdag cag rnams kyi mgo lus snying / /rul myags skams nas tshig par 'gyur/ /ma 101—369

370 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101sring ①bu mo chung ma rnams/ /'bangs su 'bul lo tshis ②ma chung / /dbus su mchi skal mi ldan gyisaskye/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' la zhog /phud la 'tshal skal mi ldan gyis④/ /lhag ma zhal chab bron la 455/ /nye gnas gdung ba'i ma sring 5snyernams/ /de nas rgyal ba'i 'bangs yin gyisayi/ /khyed ni ci bgyi bka' yi (7)las mkhan te/ /bka' yi las byung rtag par myur du sgrubs/ /bdag kyang deng (8)sngon lam log las spyad pas6)/ /dpag tu med pa'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal brgyud/ /da ni thugs rje las 'phro gnyis phrad pas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du myur 'gro yis/ /rjes su bstan pa'i bka' la nyams sa re ji ltar kyim byams bu la gdung ba bzhin/ /dam tshig can la dung dung gdung bar gyis / /gang du srid 67byams ming tshul gdung ba bzhin/ /yal gam can la lhang lhang brtse bar gyis/ /mdza' mo grogs la ji ltar gdung tshul bzhin/ /rnal 'byor can la kyil kyil brtse tu bar gyis/ /ji ltar g.yog byams dpon la snying brtse bzhin/ /dam pa rnams la nges par nye bar gyis/ /zhes 8'khor nye gnas rnams la gdams ngag bor nas dpa' bo chen po la skyabs su dong ste tsobaka' che ba yongs su bsrung ba'i phyir rang rtags srog gi snying po phul te mna' dor ro/ /ru lu ru lu bh+yo zhes rang gi srog la tshad bzhag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yongs su gnang ba ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ zhes byin gyis ⑩brlabs te bsregs sbyangs btul nas dgongs khral chung bar bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las bdud yongs su btul ba'i le'u ste nyi shu bdun pa'o// //101—370

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/371de nas de'i tshe de'i dus na dbang phyug chen po'i tshogs rnams 'di ltar rtog ste / e ma'o drag po chen po 'di/ 'di ltar methu che ba/ 'di ltar dregs ①pa/'di ltar gti mug pa/ 'di ltar chags pa/ 'di ltar nga rgyal ba/ 'di ②ltar gtum pa 'di dpa' bo chen po 'dis rnam par non/ nges par yang dag par non/ kun du rab tu non to snyam du rtog go/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na de dag gi sems kyi rtog pas rtog pa drag po ru tra ③de'i sems kyis yongs su shes nas smras pa/ kye nye gnas dam pa rnams gang de ltar ma rtog shig④ /sngon kho bo'i las kyi 'phro dang 'brel ba nye gnas dam pa kun gyis bshes gnyen de dang phrad pas las shes so/ /skye ba shes so/ /las mthong ngo / /skye ba mthong ngo / /las mngon du gyur to/ /skye ba mngon du gyur nas rang gi las la rang thag khos par gyur/ gang skad cig mar bde ba chen po'i g.yung (9drung gi pho brang mthong bas gang 'di ltar bud med dag sbrum pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen par gyur pa na 'di snyam du sdug bsngal 'di ni sngon du skyes pa skyobasten cing mang du spyad pa'i las 'ba' gzhig kho na'o snyam du yid la byed pa bzhin kho bo yang las 'ba' zhig la kho thag chad nas ji ltar ri gzar rtse nas rbab (8)'dril ba kyisagang gis mi yizlogs pa bzhin gdung (steb chen po'i shugs kyis 'thon pas tunyeshin tu gdung ba yin te/nye gnas khyod 8kyang rang gi las yid la gyis shig dang / gdung ba'i shugs rbab 8ltar 'dril bar 'gyur ro zhes smras nas rma ga chad par ngus nas shin tu smres yite yongs su gdung ba'i don bton pa 'di lta ste/ thugs rje chen po bcom ldan rdo rje sems/ /dri med dung mdog mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /rnam dag 'od gsal nyi zla 'bum bdal 7zhing / /dpa' bo 'od zer stong 101—371
