5 4 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi chos nyid dang / sems can kun gyi sems kyi chos nyid du shes par bya'o/ /de ni mun snang gnyis su snang yin te/ lang ku'i bdag po de yang 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po de gsang ba'i gnas pad+mo can zhes bya ba gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ①ba'i sprul pa'i lhums/gsang ba mchog gi pho brang na skad cig bzhugs pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ gang skyes bu dam pa dpag tu med pa dag de kho na nyid gsang ba dam pa'i the tshom gcod pa dang / yongs su zhu ba dang / zhu bar sdog ②pa dang / the tshom ⑧chad nas slar dong ba dang / gang kho bo 'khor der 'dus par gyur pas ④bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis byang chub kyi snying po zhes bgyi ba chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba de ma mthong ma ⑤dmigs lags so/ /yang dag par ma rnyed nges par ma 'tshal ba lags so/ /bgrod 0pas ma ༷khyab lags na 'di gang na ⑧mchis/ gang du btsal①/ gang zhig lags/ gang la bgyi/ gang du stor/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi skad cig ma 'di nyid du bstan du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa 'di bstan du ⑩gsol / zhes zhus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das des 'di skad ces bka' stsal ⑪to / /sems dpa' chen po byang chub kyi snying po zhes bya ba chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba de ni sgrib pas ma mthong / med pas ma dmigs/ zab pas ma rnyed/dka' 7bas ma shes/ myur bas ma slebs/ yangs pas ma khyab pa yin te/'di mun pa'i khams na yod/ grong khyer gsum du btsal/ 'di yan lag dnge mdo dang rtsa ba yin/ ngo bo de kho na nyid la bya/ mun pa'i khams su stor/sems dpa' chen po de ⑩lta bas na mun pa 'di bsal chaba'i phyir 'di'i rang 101—524

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor spub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/5 5bzhin la mkhas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du ngo bo dang / mtshan nyid dang /yan lag dang / ji srid pa'i yun dang / las dang / mun pa'i rnam grangs dang ske/ dpe la sogs pa ①dang / bsal ba'i thabs rnams la mkhas par bya'o//'di la nan tan du bya'o/ /gang mun pa'i khams pa dag dang / cha gcig tu shes ②bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / kho bos 'di skad ces gsol torka/ /bcom ldan 'das mun pa 'di ci las byung / mun pa 'di'i durang bzhin ci / mun pa 'di'i dungo bo gang / mun pa 'di'i dumatshan nyid ci/ mun pa 'di'i duyan lag tu/ mun pa 'di'i ⑦ma ba gang / mun pa 'di ji srid cig gnas / mun pa 'dis nici la sgrib/ mun pa 'di'i bye brag du/ mun pa 'di gang dang mthun/ mun pa 'di gang du 'thibs/ mun pa 'di gang gis sel/mun pa zhes ci'i ①phyir bgyi/ 'di ci phyir 'thibs/ dra ba tsogang du ⑩'dus/'di bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa 'di bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das des bka' stsal pa/ sems dpa' chen po mun pa dang snang bas bsdus ⑩pa'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni gzhi tsodang rtsa ba ④med par 'dus par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar ston pa'i mdo ni 'di lta ste / sangs rgyas byang chub 'byung 8ba yi/ /bskyed ⑩cing snying po de nyid de/ /pad+mo kha 'bus snying po ltar/ /rtsa ba 'khor ba'i 'dam na ⑩yod/ /rtsa ba thams cad 'byung tsob yi7/ /rtsa ba med pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin//khams gsum 'di dag nyid du 'dus/ /chos 'di zab ste 6 )mthong bar dka'/ /rtogs 0par yang ni mi nus te/ /mthar phyin sa la gnas pa yin/ /skyesabus tsokyang ni mthong ma yin/ /med pas stong pa'i chos nyid 'di/ /yod pa'i dngos 101—525

5 6 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101por yang ①mi dmigs/ /dmigs dang mi dmigs tshig lam chad/ /rnam par mi rtog skye ba ②med/ /gsal bas dus mtha' med pa ru/ /ma lus khyab par kun btsal yang / /'di zhes bya ba'i dngos po zhig /mi rnyed rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /mkhas pas dus mtha' med pa ru/ /shin tu bsgrims ①te cir brtags kyang / /gang 'dir ci yang mthong dub med/ /mgyogs pas dus mtha' med pa ru/ /nyam (shethag chad pas brgyugs kyang ni/ /da dung de nyid dbyings 'di las/ /gar (7yang ma phyin phyin pa med/ /skye ④med chos kyi sdong po la / /rnam pa bzhi yi ⑧yan lag gelakhyi/ /byang chub bla med snying por smin/ /de ni kun 'byung byang chub shing / /'jug pa don la 'dod pa'i khams/ /mngon med 'dzin pa gzugs khams so/ /snang med ma chad gzugs med nyid/ /gang de 7ched las byed las 'gyur/ /yul du gang 'gyur 'jug pa nyid/ /gang la 'jug pa de (nyernams shes/ /de yul mun pa'i khams gyur 8kyang / /mun pa'i khams na de nyid snang / /snang dang snang pa'i 'od byung ba/ /skye 'byung rtsa 'ba'i snying po nyid/ /phyogs rig des mi rig pa yicha/ /ngo bo nyid med de nyid do/ /mun khung gser stor ji bzhin du/ /'khor ba mun pa ༷mun nag tu/ /rin chen gser dang 'dra ba yi/ /byang chub sems 'di stor bar 'gyur⑩/ /mun pa'i khams su gyur pa dag /mun pa'i 'du shes nyid 7du 'byung / /mun pa'i khams pas gang shes pa/ /phra mo'i cha shas 6)tsam yan cad(kye/ /gang 'di 8)blo chung byis pa rnams/ /ched du gleng 6)zhing gang brjod pa/ /blo ldan ()kun la 'di brjod kyis( gye/ /blun po'i ched du shes par gyis/ /'di yang 'di ltar yongs su snang ske/ /yan lag mdo dang rtsa ba ste/ /'byed dang 'grol dang 'byin 6 )pa yin/ /101—526

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kuna'adusarisapa'imado/527yan lag drug tu ①gang grags pa/ /mthong gethos tshor myong reg shes drug /'byung ①'jug gcod pa'i yan lag yin/ /lang ma'i bdag po mdo bzhi ni gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzhi'i mdo dang / dmigs ④pa'i mdo dang / snang ba'i mdo dang / 'jug pa'i mdo'o/ /de yang 'di ltar/ mdo bzhi gzhi dudang dmigs pa dang / /snang dang 'jug pa lung bzhin bshad/ /lang ku'i bdag po de la gzhi'i khyimado ni 'di lta ste/ gzhi ⑦ni byis pa 'di ltar 'dod/ /gzugs med ming la mngon zhen pa/ /med pa'i khams nyid de kho na/ /shes pa kun gyi ngo bor 'byung / /shes bya nyid de yul du snang / /thams cad 'byung bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /ye nas ngang gis ma skyes la/ /ma bcos yang lagis 'od gsal ba/ /rgyu rkyen ⑨med pas 'dus ma byas/ /yongs su ma chad yul kun la/ /shes la mi gsal lhan ⑩cig 'byung ⑪/ /khyab 'jug btang 8stoms dngos med nyid / /rnam par mi rtog dpyod dang bral/ /mi rtog de yi 8de nyid layi/ /skad cig snga 8phyi ji snyed pa/ /rgyun dang bcas pa'i chu bo bzhin/ /rgyun 'byung skye 'gag bcas pa'o/ /gcig tu chad pa med pa yi/ /so so ris ltar mi snang bca/ /bye brag rnam par 'byed ⑩pa ni/ /'di dang 'di zhes ga la yod/ /tha snyad gnyis kyis ⑩bsdus pa'i chos/ /thams cad thams cad pa nyid de/ /kun 'gro 'akun 'jug kun la sbyor/ /dngos rig sna tshogs dbyer mi rig /g.yo ba nyid dang rnam par bkod/ /yongs yimyong gcod dang de 'dzin byed/ /lnga ldan mdun 6 )du ldan pa la/ /de ni kun la snyoms ( stepa yin/ /gang zhen de 'dzin kun mi gtong / /go skabs yod pa'i nam mkha' ltar/ /chos kun gnas 'byung go yod pa/ /skyed min sogs ru dang len pa yin/ /rkyen ni 101—527

5 8 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101gnyis dang mi ldan te①/ /ma nges de nyid kho na la/ /thams cad du ni gnas pa yin / /rkyen ni gang phrad de nyid du'o/ /chos rnams rtsa bar gcig pa la/ /de rgyun dbang gi ②rnam pa laganyis/ /gzhi dang rten zhes grags pa la/ /rmongs dang shes pa'i khyad par snang / /gzhi la kun 'gro kun la durmongs/ /rnam pa zhen pa'i bsti duganas med/ /rten ⑥ni gzhi ༷sbyor snang ba dang / /'gyur med rnam dag btsal ⑧med gnasasti/ /de dag re zhing rgyu 'bras gnyis/ /snga ma snga ma gang dag gang / /phyi ⑩ma phyi ⑩ma smin 8pa'i rgyu/ /de bzhin kun du 'khor bar 'byung / /rten lnga de rgyun de dbang gis/ /rnal 'byor lngar snang gnyen po lnga/ /smin pa'i dpe lnga sbyor dpe bzhin/ /skabs lnga lam lnga de bzhin sa/ /lnga lnga bste gnas dus lnga dang / /gnas lnga mthar phyin rnam pa lnga/ /'dir dbye ba las lnga bcu drug /rdzogs par snang bas lngar bshad do/ /chos rnams kun gyi gzhir ⑫gyur pas/ /nor ba'i rkyen gyis 'khor bar tsosnang / /rang bzhin ji ltar yin pa'i dona'/ /nges par mthong na mya ngan 'das/ /kun gyi gzhi dang gang de shes / /chos kyi ⑩phung po srid gsum 'byung / /de byung rtsa ⑩ba sna tshogs len/ /dbyings dang 'byung gnas rgyu zhes grags/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan nyid med/ /de bzhin nyid de ma nor ba/ /ma bcos gzhan ma yin pa nyid/ /ting 'dzin rtog pa stong nyid grags/ /lhag mthong zhi 8gnas rnam par thar/ /dbu ma mtha' bral gzung 7ba med/ /'dzin med chad 0med rtag pa med/ /skye med 'gag med rtog pa med/ /rnam par rtog med mtshan ma med/ /de bzhin bdag med gzhan med pa/ /'gro ba med cing 'ong ba med/ /dri med 'du ba 'bral 9 7ba med/ /phung med khams med skye mched med/ /yul dumed las med 101—528

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/5 9rgyu 'bras med/ /ma skyes snying po byang chub med/ /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems/ /de ni mi skye ①mi 'gag la/ /de ni nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /chos kyi dbyings nyid chos kyi sku/ /mi rtog ye shes yin zhes grags/ /ma byung ye nas rang bzhin snang / /ji srid len pa'i srid pa dag /gang sangs gang dag byung 'gags ②pas/ /sdug bsngal de rgyun zad bsregs pas/ /'gyur ba'i skabs lngas nges par 'byung / /gzugs med mthong med yod ma yin/ /yod pas mthong ba'i yul du gyur②/ /mthong med duyul du ma gyur pa/ /yod ces bya bar ga la rigs/ /mu mtha' med par 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /dngos med gzhi rten ngo bo nyidal/ /de bas tha dad sna tshogs snang / /dbyings 'di med na kun dang 'gal//gal te med pa gcig yod na/ /'dzin pa phyogs kyang de lta bas/ /nams kyang grol ⑤bar mi 'gyur te/ /'ching ba'i mdud pa de na yod/ /gang zhig mur 'dzin mthar dulta ba/ /des ni mu med don ma mthong / /mur 'dzin mkha' ⑦la mthos ⑧'jal 'dra/ /mu med nyid na grol stibar bshad/ /mur 'dzin grol 'dod grol ma yin/ /bye ⑩ma skyed 0kyang 'brur mi smin8/ /shel sgong bsgyur ⑫yang gting mi 'gyur/ /mching ④bu bsgyur 8yang rin chen minatso/ /sa rdo bsres 0kyang 'drir tsomi rung / /glog 'gyus gzhi la mun pa med/ /mtshal zi gser yizhun gcig mi srid/ /skyes bus nyid la mchod mi srid/ /chu bo snga phyi rgyun mi 'phrad/ /chos mthun pa na rigs mtha' yas/ /des na de bzhin nyid ces bsngags/ /de nyid med na thams cad du/ /gang de len yod ga la srid/ /de nyid med na rgyun bkag nas/ /ji srid cig na slar ldang ba/ /gang las byung de gang las min/ /gang med de med gnyis med na/ /gang las ldang ste gang mi 101—529

530 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101'gyur / /de bzhin gang gis 'gags 'gyur na/ /skad cig ji srid de nas ldang —/ / des na ①de nyid kun gyi gzhi/ /lus dang dug sman ji bzhin no/ /'jug pa lnga ni rmi lam 'dra/ /de ltar na 'di gcig pa 'am/ /'on te tha dad pa zhig yin/ /gcig dang tha dad ngo bo las/ /grol te dbyibs sam kha dog gam / /rnyog chu 'o ma'i chu bzhin no/ /de na de nyid de btsan srinam/ /gal te de yi gzhi 'di btsanani/ /mi g.yo mi 'gyur g.yo dang 'gyur/ /ma byung ba dang de bzhin 'byung / /nam mkha' 'byung ba ji bzhin no/ /thog ma tha ma dus mi dmigs / /ma nor ma bcos ④de bzhin nyid/ /rang bzhin kun du snang ba'i dbyings / /ma byung rang bzhin ye nas gsal/ /gzhi 'am de rgyun zhes bya ba/ /shes rgyun thams cad skye 'byung ba'i/ /rtsa ba mthu ⑤can gzhir gzhag pa/ /sna tshogs 'byung rgyu de nyid do/ /dang ba'i mkha' la rgyu ba'i sprin/ /gser gyi grangs tsam byung (nyatshun chad/ /khug rlangs sprin ⑦phung 'thibs zhes bya/ /'byung ba'i skad cig de sngon cad(nya/ /dang ba'i mkha' nyid snang zhes bya/ /de bzhin de nyid de gzhir gzhag /mtshungs dzi)pa yin kyiphyir der snang ste(7/ /so so'i bye brag de tsam mo/ /de nyid de yi rgyu ba las/ /'jug pa'i tshogs rnams rtsal ⑩du snang / /rtsa ba mthu (nyachen 'phel 'gyur bas/ /gang dang tshigang du gang nyon mongs / /mtshan mar snang 'dzin g.yo 'gul bskyod/ /rang snang gang la de gsal rig8 /gang du lta dang gang 'dzin pa'i/ /de rgyun de las der 'di 'byung ske/ /gang tshor gang shes 7gang de shes/ /skrag cing dngang 'jigs ⑩dngos po nyid/ /me long me shel me 'byung gsum/ /gang dang phrad (nyen de bzhin 'byung 16/ /me long mtsho rlabs sa 9 harlabs mnyagasum/ /ji srid de rgyun 101—530

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/531byung ①tshor rnams/ /de nyid rgyu yis ②rang bzhin lnga/ /me 'dzin de 'dzin 'dab 'dzin ltar/ /de nyid de yis de rgyun la②/ /gang zhen de 'dzin byed pa yin / /ras dkar la sogs de dag ni/ /gang sgo'i ④dbang du de dag 'du'o/ / ngade nyid de la de rgyun rag⑤ /gang nyid bsgos 0pa de nyid du'o/ /gangs dreg la sogs de dag ni/ /sogs pas de dag nyid du snang / /de rgyun 'byung gang de dag ni/ /de yang de dag nyid du'o/ /'o ma chu dang sa bon las/ /de mi 'dra bas de rtas ( )yin/ /tshenide nyid de yi rgyun de las/ /de yang de ltar snang ba yin/ /gnas pa de dag gang yin pa/ /der 'byung ba de nyid du'o/ /myur smin dus smin dus gnyis min/ /sa bon che chung 'phel 'grib de'o/ /sprin dang ling thog mun pa yis6)/ /rdzas gang mi mthong sgrib pa ltar/ / de yi 0rgyun 'khrigs mun pa yis/ /blta (7bya de nyid mthong ma yin/ /dang po gnyis dang phyi ma la/ /gsal dang 'gags dang tha dad snang / /de nyid kun la 'gro ba'i phyiral/ /gcig gis sna tshogs tha dad len/ /de nyid rtsal las 'jug pa drug /slar 'jug pa yang de nyid las/ /char rgyun smig rgyu 7ji bzhin no/ /mig nad dbang gis yul dag la4)/ /tha dad ma yin ngo bo tsam/ /gang dang 'di gcig 'dres pa las/ /sgyu tsomal de 'byed de dag len/ /de nyid las byung de rnams 'byed / /gang 'dir sbyor zhing mig snang yang / /gang gi 8dbang gis tha dad snang / /de las de yi'abyung de nyid las/ /de bzhin de dag 'byung ba'o/ /dri nga'i dri 'byung gang gi dri/ /gang med gang la zhen pa ni/ /mi 'dra mi gcig de nyid las/ /de nyid gzhan la de rgyun gzhan/ /gang gi ngo bo de gcig la/ /de yang gnas dang skabs kyis 'gyur/ /gang la bag chags rnam dag pa/ /dang 101—531

53 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101bas thams cad gsal ba bzhin/ /gang gi rgyun sangs kun khyab rgyas/ /dbu ①ma rnam dag de nyid ces/ /mun pa'i spyod yul ba dag 'dzin/ /mun pa 'ang de nyid de la 'byung / /mun pa'i rang bzhin ngo bo dang / /mtshan nyid yan lag rtsa ba dang / /gnas dang sgrib pa bye brag chosal/ /gang du gang gis gang phyir gang / /de dag nges par dbye bar bya'o/ /lang ma'i bdag po de dag ni gzhi yi ①mdo zhes bya ste/ gang (snyamun pa'i spyod yul ba las kyi bsgyings ⑤pa rnams la dgongs te mun pa'i chos rnams gsungs pa'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po de la dmigs pa'i mdo gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs khams de 'dzin gnas gcig nyid/ /de 'dzin de nyid de la lta/ /de 'dzin der byed mun pa can/ /phyogs 'dzin phyogs med rnam 6)dang gcig /ma nges spyir 'gro gnyis mi dmigs / /sna tshogs med de ⑦bdag nyid 'dzin/ /dri med 'dzin med gzhan 'dra med/ /de 'jug rten med khyad (kyepar med/ /dus gsum dus su de 'dzin med / /de 'dzin de la der ⑨'dzin pas/ /gzugs ming tiganyis la chags khams so/ /lang ku'i bdag po de la snang ba'i mdo gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/'dod khams de 'jug de 'brang ⑩gnas/ /gsum pa yin te de dag ni/ /de nyid 'byung rten de ma thag /'dod pa lnga dang chos gnyis so/ /byed pa kun dang rtag tu gcig /rigs gsum dag dang phrad rigs 'dzin/ /de 'jug tshol 7gcod 'bebs pa'o/ /ma 'gags gang du rgyun khyab 'jug /dus gsum skabs gsum 'jug med pa'o/ /sna tshogs de nyid de la 'debs/ /de yang 'jug pa rnam gnyis te/ /lnga dang thun 7mong de khyad 8par/ /yul rig 7pa dang mtshan nyid rig pa dang / dus rig pa dang / skad cig ma'i rgyun rig pa 101—532

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/533dang —/ las la 'jug pa dang / gang gi ①'bras bu yongs su myong ba'o/ /drug gnyis lnga gsum bcu ②gnyis gcig /thams cad de 'jug byed pa yin/ /lang ma'i bdag po 'di lta ste/ gsang ba mchog gi bdag po de/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /dgongs te yul 'di ③rgya cher bshad/ /dang po rnam rtog bdun rtog pa/ /mtshan ma can dang mtshan ma yin/ /rang gi ngang gis 'jug tshol dub/ /so sor rtog dang nyon mongs can/ /de min rnam par rtog pa'o / /gnyis pa nye bar sems gsum ste/ /rigs bskyed ⑤rigs min gnyi ga minadu/ /gsum pa rmongs byed dpa' byed rkyen/ /gang 'dir 'byung 'gyur dbang rten 'gyur/ /dbang po ⑦'byung 'gyur rnam shes kyil/ /de dang cha mthun 'byung cha mthun/ /nyam khyachung ba dang ma goms dang / /rno dang tshad las 'das pa'o/ /bzhi pa bla 'khyal snying khrin dang / /gang ma snyoms dang 'jigs 0skrag dang / /gnad du gyur dang gzhan gyis brlams/ /lnga pa yind 'jug nyam 8chung ba/ /ngal dang drags 8dang 'jibs pa dang / /gtad dang goms dang gzhan rkyen 'gyuratso/ /lnga gnyis dang po phyir byung ba/ /rtas dang gang 'dir sangs pa dang / /gang de blong bas kun dkris 8zad/ /gza' gtad rkyen gyis 0de 'joms dang / /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gyur ba'o/ /thang cig 'gags ⑩dang de tsosangs pa/chi /de yang der 'jug de nyid do/ /gnyis pa gnyis byed la 'jug pa/ /'di'o snyam du sngon 'gro dang / / bdun pa yiskyed dang 'bad rtsol sbyor/ /thams cad 'byung ba g.yo 6)bar byed/ /gsum pa chags dang bral byed pa/ /chags pa yul gnas las skyo zhing / /gzhan gyis bral dang bar gcod dang / /yang dag yid la byed pas byed/ /bzhi pa chags 101—533

534 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101pas nyams gyur pa/ /rmongs pa'i lta bas brtan par gnas/ /gang 'dir goms pa chung ba dang / /rnam pa rtags 6)dang mtshan ma dang / /de byed yid nyams sogs 'gyur bas/ /yang dag blangs te der ②'jug dang / /sgribs ②dang gzhan gyis zin pa'o/ /lnga pa don rgyun ④cad byed pa/ /gsal dang log pa'i stobs ldan dang / /longs spyod mthun pa'i grogs rnyed (snyedang / /de dag rgyun mi 'chad ⑥'gro dang / /rgyun du gcod ldog mi byed pa/ /log rgyun gnas byed don rgyun bcad/ /lnga gsum dang po mtshams sbyor ba/ /de las ldog ⑦pa'i don rgyun ldan/ /gnyis pa nying mtshams sbyor ba yi(nya 'chi ba'i chos la gnyis yod de/ /dus dang dus ma yin de la/ /kha cig 6)dus min 'chi ba yi7//de rkyen zad dang de gzhan rkyen(1/ /de tshe yun ring rgyu yod kyang / /yun ring gnas pa'i rkyen ma tshang / /ya nga ma spangs las kyi rkyen/ /tshad las 'das dang mi 'phrod 7dang / /gang ma sangs par gang non dang / /rnying 'khrigs 'byin ⑫par mi byed dang / /gang de 'gags 7par rgyun 'gog dang / /so so'i gnyen ⑫po sten mi byed/ /ma goms yimathun 'phrod mi shes dang / /dus min 'gro ⑩dang spyod pas nyesaXsnye/ /de nas 'du shes gsum ldan te/ /don dang log pa 6)btang snyoms ldan/ /don de gang ldan gar 'gro ba/ /sngon du de bsten de dran nas/ /gzhan gyis gsal bar byas kyang ni/ /rags pas 'byung ba de bar du'o/ /'du shes phra bar rgyu ba'i tshe/ /de las ldog 0cing btang snyoms ldan/ /de sngon de bsten de 'byung la/ /bsal 61bar mi nus gzhan dag gis/ /bskul yang dran par yang 2nyami nus/ /de dang 5nyagang ldan bde 'gro ste/ /mi bzad (nyedrag po'i 22tshor ba yang / /nyams su myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ / de yi lidus na gang 101—534

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/535mthong bsti/ /gang du ma mthong de nyid mthong / /ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od rkyen gyis//snang ba khad kyis 'byung ba bzhin/ /mun pa'i khams nas snang bar 'gyur/ /rmi lam lta bur gzugs snang ba/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs mthong bar 'gyur/ /de yi ②de kun shes pa des/ /gang 'dir smad ①nas 'dor bar byed/ /drod rjodang steng du yal bar 'gyur/ /gtsug tor ⑤gang 'byung bde ba'o/ /gang du log par de 'gro ba/ /gong las bzlog ⑥pa ji bzhin te/ /mi bzad ⑦drag po'i tshor bas ni/ /shin tu zug gzer ⑧mi bzod de/ /g.yo 'gul mi snyan khying ro gdon / /'khrul pa'i gang snang mthong ba na/ /byams pa la sogs gang zhig ni/ /gshed ma la sogs mi 'dod pa/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs ni sna tshogs su/ /mthong bas rdul 'byung ba spu gzing / /yan lag g.yob cing mkha' la rnyob⑩/ /bshang gci 'byung zhing mig kyang ldog /snang ba'i khams nas mun par byung ⑩/ /de yi de kun shes 'byung ltung / /gang de mthar 'byung mi bde'o/ /btang snyoms de yis tsom gsal lam/ /gzhan gyis gsal bar ma byas pa'o/ /gnyis su mi gsal btang snyoms so/ /'di dag gang ldan gang 'gro yang / /gang ltar goms pa kho nar nges/ /goms pa la gzhol 8de stobs ldan/ /gang ma goms pa gsal byas kyang / /ma zhen dbang gis 'gag 8par 'gyur/ /gang de gnyis la mtshungs goms na/ /der ni dang por gang gsal lam/ /gzhan gyis gsal bar byas pa las/ /log par mi 'gyur gzhan mi 'jug /btang snyoms tsokha cig 'gyur ba yin/ /kha cig mi 'gyur rdzogs mi 'byung / /thams cad kyang ni 'pho ba'i tshe/ /gang 'dir rgyu ba mi gsal ba'i/ /skabs su ma bab bar dag tu / /yun rings 'dus na goms pa yi/ /gang la gang chags de 'byung ngo / /101—535

536 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101de las de yi de dbang gis/ /'dir de med par 'gyur shes nas/ /de 'di nyid la zhe sdang skye/ /gang ma 'ongs la 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhe sdang me yis ①zil mnan ②pas/ /gnas pa 'di yi ①rgyun 'gags te/ /gang ma byung la chags pa de/ /srid pa gsum gyi dubar bdun pa/ /mngon par bsgrub ⑤pa'i rten yin no/ / de yi 0dus na rnal ⑦'byor pa/ /de bzhin de la goms ched cheni / /de tshe chags pa 'byung mod kyil/ /goms par gyur pa'i ⑩don stobs kyis / /chags pa de zil gnon pa ni⑩/ /mi gang rtsal dang ldan pa yis8/ /shugs med gang dag gnon bzhin no/ /byang chub rigs 8'dzin rnal 'byor la//gang chags de 'byung mi 'gyur ro/ /gnad kyi sdug bsngal mi bzod pa'itso/ /gang la mtho 8dman ma gtogs pa / /gzhan dag kun la 'byung ba yin/ /shin tu nyen dga' med phyir ro/ /sdug bsngal che chung gnyis kho na/ /gang 'gags gcig dang rim gyis ⑩'gags/ /de nyid goms te gang ma 'gags/ /gtso bas de la der ()zhen gces/ /gsum pa srid gsum bar bdun pa/ /brdzus skye ()dbang ldan las kyi 'gro/ /gang mthun mthong yin gang mthong min/ /shin tu bde dang bde sdug bsngal/ /de sogs gang du skye 'gyur de'idu/ /de dbyibs 'dzin cing thogs pa med/ / de yi (1lus sam duspyod yul ni/ /dri ma can du gyur pa rnams/ /mtshan mo mun nag rdzas nag ltar/ /thams cad thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang dag dri med pa dag rnams/ /zla 'od dkar dang rdzas dkar ltar/ /de gnyis 6)de mig dag pas mthong / /gang de'i de tshad tha ma pa'i/ /sprul pa 'byung ( steganas lnga tshad par/ /gang skye gnas ma blangs bar du/ /de mig de yi mig lta bur/ /gang las thogs med skal (ste101—536

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/537mnyam pa'o/ /gang ltar kun la ma yin no/ /gang skal ①mnyam pa'i skye gnas dang ske/ /de dag nyid gnas mthong bar gyur②/ /gang dag dri mig thur du gsal / /spyi tshugs 'gro la gzhan mthong min / /dri med mthor dugasal gzhan de bzhin/ /gang gi thad du de nyid snang / /gzhan ni gong ma nyid bzhin ⑤rna/ /bar bdun pa yi 0snying po can/ /skye ba de ma rnyed bar du/ /ring ltar thogs na ⑦bdun pa'o⑧/ /gang de ldan na nges med de/ /gcig gam gnyis sam gsum na 'pho/ /gang ma ldan na de rjes nas/ /yang bdun bar du de na gnas / /gang yod de gang mi ldan na/ /bdun phrag bdun gyi ⑨bar dag tu/ /bdun nyid re na de rje ⑩zhing / /de rdzogs srid du de na gnas/ /des ni gnas pa de zad nas/ /gzhan du gnas pa de 'dzin pa'i/ /gang de ji srid zil gyis gnon / /bdun nyid bdun rdzogs de phyin cad⑩/ /nges par de med ga la srid / /gang nub gang snang de skabs na/ /skad cig gnas pas bar ma do/ /bdun zhing nub pa'i rang bzhin pas/ /nub pa'i srid pa zhes kyang bshad/ /bdun pa'i bar du gnas pas na/ /gang de bar bdun pa zhes bya8/ /dri yi phyir 'brang dri rta bas/ /dri za nyer 'gro zhes kyang bya/ /de la brten tsonas de byung bas/ /de las byung ba zhes kyang bya/ /skye ba'i dbyibs tshugs de 'dzin pas / /sngon dang phyi ma'i tshul bzhin can/ /skye ba sngon 0du byed pas na/ /mngon du grub 8pa zhes kyang bya/ /rtag tu zas la nye 'khor bas/ /nye bar 'khor ba zhes kyang bya/ /gnyis kyi ⑩bar skabs yin pas na/ /srid pa mtshams sbyor ba zhes bya/ /de ni gzugs can yin pas na/ /gzugs med pa yi ⑩gnas med do/ /de na gnas pa'i srid pa de/ /sngar 'gags pa yi ()srid pa la//101—537

538 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101de dang de min btang snyoms ①pa/ /gsum la chags snang ③zhen goms pas/ /gang dusngon gang la zhen pa bzhin/ /dus der ④de la mngon par dga'/ /sngon tshe legs nyes spyad ⑤pa'i yul/ /klung ⑥nu gang gyur de nyid snang / /de dag rmi lam bzhin mthong nasaX/ /mthong nyid yul du mngon par gyur/ /de tshe 'khrul pa'i gzugs mthong ltar/ /gang gis snga ltas 'byung ⑧bar 'gyur/ /bde rkyen mi ldan pa zhig na/ /de na gnas dang de nub na/ /dman par 'byung ⑨ba'i snga ltas ni/ /srog chags ldem 7bu la sogs pa'i/ /gang du 'byung ⑩ba'i rigs mthun mthong / /ca co'i sgra dang 'dam bu'i thibs/ /nags 'tshal thibs po la sogs pa/ /ldum bu'i tshal dang dri sna tshogs/ /khang bzangs 0rdzing dang 'khrigs sprin gyis/ /nang du 'jug pa'i mtshan ma 'byung / /gang 'dir dag pa ba zhig na/ /rigs mthong gyur pa'i snga ltas ni0/ /zhi ba'i yul dang snyan pa'i sgra/ /yid 'ong dbang po tshim pa dang / /khang bzangs tsodang ni gzhal med khang / /skyed 7mos tshal dang snang yul du0/ /'byung ba'i mtshan tsom snang bar 'gyur(7/ /'khor los sgyur so rgyal la sogs pa'i/ /dag pas dag pa ⑥de rigs mthong / /de na gnas pa'i snying po de/ /'dod la zhen pas zhen pa'i phyir / /gang du dri byung der sonya'abrangs pas/ /nga dang mi nga dri 'byung yul/ /de la zhen pas tshim 'gyur 6 te/ /'khrigs pas de la zhe sdang 'byung / /des ni bar bdun rgyun 'gags byed/ /de zhen par du ( stede zad nas/ /des so ni de nyid de rtas 7te/ /gang du rtas pa'i snying po las/ /sogs pa'i lus can tha dad snang / /drod rkyen rlan rnams de rigs 'dzin/ /de med khams su de mi 'byung —/ /de ( 7med ma yin mkha' rdul 'dra/ /gang de ldan pa'i yul rnams ni/ /101—538

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/539dpag par gang ①ni ring gyur kyang / /thogs med mig ris mthong tshor phyin/ /gang gi dbang gis de 'gro bas/ /rig la ②nyid na phyin pa yin/ /de la de ring tha snyad med/ /ci phyir khyab 'jug gdos med de/ /lus can rnams kyi ①spyod yul min/ /la la gang la zhen pa'i mthus/ /mthun par snang ba'i rigs can dag /gang du 'phrod byed mthong bar 'gyur/ /de na ④nyid na der 'khyims nas / /de la de 'khor rtog dpyod 'dzin/ /zhen pas zhen pa'i rang bzhin ldang ⑤/ /gang de'i dbang gis der rmongs nas/ /phyin ci dulog tu mthong gyur te / /sgyu ⑦ma lta bur 'khrul par snang / /gang du gang zag de 'du 'phrod/ /byed par de la de snang gsal/ /gal te gnas pa'i cha len na⑧/ /'byung la chags pa'i 'dod pa 'byung / /de las bzlog 6)pa de bzhin te0/ /gnas 'gyur gnas dang bral bar 'dod/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba de bzhin te/ /gang du mi 'phrod de mthong 'gyur/ /de la de bzhin ⑩de dbang gis/ /gnas 'byung mtshan ma 'ba' zhig tshulas/ /gang gzhan 8snang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de yis de mthong de 'khyims nas/ /de la de ma rangs ltar 'byung / /de yis de yi 8rgyun 'gags nas/ /gang gis gang zin ji bzhin du/ /zhen pas srid pa de 'dzin byedaX / /gang de de yi tsogados kyis bsrung ⑩/ /dman 'gro gang de bar bdun pa / /gsod 8la zhen goms de brtsegs pas6)/ /gang gnas gang yin de gnas na/ /bsad la sogs pa de snang (nya'agyur/ /gang de de yis mthong ma thag /sngon du goms pas de rig nas/ /gsad bya snyam du de rgyug byed/ /gsad yul skye ba'i gnas mthong nas/ /gsad puspel sogs pa'i las brtsams (gepas / /de dag 'khyims nas zhe sdang 'byung / /de yis bar bdun rgyun 101—539

540 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101'gags nas/ /dman ①pa'i lus blangs nyon ②mongs myong ⑧/ /de ltar gang du 'byung ba yi/ /gnas ris rnams kyi bar bdun pa/ /gang du 'byung ba'i gnas de na/ /gang zhig goms pa'i yul snang 'gro/ /de la zhe snang spyod 'khyims pas/ /snang duba'i dbang gis de rgyun 'gag⑤ /de snang byung dub ma byung len/ /bzhi pa'i skye gnas 'jug chos bzhi/ /shes bzhin 'jug gnas 'byung ba dang / /de bzhin 'jug gnas mi shes 'byung / /shes 'jug mi shes gnas 'byung dang / /mi shes bzhin du 'jug gnas 'byung / /'dzin dang 'dres pa'i nyer ⑦gnas pa/ /gnas gsum mthun pas ②skye 'dzin byed/ /skye ⑨gnas sa bon las rnams kyis/ /nyes pa'i bar chad gsum med na/ /mngal du thams cad smin par 'gyur⑩/ /de yang 'byung gnas gcig la 0gcig /zhen pa drag po 'byung skabs su/ /mthar 'dzin pa yi 8bcud 'byung 'gyur/ /de nas de bzhin gnyis ka tsolas/ /gang bcud 8thig le re re dag /gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nyid gang der 'dres 'gyur tsonas/ /gang tsodrod zhabs bzhin 'du ba yin/ /thams cad pa de der 'jug 'gyur/ /gang la ngo bo med pa de/ /dngos po ci phyir 'dzin par 'gyur/ /dper na mkha' 'gro 'dod dbang gis/ /sa khus bris pa'i nyis ⑩'dzin bzhin/ /gang med chags pa'i rnyis tso'adzin to/ /thams cad pa yi dbang des na/ /mi 'drul dngos smin 6)rta ba yin/ /de dag med 63nur phyogs gang du/ /de zhugs pa nyid snying rten pa'o/ /gnas ma thag pa btang snyoms ldan/ /de mtshams de ni gnyis su 'gyur/ /'du mched drug 'dod skabs dag tu/ /gang gi dus na dngas sla ba/ /shin tu rtas par gyur pa yin/ /de bzhin 'dril dus 'dul (me101wa 540

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/541ba de/ /'dren pa nas 'jug des rta ba'o/ /lnga gang gang ①'di 'byung bas bskyedam/ /gcig tu gang rten 'byung ba nyid/ /de nyid rten zhugs snying po'o/ /tha ma gnyis la dbang 'byung skye/ /khams bzhin rgyas sra ②sdud smin 'dzin/ /yan lag rnams 'byed 'byin ③pa yin/ /gang dang gang gis bzhin mdog 'gyur / /gnas yin bzhin phyogs mthun ltar g.yon/ /'byung nyid snrel duzhi phan tshun g.yas/ /gnas na gnas dus brgyad nyid de/ /mer nur ltar mkhrang yan lag 'gyur/ /de la de ⑤phyir 'byung ba dang / /dbang po dang ni mtshan dod pa'o/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i dus de na/ /bdun phrag pa yi byarlung byung ste//gang gi nad ni skyed ⑦par byed/ /'byung ba'i char gtogs rlung 'byung bas/ /g.yo 'gul can du 'gyur khyab ste/ /srid 'byung lugs su ji bzhin bzlog /de dag de na dhiganas pa'i yun/ /bdun phrag sum cu ⑩ma brgyad kyis/ /thams cad des ni rdzogs pa yin/ /gang gi rtsa drug bzhi rdzogs nas/ /gdon mi za bar 'byung skyob yin/ /lnga pa 'byung ba'i chos bzhi la/ /gang las rnal 'byor 'byung gnas nyid/ /gang 'di de tsodag bzhi phrag bzhi7/ /bcu drug chos su grags pa la/ /gang skye ba dag kun 'dus pa'o/ /'di dag las kyi skye tsob ste/ /thams cad thams cad byed pa ni/ /ngang ring mgyogs 8pa'i las yin zhes/ /mun pa'i spyod yul pa yis mthong / /las kyis bsgyangs ⑩pas bsgribs ⑩pa la/ /dgongs de ()de ltar mdor yigasungs pa'o4)/ /lang ku'i bdag po de dag ni snang ba'i mdor shes par bya'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po gzhan yang 'jug pa'i mdo gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de 'dod byed pa rnam (nyegasum gnas/ /go 'byed rgyun gcig rgyun gzhan byed/ /so so ris su bcad dbang byed/ /de nyid ldan 101—541

54 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101pa de kho na/ /gang gi ngo bor byung tsam nyid/ /gang yang ma yin de dbu ma/ /kun du mi 'chos ①rang bzhin blun②/ /gsum gsum gnyis dang rkyen gsum dus / /'dod khams yongs su rdzogs pa yin/ /lang ku'i bdag po de dag ni mdo bzhi zhes bya ste/ des de yongs su dgrol bar shes par bya'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po de la rtsa ba gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dngos po'i rtsa ba dang /brjod pa'i rtsa ba dang / thams cad pa'i rtsa ba'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po de la dngos ①po'i rtsa ba ni ④ci yang med pa las cir yang snang ba'o/ /⑤brjod pa'i rtsa ba ni ci yang med pa las cir yang 'gyur ba'o/ /thams cad pa'i rtsa ba ni gang ci yang med pa las cir yang rig pa nyid do/ /lang ma'i bdag po de dag ni rtsa ba ste/ /des thams cad nges par 'byin pa'o/ /lang ma'i bdag po de dag ni 'di lta ste/ chos kyi ⑥rgyal pos gang gsungs pa/ /thugs dang zhal dang zhus lan gsum/ /dom/ dang lung dang rgyud ces pa/ /gang 'dir gsum du grags pa la/ /gang dag 'di la rnam rtog pa/ /chos kyi ⑦rgyal po'i gsung gcig la/ /rgyud dang lung dang don dam zhes/ /gsum du snang ba 'di ji ltani/ /snyam du rtog 6)pa de gang drugabo /nyid kyis mkhyen te de gsal bar/ /dgongs te gsum nyid rnam par gsungs/ /gang de skabs dang skabs 'phros (1pa'o/ /skyes 7bu'i thugs la gang gnas pa/ /zhal du ma byung don dam nyid/ / gsung gi 7'gyur bas de mtshon bon/ /skyes bu rgyal po'i bka' lung yin/ /zhus lan phra men 'phel 8rgyas na/ /skyes bu rgyal po'i tsobaka' rgyud yin/ /thabs che tshegs 7chung don dpag med/ /bya sla dpag dka' man ngag dam/ /de nyid nges pa de kho na/ /ma bslad yonaji bzhin bcad pa lung / / bcas gzhi ()gtam 101—542

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/548rgyud las rgyud ①dang / /rtog chen yan lag 'brel bcas rgyud/ /gsum du snang ②la gcig tu zad/ /dbyer med tshul gcig rang bzhin la/ /rtsal dang rnam par snang ba dag⑧ /gcig ste ④rnam pa ku yongs ⑥kyis med/ /de skad gsang ⑦ba mchog des bshad/ /las kyis bsgyangs ⑧pa gang dag la/ /gang 'dir mun pa'i phyogs bshad pa/ /go cha stibagos pas shes par gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ⑩dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gang gi yimun pa'i spyod yul bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu 8lnga pa'o// //de nas lang ku'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des/gsang ba pa'i 8bdag po la yang yongs su 'dri ba dris pa/ kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po rtsa ba gang la gang gi snang ba yongs su dag pa'i spyod yul gang lags/de skad ces gsol pa las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ lang ku'i bdag po gang yongs su dag pa'i dri ba de ni 8legs so/ /shin tu rab tu legs so / /lang ku'i bdag po de yang 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag pa ste/yongs 0su dag pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams na ngang gis bzhugs pa de'i tshe de'i dus na gang dpag tu med pa'i rgyal ba dag smyo dgongs pa kun nas 'dus pa dag la gang snang ba 4nyayongs su dag pa'i spyod yul du dgongs te/ de kho na nyid snang ba de kho bos phyin ci ma log par yongs su bgro bar tu)bya'o/ /lang ma'i bdag po 'di lta ste/ mun khung gser stor sgron mas ( rterang snang ltar/ /ma rig mun par sems stor rang snang ba/ /dgongs pa kun nas 'dus pa'i rtsa (nyab 'di(ste/ /snga rabs 'das pa'i dgongs pa sa 'dus nas gsungs/ /chos kun rtsa ba sems 101—543

544 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101'di nyid la 'dus/ /sems nyid gnas 'gyur ye shes lngar snang ba/ /de nyid don la nges par bzhag ①pas na/ /sems nyid gnas 'gyur ba yang de nyid yin / /ye shes lnga nyid de la rdzogs pas na/ /ye shes lnga yang ②gcig tu 'dus pa yin③/ /sems kyi ④chos nyid ji bzhin de ⑤rtogs na/ /ye nas sangs rgyas ma nor ma bcos par/ /bdal dukhyab sa nyid non pas ⑦'dus par ⑧gsungs/ /gnas skabs de ⑨na yod 0med lta ⑩mthar thug /sems kyi de bzhin ji ltar yin pa dang / /deng rgyun yod med shes par bya/ /de bzhin nyid la gang 'dir ji ltar blta/ /de nyid snang ba yin nam mi snang ba/ /'o na sangs rgyas yin nam sangs rgyas min/ /de las gzhan na kyisangs rgyas yod dam med/ /'di ltar cir bzhag gros kyis chod tipar bya/ /'di 0ltar nges nas de ltar gyur na yang ske/ /blo 'bur las lam mi dgag de bzhin spyad/ /des na kun gyi rang bzhin de nyid 'dus/ /de la bsam med dmigs med ⑩der bzhag na/ /cir snang cir srid mtshan med de gcig pa/ /skye 'gag med pa'i de nyid ye sangs rgyas / /de nyid ma yengs ⑩pas na ma bsal tsoyang / /rdzogs pa spyir chib sa ⑩nyid ye dunas non/ /de nyid nyam zho )drod nyams su gsal na yang / /chos kun sgo dang mi 'gal bstan pa'i phyir/ /ting 'dzin gsum ldan gol sa'i sgo bkag nas / /drod chen gsum gyis dam pa'i dgongs pa myong / /des na ting 'dzin rnam gsum nyams rnyed (nyapas/ /'bras bu pha rol phyin drug rang bzhin rdzogs/ /sems nyid ma bcos nam mkha' ()ngang la gzhag /des ( sten dran cing rtog ⑥pa ci byung yang / /de bzhin ma 69bcos nyid kyis la bcad pas/ /ngang gis ma bcos yang 6)gis 'od gsal ba/ /gsang ba 'dus pa rnams kyis yin par 101—544

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/545bsngags①la/ /ma yengs skye 'gag med nyid ting 'dzin te/ /rnal 'byor gsum don de yi ②skabs na rdzogs/ /des na kun gyi ①bshes nyen ④dgongs brgyud thunas / /dam pa'i don du sems nyid shes par bya/ /de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas na/ /gang gis 'di mthong de yi duzhal mthong yin/ /de mthong phan chad dam pa nyid yin pas/ /des na kun gyi bshes nyen ⑦yin par grags/ /de lta'i don mthong gang dang gang zhig gis/ /ci la'ang mi lta de la zhen par bya/ /des na byas zin btsal ⑧med der nges nas/ /rang ⑨'byung ye shes yongs su dag ces bya/ /des ni zin chags bde sdug ci byung ba/ /tshogs gnyis ma bsags 0rdzogs par dam bca'o/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin mtshan ma rnam dag pa/ /chos nyid mngon 'gyur 0che yon rgyun mi 'chadakyi/ /sgrib pa gnyis byang tshogs chen rdzogs pas na/ /gang gi phyogs rnams mthun par sa rnams non/ /'di ni kun 'dus dgongs spyod zab mo yin/ /gang dag kun gyi spyod yul ma yin no//gang gis gang ltar de yi 'don mthong ltar/ /gang dag 'khrul pa rnams kyis ma mthong bas/ /gdod tsonas zhen pa'i mun pa sangs dka'o/ /sa dang sa yi ⑫khyad par yod ces pa/ /mthong dang ma mthong gnyis 0med gsal dus na/ /dam pa'i dgongs pa lhun gyis grub nges pa'o/ /stong dang ⑩ma skyes tsorang bzhin khyad par ci/ /yod med rtag chad bya btsal yil sogs pa/ /kun nas lhun gyis grub par ye gnas 4)pa'o/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu cir snang cir srid kyang / /chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi rgyan du snang / /de nyid ma bkag yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshul / /gong 'og la sogs skyon yon gnyis po dag /mthong dang ma mthong re rtsol rkyen tsam gyis/ /rgyu 'bras so sor gsal zhes smra ba yang / /thams cad de 101—545

546 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 'a 101bzhir nyid du gcig par zad/ /de la ye nas 'du 'bral med bzhin du/ /mi mnyam mnyam pa'i spyod yul cir snang yang / /ji bzhin nyid 'di ma yin gang yang med/ /de nyid de la tshogs rdzogs thabs shes 'brel/ /des na dam pa 'dus pa'i dgongs pa rnams/ /don dam ma bcos sems nyid de la 'dus/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ma byas rang byung bas/ /ting nge 'dzin zhes dmigs pa ①kun dang bral/ /'di ltar nges pa'i byang chub sems de la/ /bgrod pa'i gnas dang lta ba'i gzugs med pas/ /mtshan ma kun mkhyen skyon yon yang ②ye med / /theg chen gnyis rdzogs the tshom ①kun bcad cing / /bla med rdzogs pa chen por la bzlas pa'o/ /des na mtha' dbus ④'byed pa cha phra ba mtha' dbung ⑤'byed pa nyid du kun gcig ste/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i don du kun 'dus gsungs/ /rgyur 'dod las ⑥sogs phyi nang yul dag la/ /dga' ba'i mtshan ma tsam du gams pa dang / /gang dag spyod pas chos rnams sems su 'dus / /mtha' gnyis ngang ⑦gis gsal zhes smra ba yang / /la bcad mthong bas gud (nyan yod med do/ /gal te yod par 'dod na skyon chen yin/ /des na bsam gtan so so ci po)snang yang / /byis pa'i spyod yul 'khrul pa nyid snang yin / /dam pa dman pa sgyu ma smig 7rgyu'i tshul/ /rang bzhin skye 'gag med pas nam mkha' bzhin/ /der ni kun 'dus (1kun la mthong ba med/ /ci yang mi snang ba nyid skyon med 'dod/ /de ni 'khrul pa yin pas btub ma yin/ /mthong dang ma mthong snang la rang bzhin med/ /kun 'dus gsang ba'i dgongs spyod zab mo ni/ /rang byung 7rang rig mngon sum khye snang dus na/ /rang byung ye shes de nyid mthong zhes bya/ /de ltar dgongs pa dam pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /rtog 101—546

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i spa shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor thub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/547chags kun sangs mthong yul 'das pa ste/ /bya med snang med mi btsal bzhag ①pa'ol/ /dmigs pa'i yul med chos lam chags pa spangs/ /mthong tshor bde lam mu ②med bdal niba'i dbyings④/ /gang 'gyur gang snang de las gar ma g.yos / / de yi ⑤gtan tshigs de bzhin nyid kyis gsal/ / de yi yidon la kun 'dus dpyod mi mdzad/ /chos kun rang 'byung stirang rig ye shes snang / /de don ma skyes ma byung ⑧ma skyes te/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur btags ⑨pa yang 0ye med / /de ltar gang rig de nyid tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /don la mnyam bzhag ⑪blo bcos skyon nyid nitshu/ /de dang 'gal zhing de dang phrad mi 'gyur/ /de las nges blo khyab par btang ba ni/ /de dang mi 'gal de nyid nges pa ste/ /rang rig dus na de la gnyis su med/ /snying po de nyid rgyu 'bras lhun gyis grub/ / de yi 'dus na don dam nyam dhidrod rdzogs/ /snang dang mi snang rtag chad la sogs pa/ /nyam 8drod nges pas tsodon gyi gting 7phol te/ /tha dad phyogs kyi ⑫the tshom ()'di bcad pa'o/ /de nyid de la zhen 0nges blo brtan zhing / /gang dang 'brel pas lta ba'i thag chod na/ /dman pa'i lus la dam pa'i go 0'phang can / /dbang phyug yin pas de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /g.yo sgyu med pa'i yo byad chen po lngas/ /dbang po'i spyi sa)gtsug nor bu 6 bzhin du lta/ /kun nas 'dus pa'i dgongs pa tshig (stegasum po/ /yid ches (genges pas blo yi gdeng yodu bya/ /tshig 4)gsum don la nges rnyed mngon du 'gyuras / /nges pa'i don ni rang rig kho nar zad/ /gsang ba'i bdag pos de skad ces smras pas/ lang ma'i bdag po la sogs pa dman pa'i lus kyi sems dpa' rnams kyis chos thams cad kyi ⑥ma ba gtan la nges par phebs par gyur (rteto/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi (medagongs pa 101—547

548 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101'dus pa'i mdo chen po las chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gang snang ba dag pa'i spyod yul bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu ①drug pa'o// // bam po dgu par ②zug pa①/ de nas yang lang ma'i bdag po la sogs pa ④dman pa'i lus kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyis ⑤gsang ba pa'i bdag po la yang gang gi ⑥dri ba yongs su rgyadris pa/ kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'dir nyid kyis chos kyi rnam grangs bcur bkod pa las rang bzhin ma bcos par bya'o zhes thos na de ji ltar yongs su shes par bya/ rang bzhin ni gang / gang ltar na ma bcos/ de gang gi rang bzhin lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ kye dman pa'i grogs po dag ⑧gang rang bzhin ni mi 'gyur ba'o/ /ma bcos pa ni rnal ma'o/ /'di dag ni gsang sngags kyi rang bzhin dang / de la lta ba'i rang bzhin dang /de las mi 'da' ba'i rang bzhin dang / de ltar spyod pa'i rang bzhin no/ /grogs po dag 'di la gsang sngags kyi rang bzhin ni 'di lta ste/ nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /rnam par rtog bral gang mi rtog /de bzhin sa yi rang bzhin pas/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i rang bzhin no/ / me yi 6nyerang bzhin lta bu bas/ /dngos po thams cad med par byed/ /rlung gi rang bzhin lta bu bas//g.yo rdul mi g.yo'i 0rdul kun sel/ / chu yi yirang bzhin kho na bas/ /gzhan med de bzhin nyid du 'dus/ /sman gyi rang bzhin yin pas na/ /'khor ba'i gcong rnying 7rnam par 8'byin/ /'di ltar 'tsho ba'i yirang bzhin pas/ /'tsho ba 7dag pa kun gyi gsos/ /gcod pa'i rang bzhin lta bu bas/ /sdug bsngal 101—548

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i rlu shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/549rgya ①mtsho rnam par gcod/ /nyi ma lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /mun khang snang ②ston gsal ba nyid/ /ri rab lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /cis kyang bskyod cing g.yo nib med/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /mi g.yo ba las byin brlabs du'abyung / /de bzhin rtsi yi rang bzhin pas/ /dug la sman 'gyur ji bzhin no/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /rnam par rtog bral thams cad 'byung —/ /ma bcos ma bslad ⑤de bzhin pa'o/ /grogs po dag de dag ni gsang sngags kyi rang bzhin du shes par bya'o zhes thos pa rnam par bgros pa'o/ /grogs po dag de la lta ba'i ⑥rang bzhin ni gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ma ⑦rnar mi 'gyur nges bcad de/ /ma chags mi rtog nyam mi nga / /dper na nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /sprin dang na bun khug rlangs ⑧dang / /zla ba nyi ma skar tshogs dag /snang yang nam mkha' bzhin du gnas/ /de bzhin nyid kyi nam mkha' las/ /mtshan ma'i rnam rtog ci byung yang / /chos nyid nam mkha' bzhin gnas par/ /rnal 'byor can gyis blta bar bya/ /ji bzhin ma bcos de bzhin la/ /mthong dang ma mthong khyad par gyis/ /lta ba'i khyad par so sor bltakhyam/ /rnam par rtog la rnam rtog 0nyid/ /log sred can la log rtog nyid/ /phyogs 'dzin tsam la tha snyad rdzas/ /phyogs shes dag yil sgyu mar tsosnang / /de nyid der nges nam mkha' tsomathong / /nam mkha' bzhin gnas nam mkha' la/ /nam mkha' nyid du snang bar zad/ /grogs po dag de dag ni lta 8ba'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /zhes thos pa nges par bgros pa'o/ /grogs po dag de las mi 'da' ba'i rang bzhin gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu 'dir/ /thams cad yongs kyis gcig pa la/ /bsrung tsodang mi 101—549

550 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101srung 7phyogs dang bral/ /bsrung ba'i tshad gzung ②ga la yod/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dam tshig bsrung ⑧/ /gang 'dir bsrung mtshams med na bde/ /des ni thams cad bsrungs pa yin/ /ci phyir thams cad thams cad kun/ /dam par nges pa yin pas na/ /tshad 'dzin tshad yod byed nyid nyams/ /gang la bsrung dang mi srung duba'i/ /rnam rtog de dag med kyang bla'iphyi/ /de 'dra bsrung ba'i mtshams ⑥'dzin pa/ /sgyu ⑦ma yin pas dam pa yin⑧/ /de la bsrung ⑨zhes su zhig zer/ /bsrung dang mi srung ⑩tshig med de/ /chos nyid de la blang dor byed/ /dam par gyur pa tsog la yin/ /bsrung ⑩dang mi srung 0chos rnams ni/ /srung 'du med pas de bzhin gzhag /de bzhin nyid kyi don dam la/ /ji bzhin pa yi blo bzhag ste/ /brjod pa med pa'i dam tshig gis/ /bsrung mtshams med pa'i ngang du bsdam/ /bsrung med nam mkha'i dam tshig 'di/ /ji ⑩ltar grags pa'i rang bzhin la/ /sdom dang tshul khrims so sor snang / /'jig rten pa la chad mdo btsan⑩/ /byis pa rnams la tshul shes pa/ /nar son pa la sdom ⑩par grags/ /bla med mchog ()la dam par snang / /gcig gi don las ()ma g.yos kyang / /'dul ba'i ngo la so sor grags/ /de bzhin nyid ldan 9 nyadam pa ste(nya/ /de las 'das na tshig par 'gyur / /gcig bsrungs pas na ( )kun bsrungs pa'idu/ /dam pa'i dam tshig chen po 'di/ /kun dang 'gal bar mi 69bya zhing / /gang gi don du 'gyur bar bya / /grogs po dag de dag ni mi 'da' ba'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o zhes thos pa yongs su bgros pa'o/ /kye grogs ngo/ dag de ltar spyod pa'i rang bzhin gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lus dang ngag dang yid gsum gyi(nya/ /mtha' gsum 101—550

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i rlu shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/551yongs su dag rdzogs na/ /dam pa'i spyod pa yin pas na/ /dman min dam pa'i rigs shes ①bshad/ /rdo rje lus kyi spyod pa ni/ /phyin pa med las lus mi bcosal/ /gcig pu nyid pas gcig tu gnas/ /glang po'i lta stangs ji bzhin dang —/ /de bzhin rnal mas gnas par bya/ /gang du gnas pas rtag ②par gnas / /gnas pa de la chags mi bya/ /spyod lam rnam bzhir gar ldan pa/ /ma bcos rnal mar gnas par bya/ /gang gis gdung ba mi nyen pa'i/ /gnod pa skyob pa dag tsam las/ /bzang dang rgyan phyir bcos mi bya/ /gang du ji ltar bde ldan sbyar/ /rdo rje sngags kyi spyod yul ni/ /bya ba med pa'i rnal 'byor pas / /mchod rten dag gi dulas mi bya/ /glegs dubam bklag ⑤par mi bya zhing —/ /gzugs brnyan dubartsam pa'i las mi bya/ /lag gi ༷phyag rgya mi bcing ⑧zhing ske/ /ngag gi bzlas pa de la sgrib/ /rnal 'byor lus kyi phyag mi bya/ /rnyed ⑨dang bkur sti blta ma yin/ /khe phyir ma yin grags phyir min/ /ci phyir phyi rol g.yeng ba tsodang / /shin tu g.yeng ba 0yin pa'i phyir/ /de la nye ba ma yin pas/ /lus 'di rnal mas gnas par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor nges pa'i bsam gtan pas/ /rdo rje sngags kyi kha zas ni/ /lus zungs 'dzin pa'i rten tsam du/ /gar ldan 'byor ldan tsom gtogs pa/ /zas phyir ched 'du bsgrub tsomi bya/ /mtshag ⑩dang nyam 0phyir ga la yin/ /ma bcos rnal ma ji bzhin bza'i/ /'tsho ba'i ched ⑩du bcos ()mi bya/ /chags dang ma chags spang blang med/ /blang bar bya ba ma yin zhing —/ /slong (7mos 'tsho bar yong mi bya/ /ci'i ()phyir de ni mi 'gyur phyir/ /'tsho ba yongs su ma dag pa'o/ /mtshams med pa las mtshams gcod pa/ /'di ni rnal 'byor can gyi las/ /shes bya nang gi chos nyid la(nye/ /rnal 'byor 101—551

55 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ la 101don du 'jug pa na/ / phyi yi ①'du 'dzi ②g.yeng ba yis/ /bar du gcod pa bsal ①ba'i phyir/ /phyi dang nang gi so mtshams su/ /'gro 'ong 'drul ④rnams gcad (9par bya/ /gang la gnas gzhi rten med pas/ /gnas bder lus bcos kha na med/ /zhen pas spyod lam bcos byed pa/ /des ni lus bcos bslad pa yin/ /bsam gtan lus dben bcos mi bya/ /de la de dben ma bcos pa/ /de nyid ye nas dben pa'i gnas/ /'di ni rnal 'byor mchog gi yul / /ri phug gzhal ⑥med bcos mi bya/ /de nyid dpag med ma bcos pa'i/ /'di ni ye nas rmad 'byung (7gzhal/ /byed pa med par rang byung (nyaba'o rdo rje ngag gi spyod yul yang / /dam pa'i ched du snyan smra ⑨las/ /gzhan du kha gsag ga zha min/ /brjod pa thams cad nges pa nyid/ /gsong por smra zhing tshig mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar brjod pa de bzhin bya/ /thams cad kun du smra ma yin / /gang brjod don yidang 'brel bar bya/ /skabs dang dgos ched 0ma gtogs pa/ /rnam par 'chal snyibar bya ba min/ /kun la dpes mtshon thog tu dbab / /thams cad tshad pas tshad mar bya/ /ma bcos ngang gi rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje ngag gi spyod par 6stobashad/ /rdo rje yid kyi spyod yul ni/ /ma bcos ma g.yos bsam dang bral/ /mi g.yeng ma rmugs gsal zhing gnas/ /'dod la ma chags sgro skur bral/ /blang med dor med chags sdang med/ / 'chab bcom ④med de rnyed 7'byor min/ /phyogs bral mu med yongs su dag /go bgos ⑩lam nyid drang por song dzi 3/ /dug 'gyur sman bsrel mtshon char ldan/ /rdo rje rdzong la zhen pa dang / /yid bzhin nor bu blo gros ldan(nya/ /gang du mi 'gyur gang mi 'gyur/ /dbyings 'dir kun dang gcig pa dang / /gang gi blo la 101—552

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/553mngon pa'i phyir/ /yongs su mdzes ①dang bag yod dang / /de nyid dbang las khrel ②yod dang / /de la nga 'am nga med pas/ /kun la yongs su ldan pa dang / /thams cad bde ②bas nges pa dang / /gang 'di dustong bas cir mi rtog⑤ /de nyid zhi bas 'khrug dumed dang / /gang nas ci yang mi 'byung bas/ /gzhan du tshol ba med pa dang / /zang zing med pa tshul mi 'chosaX/ /gdung ba med pas 'dod pa med/ /ma chags 'byung bas chog ⑧par 'dzin/ /gang la mtshan mar mi 'dzin pasal/ /gtsang sme kyimed cing dus gsum med/ /de bzhin dam ⑩pa yod ma yin/ /sems nyid nam mkha'i snying po de/ /glo 8bur sprin gyis gtibs spungs pas/ /shes rab rlung gis tsom gtor bar/ /ga zha mkhan gyi spyod 'dra yis / /sgrib bsal 8chos nyid gsal 'dod pas/ /ji ltar chus gsher byas pa dag /nyi ma sprin ltar grib ma yis8/ /shin tu bsgribs ⑩par gyur pa na/ /byis pa'i rang bzhin mi shes pas/ /sprin chen 'dus pa'i phung po la/ /kha yi ⑩dbugs kyis bus byas nas/ /sprin bsal nyi 'od gsal 'dod 'dra'o/ /grogs po dag de dag ni de ltar spyod pa'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /zhes thos pa phyin 8ci ma log par sangs rgyas kun gyi /9)dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo duchen po las rnal 'byor rang bzhin gyi 7le'u zhes bya ste lnga bcu ()bdun pa'o// //de nas yang lang ma'i bdag po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po (snyernams kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po la dri ba yongs su dris pa/kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po ljon shing bskyed pu stepar bya'o zhes dam bca' bar snyen gsungs pa de ji ltar yongs su shes par bgyi/ de gang gi ljon shing lags zhes 101—553

554 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101dris pa las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ kye grogs po dag shing ni byang chub kyi ljon shing ste/ bla na med pa'i 'bras bur smin pas gang mtha' dag gi gsos su 'gyur ba'i phyir ljon shing de bskyed par bya'o/ /grogs po dag 'di lta ste/ de nyid rdo rje snying po las/ /gang gi zug rngu kun byang ①der/ /ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa la/ /gang gi dgongs pa nges 'grel pa/ /sbyor ba'i skabs su bshad pa dag /de nyid rnam par 'gro ②bar bya/ /de la dgongs 'grel sbyor skabs bcu/ /'dun pa skyed chadang rtsol ba dusbyor/ /bslab par 'jug dang 'du byashes 'gyur/ /sbyor nas ro tshor yul la 'jug /rtogs 7chen gdeng ⑦'gyur las su rung / /rgyun dang bcas pa'i sems skabs bcu/ /snying po de dag rgyun bcas phyir/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i skabs bcu yis/ /rnal 'byor rnam ⑧lnga'i khyad par la/ /bcu drug rgyun gyis nges par rdzogs/ /de bzhin ye shes thams cad la/ /rnam pa bcu yi khyad par gyis/ /dang po nas bzung rdzogs bar du/ /sbyar ba gang de sgrib pa nub par 'gyur/ /gang zag gis gang mthong der na/ /rig pa byang chub sems re 6)'byung / /de nyid de nub gang zhe na / /g.yo dang smon dang ldang ba dang / /sbyor ba ti'ajug dag mi 'gyur ba/ /rig dang gnas dang rdzogs pa'o/ /gang gi gzugs brnyan gang snang ba/ /dngos med rang snang mthun pa'i dpe/ /phra mo tha mal chen po yi/ /skar ma zla tshes gnyis pa dang / /gsum dang bzhi dang lnga pa dang / /brgyad dang bcu drug lta bur snang / /'dun pa skye ba'i skabs dag la/ /g.yo ba lhag pa'i sems 'byung ste(1/ /mun pa'i sprin rum lta bu yi7/ /gzer 'phro skar ma rab rib snang —/ /rtsol ba sbyor ba'i skabs dag la/ /smon pa lhag pa'i sems 'byung ()ste/ /101—554

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/555shin tu skar ma phal pa dag /gang la rab rib lta ①bu'o/ /bslab pa 'jug pa'i skabs dag la/ /ldang ba byang chub sems 'byung ste/ /ji ltar me yi gzer chen dang / /skar chen lta bu rab rib snang / /'du ②shis 'gyur ba'i ①skabs dag la/ /sbyor ba lhag pa'i sems skye ste/ /ji ltar mgal me'i bya'akhor lo dang ske/ /gcig pa'i zla tshes lta bur snang / /sbyor chen 'jug pa'i skabs dag la / /'jug pa ⑧lhag pa'i sems skye ste/ /ji ltar sgron me lta 0bu dang / /zla tshes gnyis pa lta bur snang / /ro myong ba yi ⑦skabs dag la/ /dga' ba lhag pa'i sems 'byung ⑧ste/ /snod kyi sgron ma 6)lta bu 'am/ /gsum pa lta bur de snang ngo / /yul la 'jug pa'i skabs dag la/ /mi 'gyur lhag pa'i sems 'byung ste/ /thob dang bstan la nye ba yin/ /bzhi pa lta bu'i rang bzhin snang / /rtog chen dag gi skabs dag la/ /rig pa lhag pa'i sems 'byung ste/ /rtags chen dang po nye bar bsnyen⑩/ /lnga pa lta bu'i rang bzhin snang / /gdeng ⑩du gyur 8pa'i skabs dag la/ /gnas pa lhag pa'i sems 'byung ste/ /shin tu brtan 8pa'i sgron ma skyodang / / brgyad pa ⑩lta bu'i rang bzhin snang / /rtags thob nyid na 'grub ces bya/ /las su rung ba'i skabs dag la/ /rdzogs pa lhag pa'i sems 'byung ste/ /gnyen po med pa'i sgron ma dang / /cha la rdzogs pa lta bur snang / /brtan par 0nges pas 7grub pa yin/ /sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas la/ /rtog pas bsgribs 8pas de ma shes/ /byang chub sems kyi skyoljon shing las / /bla med 'bras bu smin (nyepa yin/ /des na grogs po dam pa dag /dam pa rnams kyi (stebyang chub sems/ /kun du rgyun dang bcas pa ste/ /rgyun med (gyechad pa dam pa min/ /rgyun nyid kyis ni rdu nges smin ( stepa/ /gang du smin li101—555

556 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101pa'i skyed shing de/ /byang chub dam pa ljon pa'i shing / /'bras bu dam pa smin nges ①pa'o/ /grogs po dag de dag ni ljon shing dam pa bskyed pa'i dgongs pa nges par bgros pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ②dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las de kho na nyid gsang ba'i dam pa ljon shing bskyed pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu ②brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang lang ku'i bdag po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ④dag gis dri ba yongs su dris pa/ kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po dam pa rnams kyi (nyarjes su 'jug par bya'o zhes dam bca' bar dgongs pa de dam pa rnams kyi zhurjes su ji ltar 'jug par bgyi/ de ji ltar yongs su shes par bgyi/⑦ de skad ces yongs su dris pa las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ kye grosas po dag de ni 'di ltar dam ⑧pa rnams kyi 7rjes ni gang nges par shes pa'i lam dam pa la bya'o/ /grogs po dag lam dam pa gang zhe na/ de ltar de kho bos ⑩mthong thos pa'i skabs gcig na bshes yiganyen dam pa nyid kyis nges par gsungs pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku gnyen po med pas rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang ldan te'i/ rtag pa nyid dang chad pa nyid dang / skye ba 'o)dang /'gag pa nyid dang / dmigs pa dang / 'dod chags pa nyid dang / zhe sdang ba nyid dang / gti mug pa nyid dang / nga rgyal ba nyid dang / phrag dog pa nyid dang / 'dod pa lnga dang / srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang —/ 'dod pas log par g.yem yipa dang / brdzun 7dang / phra ma dang /ngag rtsub mo dang / tshig 'khyal pa dang / brnab tsosems dang / gnod 101—556

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/557sems dang / log par lta yo)ba nyid do/ /mtshams med pa lnga dang / de dang nye ba lnga dang / lci ba bzhi dang / log pa brgyad dang / sme sha dang / bshang ba dang / gci ba dang / khrag dang / khu ba la sogs pa dag la nges par spyod pa ni dam pa rnams kyi lam dam ②pa yin par shes par bya'o zhes nges pa dam par gsungs pa las/ kho bos de la 'di skad du/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyil/ /yang dag tshad ma'i gsung dag las/ /phyin ci log kun 'byung ci lags/ /de skad zhu ba 'dun pa ④las/ /bshes gnyen dam pas bka' stsal pa/ phyin ci ⑧log la ⑥zhen pa rnams/ /thabs mchog dpag gis mi lang bas/ /nges pa'i don la gzud pa'i phyir/ /khrid pa'i thabs su bstan pa yin/ /log zhen gang la nges brtan ④yang / /'jug par ⑧mi 'gyur spong 'gyur rnams/ /log spyod thabs kyis de drangs 6)na/ /the tshom 7med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /slu ba'i thabs kyis gzud pa'i phyir/ /so so mos pa sna tshogs kyis/ /lta spyod rnams dang mthun 'jug tu/ /sbyar nas bsten 'brid thabs yisu gsungs/ /dper na log spyod byis pa rnams/ /pha mas sdigs tshibrid thabs kyis ni/ /bya ba'i las la gzud pa ltar/ /brtse 4)bas don tsol 'dren 7pa'o/ /de yang ji ltar la la zhig /chu bo tsos mthar 'gro 'dod pa/ /gru ba dag la brten pas 'gro/ /mthar son pas ⑩na 'bor 8ba bzhin / /thabs sam theg pa'i bye brag rnams/ /brten (6pas drang ba'i thabs yin yang / /don gyi nges pa rnyed ma ( rlonathag /chu bo rgal (nyaba'i gru bzhin 'dor/ /des ( gyen de bzhin nyid shes na/ /thams cad thams cad gang yang rung / /dam pa'i lam du nges pas na/ /lam gyi nang na nye lam yin/ /de skad ces 101—557

558 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101gsungs nas cang mi gsung ①bar bzhugs so/ /kye grogs po dag de bas na dam pa rnams kyi rjes lam dam pa 'dir zhugs na ②thams cad nas thams cad du rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du shes pa dang / gsal ba dang / ma 'dres pa dang / yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ 'khor ba yongs su shes par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di shes par bya'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su shes par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang cho 'phrul chen po nyi shu thob par 'dod pas kyang lam dam pa 'di yongs su shes par bya'o/ /rtog pa'i ri bo brgyad cu chagazhil bar 'dod pas kyang lam dam pa 'di yongs su shes par bya'o/ /ltung ba'i sgo dgu chad par 'dod pas kyang lam dam pa 'di yongs su shes par bya'o/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i thams cad thams cad yongs 6)rdzogs pa'i/ /shes par 'dod pa gang dag gis/ /dam pa'i lam 'di shes par bya/ /sems nyid dam pa'i lam nyid de/ /mkha' la bya lam rjes med bzhin/ /nyam nga log med dam pa'i lam/ /'di ltar nges pa'i lam 'di yang / /kun gyis shes par bya ba'i phyir/ /tshig gi lam gyis nyer (nyamatshon te/ /brjod med tshig gi yul bral ba/ /de yi rang bzhin de nyid na/ /rang bzhin ma bcos de bzhin nyid/ /de ⑥la ming med ming btags ①rgyus/ /mthong dang ma mthong tha dad 'gyur(mi/ /de las spyod pa'i gzhir gyur 6)te/ /brjod pas de nyid mthong bya'i phyir/ /tshig gi lam ni rnam grangs las/ /tshig lam sgo mo dpag med 'gyur/ /de las dam pa'i rjes bcad ⑩pa/ /gang gi thugs las byung ba'i lung / /sgron mas nye bar gter btsal ba/ /nye lam byang chub dam pa ni/ /gang byung rjes su de 'brangs na/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lor (nya101—558

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/559'khor bar 'gyur/ /gang 'byung g.yo ba gang bkag ①pa/ /rgyun gyi ②'gog pa nyid du 'gyur③/ /gang 'byung dumed pa'i blun po pa/ /mur 'dzin mun pa'i lam du 'gyur/ /'di zhes ⑤gcig tu gang bzung ⑥ba/ /mtshan ma rtog pa'i ri bo yin/ /snga ⑦phyi med ces mu ⑧bcad na⑨/ /de med chad pa'i mu can yin/ /ma bcos nyid la yud tsam zhig /cir g.yos skye 'gag 'byung ba de⑩/ /de las gang 'byung gang 'phel ba/ /rnam grangs lam de 'phel 'gyur 0gyi/ /dam pa'i lam nyid 8rnyed ma yin/ /dper na 'gro gang tu byis pa dag /grib ma spangs nas rnam dag ④tshol/ /gang las byung ba de nyid kyis/ /btsal 8yang 'grib 'phel dag mi rnyed/ /de nyid ye nas de bzhin du/ /gang 'dir sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis/ /sha thang bar ni lam tshol ⑩ba/ /don med bdud kyi las yin no/ /de la tshig tu gang brjod pa/ /nam mkha' dag la rtsod pa 'dra/ /tshig tu sman dang dpyad dhibashad kyang / /nad pa'i tshogs la mi sman noyi/ /de nyid de bzhin ma gyur na/ /tshig lam de brjod de ma yin/ /gang 'dir gang spangs gang tshol bske/ /gzugs spangs nas ni grib tshol 'dra/ /sems nyid dam pa'i lam nyid pas / /ma rig ye shes tha dad min/ /mi rtog pa ni lam 'dir gcigayi /sems nyid sna tshogs bar snang bas/ /sna tshogs lam 'dir gcig zhu pa yin/ /dper na gser gyi rgyu gcig las/ /dbyibs dang gzugs ni tha dad par/ /byas pas de dag ming re rustegrags/ /gang grags gser gyi ngo bor gcig /de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin la(nya/ /mthong dang ma mthong khyad par gyis/ /gang ltar bltas dgu de ltar snang / /snang yang de las gzhan mi dmigs/ /sgron ma e'abar ba'i rin chen ni/ /ji ltar ngan khung zhi sbas gyur yang / /de yi rang 101wa 559

560 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 7 101bzhin rang snang bas/ /'od ni mkha' la gsal bar 'gyur/ /de ①bzhin sems nyid rin chen sgron/ /lus ngan 'dam du bying gyur yang ②/ /rang byung rang zhi nirang snang bas/ /ma bcos rang bzhin yongs kyis gsal/ /sems 'di nam mkha' ji bzhin te/ /kun khyab stong gsal sna tshogs 'byung / /byung ④tshor g.yo 'gog thams cad kyang / /rang bzhin gyis 'byung ngang ⑤gis zhi/ /mdor na ji ltar brtags bsams bzhin/ /'gyur bas thams cad ngo bo snang / /ma bcos g.yo ba med nyid las/ /sna tshogs rgyu 'byung mi skyon zhing / /cho 'phrul mi 'gag nyam nga med/ /ji bzhin nam mkha'i rang bzhin layi/ /blo bzhag ma yengs kho nar zad/ /de ni tshegs med don po che/ /de nyid dus gsum thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i ngo bo yin/ /de yi don la ji snyed gnas/ /mthong bas de nyid der goms na/ /lam rnyed ⑦lam mthong nyam nidrod ni/ /don gyis nges par 'byung ba yang 6)/ /gang ma yin la zin 'byung ba/ /byang chub dam pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mtshan ma rtog pa'i chos rnams la/ /nges pa'i blo gros 'byung ⑩ba yin/ /chos kun 'di ltar yin pa layi/ /de ltar ma mthong ngo mtshar che/ /de mthong de yang ngo mtshar che/ /e ma'o ⑩ci ga snyam du 'byung ske/ /de nyid ma mthong gang su dag /rtsol grub dka' ba'i tshegs chen gyis / /dam pa'i lam tshol lam kyire ring / /de yi don 'byung de yod kyang / /lam de rnyed par yang yimi 'gyur/ /dam pa rnams kyi lam rnyed pa/ /dam pa nyid las dam pa yin/ /de ni rten brnyan limatshungs ma yin/ /zhi lus mthar 'gog gnyis mtshungs min/ /slob pa'i sa dang (7de mi mtshungs/ /rnal 'byor sems pa rtog (nya tshomatha' dang / /gang mtshungs de 6nya'adra de mi mtshungs/ /des (me101—560

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/561na rnam dag lam chen ni/ /sems kyi gsang 'di yin pas na/ /dgongs pa kun las 'dus pa yitshi/ /gsang ba'i lam ②'di shes byas pas / /btsal ④ba'i bya ba rgyu med de/ /lam 'di mthong ba de nyid kyis/ /dka' phyib rtsol ba gang med par⑥/ /thams cad thams cad grub pa yin/ /sems kyi gsang ⑦ba gar gnas pa/ /de ni dben pa dam pa ste/ /dgon (kyepa chen po mchog nyid du//dgongs pa kun nas 'dus pa gsungs/ /de nyid dpag med gzhal yas mchog/rmad 'byung ⑨rnar bu yid bzhin khang / /ma byas rang byung phyi hu nyenang med/ /kun du nang du gyur pa yin/ /gang 'dir gang 'dus tshogs ma yin/ /de la de nyid tshogs 'dus mchog /chos kun bsdus 7pas 'byung ba med/ /dpag med rgyal ba 'dagyes pa'i mchog /gang 'dir 'dod spyod yo byad yina'/ /de nyid yo byad chen po ste/ /lhag pa'i yo byad 'di shes nayi/ /yo byad kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /sgom par byed pa bsgom pa min/ /bsam bya dmigs rigesu med pa ste/ /dam pa'i gsang lam 'di tsoshes na/ /bsgom lam dam pa 'di nyid do/ /bsrung zhes bsrung bar bya mi dmigs/ /stong nyid med 'byung dzi tshogasang lam 'di/ /dbus mthar che bas tshig shes na/ /bsrung ba'i gsang ba dam pa'o/ /tshig lam mnyam brjod mnyam mi dmigs/ /gsang 'di thams cad gcig pa la/ /mnyam zhes lhag par ga la yod/ /dgongs pa kun nas 'dus dang mnyam/ /gang gzhan (nyebartul zhugs spyod pa yin/)/ /de la de gzhol rol spyod pas/ /thams cad 'dir brtul 'dir zhugs pas/ /brtul zhugs mchog tu kun 'dus gsungs/ /lam 'di dngos nyid sems kyi ( )gsang / /ye grub zin pas gsol thob med/ /dngos grub rgyun mi 'chad pa zhesas / /dgongs pa dam pa 101—561

56 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101kun 'dus gsungs/ /de ①ltar sems kyi gsang mthong na/ /sngon ma mthong ba'i lam mthong ②bas/ /mthong ba ci yang med pa nyid/ /gang la snang ba lam mthong yin/ /grogs po dag de dag ni dam pa rnams kyi rjes lam dam pa zhes bya ba 'di skad thos pa yongs su bgros pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chadagongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las rnal 'byor rjes 'jug gi le'u ste lnga bcu dgu pa'odu // //de nas yang lang ku'i mnga' bdag ⑤la sogs pa grogs kyi sems dpa' rnams kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po la yongs su dri ba dris pa/ kye ⑥gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'dir rin po che 'bar ba'i sgron ma bsrel ⑦bar bya'o zhes dam bca' bar dgongs pa ji ltar yongs su shes par bgyi/ de skad ces dri dub yongs su dris pa yo)las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ kye grogs po dag rin po che 'bar ba ni 'od kyi kyi'abyung gnas lags te/ 'thor rlung tshogs kyis kyang mi sod pas mun pa sel bar byed pa kho na bas sgron me zhes bya'o/ /de ni 'di ltar mi shes pa sel ba'i shes pa nyid yin te/ nyi ma'i snying po'am rin po che'i tsho/)sgron ma la mun pa'i gzhi med pa bzhin gang kyishes pa'i rang bzhin la mi shes pa'i gzhi med do/ /de yang 'di ltar sgron ma dam pa nub par gyur pa na kun gyi de nyid gcig kho na la khyad par gyi rnam par tso'abyung bar 'gyur ba ni 'di lta ste/ mun pa'i shes pa dang / ya mtshan can tigyi shes pa dang / byis pa 7rnams kyi shes pa dang / phyogs su rigs pa'i shes pa dang / mtha' dbus 'byed pa'i shes pa dang / dam pa nyid kyi shes pa'o/ /kye grogs po dag gang 101—562

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/563mun pa'i shes pa ni gang 'di las log par shes pa'o/ /log sred ①can gyi ②shes pa ni tha dad smra zhing gnyis su 'dod pa'o/ /gyis pa rnams ni 'di lta ste/gang med par smra ②zhing thams cad yod par 'dod pa'o/ /de yang 'di ltar rdul nas dpag tshad skad cig dum/ /bskal pa skar ma nyi zla dang / /ri bo khor ⑤yug lus can lus/ /sems dang tshe la longs spyod tshad/ /dus gnas 'jig nub mtshan nyid las/ /tha dad bye brag thams cad du/ /bshig dunas med smra yod ces 'dod/ /mos pa chung bas ⑦de las min/ /gang 'dir rnal 'byor phyogs rig pa/ /'di kun gang 'dir kho na bas/ /dngos med rnam shes nyid du snang / /de nyid ma bcos de bzhin nyid/ /yod pas chos sku rtag ⑧par 'dod / /nges par 'byed ⑨pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gang dag sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du / /snang bas kun rdzob bya ba byed/ /nges par dbye ba med pa'o/ /la la de ltar de nges te/ /de las ma gtogs de 'ong ⑩min/ /de nyid des ni dngos med phyir/ /dam pa nyid du med pa'o/ /la la gang ma zin pa'i phyir/ /de snang ba ni gang na'ang 7rung / /phra rab sa ni rnam kun mkhyen8/ /slu 'drid pa ⑫ltar yod ma yin/ /dam pa nyid kyi dam pa gang / /chos nyid ye nas sangs rgyas la/ /de min lta ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /ye nas sangs rgyas zhes brjod pa/ /tha snyad tsam du brjod par zad/ /ye nas brjod pa tshig gi lam/ /tha snyad gnyis dang bral ba la④/ /sgro skur tshig gi snyad mi gdags/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad tshig lam 'das/ /nam mkha' e'adi ni yod med ces/ /blun tsopo rnams ni rtsod 7par 'gyur4she/ /mkhas pa rnams ni de lta ()min/ /gang de rtsod la ngo mtshar che/ /de bzhin nyid 'di yod med ces/ /byis pa rnams ni rtsod par 101—563

564 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101'gyur / /skyes bu gang dag de lta min/ /rtsod pa shes rab 'chal bar ⑨zad/ /'di ltar snang ba'i (michos thams cad/ /ye 'am ngang gis chasangs rgyas la④/ /min las yin par 'gyur ma yin/ /ngo bo nyid kyi de nyid la/ /yin dang min zhes ci (gebyar yod/ /nam mkha' 'di ni med do zhes/ /mi shes gang gis rtog par byed/ /gang shes ye nas yang (6)mi rtog /min par mi rtog ⑦tshig mi brjod//rgyu dang las dang rnam grangs 98)la/ /mtshan nyid nges pa ngo bo dang / /'bras bu dgos ched dzitshore re 'byung / /'di ltar 'dir ni gang gi rgyu/ /rang 'byung de nyid rtog dpyod bcas/ /gang dag gang la skye mched pa/ /gnyis po 'di dag nyid kyi rgyu/ /gang las gang min ji snyed pa/ /khyad par bye brag tha dad pa/ /nges 'byed 7'jug 'brel /11sbyor bcas pa/ /de 'dzin phyin ci ma log pa/ /mngon 'byin don 'dod 'brel pa'o/ /rnam grangs rnam gnyis don bzhin no/ /kun la nges par byed 12pa yin/ /de nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs pa/ /dngos med mi rtog yongs su rdzogs/ /so so tha dad bsam mi khyab(nya/ /ma 'dres de ltar ji bzhin byed/ /gang 'dir phyin ci ma log par/ /yongs su chub pa phul tsonyid do/ /kun nas ma rmongs thams cad gsal/ /gang la ma 'gags thogs pa 8med/ /kun tsha'ajug gang ma rig pa chagacod/ /skye mched kun du gyur pa nyid / /gang mched 1nyagang gi rlung zhugs pa/ /mkhas pa'i ye shes tshad med pa'ormo/ / /gang la log pa de nyid dag /de nyid phul du phyin pa'i phyir/ /dmigs bu gsal ba'i sgron ma yis/ /de nyid de la blta bar bya/ /sgron ma'i snang ba mi shes pa/ /mthong bya kun la mun pas bsgribs/ /nams kyang ( )snang bar mi 'gyur te/ /long ba'i grong khyer chen por 'gro/ /sgron ma 'bar ba gang 101 wa 564

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/565srel ①ba/ /kun la mun pas sangs gsal ba'i/ /ma nor ma bcos ②de bzhin nyid / /sgron ma dmigs bus mthong bar 'gyur/ /de ltar dam ②pa'i grogs po dag /rin chen sgron ma 'bar ba'i me/ /mun snang dmigs bur ma bsrel bar / /de nyid gser mthong ga la rigs/ /grogs po dag de dag ④ni sgron ma dam pa bsrel ⑤bar bya'o zhes dgongs pa dam pa legs par 6)bgros par gshes par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las rnal 'byor mig gi sgron ma bstan pa'i le'u ste drug cu ⑧pa'o// //de nas yang lang ma'i mnga' bdag ⑨la sogs pa dman pa dam pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis dri ba yongs su dris pa/ kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po khyad par du bla mar 'gro bar bya'o zhes dam bca' bar dgongs pa de ji ltar yongs su shes par bgyi/ de skad ces gsol pa las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ kye grogs po dag khyad par du 'gro bar bya ba de ni legs so/ /shin tu rab tu legs so/ /sa de ni 'di ltar sa mkhan dam pa rnams kyi rnal 'byor gyis yongs su snang ba zhes bya ba'i 7sgron ma legs par bkod ⑩pa ni 'di lta ste/ sa dang sa yi tsokhyad par ni4)/ /gang 'dir yongs kyis med pa la/ /shes bya gcod pa'i khyad par gyis/ /rang rig mtho skidaman rim par zad/ /dper na rgyal po'i dkor tsomadzod nas/ /che chung thabs 'dod tsogang su dag /dka' thub phyi nang khyad par gyis/ /spyod sgo 'jug pa'i las thabs las/ /mtho 7dman rtsal gyis gang len pa/ /rgyal po gcig la spyod na yang / /rin chen sna 'ga' khyad par dag /thabs chen sgo dgu so sor spyod/ /rgyal por 101—565

566 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 7) 101gyur ①na de nor kun/ /dbang bskur ⑤byed pa'i bdag po yin/ /mi gnas ma bcos de bzhin nyid/ /shes bya de las med pa la / /gang 'di rtsal gyi byakhyad par gyis(ge/ /so so'i 'jug sgo kun nas spyod/ / de yi ⑥de nyid de gcig la/ /rtsal 'phang mtho ⑦dman khyad par gyis/ / sa yi ③go 'phang khyad par du/ /rig pa de ltar snang ba yin6)/ /gang 'dir thams cad gcig pa la/ /de mthong mi mthun de dbang gis/ /dper na 'byung gnas sgo mangs bzhin/ /sa dang rnam thar so so'i sgo/ /gcig la sna tshogs de ltar snang / /sa dang rnam thar gang dag la/ /'jug pa la sogs sa sbyangs kyang / /kun gyi rtsa ba 'dir ⑩bcad pas/ /gcig ste tha dad yongs kyis med/ /de ni ri dang lhun po dang / /kun du rgyu dang gzhon nu ltar/ /mthong thos ston pa'i khyad par ni/ /don gyis de ltar yod pa yin/ / des na (1chos rnams thams cad kyi7/ /gnas pa'i sa nyid sems yin nga sa/ /nam mkha' 7lta bu'i dpe 8mtshon te/ /kun gyi sa 'dir 8shes par bya/ /'di ltar gang shes rnal tso'abyor pa/ /lam gyi 7thabs la mkhas pa yi1nya/ /lam stor lam btsal lam rnyed 47pas/ /nye lam bder rnyed grub pa'o/ /gang rnyed de rnyed der gnas pa'i / /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i (nyes pa ste / /sa kun gcig tu yongs rdzogs la tshoste/ /rig pa mchog 'bring tha ma'i phyir/ /gcig pa'ang khyad par bcur snang ba/ /gang gi ched du bgrang 6)bar bya/ /'di dag gnas 'dzin spyod pa'i sa/ /rnam pa bcu phrag gcig gis rdzogs/ /'gyur dbang ma nges sa 'ge'adi la/ /bcos ma phra chamen spyod pa dang / /tshul rtags 'dzin yodang mos pa dang / /legs par 'dun pa'i rnal 'byor lnga/ /'jug ldog ltung 7 dang bcas pa yi/ /kun du 'khor zhing ma nges pa'o/ /'dun pa 101wa 566

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor spub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/567sems pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnas shing sbyong ba'i stis zhes bya/ /brten ②pas gzhi yi sa 'di la/ /dang po las can rnal 'byor pa/ /bslab pa spyod chadang nges pa la/ /dag dang ma dag gis spyod pa'o/ /bka' sdod las kyi durnal 'byor pa/ /gnas shing sbyong ba'i phyis zhes bya/ /gal chen spyod pa'i dus 'di la / /rigs chen 'byed pa'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /gnas shing sbyong ⑦ba'i sa yin te / /yang mi nga yi chas rnams kun/ /gcod sbyong sbyor ba'i tshul nyid kyis/ /legs nyes stobs chen 'gyed ⑨pa'o/ /bslab ⑩pa rgyun gyi sa 'di la/ /g.yo dang thob ()dang brtan pa'i drod/ /de bzhin rtags chen g.yo ba dang / /thob pa nyid dang brtan tshupa yi'i/ /rnal 'byor rnam 8pa drug po dag /bslab pa'i mtha' bcu mthar phyin cing / /ji ltar zla ba yar gsal bzhin/ /bslab pa'i ye shes 'phel 'gyur te/ /don la mi skrag snyingo mtshar skye/ /sbyong tsosems 'jug pa'i sems dpa' desatso/ /ngan 'gror mi ldog dgon par 'jug /bar chad dag kyang de la 'byung / /gsang sgo lung gi rnal 'byor dang / /spyod pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang / /mtshan ma rtags kyi rnal 'byor gsum/ /gnas shing tsosbyong ba'i sa zhes bya/ /bsod (zhenams gter gyi sa 'di la/ /spyod pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyid63 / /mos pa dag cing 'dun pa'i gnas/ /rtsal chen blo yi bsti gnas sa/ /bslab pa'i mtha' bcu spyir sa chib pa'o/ /brten 4)pas khyad par 'gro 'di la/ /dbugs chen 'byin 6 pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rigs chen 'dzin dang mnyam rdzogs che/ / nges par munaspyod dang rtsal chen sbyor/ /yul la 'jug dang rig dupa sbyor/ /bdun cinyid rdzogs par 'gro ba ste/ /bslab pa'i rgyu 'bras mtha' bcu la/ /goms par byed pa'i tshul du sbyor/ /ngal bso su ba las 101—567

568 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ blo 101thams cad mthong / /mi ldog sa la 6)goms byar med/ /'di dag sbyor ba'i gzhi gcig khukyang / /so so thun mong ⑧ma yin pa'i/ /sgrib pa ④las zhes rtsi byed 0cing / /ye shes re re 'char ⑥pa'o/ /des na bslab pa'i mtha' gcig la / /mi ldog la sogs rdzogs chen rnams/ /gang der bden ⑦pa re re la/ /rtsal 'byung phyire re 'char ba ste/ /tha ma rang 'byung nyid kyis rdzogs/ /mthar phyin pa dang thob pa dang / /mi ldog ⑨rnams la rim pa bzhin/ /mi tshulam dang ni sgra brnyan 7dang / /mngon sum 8nges pa ci rigs paratso/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje lung ston ④pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes byar nyid dang sa khams dang —/ /zhing khams kun du bsgrags 8byas nas / /rnal 'byor dam par 'byin ⑩pa'o/ /dmigs pa'i 'bras bu skye 'di la/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /nges par 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor gsum/ /rgyal ba'i thugs lam rgyal skyes shing / /rgyal ba'i sras po gdung 'tshob pa/ /khyad par rtsal 'phang ⑫kun rdzogs shing / /gang la ting 'dzin sbyor 7ba'o/ /gnas pas mi 'gyur sa 'di la/ /rmad 'byung 6)rol pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /tshogs chen 'dus dang rtsal chen rdzogs/ /gsum du rdzogs par shes bya ste/ /phyag rgya chen po sgyu 6)ma yin / /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal chen po/ /mthong ba'i gnas nas bcu drug sa / /rdzogs pa'i gnas na longs spyod pa'o/ /bdal 6)ba chos nyid sa 'di la/ /rol pa rgyan gyi rnal 'byor dang / / bde ba chen 6)dang thig ler rdzogs/ /gsum nyid du ni snang ba la/ /yul don ye shes des sbyar (srin/ /shes par byas pas thams cad rdzogs/ /sgyu ma'i sgyu ma yin ( stespyod pa'o/ /rdzogs pa spyir 'chib ( lhas 'di la/ /bcu pa tha ma dang po las/ /mthar rdzogs kun gyi rtog ( 7yin te/ /101—568

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/569klong ①yangs nam mkha'i snying po la/ /sprin med nyi ②ma 'bum gyis bdaladu/ /ci snang ci yang ma yin pa/ /mi skye mi 'gag ngo bo la/ /ji ltar bltas ④dgu der zhi)snang ba/ /bdal dukhyab mi rgya rlabs kyis bcadaX/ /de yang dam pa'i khyad par gyis/ /bdag nyid chen po'i ⑧rnal 'byor dang / /lhun gyis grub dang klong 6)yangs chub/ /gsum rdzogs rang 'byung bdal ba'o/ /'di dag rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa/ /khyad par gang la khyad par snang / /gang khyad med la de khyad med/ /rtsal ⑩'phang mtho yidaman rnal 'byor pas/ /mtho 8dman go 'phang sa bgrod bya/ /gang 'dir dri ba'i mchog snang ba/ /dam par gyur pa'i ⑫lang ma'i bdag /gang 'dir rnal 'byor kun sbyor ba/ /nges pa'i sa bcu rtsa ba 'dir/ /gang gi rtsa ba yan lag las/ /bcu gnyis bdun gnyis ④rdzogs pa'o / /des na sa yi 8khyad par las/ /rgya che ba dang grangs tsomang yang / /rnal 'byor sa 'di 0sbyar bar bya'o/ /sa dang sa yi 'byung gnas 8pa/ /kun gzhi yikun gyi sa chen te/ /gang gi sa chen 'di du non na/ /sa rnams skad cig ⑥tsam bgrod pa'o/ /grogs po dag de dag ni khyad par bla mar 'gro bar bya'o/ /zhes dam bca' bar dgongs pa yongs su bgros 6)par shes par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dudagongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las rnal 'byor sa'i sgron ma bstan pa'i le'u ste drug cu lustegacig pa'o// //de nas yang lang ma'i bdag po la sogs pa dman pa dam pa rnams (nyekyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po la dris pa/ kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po yul la 'jug par bya'o zhes dam bca' bar sridagongs pa ji ltar yongs su shes par bgyi/ de 101—569

570 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101skad ces yongs su dris pa las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag pos yongs su smras pa/kye grogs po dag yul ni 'di ltar gang gi ①zhing yongs su sbyong bar 'dod pa rnams kyis gang du dgongs pa'i ②yul de kho na nyid dang / gang la 'byung ba'i yul mtha' yas pa'i 'khor ba rnams la 'jug par bya'o/ /de ni dper na btso blag mkhan dag gis/ /ras sbyangs gang du bya ba 'jin pa ltar②/ /gang 'dir las kyi godang po las/ /gang de sbyar ba rab tu gces⑤/ /de skad ces smras pasadu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lang ma'i bdag po des 'di ⑦skad ces smras so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang thams cad nas thams cad du ye nas sangs rgyas pas na ⑧da gdod sangs rgyas par byar med phan cad 6)dgongs pa'i yul la sbyor ba dang / snying rje'i yul du gyur pa gang yang kyimed lags na/ 'dir 0snying rje'i yul du gyur pa gang lags/ su zhig snying rje'i yul du gyur de skad ces smras pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa / kye lang ku'i bdag po de de ltar kun kyang ye sangs rgyas 'phan chad 8de kho na nyid pas snying rje'i yul dang dgongs pa'i yul gang yang med na yang gang ji ltar yang chos nyid las mi 'da' ba'i 8tshul gyis gang dang yang 'gal zhing 'gal bar mi 'obya'o/ /nang 7gi don nyid byed pa ni dam tshig chen po yin la/ye nas sangs rgyas pas don byar med pa ni snying rje chen po yin no/ /dgongs pa dam pa la 'jug mi dgos par shes 7pa ni dgongs pa dam pa'i yul de kho na nyid la zhugs pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po 'di lta ste/dgongs pa dam par gang bzhugs 3nyepa/ /zab pa bas kyang ches zab pas de nyid gting (1rtenas thag gcad phyir/ /gsang ba'i yul bzhi skye bo dang / /lhan 101—570

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/571cig ci la'ang mi brnal lo/ /de yang yongs su rdzogs pa ①gang / /bya bas bya ba med na yang / /de yi rang bzhin phan gzhan pa/ /yin pas gang 'dir phan par bya/ /gang gi don dang 'gal ②'gyur bdu/ /de las gyur pa'i yo byad dag /rus stisbal mgo la 'ongs pa ltar/ /mu mtha' med pas bshug ⑤par bya//ci phyir kun du rnal 'byor pas/ /rnal 'byor dam pa nyid las min/ /gal te gang gi dbang gis na/ /dam pa'i don dang 'gal 'gyur te/ /de dang mi mthun nyen chen 'byung / /gal te de la de 'byung na/ /mgon btsun de la de las med/ /de gang ma zin 'ban 0thag chad/ /gang gi don du gang 'gyur na/ /phra mo'i phra ⑦mo phra yan chad/ /thams cad thams cad ji lta ⑧bar/ /nan tan gyis 0ni dga' nas bya/ /slong mo ⑩pa dang slong 7la dga'/ /slong la 'tsho ba'i tshe spyod rnams/ /sde 8dang tshan tsodang grar byas te/ /snying rje khud pa'i zhing du bya / /sman dang 'bru dang rtsi 8rnams dang / /bcud kyi mchog tu gyur pa chadag /btags sam phye mar byas nas kyang / /klung ngam chu gang mtsho chen du/ /dor te chags med sbyin 0par bya/ /gang gi rten du khas blangs te/ /nad gso tshugang slob spyod sgom gra4)/ /btsugs te bste (gleganas mchog zhi)bya zhing / /dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchod dusbyin bya/ /gang la dam pa'i lung byung tsob/ /gsung gi mchod rten kun rten te/ /brjod dang bsnyen bkur bsti gnas kyis/ /rgya che yangs pa'i lam rnams bya( / /gang gi dam pa 'phel 'gyur ba/ /'di ltar nges pa'i dam pa dag /smra'am sbyin nam bstan nam khrid/ /de yi zhu naye shes tshad med 'gyur / /goms dang goms par byed pa yis4ge/ /gang de dag par bya ba'i phyir / /bsam yul bya ba mang po la/ /de nyid yul gyi rtsal rnams sbyang (zhe/ /101—571
