de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/579tshig gcig bsgyur ①bas tshig mtha' yas/ /tshig lam rab tu bral ba'i don/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ston/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rmad 'byung ②rol pa'i don 'byung ngo / /cha mthun sbyor ba'i khyad par las/ /'jig rten drug tu rol pa 'byung / /'khor ba'i lam nu)rgyud gcad ④pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten drug gi snying po la/ /thugs rje (gethabs kyi 'od 'phros pas/ /rgyud drug dngos po thams cad bsregs⑥/ /spyod lam ma chags ye shes kyisame/ /cha mthun thabs su sbyar ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten byis pa'i spyod pa bzhin/ /'jig rten bu mo drug dang rol/ /stabs drug bskyod pas 'gro drug bsgral/ /glu drug blangs pas yul drug drangasal/ /tshig drug bsgrags pas kyi)don drug rdzogs/ /le lo tshugayeng ba'i sa gzhi (nyal/ /brtson 'grus myur ba cang shes stabs/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi snyan ⑩pa'i glu/ /don grub rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig /nga rgyal ri bo'i sa gzhi tshul/ /dpa' bo tsham cingam rgyad kyi stabs/ /sil snyan 'bum gyis snyan pa'i glu/ /zhi gnas mi rtog nam mkha'i 8tshig /kun nas 'dus pa'i sa gzhi la/ /khyu ⑩mchog lnga yis rol pa'i stabs/ /glu gar yid 'phrog 7snyan pa'i glu/ /'dzin pa'i rtod phur 'byin pa'i tshig /gti mug 'dus pa'i sa gzhi la/ /seng ge rngam pas rol pa'i stabs/ /ka la ping ga'i 8dbyangs snyan glu/ /ye nas don gyis gsal ba'i tshig /chags pa 'dus pa'i sa gzhi la()/ /rdo rje khyung chen ldings pa'i stabs/ /'brug rdu )chen 'dir bas snyan pa'i glusaspre/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'bar ba'i tshig /zhe sdang 'dus pa'i sa gzhi ru la/ /khro bo ma rungs khros pa'i ru stabs/ /srin mo (sem rungs khros dunapa'i glu / /rdo rje bu yug ru 7skar mda'i ( ci tshig /rmad 'byung gsang sa ba'i 101—579

580 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101dkyil 'khor nas/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i me 'byung bas/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i bud ①shing bsregs95)/ /srid gsum 'khor ba'i khrag mtsho bskams / /nga rgyal ri bo rmang nas bshig /zhe snang 'bar ba'i me dbal gsad④/ /gti mug mun pa gtan nas bcom/ /'khor ba 'dus pa'i 'dam ⑤rdzob bskams⑥/ /lang ma'i bdag po 'di dag ni/ /gang gi cha dang mthun sbyar bas/ /dam pa'i don la sbyar ba yis/ / byis pa 'drid ⑦pa'i rol pa'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po gzhan yang gang / /thabs 'dzud bsre ba'i brtul (9zhugs ni/ /'jig rten log sred 38ji lta b.ratsha/ /brtul zhugs (1spyod pa'i khyad par spyod/ /wa dang cang shes gyi ling dang / /shin tu glang 'chen myos 8'dra ba/ /dpa' brtul za byed gtum rngam 'khrug /mkha' kyildeng khyung chen gang mi lta/ /gtum thung sdong ⑫chen 'jigs 'dril slob/ /gang thub mi ldog rgya mtsho'i gser/ /mun ltar lkugs tshipa'i blo tshul ldan/ /lhun po mi 'gyur brtan pa che/ /mkha' ltar yangs (nyedog kun dang bral/ /gnam lcags lce yi drag (7shul can/ /drag ( )shul chen po brtul zhugs 21bdag /khu 'phrig lta bu zan can blo/ /nges pa'i nga rgyal glang chen brtun/ /zla med seng 82ge gcig brjod pa( rte/ /reg 'jam ( nyebya ltar chags 'grogs pa/ /sgyu ma sgyu ma'i tshul 'drid ( nyapa/ /gang la rtogs ( nyemed kun spyod nyid/ /thogs med za byed mnyemyur spyod za byed kha na / /yud ltar myur 'gyogs 9 7glog ltar 'gyur/ /gang gi gang bsrung nam mkha' lding / /sa thub bag len rgyal 'khor skyod tsho/ /rnal 'byor brtul zhugs chen po ni/ /bcu gnyis dang 81ni gsum blor ldan/ /gang 'dir nyams su len byed pa/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i thabs mchog ste/ /gang la 'dzud pas 4)bsre ba yi/ /tshul 101—580

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/581khrims thams cad gcig spyod pa'o/ /lang ma'i bdag po gzhan yang gang / /mthun pas 'jug par spyod pa ni/ /de nyid de ltar de bzhin te/ /gang dang 'dra tshul ①gang yin pa'o/ /'dod chags pho mor gyur pa la/ / pho mor 'dod las ③po mor snang ba gang yin la/ /pho mo med las pho mo ①snang ba mthun 'jug spyod / /'dod la chags pas khro 'gyur la④/ /khro bar 'dod las khro bar snang ba gang yin la/ /khro ba med las ①khro bar snang ba mthun 'jug spyod/ /'dod la yichags pas gamun snang la/ /mun par 'dod las mun par gyur pa ⑧gang yin la/ /mun pa med las mun par snang ba mthun 'jug spyod⑨/ /ji ltar gang ltar de bzhin du/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas par/ /thams cad thams cad der snang ba/ /mthun 'jug spyod pas don byed yin/ /lang ku'i bdag po de dag ni mthun par 'jug par bya'o zhes de 7skad ces smras pas/ lang ma'i bdag po la sogs pa dman pa dam pa rnams mtha' thug pa med pa'i lta spyod la yongs su rtog 7pa med par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las sgyu ma ()rol pas rnam par rol pas arnam par ④grol pa'i le'u zhes bya ste drug cu snyibazhi pa'o// //de nas yang lang ga'i bdag pos gsang ba pa'i bdag po la dri ba yongs su dris pa/ kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po nad gso ⑩bar bya'o zhes dam bca' ⑩dgongs pa de ji ltar yongs su shes par bgyi/ de skad ces yongs su dris pa las / gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ lang ma'i bdag po 'di ltar grong khyer gsum gyi (shend pa gso bar bya'o/ /nad kyi gzhi rtsa la mkhas (7par bya'o/ /101—581

58 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101nad sbyang ba'i thabs la brtson par bya'o/ /sman pa dam pa rna mas bsten par bya'o / /gnyen po dam pa'i sman bsrel ①zhing spel ②bar bya'o/ /sman sbyar ba la mkhas par bya'o/ /sman gyi ①lam bsrung bar bya'o/ /nad pa'i tshogs dang mi 'bral byabar bya'o/ /nad kyi rgyun gcad ⑤par bya'o/ /nad kyi duganyen por 'gyur bar bya'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po de la grong khyer gsum ni mi ⑦snang ba'i grong khyer dang / kun snang ba'i grong khyer dang / phyed snang ba'i grong khyer ro/ /nad kyi gzhi rtsa ni mun pa chen po las byung ba'i zug rngu'o/ /nad sbyang ba'i thabs ni sman dang sman par sbyor ba'o/ /sman pa (kyedam pa ni bshes gnyen dam pa'o/ /gnyen po dam pa'i sman ni zhi gnas 7lhag mthong ngo / /sman sbyar ba ni de dag de nyid du sbyor ⑩ba'o/ /sman gyi hunyelam gsung 7ba ni de bzhin nyid las mi 'da' ba'o/ /nad pa'i tshogs dang mi 'bral ba ni 'khor ba la mi skyo ba'o/ /nad kyi rgyun gcad par bya ba ni thams cad de nyid du nges pa'o/ /nad kyi gnyen por gyur pa ni 'khor ba yongs su sgrol ba'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po de yang gang / /kho bos mthong thos skabs shig tson/ /kun gyi bshes gnyen dam pa des/ /dur khrod bdag po btul ba'i tshe/ /'jig rten gtso bo kun 'dus nas/ /sras kyi dhitshogs su bkod pa yi/ /'dus pa phal mo tsoche dag las/ /'khor der 'dus par gyur pa yi'/ /zhar las gyur pa'i log sde pa/ /sman gyi brtul ()zhugs cher spyod pa/ /drang srong 1nyanag po ka la yis/ /gang 6)der 'dun nas don gsol pa / /che mchog sman gyi rgyal po khyod/ /dug 'joms sman gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzin / /nad do cog gi 'gyedagar gyur pas/ /zug rngu'i nad rnams ( mezhi bar mdzod / /de skad zhu ba 'dun sa pa las/ /che mchog sman gyi rgyal po des/ /101—582

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/583drang srong de la rjes dgongs nas/ /sngon 'dus gsungs pa gang gsungs pa/ /khams gsum za ma tog ①nang du/ /srid gsum sems can dug chen rnams/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rtsi ②sbyar bas/ /rang 'byung bdud rtsi'i rgyadakyil 'khor rdzogs / /de skad nges par gsungs pa las/ /nag po ka las don gsol pa/ /rang bzhin snang ba'i lus 'di las/ /yo byad chen po lnga byung ba/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi ste/ /drang srong rnams kyi 0sman gyi mchog /de skad nges par 'dun pa las/ /sman pa dam pas 'di skad gsungs/ /rang 'byung gdod nas dag pa ste/ /rtsa brgyad stong la ⑤sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dudangos / /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol phyir / / dug lnga ⑦sel ba'i bdud rtsi mchog /de skad ces gsungs nas cang mi gsung bar khyabazhugs so/ /de nas ka la nag pos yang gsol pa/ /rang las byung bas gzhan byung 8min/ /dngas snyigs kho nar zad pas dag /rtsa ba brgyad dang yan lag stong / /nyis sbyar lnga dag rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de skad zhu ba ⑩'dun pa las/ /'khor der 'dus par gyur pa'i sras/ /blo gros thabs ldan khyod nyid kyisayi/ /zhen pa 'grol pa'i thabs 'di smras8/ /zag pa phyi ma rdzas lnga poti/ /'byung ba dang ni zas khams kyitso/ /rgyun gyi rgyu byalas byung bas na / /rang las ma byung gzhan 'byung yin/ /grogs po dam pas de smras pas/ /ka la nag pos yang smras pa/ /ji ltar gal te de ⑩ltar na/ /'gal ba nyid du yin 0zin na/ /rang 'byung rang 'byung zhes bya ba'i/ /chos de gang nas rnyed par 'gyur/ /de skad dri ba dris pa las/ /dam pa nyid kyis des 8blan pa/ /rgyu 4)dang rkyen las ma brten par/ /gang zhig du'abyung ba'i chos yod na/ /101—583

584 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101gzhan las ma byung byed med pas/ /chos de rang 'byung nyid du 'dod/ /de skad smras pas de lan du/ /ka la nag pos 'di skad du/ /spangs pas spong bar ①mi 'gyur te/ /bdag las rgyun du 'byung ba'i chos/ /gzhan ②las ma byung ①rgyu 'bras med/ /chos de gang yin rang 'byung yin/ /de la de yis 'di skad du/ /mi spang dang du blang ba'i chos/ /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /'du 'bral med par bluganas 'os na/ /'byung rgyun 'gags (snyen de rgyun 'gag /de stil 'di ltar 'di skad du/ /nag po ka las slar blan ( )pa/ /bdud rtsi yin pas rang gnyer gyi(5/ /las rnams so sor byed par yo)nus/ /'jig rten dag na phan 'dogs pa/ /gang nus de la rtsi zhes grags/ /de la 'dir ni 'di skad du / /grogs mchog dam pas de lon pa/ /bdud rtsi zhes ni brjod pa las/ /bdud rtsi'i las ni gnyis yod de/ /nad gso shi ba slong byed na/ /de gnyis mthu dang yang 7mi ldan/ /de smras lan du 'di skad du/ /ka la nag pos de blan pa / /sngon gyi rgyal ba grangs med kyis/ /brtul zhugs 'di lnga gtsor spyad na/ /dam tshig dam par bzung nyesprobs na/ /sngon gyi 7dam tshig yin par grags/ /de la dam pas 'di skad du/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig yin nges na/ /dang (nyapo nas bzung rdzogs par du/ /de dang mi 'bral ldan dgos na/ /zag rgyun chad na 'bral (thu'agyur 'gal/ /de la ka las 'di skad du/ /bdag de rtag par 'gyur ba yis/ /zag pa de yang rtag pa ste/ /kun nas kun du mi 'bral zhing / /zad nas bral ba ga la yod/ /de la dam pas 'di skad du/ /phyi dang nang gi zag pa rnams/ /thams cad thams cad kun zad pas/ /sa dang rnam thar las rnams lta/ /ci smos kun snang zag lam zad/ /de la ka las 'di skad du/ /101—584

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/585ji ltar gal te de ltar na/ /'gal ba nyid du yin ①zin na/ /thams cad mnyam par 'ches pa rnams/ /mnyam pa nyid du mi 'gal lam/ /de la dam pas 'di skad du/ /kun du ma 'dres mi shes par/ /bzang po'i tshig la blo gtod cing / /kun du bzang por khas 'ches pa②/ /mun pa'i skye mched nyid du 'gyur/ /yongs su rdzogs par kun mnyam yang ②/ /ma 'dres par yang kun du snang / /yongs rdzogs don du ma mthong bar/ /rdzogs spyod log pa'i lam pa yin / /gsang chen theg pa'i tshig dang sgra/ /gcig la mi gcig so sor snang / /ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par phye/ /gang nyid nges par grol bar snang / /nges par zag 'byung rtsar ④'dod na/ /de dag de bzhin ma bcos par/ /ye nas stong nyid rtog med pa/ /yin par nges pa de kho na'o/ /de dag ci ⑤phyir rtsi ①zhe na/ /rnal 'byor nad ni rnam rtog ste/ /rtag par 'khor ba'i gting mthar 'chi/ /rtog pa'i rtsa ba phyi nang gi⑦/ /kun nas zag pa rnam lnga yin/ /de kun de bzhin nyid stong du/ /rtog bral mu mtha' med 'byung bas/ /nad gso shi ba slong ba'o//dam pa mchog des de blan pas/ /mtshan mar ri zhen las 5)de 'grol te/ /de nyid der nges rnyed gzhan min/ /de nyid che mchog sman par 'gyur/ /lang ga'i bdag po de dag ni nad gso bar bya'o zhes nges par thos pa rnam par bgros r+shapa ste 'di ltar nges par shes par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag pos de skad ces smras pas/ lang ku'i bdag po la sogs pa dman pa dam pa rnams mtshan ma'i rtog pa las yongs su grol bar gyur tshosteto/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus tsopa'i mdo chen po las rang 'byung bdud rtsi'i le'u ste drug cu /kyelnga pa'o// //101—585

586 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101bam po bcu pa ste tha mar zug pa①/ de nas yang lang ma'i bdag po la sogs pa dman pa'i lus kyi sems dpa' rnams kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po la gsol pa / kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po nyid kyi ②rgya cher bgros pa'i gsang ba dam pa 'di ji skad du brjod par bgyi/ mdo ni gang du 'dus pa lags/ de skad ces gsol pa las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ kye lang ma'i bdag po kho bos ji lta ba bzhin bgros pa'i gsang ba dam pa 'di ni brjod pa'i rnam grangs brgyad du ①brjod par bya'o/ /mdo ni bcur 'dus par shes par bya'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po de la rnam grangs brgyad gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po zhes kyang bya'o/ /snying po zhes kyang bya'o/ /rdo rje dgod ①pa'i rgyud ces kyang bya'o/ /rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i lung zhes kyang bya'o/ /kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo zhes kyang bya'o/ /theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs rnam par bkod pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /theg pa chen po byung tshul bstan pa'i mdo zhes kyang bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lang ku'i bdag po gang la dgongs pa de nyid las mi 'da' dub dang / gang gi spyod yul ma yin zhing / med pa las thams cad 'byung ba dang / gang gi ye shes yongs su bkod pa dang / 'di ltar gang nges pa rnal 'byor du lung ston pa dang /'dir kun nas 0rngub pa dang / dam pa rnams kyis mngon par chud pa dang /gang la ma 'dres par bkod pa dang / gnas skabs bcu gnyis su nges par byung zhing 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /lang ma'i bdag po mdo bcur 'dus pa gang zhe ⑦na / gang mtha' bcu kho nar 'dus pa ste/ de yang 'di ltar gzhi gzung bar bya'o / /rgyud dgrol bar bya'o/ /sgo dbye bar bya'o/ /rimathar phyin par bya'o/ /101—586

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/587 thams cad ①'du bar bya'o/ /la dor bar bya'o/ /sa gcad ②par bya'o/ /nyams rnyed par bya'o/ /tshegs chung bar bya'o/ /mdo gcig tu bya'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po de la chos thams cad ②kyi gzhi ni dam tshig yin par shes par bya'o//dam tshig gnas ni 'di lta ste/ /bsrung bya bsrung du med pa ni/ /chos nyid dam ①tshig dam pa yin/ /kun kyang dam pa nyid yin pas/ /gang la'ang 'gal bar mi bya'o/ /su la dam pa 'di gnas pa/ /rig 'dzin dam pa'i sa pa yin/ /bsrung bar bya ba'i yul rnams la/ /sgyu gsog g.yo med dam pa nyid/ /zab sangs rgya lache dam pa ༷'dir/ /'di skad grugs ⑦pa'i tshul khrims dang / /rtog pa'i bya ba ji snyed par/ /kun 'dir dam bsrungs rnam par dag /dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ /kun gyi thun lamong ma yin phyir/ /mos pa chung changu thams cad la/ /bsrung ba'i mtshams dag gzung bar bya'o/ /theg chen yongs su gsang ba dag /snod ma yin par gyur pa la/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi / /sba ba'i thabs su bsrung bar bya0/ /bstan pa'i gnas min snod gang dag /rnam pa bzhis bsdus bye brag rnams/ /ma 'ongs rab hu'abyor dam pa yis / /brtags nas gsang bar bya phyir bshad/ /gsang chen yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /skyon yod nyes pa ma yin te/ /blo chung rnams la phan don du/ /thugs rje 8thabs kyis shin tu gsang / /'jig rten pa dang theg dman tsodang / /log sred log la phyogs la zhen/ /dad med blo zhan g.yeng rmugs shing / /gang la mi brtson mun par byamatshungs/ /'di log dam nyams 'di las log /byang chub thag 8pa gting nas chad/ /sems kyi 8myu gu rtsa tshig pa/ /ngan 'gro'i 'dam ⑩du kha spub tsoyin/ /gsang ba'i don rnams sgrar smra yang / /gab pa'i 101—587

588 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101gsang ba 'di mi shes/ /g.yon can shes rlom grogs rnams la/ /gsang bar 'os pa 6)lhag par smra/ /yan lag rnam ②bzhi de nyid la/ /sgra thos don med nyams mi len/ /gang gis gang gtad mi thub pa/ /bcud med 'khor bar zag pa yin①/ /lta dang dam tshig spyod pa yibya/ /dam pa'i mdzod gsum sgrar smra yang —/ /zhen ⑧pa'i mtha' ⑥med gnas ma gyur/ /g.yo sgyu phrag dog ser snas gdungs / /bya med chos la nges 'dzin cing / /de la de nyid de med par/ /rnal 'byor can la dman zer ba/ /dam pa pham 'gyur 'khor ⑦bar 'bo/ /tshul rtog tshod len khyad tshig 'dren/ /kha gsag lce gnyis sgyur gabyed cing / /gang la dmod 0rmongs dam can te/ /tshe gcig dregs pa'i ched phyir rung / /rku g.yo sgyu ldan slu 'drid ⑩pa/ /zang zing phyir 'breng tshig la dga'/ /rlom sems brjod 'dod tshul 'chos ⑩pa/ /log smra dug can tha mar ltung / /'di ltar pham 'gyur snod ngan la/ /gsang chen gsang ba de kho na/ /zab cing gting dpag dka' bas na/ /bstan kyang pham ltung gnas su 'gyur/ /de bas bstan par bya ba min/ /gal te bstan par gyur 7na ni/ /ston smra nyan byed de dag gang / /mthong yun phung byed gnyis sreg 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor mkhas gsal don ldan la/ /rnal 'byor mi shes gang dag gis/ /dregs pa'i dbang gis phrag dog gis/ /bsam pa'i rnam grangs ci bskyed pa/ /de snyed bskal pa'i grangs mnyam par/ /'bras bu mi bzad myong bar 'gyur/ /gal te bde bar rjes len pa/ /de snyed bskal par gzod 'jug dgos/ /mkhas yigasal don ldan gyis kyang ni/ /gong ma bzhin du nges bsams na/ /de yang gnas ⑫ngan len pa rkiste/ /mkhas pas de la skyob mi nus/ /rnal 'byor tshul byung dam 101—588

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor spub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/589pa la/ /mtshon cha'i tshig gis ①de dkrugs shing / /sgro skur glu gleng changan brjod na/ /dmyal ba'i rdo rjer de ltung 'gyur/ /zhar las byung ba'i rnam smin yang ske/ /ji lta dub nyid de ltar 'gyuradu/ /skal ba dman pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rtsa nyams skyon can rang bzhin ni/ /ngan rgyu khro gtum ldan pa dang / mi bzad phra ⑤men las spyod byed/ /gang dag mi shes ngang tshul can/ /byis pa'i rang bzhin blo zhan pas/ /shin tu dman pa'i lta ⑥ba yis/ /tshul 'chos pa la ltos par byed/ /gang dag dam pa'i dam par ldan/ /byams tshul rtag tu bzod gnas pa/ /tshul shis don rnams de bzhin slong / /de la gang dag 'dun pa medag / /dam tshig spre'u ltar spyod bzhin du/ /byang chub snying po thob pa yi(kye/ /sangs rgyas nam yang mi 'byung ngo / /'byung bar yang dag ngas ma mthong / /rgyal ba'i sras gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /lam ston skyon sel mkhas pa la6)/ /gang dag kha cig yidregs dbang gis/ /de spong thabs kyis de dmar byed/ /de ni 'khor ba'i gting rdo ste/ / nams kyang 0thar pa'i khar mi 'byung / /mi shes rmongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /yang dag dam par nges 'gro ba'i/ /rjes su 'gro bar mi byed cing / /zang zing 'dod par gang lta ba'i/ /rjes su 'gro zhing der 'dun byed/ /de ni log pa'i lam pa yin/ /rnal 'byor lta dang byang chub khe/ /'ban thag chad par blo mi 'byung / /zang zing 'dod dang g.yo sprul khe/ /chung ngu'ang 8ci sgrub srog dang sdoyi/ /rnal 'byor dam pa'i rang bzhin can/ /bum snod nang gi sgron ma ltar/ /rig pa mdzod kyi don ldan yang / /srog chags rkun po'i 7sder mo ltar/ /khong nas gang sbas don ston la/ /gang 'dir blun pos cir mi mthong / /dper na 'di 'dra tshul gcig snyiste/ /gang gi tshulus la gter 101—589

590 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101'chang mi/ /blun por gyur pa'i mi dag gnyis/ /gnas gcig gnyis mtshungs khyad med 'dra/ /gsang 'di sngags ①pa rjod byed cing / /gsang ba don du gnyer ba med/ /ting 'dzin bsngags pa rjod byed cing / /ting 'dzin don du gnyer ba med/ /yang dag bsngags pa rjod ②byed cing / /yang dag don du gnyer ba med/ /dam tshig bsngags pa rjod byed gcing / /dam tshig don du gnyer ba med/ /ji ltar 0'gro gang la la dag /nor bu rin chen 'di 'dra ste/ /'dod pa'i yon tan kun 'byung zhes/ / de yi ⑤yon tan rgya cher brjodadu/ /de la 'gro gang gzhan dag gis/ /de ltar 'dod pa 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de dag cung zad yod dam zhes/ /dris ④kyang med pas ⑤slar smras pa/ gang zhig dgos pa skong ba yi/ /yon tan chung ⑨zad smos par zad/ /de nyid bdag ⑩la med ces smra0/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor mi brtson 8pas/ /bslab par bya ba'i chos bral bas/ ’/dam pa'i bsngags 8pa rjod 8byed kyang / /de dag la ni dam pa med/ /de la sogs pa'i longs spyod rnams/ /dam pa nyid dang phrad par dka' / /rnal 'byor chos 'dzin chagang dag gis/ /rnal 'byor nyams 'gyur log sred can/ /gsang ba 'jigs pa'i sgrar bltas nas/ /de dag sdig pa mthong ba ltar/ /'chad cing sa bcing tsogang byed pa/ /skyes bu de ni dam pa'i sras / /dper na gang de gang dag gis/ /gang gi ⑩rgyal khrims 'das 'gyur na / /rang dga' mi gtong lugs dang sbyor/ /bka' yi yo srongs dka' tsob de / /rgyal po'i thugs mnyes dam pa zhes/ /kun la snang ba grags par 'gyur/ /ldum rar dug gi sdong skyes na/ /ldum pas dug de shes ma thag /rtsad nas phyung ste med par byed/ /ci phyir ldum zas de dag la/ /dug 'phel gyur na 'chi phyir 101—590

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/591ro / /gang dag nyams 'gyur dug can de/ /brtul lazhugs can gyi ②rnal 'byor pas/ /gnas sam lo yis shugs te spang ③/ /gang dag mi spong mgon byed pa/ /de dag gsang ba'i dam sri yin/ /don la rnal 'byor gang zhig gis//tha tshig duzab mor bcas rnams la/ /bsrung ba'i bsam pa mi g.yo bzhin/ /rtsa ba yan lag bcas rnams la/ /gal te ma tshor zhig 'gyur yang / /rnam smin yod kyang rtsa mi nyams/ /ji ltar glang po e na ⑤ya/ /shi nas ror ni gyur mod dukyang ske/ /gi gawang rtsis ni don byed ltar/ /rnal 'byor nyams te ror gyur kyang //gzhan gyi dam par de 'gyur zhing / / de yi ⑧don byed nus pa yin/ /de lta mod kyang 'di kun rnams/ /rmi lam du yang mthong mi bya/ /ci phyir 'o ma nyung ngu zhig /rul ⑨bas 'o ma kun rul ⑩bzhin/ /rnal 'byor nyams 'gyur gcig gis ni/ /rnal 'byor can kun ma rungs 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i g.yul rgyal byed pa yi7/ /log pa'i rnal 'byor thams cad kun/ /don dam nges pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad bsgrims te spang bar bya/ /gal te ma spangs log spyod na/ /'khor ba'i g.yul ⑩ni rgyal 'gyur te/ /bden pa'i byin brlabs timathu chung 'gyur/ /kun kyang dge spyad don chung zhes/ /yang dag don la yid 'byung zhing / /log pa'i chos la gzhol bar 'gyur/ /kun gyis ⑫log pa'i las spyad pas/ /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs 'byung / /des na sgro skur gnyis byas pas/ /bka' 8yi chad pa gang yin pa/ /ye shes can lta rang bzhin gyis/ /nam yang gnod pa yang ⑩mi mdzad/ /de yi 'khor na gnas pa yi / /de dag ma rungs mthu chen rnams/ /rnal 'byor log par spyod rnams kyis7ske/ /skyon mthong tsam na chad 8pas gcod/ /thams cad ngan 'gror spyi'u 101—591

59 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101tshugs lhung ①/ /sgrub pa'i gnod mchog gcig yod de/ /'di dang mi mthun kun rdzogs pa'i/ /rgyud ldan don ldan ngang tshul bzang / /ci la'ang chags med stong ②ldan sems/ /shes rab rnam grol lde mig gisal/ /gti mug tha ram ④blo phye nas/ /chos kyi 0rgyal po'i mig ldan pas/ /mtha' dang dpung dubral dam ⑦pa'i yul/ /ma nor lam du 'jug shes ⑧pas/ /sdong chen sdong por rab tu dul / /tha tshig ①lung las 'byung ba bzhin/ /drang srong dka' 0thub dam pa de//dam pa'i dam pa nyid yin pas/ /de la gsang sgo dbye bar bya/ /ji ltar dka' thub thub pa ltar/ /de ltar yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /yid 'ong 'dod dang bde ba 'byung / /rig ⑩'dzin rgyal ba kun yum mo/ /de bzhin dka' thub dam pa 'di / /gnas pas rten pa'i gzhi yin te/ /dka' thub kun gyi srog kyang yin/ /dam pa kun gyi nor mchog go/ /dam pa 'di ni 'jigs pa'i skyabs8/ /dam pa'i bgrod pa'i lam mi mchog /dam pa 8chu bo sgrol ba'i gru/ /de bzhin dngos grub dam pa yin/ /dam tshig grogs kyi mchog yin te/ /dam tshig long ba'i dmigs bu yin/ /gzhan sde 'joms pa'i dmag dpung yin/ /'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal bar byed/ /des na dam pa'i gtan tshigs ④yin/ /ci nas gang gi sgo gsum po/ /dag pa gsum gyi tsomatha' bzung nas/ /gang 'dir dbang bzhi 8sun mi 'byung / /sgo gsum mi gnod dang bcas gzung ⑩/ /yongs su ma nyams mdo bzhi'o/ /mthar phyin rgya rtags rnam bzhir bcas/ /mdo dran pa la bgrang zhing bsngo()/ /'dul ba'i rgyun ldan tha tshig (7can/ /mos pa chung ba'i bu rnams kyis4)/ /phra mo'i phra mo phra yan cad(nye/ /nan tan gyis ni bsrung bar bya/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /gsung dang spyod dang yid 101—592

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/5 3'ong dang / /mi 'dor ①shes bya grub pa dang / /med ②dang phyal ba gcig po dang ske/ /lhun gyis grub pa rnam dupa bcu/ /lta ba 'di las 'bum phrag 'byung / /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor thams cad kyi0/ /spyad par bya yi dunor mchog yin/ /rnal 'byor dam pa'i rigs rgyud las/ /nges par brtags te spyod pa'i bu/ /zab mor rdzogs mchog bde ba yi/ /blo la nges pa'i lung 'di bstan/ /'di yi sngon 'gro dam tshig ste/ /zab mo la sogs kun sngon du/ /rdo rje tha tshig yidrag po yi / /gcan 'phrang ⑦lam rnams bsrung ba'i phyir/ /spyi dudang khyad ⑨par dam tshig rnams/ /nges pa'i don gyis btsan red kyin/ /de ni dbyig gi snod chen yin / /de ltar dam pa'i sdom pa la/ /gnas nas dus kyi skabs dag tu/ /bsrung bya thub par bya ba ni/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dam tshig dag /dam tshig kun gyi ⑩thog mar 'gro/ /don du mi 'gyur kun spangs ⑩nas/ /kun dang mthun phyir de ltar spyad/ /mi shigs pa ni seng ge ste/ /gcan gzan 8rgyal po yin pas so/ /za ma tog ④ni rgyal po'i mdzodabya/ /dug spyo ba ni der mi rigs//rin chen myu gu'i lcug phran dag /bregs te 'byung rgyun gcad tsom yin/ /gangs kyi zhun chu phal pa yang / /mkhas pas btung bar mi bya'o/ /pad+ma'i ze 'bru kha mi dbye/ /zla zer ma yin dbye mi bya/ /ma brtags bug rdol can snod dul/ /bdud rtsi sman blugs zag par 'gyur/ /don med bcos ma'i tshul rtags can / /bsrel zhing spyad par bya ba min/ /shel dkar rin chen sgo nga dag /'dam 'khung rdzab tu bsgrub mi bya/ /seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma dag /gser snod (nyem yin blugs ()mi bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /bsreg ( )par bya ba yang sa7ma yin/ /khyung chen gshog pa mkhar brkyang ba/ /de dag gcag par tsobya 101—593

594 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101ba min/ /gnam lcags me yi dur mo dag /brdab par bya ba ma yin no/ /stag seng larol pas las byas pa'i/ /las kyi ②rjes la bzlas mi bya/ /rdo rje brag chen gtams pa'i gzhi/ /gzhig par bya ba ga la yin/ /rdo rje ra ba'i re ga ②de/ /bsdam dubya dral dubar bya ba min/ /bud shing sreg 0pa'i sgron ma de/ /'thor pya rlung drag pos bskyod mi bya/ /rdo rje ③tshig gi chu rgyun dag /'ol kur gcad ⑨par bya ba min/ /rgyal po bka' rtags ⑩phyag rgya yidag /rnam zhar ⑫dbyi bar mi bya'o/ /rdo rje pha lam gtams pa'i mkhar/ /rmang nas bzlog par mi bya'o/ /gtsug gi 8yid bzhin nor bu de/ /rgyal mtshan rtse las dbog mi bya/ /rnal 'byor thabs kyi 8khyad par can/ /rtsal can rnams kyi 8dam tshig ste/ /skal ldan dag gi tsonor mchog yin/ /rgyun du sbyang ba'i ⑩rnar mchog ni/ /rdo rje las kyi bsam gtan dag /rdo rje go phur trom chen gyis/ /srog la bar chad byed pa'i dgatso/ /nyon mongs thibs po de gzhom bya/ /snyom yilas le lo'i ⑥gzhir gyur pa/ /thugs thub ra cod 0nga rgyal ri/ /dregs dubyed dbang po nyams pa'i bcud/ /dpa' byed rkyen yang bsdam par bya/ /theg chen gsang sngags ma gtogs pa/ /mtshan ma gang dag byis pa'i tshig /zur yang brjod par mi bya zhing / /thams cad de nyid kho nar bya/ /ji ltar gsad pa'i ⑥mi gang dag /gshed ma mis ni gsod 69pa'i tshe/ /thar pa'i thabs la brtson pa ltar/ /le lo dgra bcom brtson par 'bad/ /rnal du'abyor sgrib 0pa'i gags bsal ⑩ba / /dka' sostethub sdom pa'i mdud 0pa can/ /'dod spyod zhen dang mi mthun dang —/ /gcig la gang 'dir mi gcig pa/ /phyi nang can dang gnod sbyor can//'dod myos bying rmugs brkam pa dag /dad med rtsa nyams 'phyar g.yeng can/ /101—594

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor spub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/595mkhas pa yongs kyis spang bar bya/ /de ni rnal 'byor bgegs yin te/ /rnal 'byor bar du gcod par byed/ /rnal 'byor nges par ①thugs pa la/ /rgyun gyi bar du gcod pa'i bdud/ /rnam rtog 'phrig pa chen po dang / /gang la btang snyoms le lo dang / /longs spyod 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba dang / /tshig rtsub mtshon cha rnon po dang / /khro gtum ngang thung shin tu 'khrug /rnal 'byor sbyor ba'i bdud lnga yin/ /yang dag don la sgrib pa ste/ /gnyen po byang chub sems mchog gis/ /zhi ba chen po'i ngang du bzlog /rnal 'byor nor la 'phrog pa'i ②dgra / /thabs la mkhas pas dul bar bya/ /gang gi rnal 'byor rang bzhin bcos / /drang srong nyid las nyams 'gyur te/ /kha na ma tho grags pa yis / /de dag bcas dgar 'gyur ba'i dgradhi/ /lta dman spyod cing 'chol ⑤ba yis/ /lugs bor 'di las log par spyod/ /bka' 0log phra ①men las spyod ⑧pas/ /don du mi 'gyur 'chal ba'i dgra/ /'da' ka dhirdo rje dka' thub dam/ /klong ⑩du ma gyur phyal bas 'chal7/ /rtsa ba rul ba'i ljon shing bzhin/ /'chad pas drug por 'byung 8ba'i dgra/ /rnal ma nyid la sbyor ba de/ /gang la nges pa'i tshig med na/ /don 8rnams grub pa tsom yin te/ /'bras bur mi 'gyur gol ba'i dgra/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor spyod pa la/ /dam pa'i nor mchog 'phrog pa'i dgra/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i blo gros kyis/ /skyon gyi dgra bzhi bzlog ⑫par bya/ /srid gsum snang ba'i zhing 'di dag /rnam dag zhing du nges pa ste/ /sa rnams cig 0car sbyangs pas na/ /zhing rnams dam pa'i mchog yin no/ /'dod spyod mchod pa'i tshogs 'di dag /yo byad chen po'i mchog yin te/ /dgongs pa dam pa kun mnyes pa'i/ /rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa'o/ /'khor 101—595

596 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101ba dur khrod gnas 'di dag /bde ba chen po'i gnas yin te/ /ma nor ma bcos chos kyi dbyings/ /rtsol med lhun gyis grub pa'i sa'o/ /kun gyi rtsa ba dug chen lnga/ /ye shes chen po lnga nyid de/ /kun shes rang rig rang byung ①bas//rnal 'byor rang rig mig ldan pa'o/ /lang ku'i bdag po ②'di dag ni/ /dam tshig gsang ba'i mchog yin te/ /dam pas gdams pa'i sritshig 'di la/ /gang dag nges pa'i rnal 'byor yin/ /ji ltar sa gzhi gshin pa la/ /brten ④nas sa bon btab pa las/ /dam pa kho na 'jug par 'os/ /'un pas gang gi ⑤de nyid kyang / /'un cing dam pa'i yul la 'jug /lang ma'i bdag po ji ltar na//de yang ji lta (7bu zhe na/ /kho bo stimathong thos skabs gcig ⑧na/ /bdag gi bshes gnyen dam pa des/ /'dus pa phal po che dag la/ /lam 'di rgya 6)cher bstan pa'i tshe/ /'khor 'dir 'dus par gyur pa yi7/ /lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /bu mo drug gi 'khor 'dus pas/ /'bras drug smin par gyur pa yis//gang dag 'tsho ba'i srog 'dzin ltar/ /chos rnams kun gyi gzhir gyur pas/ /dam tshig 'di la gnas pa ni/ /bla med byang chub rnam smin pas/ /dge ba'i srog 'dzin dam pa'o/ /gal te nyams par gyur tunyepa na/ / chad pa'i skye ⑫gnas dmyal chen brgyad/ /mi bzad hu)sdug bsngal drag po yis/ /'khor lo mtshon cha bzhin du 'khor/ /lang ku'i bdag po gang 'di las/ /nyams par gyur pa gang zhe na/ /kun du nyams pa chen po dang / /rtsa ba nyams dang yan lag nyams/ /de bzhin bzlas nyams zhar nyams lnga/ /rtag par rgyun gyi khor mor 'byung cha/ /gang de bkang snyibar bya ba'i thabs/ /rnam pa lngar ni bshad par bya/ /las dang rdzas dang 'dun pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang de nyid do/ /101—596

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/597las ni rnam lngas skong ①'gyur te/ /dang po 'bum khri gsum pa ste/ /rtsa nyams khri lnga stong gsum mo/ /yan lag nyams par gyur pa la/ /stong lnga brgya gsum thon ②par bya/ /bzlas nyams brgya lnga bcu gsum mo/ ci/zhar gyis nyams par gyur pa la/ /bco ②lnga gcig gsum dag gis skongs④/ /rdzas ni ⑤rin chen sna lnga yis/ /rigs ⑥kyi dam tshig gang nyams las/ /bla ma rigs lnga gang dag la/ /tha tshig ⑦gang rlag nor des bslu(nya/ /'dun pa dad pa dang ba yis/ /gdung ba'i shugs kyi nga ro yis/ /rtag par rma ga chad pa ni/ /dmyal chen gnas na spyod yo)bzhin du/ /gnyen po mchog tu de 'gyur 0te/ /de ni skong ba dam pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi thabs chen yang / /'jig rten sreg la me dgos kyang / /bag chags sreg la me mi dgos/ /rig pa'i ye shes me byung bas/ /sgrib pa'i bud shing thams cad bsregs7/ /'jig rten gtor la rlung dgos kyang / /mtshan ma 'bud la rlung mi dgos/ /rig pa'i ye shes rlung byung bas/ /mtshan ma'i rdul kun rnam par 'phyagatso /lus bkru ba la chu dgos kyang / /sems bkru ba la chu mi dgos/ /rig pa'i ye shes chu byung bas/ /bag chags ljan smin thams cad dag /stong nyid chu bo khrus kyi 'ardzing / /de bzhin nyid kyi nam mkha' nas/ /'bar 'phro me yi 8bskal par tshig /de ni skams 8pa dam pa'i mchog /de nyid de yi thabs mchog kyang / /rnal 'byor dam pa gang zhig dag /nyams pa'i chad pa tsobyung ba la/ /de bzhin de nyid ma g.yos kyang / /mgon skyabs de las gzhan med de/ /nyams dang ma 7nyams tha snyad med/ /bkang (3ngam mi bkang 5)tshig lam bral/ /lang ku'i bdag po de dag ni gzhi yongs su gzung byab rnam par bgros (7par shes par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pas lang ku'i bdag 101—597

598 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101po la sogs pa dman pa rnams ①dam pa rnams ②kyi nor la yongs ①su spyod par gyur duto/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las dam tshig gsang ba'i mchog gi le'u zhes bya ste drug cu ②drug pa'o// //de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ kye grogs po dam pa dag rgyud yongs su grol ba ni dam pa la rag las pa ste/ de yang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bla med snying po smin 0pa'i rkyen/ /blo gros chen po dri ⑦ba'i yul/ /lam stor sa mkhan bshes gnyen mgon/ /mun sel sgron ma'i rin po che/ /mthong mig dbang po yid rnam ⑤shes/ /chu bo rab med sgrol ⑨ba'i gru/ /'jigs pa'i rdzong chen rten pa'i mkhar/ /'khor ba'i gcong ⑩'byin sman pa'i mchog /mtsho gling rin chen len byed pa'i/ /ded dpon dam pa'i bla ma de/ /sngon (7du nges par shes par bya/ /sde mdzod gter khyim khang chen dang / /rnam 'grel 7lde mig bcu gnyis dang / /nges mdo dam 0pa de nyid bcu/ /mtha' bcu yan lag mdo rtsa ba/ /gang 'dir skabs bcu rdzogs ldan namatso/ /skyon gyi mtha' rnams zad 'gyur zhing / /yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /dam pa'i tshad la bab ma bab/ /de la bshes gnyen mgon bltas na/ /mthar chub yongs su rdzogs zhe 8'am/ /gang rig de yul ma yin par/ /thabs dang yan lag bcas pa yis/ /gzhan gyi yul nas brtag ⑩par bya/ /brtags pas bsngo ba kun ldan na/ /gzhan gyi yul la 'gro mi bya/ /dam pa'i yo byad lnga rdzogs na/ /dman pa'i yo byad med la min⑩/ /nges par kun du bzang nyid na/ /gang gi blta 6)yul ngan la min/ /sgron me 'tshub rlung bskyod la min/ /'dod 'chal 7101—598

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/599tshig 'chal ①dman la min/ /blun rmugs ②mongs la ga la srid/ /'jig rten pa'i sriskyon de bzhin duX/ /dam pa de dag ji ltar yang / /sa mkhan lam la mkhas nges na/ /ji ltar bzod par bya dka' duyang / /thams cad thams cad bzod par bya/ /dam pa 'di ni sa mkhan te/ /'di ni bdag gi ⑥mgon yin pas / /'jig rten pa yi ④tha snyad kun/ /nges ⑧par thams cad sgyu ⑨ma yin/ /gang 'dir gyi na tsam 'di dag /dam par gang la 'gog ⑩ma yin/ /skad cig tsam gyis yimathong 'di la/ /de lta 8zhig na 'di lta la/ /de srid tsam du bzod par zad/ /ci gar gar cig 'byung 'joms sgrubs8/ /log pas 8gyin da ⑫gyin da tso'adi/ /dam pa'i don du mi sbyor ram/ /snyam du brtags te dam par bya / /yun gyi don srid chen po la/ /dmigs nas blo gros phyir bskyed ⑩de/ /bde mchog bde ba'i dam pa dang / /skad cig 8tsam gyi tha snyad 'dis/ /btang snyoms bya ba ga la srid/ /gang 'dir mgon med bdag 'khyams na/ /gang gis 8phyogs 'di dag la ni/ /phan 'byung rigs can su ga nadu / / bodam pa ma gtogs phyugacig 'ga' med/ /'di na phan dang mgon mang zhing / /dman par 'brel pa gang yod kyang / /log par bsgrub pa'i blo gros mkhan/ /g.yang tsosar mchongs pa'i dusnga bgros mkhan/ /don (srel 'gog snyam yod min tebya / /bshes gnyen skyabs med ci slad du/ /kun kyang dmangs tsorigs grong khyer (nye'agro/ /byams blo'i yul du ga la rung / /gang 'dir mun par 'khyams pa la/ /bde mchog snang ba'i lam ston pa/ /skyabs chen dam pa gang de lags//gzhan gyis bskyab ⑥par nus ma yin/ /des na dam pa gang dag la/ /bsnyen ⑥pas shin tu bsten 0par bya/ /gang 'dir snang ba'i tshul 'byung na/ /dam pa 101—599

600 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ tsasdi 101nyid du 'dun par gsol/ /dam par snang ba thob phan chad/ /dam pa de las 'gal 'gyur las/ /rdul gyi cha yang mi bya'o/ /rgya mi bcag ①cing lung mi bor /'dun pa nas bzung las rung ba'i/ /bar du de la ltos dgos so/ /gang 'dir ngo gang ma zin pas/ /btang ②snyoms tsam du tshul bsad na/ /de la dam pa'i don med de/ /de rkyen de dang mi ldan pas/ /bslab pa'i yul bzlas the tshom gzos/ /le los yul la mi brtson zhing / /phyal bas de la ma gus pas/ /shes bya mun pa'i tshogs kyis thubasgribs/ /gang gis nam mthong thibs kyis 'gags⑤la/ /gang la byis pa shed mi 'bye/ /mdud pa'i bcing ba de las byung / /shes rgyud grol bar ga la srid/ /dam pa'i yo byad lnga dbul ba'i/ /phongs pa de yis gzhan bsgral na/ /de yang dbul po nyid du 'gyur/ /'tsho ba dam pa dang bral bas/ /longs spyod chen pos phongs pa yi/ /mu ge'i dgon pa nyid du ltung ske/ /de lta'i gang zag dman pa de/ /dam par gzung bar gyur phan chad/ /dam par nges dang ma nges kyang / /bka' bcag (5)lugs por ga la srid/ /gal te de yi rgya nyams na/ /dmyal ba rdo rjer de (7'gro ste/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /dmyal bsrung 98)khyi ni lu de zhes/ /grags pa seng ge gzugs 'dra ba97/ /mche ba gzangs 7rings dbal rno bas/ /rbad (7cing mtshon cha'i lam du bdas7/ /spu gri rno dbal ral gri nags/ /nang du ga chad rgyugs skyabs med/ /khro chu khol ma thal skyo yikyi / /chu bo rab med nang du 'bying —/ /rtse gsum mdung dang mda' bo che/ /khab 'dra dbal yirno gzangs rings dang / /chu gri ral gri rnos gang ba'i'/ /mun dong me 'bar nang du ltung / /sdug bsngal rgyud pa de dag las/ /thar pa'i skabs ni mi srid do/ /101—600

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/601slob mar gyur na sems ldan pas/ /dam pa de la nyes byed gang / /sangs rgyas kun la nyes byas pas/ /de dag rtag tu spyi'u tshugs 'gro/ /dam pa kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /dam pa nyid las gang 'das payo)/ /rnal 'byor dam pa dbang gyur pa/ /thams cad 'khrugs nas khrag chen 'thung / /dam pa'i yi ge 'bru bkod pa/ /dbugs chen nang du shar nas kyang / /lcags kyi sdig ②pa mgo dgu pa/ /rag sha yag ②shar gyur pa des/ /bsad nas dmyal ba chen por brgyud④/ /rnam par 'tshe dang (nyanor 'phrog ⑥dang / /bgegs dang sdig pa'i dug dbal ⑦gyis/ /nyams pa de la 'tshe bar byed/ /sdig can yin te 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i chad pa la sogs pa/ /'jigs pa brgyad rnams de la 'byung / /sho gam gcan (9chen la sogs pa/ /gnod sbyin gyis bsad ⑧mi bder kyi'agro/ /ci phyir lha 0srin sde brgyad las/ /gtum pho tsogatum mo dam can kun/ /chos srung bka' tsoyi las mkhan yin/ /bka' tsoyi las la dus mi ⑫'dor / / des na 8chos la spyod pa yi/ /dam par ⑩'jug pa'i bu rnams kyis/ /nam yang zhabs la mi smod 'acing / /bka' zur gcag ⑩par mi bya'o/ /gang gis rtse gcig chos bsrungs na/ /chos la bsrung ba'i sung ( — )ma rnams/ /gtum po mthu chen rnams kyis kyang / /bu bzhin rtag tu srung (nyabar byed/ /chos srung (steb yang gang zhe na/ /chos rnams kun la ma rmongs shing / /nges par shes pa gang yin pa/ /chos srung (geb la mkhas par 'gyur/ /gang zhig kun la mi mkhas shing / /rmongs pa'i lta ba brtan pa can/ /bsgyur bas cis kyang tshe(stemi 'gyur te/ / nams kyang rustechos ni srung mi 'gyur/ /gal te dus ni thams cad du / /dam pa de dang de gcig na/ /rgyud zhan skyo ngas snyom khrimalas kyis/ /de 101—601

60 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101dang 'gal na ltung grib rgyu/ /des na dam pa'i lung ①mi gcag /tshad mar nges pa dam pa'i lung / /thams cad ldem dgongs can yin te/ /yul ②dang 'tsham ①par sbyor dub yin/ /de yang ji lta ①bu zhe na/ /ji ltar log sred can dag gis//su dag 'jig rten 'dren gang lags/ /kye ma 'jig rten dga' byed khyod/ /thams cad dga' bar ston shes na/ /bdag ltar dga' ba'i don bstan nas/ /'bras bu gdon mi za shes na/ /thams cad mkhyen ces de la bya/ /de ltar mos pa gang bstan pa/ /pha ma bram ze rgyal ①po rnams/ /bsad brlag ⑦yongs su bcom byas na/ /de dag rtag tu bde ba'i mchog /de bstan de yis de spyad nas / /bde mchog bde dang ldan pa yin/ /de bzhin bka' ⑧yi ldem dgongs la / /mdo dang don gal che yod pas/ /skyabs chen dam par bzung ba de/ /tshad ma dam par yid ches ⑨na/ /de yi lugs kyang dam par bya/ /lang ku'i bdag po ⑩gang si 7tshe/ /gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des/ /kho bo la ni 'di skad bsgo/ /sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin pa nyon/ /bskal pa 'bum gyi tsosangs rgyas pas/ /slob dpon gnyan 8par shes par bya/ /ci'i ④phyir bskal pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /slob dpon dag la brten nas byung / /slob dpon dag la ma brten par/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang mi 'byung ste/ /'byung bar yang dag ngas ma mthong / /byung na dam pa'i lugs dang 'gal/ /don dang ldan pa'i dam pa la/ /dus gsum dus ni thams cad du/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ /bde snyigashegs rgyal ba kun byon na/ /sngags dang 'dun pas phyag mdzad 7do/ /sems dpa' lha dang mi dag dang / /de bzhin klu ⑩dang gnod sbyin dang / /srin po log lta can dag gis/ /rig pa 'dzin pa kun 101—602

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/603'dus nas/ /sprul pa'i me tog kun 'thor ①zhing / /bla ma bshes gnyen dam pa khyod/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha lags so/ /bla ma bshes ②gnyen dam pa khyod / /bdag cag rnams kyi ①ma lags so/ /bla ma bshes gnyen dam pa 0khyod//bdag cag rnams kyi ⑤mgon lags so/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i blo gros mkhan/ /lam stor rnams kyi dus mkhan lags/ /mun khung 'khyams pa'i sgron ma lags/ /gdung ba sel ba'i rin po che/ /nyi ma'i zhal la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nam mkha'i thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /zla ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /pad+ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'di ltar dga' dang gus pa yis/ /sngags dang 'dun pas phyag mdzad do/ /de'i phyir rgyal ba thams cad dang / /sems dpa' rig pa 'dzin pa rnams/ /dam pa'i dam pa las byung bsame/ /dper na ma yis bu bskyed ltar/ /de bzhin dam pa shes par gyisal/ /dam pa de yi rang bzhin yang ⑨/ /yid brten ⑩sems dang dul ⑩ba dang / /tshad med yangs pa'i blo gros dang / /rkyen thub bzod ldan kun du drang / /gsong por spyod la gya gyu med/ /sems can nyen can thams cad la/ /thabs kyis mi 'jigs sna tshogs sbyin/ /dpa' bo mthur ldan brtson 'grus che/ /shes bya'i yul ni thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'byung / /srid par zhus 8kyang zad mi shes / /brtags 0shing yon tan phyi phyir 'byung / /bden par smra zhing tshig mi 'gyur / /ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed/ /legs dang nyes pa'i las rnams la8 / /dga' dang mi dga' 8rtog 'dzin med/ /ri dgas ⑩rgyal po seng ge ltar / /gzi ldan brjid che yul mi 'jug /'du 'dzi tsodaman pa'i las rnams spangasatso / /'phyo dang g.yeng bral gang na rtag /seng ge lta bur gcig pur ()101—603

604 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101gnas / /dgon pa'i rgyu ①dang dben lam bsten②/ /'di dang gang ldan dam pa'i phyi'os/ /dam pa thams cad bkur gnas so/ /rang bzhin de dang mi ldan yang ske/ /dam pa'i mdzod ④dang gnyer ldan na/ /dam par gzung zhing dam par bya / /chos kun mi shes ma rtogs kyang / /dam par gyur pa'i bla ma la/ /bkur gnas rim gro cher byas pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rgal 'gyur/ /ci phyir zhing rab gshin pa la/ /sa bon btab na rgyas 'phel bzhin/ /bsod nams dam pa'i zhing rab la/ /til 'bru mi stor ⑤'phel mi 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i mtha' las skyob pa yi/ /bshes yiganyen dam pa bzhi yod de/ /khungs dang lung dang dbang 'gyur dang / /blo gros nges pa'i tshad ldan bzhiX/ /de las gnyen po bzhi 'byung ste/ /sems bskyed stobs dang 'gyod nistobs dang / /las kyi stobs dang dmigs pa'i stobs/ /log pa'i stobs rnams 'joms par byed/ /chu bo bzhi las rgal bar 'gyur/ /rgyud kun yongs su grol ⑨'gyur te/ /dam pa'i dam par ⑩de nyid 'gyur/ /de skad gsungs nas cang mi gsung / /des na 7lang ma'i bdag po 'dir/ /blo ldan dga' dang gus pa yis/ /dam par gyur to 'tshal rnams la/ /'dun sar lan gsum gus byas te/ /zhabs la spyi bos gtug tshepar bya/ /dam pa'am yang na ma nges rnams/ /dam pa'i chos sogs 'dus byas te/ /kha na ma tho gzhom bya'i phyir/ /'jig rten sri (nyazhu'i 'dun pa bya/ /lung 'byung gang smod tso'aphel gtam la/ /yang du 'dun pas ske'adun thabs sbyar/ /sri /7zhu sgra yis mtshams bzung ste/ /gang de rnams ni ci bder dran7/ /bde dang blang ba langs pa dang / /don byed zhu sogs skabs rnams su/ /rgyud mnyen tu sri zhu gus ldan pas/ /gyong sems med 9/7sngo nan tan 101—604

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/605byayo)ske/ /kun nas gzem ②mdog bag la gnas/ /gsong por ②smra zhing gya gyu med / /ci phyir dam par gyur pa la/ /ma nges gya gyu'i las byas pas/ /dam par gyur pa kun bslus teX/ /dmyal ba rdo rjer (nyede ltung 'gyur/ /brtson dang 'grus ldan ngang 0tshul bzang / /brdeg ⑦cing gsang thub spyod pa dag /ya bag bzhin bzangs mdzes ③thabs ldan/ /sgo gsum bzang spyod mtha' gsum bsdamal / /dam pa nyid dang ⑩mthun bzhin spyod/ /gsal la dag pas go rnams dbye/ /dam pa'i nang na bder 'dug tshe(nya/ /kun gyi tshig lam la mi 'byung ske/ /gang dag bzang dang ngan spyod la/ /'thing 8slad smod (9pa yang ④mi bya / /bdag la bzang dang ngan brjod cing / /kun mthong kun brjod sgro skur dang —/ /gang dag tshig lam 'dren tso'adod na/ /tshig lam bcad yin bde ba thobaske/ /dam pa'i yul ⑩na gnas rnams su/ /khong khro tshig rtsub khyal hunyemi smra/ /bag yangs tshul gyis yibya ba min/ /tshul med tshul dang mi ldan pa'i/ /nyam nga med par smra mi bya/ /phod dang lcogs (gyedang gang mthong dang / /stong (me'aphyor rngom la sogs mi bya/ /gzhan la khyad sakyis gsad pa'i tshig /gang ris gcad par mi bya'o/ /dam pa'i gnas su gyur pa la/ /rjes su rigs dang 'thad pa'i yon / /nor gyi dbyig dang na bza'i mchog /rtsi mchog zas la sogs pa rnams / /dbul dang gsol bas mnyes par bya/ /des ni nad dang dbul la sogs / /bkres dang tsha ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ / nams kyang slu'adebs par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhu ba dbul ba nad pa dang / /lung byang 4ste'adun par 'dug pa dang / /dam pa'i spyod pa ma rtogs sa pa/ /dam pa dag dang gnas gcig tu/ /zhabs (9'bring ma rtogs nams kyang nu 7min/ /'di ltar ma byas nyes byas so/ /101—605

606 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101sku yi grib ma mi 'gom ①zhing / /zhabs rjes brlam par mi bya'o/ /na ⑧bza' chags gdan rten la sogs/ / nams kyang 'gom ③par bya ba minadu/ /dam pa'i lung byung ming gis bsgrubadu/ /ming lcogs ma yin ma lcogs na/ / sgyu sogs dumed pa gnas dor ro/ /dam pa'i dkor rnams srog bzhin bsrung / /de yi nye gnas dam pa bzhin/ /de yi 'khor g.yog nye du bzhin/ /rtag tu mnyam pa'i sems kyis blta/ /khri mal stan ⑦bde bla ma'i thabs/ /mi gus la sogs mi tshul rnams/ /dam pa'i thad du yong mi mdzesal/ /byas na sri zhu dam tshig nyams/ /mgo la zer ldir ⑨gdugs thogs dang / /lag rten lus brten ⑩de bzhin stong tī/ /gang 'dir ma rab 8thor bu'i thabs/ /snang ba'i yul nas bya ma yin/ /dmangs 8rigs gdol ④pa g.yung mo'i tshul/ /dam pa'i gzigs yul nams kyang tsomin/ /khu ljo smyon 0pa kun du rgyu'i/ /spyod pa dam pa'i yul du min/ /snang ⑩ba'i lung la gang 'byung spyod8/ /ji ltar spyod byung spyod pa (7byung / /'jam dal ⑩thos 'phrigs dogs bzhin spyad/ /dam pa'i spyod pa'i snang yul nas/ /bag med che ba'i thabs mi bya/ /bsgrubs nas mdzes pa'i tshul bzung ste/ /bag dang ldan pas gnas par bya/ /lus kyi dor ba gang dag kun/ /mthong tshor yul nas yod ⑥mi bya/ /snang ba lus kyi dubya byed rnams/ /blo gros ldan pas bya ba min/ /'dus nas 'du gang byed spyod rnams / /dam pa'i 'dun sar rigs dum yin/ /'phyo g.yeng brkam chadang ma zhi ba'i/ /spyod tshul yul nas mi bya'o/ /khams las byung ba'i lus spyod rnams/ /bsgribs sam phag gam bskyor (nyebakab nas/ /thams cad bde bskyung cha'ajam byas te/ /dam pa de la ci mdzes bya/ /dam pa gdan bskyod phyugang phyogs nas/ /101—606

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/607bdag nas bsgrims ①te sri zhu bya/ /bskyod bcag ②brdzi sad gdan thabs sbyar/ /ma ldan nyid las ci bder sbyar/ /sngon rtsol lung 'byung sri ⑧zhu bsdu/ /de rdzogs nas kyang de bzhin no/ /blo ldan spyod lam bzhi spyod na/ /sri zhu gus pas de bzhin sbyar/ /gang ma gus dang btang snyoms dag④ /nam yang bya ba yang dum yin/ /sri zhu bste gnas rim gro rnams/ /bya ba'i mdun dang de zan du/ /sri ⑥nu bcug ste ci bder ⑦'gro/ /bde shes ⑧la sogs sri zhus khyezhus/ /yang dag dka' 0thub mdun nyid du/ /gar spyod gar skabs sri zhu dbul/ /mtshan nas nam yang mi brjod cing / /dam pa bla ma bshes gnyen zhes/ /brjod pa'i tha mar zhus sgra gzhug /khyad par cir yang dbye bar bya/ /lung byung bka' bzhin zhus zhes ⑩brjod/ /thal ⑤sbyar gsung ba 8gzung bar bya /dam pa'i lung yul byung rjes 'brang / /de kun sri zhus mtshon pa yin/ /mdzes pa'i tshul bzung gus 'dun nas/ /spobs pa nod pa gsum du zhuci/ /gyong khengs med pa'i mnyen 8lcag gis/ / zhabs 'bring dgongs ⑩pa thams cad bya8ske/ /dge slong sar pa'i spyod pa yis/ /bsgegs 8pa la sogs bya byed dang / /rgyan tu)dang mtshon thogs spang bar ⑥bya/ /blo gros gus pa de nyid kyang / /nyid kyis nyid la dpyas bcug ste/ /gzhan gyis dpya (nyeba'i gzhi rnams spang ⑫/ /kun du mthun par bzang brjod pa'i/ /skyes bu gang yin de ltar bya/ /kun gyis mthun par ma bsngags (nyepa'i/ /tha shal gang yin de duspyod spang / /dkyil 'khor la sogs sbyin sreg dang / /slob ma gzung dang chos smra ba/ /lung ma byung bar mi brtsam ste/ /dam pa'i yul nas de mi rigs/ /gal te gzhan gyi don byas na/ /de yi yo byad mi spyad de/ /de kun dam pa de la dbul/ /dam pas 101—607

608 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101ci blangs lhag ma blang / /dam pa'i slob ma slob mar yang / /dam pa'i mdun du mi rigs so/ /bkur sti sri zhu la sogs min/ /gang yin dam pa de nyid mnga' / /snying rjes dam pas ci gnang ①ba/ /sri zhu mdun bsu lag gnyis kyis / /blo dang ldan pas blang bar bya/ /rmugs med dran ②gsal rab bsgribs ①nas / /rang gi spyod lam 'da' mi bya/ /blo gros ldan pa'i nyi ma des/ /dam pa lha ④ltar mchod bya'i phyir/ /mnyes par bya ba'i yo ⑤byad brgyad/ /dam pa de la rdzogs par dbul/ /skyo dub med pa'i dad pa dang / /gyod 9khengs med pa'i mnyen lcug ① dang / /ser sna med pa'i zang zing dang / /som nyi ⑧med pa'i sri zhu dang / /g.yo sgyu 6)med pa'i drang dkan ⑩dang / /kha gsag med pa'i rang rgyud dang / /rmongs pa med pa'i shes rab dang / /dri ma med pa'i lhag sems brgyad / /dam pa de la rdzogs par dbul/ /dam pas bsgo skyob bslab pa'i mtha' / /chub par rdzogs pas rgyud dgrol te/ /shes bya kun la thogs 8med 'gro / /rang rgyud mdud pa dgrol ba yi/ /shes rab mkha' la bya bzhin rgyu/ /mthar chib rgyud dgrol yul spangs te/ /rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad pa'i/ /nor mchog dam pa de la dbul/ /rang gi lus kyang ci rigs par/ /rin thang gang yin nor gyis bslu(lhe/ /de nas ji bzhin gar bde bar/ /rnal 'byor yang dag 'jog la zhugs/ /sngon gyi ṇi dam pa dam pa rnams/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i rjes su 'gro/ /sngon gyi dam pa bder tsogashegs rnams/ /ded dpon dam pa mnyes byas nas/ /kun spangs dgon pa'i 7mthar gshegs pas/ /nyid las dam pa mnyes par 'gyur/ /des na ded dpon dam pa dang / /nam du'ang ⑩101—608

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/609'bral ba ma yin te/ /ji ltar lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /blo gros dris na dam par 'gyur/ /ji ltar cang shes gyi 6)ling dag /sdom byed sgrog gis bcings 'gyur ba/ /bgrol byas bde blag byung (snye'agyur na/ /ci la'ang thogs med 'gro ba ltar/ /sems kyi ②cang shes dbang po 'di/ /mi shes bcing bas ④bcings 'gyur ba/ /dam pas rnam (nyagrol sgo phye bas/ /shes rgyud kun 'grol thogs med 'grol/ /'di ni mi shes rgyud 'gro ba'i/ /mdud pa'i bcing ba 'grol (7ba ste/ /rgyud rnams grol ba'i bslab pa ru/ /goms par bya ba (7)rab tu gces(kye/ /lang ku'i bdag po de dag ni rgyud yongs su dgrol 6)ba'i bslab yipa'i mtha' yongs su bgros par shes par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pas dman pa'i lus kyi sems dpa' rnams dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams slob dpon dam par bsgrun tsopar shes par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las bsnyen bkur tsodam pa mchog gi le'u ste drug cu /stebadun pa'o// //de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag pos dam pa'i lus kyi byang chub sems dpa' lirnams la smras pa/ kye grogs po dag sgo 7dbye bar bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ji bzhin pa yi de kho na/ /nyid du nges pa'i ngo bo tshul/ /rig dang ma rig rnam pa yis/ /kun shes spyod dang kun du rmongs/ /rnam pa gnyis su snang ba la/ /tha dad du ma mang por 'gyur/ /rmongs pa rnam pa gnyis snang ba/ /mi shes pa dang log par shes/ /mi shes phyal 7pa rgyang phan gnyis/ /log rtog mur thug mu stegs pa/ /de yang zhen chags log srid can/ /'jig rten 'jig rten pa zhes bya/ /mu stegs log /snyedang gzhan rkyen log /zhar las 'byung ba zhes kyang 101—609

610 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101bshad / /mi shes 'di gnyis gzhir snang ba/ /dman rigs dang ni rigs ma nges / /rigs chad 'du shes can 'di dag /kun nas dkrigs ①pa'i mun pa yin / /'du shes can bzhi chags pa dang / /gang la g.yeng dang ya nga can/ /mos pa can zhes grags pa rnams/ /sa bon 'dzin pa'i zhing du snang / /log par rtog 'di ya mtshan can/ /brgya phrag gsum dang drug cu ②gnyis/ /nyi shu'am ③bcu ste lnga gnyis dang / /tha dad rnam pa du mar snang / /yo byad med pa'i phyogs 'dzin las/ /'jig pa'i tshogs dang mthar 'dzin dang / /log par 'dzin dang lta khyad dang / /rang gi brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin te/ /rigs mi mthun pa sde dhilngar grags/ /rang bzhin log pas phyilog pa nyid/ /gzhan rkyen log pa phra med spyod/ /lung la brten rjodang rtags tsam 'dzin/ /bcos mar spyod dang mu 〈cor smra/ /lung gi niphyogs tsam brten ⑨pa dang / /phyogs log ⑩gol dang bslang bas ⑩'chalas/ /phyogs ltos gcod 8pa rnam bzhir dhigrags/ /bcos ma gzhan las gyur pa dang / /'di las gyur pa gnyis kho na/ /gnas dang 'khor dang yo byad nor/ /longs spyod lnga ldan gzhan las gyur / /dran pa rtag lta ltos 'dzin rgyu/ /med pa'i mtha' dang mtha' med shes/ /kun nas rnam par mi g.yeng lta/ /gong tsodu shes pa yod smra lta/ /de bzhin med par lta ba dang / /'di gang 'di las gyur lta ba/ /gang du yod min med min lta / /bdag shi 'di tshe mya ngan 'das/ /gang 'dir phyogs tsam brten ⑩pa ni //gang ma yin pa ma yin nyid/ /phyogs log gol (nyebar gang gyur pa/ /drug ste ⑪so so tha dad dang / /spyir lta gang rig skyon med pa'o/ /rgyur lta byams pas dag par lta sna/ /'tsho ba bcos pas dag lta dang / /rgyan la lham dang gos 101—610

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i rlu shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bskad pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/611bcos pa/ / spa spungs 6)bcas dang rgyan can dang / /dka' thub sten ②pa drug pa'o/ /bslad ⑧pas 'chal 0pa gang 'di la/ /brten ⑤pas bdag lta rjorten rtog dang / /rten chags byin chags bkra shis mtshan/ /skyabs log yongs su 'chal ⑦pa'o/ /phyogs ltos gcod pa gang zhe na/ /phyi rol pa dang yang dag pa / /gsang sngags pa dang gsang chen pa'o/ /gang 'dir phyi rol rnam pa gsum / /bye brag pa dang tha snyad pa/ /rang snang gcig niphyogs gcod pa'o/ /yang dag phra dang zab pa dang / /rgya che yangs pa de kho na/ /gsang sngags rig byed rig spyod dang / /rigs sbyor dam par phyogs ltos gcod/ /gsang chen brtul 0zhugs cher spyod dang / /rgyal dbog ⑩pa dang rgyal thabs pa'o/ /zhar las byung ba gang 'di dag /mtha' yas sde bcur rdzogs pa ste/ /gang mu zin pa de yirtags 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nye gnas so/ /lang ma'i bdag po gzhan yang gang / /zhal nas byung ba ji lta ba/ /'jig rten sgron ma nub rjes na / /gang dag mos pa tha dad pas/ /zhar las byung ba'ang de bzhin no/ /kun shes spyod pa'ang rnam pa gnyis/ /rim gyis pa dang gcig pa'o/ /rim gyis 'jug pa rnam gsum du/ /phyin ci ma log pa nyid dang / /bsgrub 8spyod mngon rtogs gsum nyid do/ /'di yang khyad par rnam gnyis kyis/ /gsum gsum gnyis su dam pa yis/ /gsung ba khyod ci mi shes sam/ /des na che chung gnyis gsum drug /sgrub pa zab pa phra ba gnyis/ /blo che 8zab pa dman pa nyid / /spyod pa rlabs chen 8cha shas 8can/ /rgya che ba dang mtshan mar spyod/ /de ni gsang chen gsang bar bshad/ /mngon rtogs rnam gnyis phyi nang 'jug /mi mthun phyogs kyi chagal bzung nas/ /cha gnyis so sor 'dod pa 'byung / /101—611

61 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101phyi rol bye brag tha snyad gnyis/ /cha gnyis gcig las rtsod pa ①'byung / /nad ②'jug sems snang skyidabus mtha' med/ /phyi nang snrel zhir liphyogs 'dzin cing (ge/ /gang 'dir yinges par gcod pa 'byung / /mtha' dbus 'byed dang nges par 'jug /gtan la 'bebs pa de bzhin 'byung / /rang dang lta ba'i phyogs 'dzin cing / /brtsod (7)pas the tshom ⑧'byung ba dang / /dbus mtha' 'byed dang nges par 'jug /gtan la 'bebs pa de bzhin 'byung / /cig ⑨car 'jug pa'i yirnal 'byor pa/ /bya dang bya thabs bya med pa/ /skyes dang ma skyes skye 'gag med/ /'di kun ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs/ /ma 'dres mkha' la gza' skar bkram11/ /yongs su rdzogs pa mkha' khyab bdala'/ /'ja' snang mkha' ltar ma 'dres gcig /rmongs rim cig 8car 'jug spyod pa/ /'dod pa'i yul la zhen spong dang / /spyod ④sgyur shes rtogs spyod dbang byed/ /shes pa 'jig rten rtog 8'phags pa/ /spyod ⑩pa blo ldan dbang sgyur 'thabs /gang 'di'i snod kyang bzhir 3shegazigs te/ /zhen chags log srid rigs (khergyud can / /blo gros can gyi snod rnams rka ) la/ /bstan bya rnam pa bzhir gsungs pa/ /'dod rkyen bkri drung 2sto brgyud pa'i tshig /ldem dgongs ( gyedon dam nges pa bzhi//snod kyi rkyen dang sbyar ba yin/ /'di kun shes bya'i gzhi gcig la( ge/ /'dod pas mthong ba tha dad pa'o/ /'di ltar mthong sgo tha dad o )bzhin/ /rnam par snang 'byung bkod pa la/ /gang gis kun la zhugs bltas nas/ /gcig sa tu 'bebs pa dam pa'o/ /ji ltar bung ba khung tshol ba/ /kun du 'jug cing byung nas ni/ /rang gi gseng khung ( lhagang yin par/ /nges par 'jug cing gnas pa zhunaltar / /rnal 'byor don gyi 'a rjes tshol ba/ /spyod sgo ci yod bstun ( nyete bsdus )/ /101wa 612

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/613lta sgor ①'jug cing brtags ②bsdur nas/ /don dam nges pa'i gsang nyid la'o / /de nyid don gyi rjes gcad ①phyir/ /sgo mo kun nas bsdur ba yi/ /bslab par bya ba'i thabs yin te/ /goms par bya ba rab tu gces/ /lang ku'i bdag po de dag ni phyis 'byung bar snang ba'i sgo yongs su dbye ba yin te/kun nas bsdur bar bslab pa'i mtha' yongs su bgros par shes par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pas/ dman pa'i lus kyi sems dpa' rnams chos thams cad kyi sgo rang snang bar shes par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las chos thams cad kyi sgo rab tu dbye ba'i le'u zhes bya ste drug cu ④ brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag pos dman pa'i lus kyi sems dpa' rnams la smras pa/ kye grogs po dag mthar phyin par bya ba ni gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam pa ni bsam du med pa mthar phyin par bya'o//bsam du med pa ni sems kyi de kho na nyid du mthar phyin par bya'o/ /sems kyi de kho na nyid ni dgongs pa dam pa 'dus pa'i de kho na nyid du mthar phyin par bya'ol/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dgongs pa dam pa 'dus pa'i de kho na nyid la mkhas na sems kyi de kho na nyid la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /sems kyi de kho na nyid la mkhas na bsam du med pa la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /bsam du med pa la mkhas na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam pa la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mkhas na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yin te/ de ni dgongs pa kun nas 'dus pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ /grogs po dag de bas na bsam gyis 101—613

614 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101mi khyab pa'i chos thams cad kyi rnam pa ni rnal 'byor pa rnam pa gsum gyis yongs su 'grel pa ste/ gsum gang zhe na/ bya ba'i rnal 'byor dang / bya ba byed pa'i rnal 'byor dang / bya ba med pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /grogs po dag bya ba'i rnal 'byor yang gsum du shes par bya ste/ gsum gang zhe na/ phyi'i rnal 'byor dang —/ nang gi rnal 'byor dang / phyi nang gi rnal 'byor ro/ /grogs po dag de la phyi'i rnal 'byor gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen po dang / de bzhin du chu rdo rje dang / me rdo rje dang / rlung rdo rje dang /nam mkha' rdo rje dang / gzugs rdo rje dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang /reg dang / chos rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen po rnams dgongs pa dam pa de kho na nyid du mthar phyin cing phul du gyur ①pa'o/ /grogs po dag nang gi rnal 'byor ni 'di lta ste/ sems rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen po dang / de bzhin du ③rtog pa dang / dpyod ②pa la sogs pa gang zin pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor rnams dgongs pa dam pa de kho na nyid du mthar phyin cing phul du gyur pa'o/ /grogs po dag phyi nang gi rnal 'byor gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/thams cad dang / dkar po dang / nag po dang / nges pa dang / ma stinges pa dang / dman pa dang / dam pa dang / 'byung ba dang / mi 'byung ba dang ske/ byas pa dang / ma byas pa dang / bcas pa dang / ma bcas pa dang /spyi mthun (5)dang / khyad par gyi rnam pa rnams dgongs pa dam pa de kho na nyid du mthar phyin cing phul du gyur pa'o/ /grogs zhupo dag de dag ni bya ba'i rnal 'byor ⑦du shes par bya'o/ /bya ba byed pa'i rnal 'byor gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/rten pa dang / spyod (9pa dang / mig dang / khyad par dang / mi 'gyur ba 101—614

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bskad pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/615dang ske/ rtsal gyis gnon pa dang / kun nas rig pa'o/ /grogs po dag de dag kyang dgongs pa dam pa de kho na nyid du mthar phyin cing phul du gyur pa'o/ /grogs po dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ sbyor ba dang / mi gnas pa dang /bskyod pa dang / bsgyur ba dang / rtsal dang / 'byung ba dang / 'jug pa dang —/ sgo dang / shes pa dang / gnas dang / rig pa dang / lam dang /'jug pa dang / ye shes dang / khyab pa'i rnam pa de dag kyang dgongs pa dam pa ①de kho na ②nyid du mthar phyin cing phul du gyur pa yin pa'o/ /gzhan yang mthong ba dang / ma yengs pa dang / don dang / tshig dang / sngags dang /yi ge'i sgo rnam pa de dag kyang dgongs pa dam pa de kho na nyid du mthar phyin cing phul du gyur pa'o/ /grogs po dag de dag ni bya ba byed pa'i rnal 'byor du shes par bya'o/ /kye grogs po dag bya ba med pa'i rnal 'byor gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sa dang / bslab pa dang / sbyor ba dang / rtog pa dang / ltung ba dang /ma nor ba dang / nges pa dang / dgongs pa dang / ye shes dang / tshogs dang ske/ bsgrub pa dang / dngos grub sridang / ting nge 'dzin dang / chen po dang ske/ ye shes dang / byung tshul dang / che ba dudang / rol pa dang / rngom ⑤pa dang / brjid pa dang / mthu dang / cho 'phrul dang / yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam pa dag dgongs pa dam pa de kho na nyid mthar phyin cing phul du gyur par bya'o/ /de yang ji lta ⑥zhe na/ grogs po dag 'di lta ste/ ji ltar mthon ri rtse dag la/ /sgyid mi lug par brtson 'dzegs na/ /mthon sar ⑦snang mthong kun gsal bas/ /thams cad kun snang lam la mkhas/ /de bzhin shes rab mthon ri la/ /brtson ⑧pa dam pas kun bltas na⑨/ /kun gyi phul du shes rab 101—615

616 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101phyin / /mkhas pa'i ye shes tshad med do/ /don la mkhas par bya ba stekyi/ /phul du byung ba'i bslab pa ste/ /dgongs pa dam pa de nyid la/ /mkhas par bya ba rab tu gces/ /grogs po dag de dag ni mthar phyin par bya ba rab tu shes par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pas/ dman pa'i lus kyi sems dpa' rnams kun gyi ②phul du gyur par dgongs pa dam pa de kho na nyid la bzod pa thob par gyur to①/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ④dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya ⑤ste drug cu yidagu pa'o// //de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag pos dam pa rnams la smras pa/ grogs po dag thams cad du 'du bar byas pa ni 'di lta ste/ bya ba dang / rang bzhin dang —/ bsgyur bas so/ /grogs po dag de la bya ba ni bsdu ba'i bya bas so/ /rang bzhin ni chos nyid kyis so/ /bsgyur bas 'dul bar bya ba ni 'di lta ste/rgyu dang / dus dang / tshad dang / grags pa dang / gags ⑦dang /rtags dang / thob pa'o/ /grogs po dag de la rgyu ni yo byad chen po lnga kho na'o/ /dus ni mtha' bcu rdzogs pa dang / nye bar dris pa dang / rigs can (nya'adu ba dang / gsal ba thob pa dang / las su rung ba dang / mtshan ma 'byung ba dang ske/ mang po sngags (9)pa dang / nyams rnyed pa dang / bya ba rdzogs pa'o/ /grogs po dag tshad ni 'di lta ste/ ded dpon dang / snga ⑩ltas dang / smin spyopa'o / /grogs po dag ded dpon gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ goms pa dang /rig pa dang / 'du ba dang / thob pa dang / rdzogs pa'o/ /grogs po dag snga ltas ni 'di lta ste/ mthong ba dang / 'byor pa dang / nus pa dang thos ⑫101—616

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/617pa'o / /grogs po dag smin pa ni 'di lta ste/ mngon spyod dang / mi bskyod pa'o0)la/ /grogs po dag grags pa ②gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gang chu bo bzhi'i rgyud du byung ba dang / gang dag las 'phags pa dang / gang dang ldan pa dang / gang la mkhas pa dang / gang thob pa nyid do/ /grogs po dag gags chagang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ༷thob pa dang / mi chags pa dang / mi gos pa dang / sreg pa'o/ /rtags gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ grags pa dang /'gyur ba dang / btsan ⑤pa dang / 'byung ba'o/ /grogs po dag thob pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bskur bas thob pa dang / rtsal gyis thob pa'o/ /grogs po dag de yang ⑥'di ltar thob par rig par bya ste/ gang 'dir snying rje'i yul rnams la/ /byin brlabs ⑦'byung ba gang yang rung / /'dun pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag la/ /glegs bam bcu gnyis sbyin par bya/ /gang sbyor ba yi nirnal 'byor la/ /nyi zla gnyis ni sbyin par bya/ /dbugs chen 'byin pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rin chen bdun nyid nges par 'thobaskyo/ /lung chen thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /g.yung drung brgyad dag thob pa yin/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rtsal bcu'i khyad par de nyid 'thoba'i/ /kun gyi 0bla ma dam pas ni/ /rtog stong 'bar ba 8bla med 'thobatso/ /dgongs pa kun 'dus gsang chen 'di/ /ma thos gzu lums rang bshad pas/ /rab 'byam ④bstan pa kun brtsal tsoyang / /dam pa mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar rgyal rigs rgyud byung ba/ /mang pos dbang por dpon bstabs 0te/ /'khor lo la sogs rin chen gyis/ /kun la dbang sgyur ⑩thob pa ltar/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor rgyud byung ba/ /chos kyi yirgyal por dbang bstabs te/ /rtog 4)stong 'bar ba la 101—617

618 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101sogs pas/ /khyad 6)par bla ma dam par 'gro/ /'di ni bla ma'i khyad par te②/ /rgyal sar nges par 'byung ba ③yi/ /rtsal gyis bgrod cing bslab pa'i thabs /goms par bya ba rab tu gces/ /kye grogs po dag de dag ni thams cad 'du bar bya ba yongs su bgros par shes par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pasaX/dman pa dam pa dag lung dam pa bstan 0pa'i drod thob par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ⑥dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las rnal 'byor dam pa lung bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya gaste bdun cu (9pa'o// //de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag po des dman pa'i lus kyi ⑨sems dpa' rnams la smras pa/ kye grogs po dag la dor bar bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ gang go cha gyon ⑩pa'i rjes su mi ldog par 'gro ba ste/ 'di ltar ji bzhin pa'i rjes su ji snyed pa 'gro ba/ nam mkha'i rjes su 'byung ba 'gro ba bzhin sems nyid kyi rjes su sems las byung ba 'gro ba yin/ chos nyid kyi rjes su chos thams cad 'gro ⑪ba yin/ de bzhin du dgongs pa dam 7pa'i rjes su gang gsung ba dang / gang mdzad pa thams cad 'gro bas na/ dgongs pa kun nas 'dus pa ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du gang du spyod pa de ltar ro/ /kye grogs po dag de yang 'di lta ste/mnyam 7dang mi mnyam mi mnyam mnyam/ /kun nas mi mnyam yongs su timanyam/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i khyad par yang / /gang dang don gyi mnyam par spyodabya/ /byin gyi ⑩brlabs kyis 7spyod pa 'am/ /dbang sgyur tho)thabs kyi spyod pa ste/ /dper na nam mkha' rgyal po 'am/ /ji ltar me dpung chu bo 'dra/ / de yang de yul 7che chung gis/ /khyad par nyid kyis brlabs ( )pa yin/ /rgyal po de yang 101—618

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor spub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/61khyad par gyis/ /dbang sgyur ①bya ba'i khams rnams la/ /che chung rim pa yod pa bzhin/ /rnal 'byor sngags tshul de ltar snang / /thabs chen spyod la 'jug phyipa yang / /bab tshod ③thad du 'jug pa ste/ /dper na glang 0chen chur ⑤'jug pa / /rab dang glang 0chen bab mi lta/ /de yang rtsal sgyid ⑦drag zhan ⑤gyis/ /la la thad du gcod pa la/ /la la chu yi ⑨gzhol phyogs so/ /de ltar rnal 'byor spyod 'jug pa/ /'bras bu don la bab gcod kyang / /rtsal 'phang mtho ⑩dman khyad par gyis/ /ji ltar nus tshad de spyod phyir/ /sa dang gnas skabs ye shes dang / /sgrib dang gol sa rtog pa dang / /spyod dang dam tshig ting 'dzin dang / /dus dang dngos grub mthar phyin dang / /lta ba'i khyad par gnas gyur nas/ /thams cad gcig las med na yang / /grangs sam dbye ba grags ⑩phyag rnams/ /snod kyi rtsal dang sbyar nas ni/ /khyad par ci yang bstan pa yin/ /de yang rtsal gyi khyad par gyisakyi/ /dang po las kyi khyad par las8/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor chung ngu rnams/ /rang rang rtsa ba bor nas ni/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor laci/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i tshul/ /spyod par byed dang don 'dod pa8/ /sbal bus mkha' lding las spyad 0kyang / /btsal ⑩ba'i yul ni chad 8ma yin/ /nor 4)bu las kyi 'phang dmas pa / /rang skal 'tsho ba'i tshod bor nas/ /rgyal po thabs kyis 'phang 0mtho ba'i/ /longs spyod che la dmigs bcas kyang / /de dag mi 'thob du'atsho bral zhing / /skal ldan can gyi don 'di dag /skal 0zhan dag gis 'grub par dka'o/ /de phyir dgongs pa kun 'dus la(3/ /gang 'dir rnal 'byor dman don du/ /gso dang sbyong ba'i spyod pa dag /dman pa dag dang mnyam par gsungs/ /101wa 619

6 0 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ () 101gso dang bslang ①ba'i rtog pa 'di/ /rtog pa can dang mthun par spyad/ /gso ba rtog pas zin pa'i nad/ /lta spyod nyams ②pa'i sman gyis gso/ /shi ⑧bslang ba yi rtog pa 'di/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i nad pa rnams/ /rtag chad mthar shi ro gling nas/ /gti mug bam chen ro blangs te/ /skye 'gag med par blang ba'i phyir/ /ro la yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /sngags kyis btab ①ste gnon ⑤par bya/ /ro ⑥yi gnyen por ⑦bdag gyur nas/ /ro sngags rgyun mi 'chad par bzlasam/ /ro yi gzi byin byung ba na/ /bar chad med pa'i brtson 'grus bya/ /ro de 'gul bar gyur pa dang / /gang gi 'gyur rtsis byug par bya/ /ro yi yan lag kun bcings nas/ /bzlas pa drag po rgyun mi gcad/ /gang der langs ⑧par gyur pa dang / /cho ⑨'phrul 'jigs tshal tiston par byed/ /brtul zhugs ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /de tshe ro yi lce bcad yinas/ /ro la brdabs na gser du 'gyur/ /de bzhin ji ltar 'dod pa yi8/ /rkyen gyis bsgyur na de ltar 'gyur / /lce bshad ral gri mtshon cha dang / /ro yi mgo bo gcad pa des/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i rdzas 'grub ste/ /mgo thod go char bzung nas ni/ / lce yi ⑫ral gri mtshon tsothogs nas/ /lha min g.yul skeyang bzlog par 'gyur/ /ro langs 0grub pa'i rkang 'gyogs ⑩ni/ /dpag pa'i tshad las 'das pa ste/ /skyes bu rtsal dang ldan pa yis/ /phyogs bzhir (stebaltas te dus gcig tu/ /mda' 7'phangs sa la ma babs par/ /mtha' blangs skad cig 'jig rten bskor / /skyes bu lag tshod ma yal 'gyebar/ /de ma thag tu gnas su slebs/ /yud 9 1ltar shin tu myur ba 'thob/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa ra la 'dod pa thams cad 'byung / /ro la ror bsgrubs ro grub na/ /ro yi dngos po 101—620

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/6 1mi snang ①bar/ /gang ltar bsgrubs pa de snang phyir/ /ro la rnam rtog ga la yod//ro la ro yi rang bzhin dag /med par shes pas thag chod bzhin/ /spyod pas de ltar mnyam spyad ②na/ /lta spyod mnyam zhes dam pas ②bshad/ /'di ni shi ba slong ba yi/ /bdud rtsi dam pa'i spyod pa'o ༷zhes/ /dgongs pa dam pa'i kun 'dus gsungs/ /grogs po dag de dag ni shi ba slong ba'i rtog pa yongs su spyod par shes par bya'o/ /grogs po dag de la sbyong ba'i duspyod pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rtog pa'i zug rngu sbyang ba dang / rgyud ⑨yongs su sbyang ⑦ba'o/ /de la rtog pa'i zug rngu sbyang ba ni gang rtog pa'i dngos po sbyong ba'o⑧/ /grogs po dag rgyud yongs su sbyang ba ni bkod pa'i bya bas sbyang ba dang / me'i ⑨bya bas sbyang ba'oglu/ /de la bkod ⑩pa'i bya bas sbyang ⑩ba gang zhe na/ brtsam kyipa las kyi dang po dang / /dam pa'i don la 'jug pa na/ /thabs mchog lngas ni sbyang bar ⑫bya / /rdo rje dus tshigs bsnyen pa dang / /gang 'dir ④nye bar bsgrub pa dang / / sgrub po tsochen pos sbyor ba la/ /grangs dus mtshan mar bcas par bya/ /rnal 'byor bcad pa'i bka' 8sgo 'dir/ / gsang sgo ⑩mi dbye skrag par 'gyur/ /ci phyir dang po yin pas na/ /byis pa blo shed ma bye btunye/ /ma nges ldog 'jug bcas pa yis(1/ /theg chen don las gol bar 'gyur/ /gnas 'dir 'jug pa'i byis pa dag /'jig rten drug las drangs nas kyang / /'gyur dbang ma nges sar sum̐ )bzhag ste/ /ji ltar 'tsham par bde thabs sbyar/ /rdo rje thabs chen tshom bu lnga/ /rdo rje 'dzin tshogs bcu drug ldan/ /dbyings kyi (nyedakyil 'khor rdo rje can/ /bri bya yang na bsam pa'amadu/ /brjod dam dngos sam mtshan ma la/ /'jig rten dbang po chos lugs kyis/ /mos pa la bskyed so dran byas te/ /rang 101—621

6 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ la 101bzhin yul las phan nas ni/ /phyag bya la sogs mchod na ni/ /rdo rje dman ①dang rtsir sbyar ba②/ /yo byad chen po la sogs pas/ /rdo rje thabs kyi tshogs la dbul / /rdo rje rnal 'byor glu ⑧blangs te/ /mnyes byas las grub grangs rdzogs nas / /mnyes nas rgyud sbyangs ④'dod par bya/ /snod du rung ba'i slob ma dag /dbang mkhyen la sogs bya ba yis/ /'jug tshul dbang dang dngos grub stsolaske/ /rdo rje tha tshig durnam lnga yis/ /bslab pa'i gnyer durnams ci rigs par//rtsal gyi rnam par byin nas kyang / /rdo rje gal chen mna' bor ro/ /de nas sgrub ⑦pa che chung rnams/ /ji ltar 'dod pa nan tan gyis/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dka' ⑧bya'o/ /mi nus la sogs mi snang ba'i/ /rdo rje'i tshig gis nan chags bya / /rmongs pa gang phyir sems bskyed de/ /ngo mtshar ⑦tshig gi 'du shes bsgyur / /shes rab mig can shes bya'i yul/ /thams cad rim bzhin bstan par bya/ /drod can blo dkyil 0che rnams la/ /rnal 'byor nang ⑩par gsang sgo dbye / / rtsing po 8'gros kyi tshudamu rgod la/ /gcan 'phrang tso'akhor ba'i g.yeng rnams bstan/ /rdo rje lung gi tshig can la/ /ji ltar nus pa de dbang bskur/ /rtsal med mi nus gang dag la/ /phan pa 'ba' zhig bsngags pa yin/ /gnas 'dir tsogasal dang mi gsal dag /'od mi dbab cing ljid mi dbabatso/ /rdo rje blo yi 0yul can la/ /rtsal chen sbyong zhes gdam ()par bya/ /rdo rje 'dus pa'i dbang gral du/ /rdo rje don gyi ltang yichen bsheradu/ /rtsal dang rim pa khyad par dbye/ /so so'i rigs kyi phyag rgya dag /spyi 'am yang na re re'o/ /gzhan yang shes rab gzungs kyi tshogs/ /ji ltar thabs kyi tshogs sbyor ltar/ /gang dag rnal 'byor mar ldan rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma la sogs pa/ /lha 0mo 101—622

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'phyor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/6 datshogs su bkod nas kyang / /gnas 'dir 'jug dga' la sogs pa/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya mtshan mar sbas①/ /rdo rje mnyam pa'i gzungs rnams la/ /mnyam pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /bro gar glu tshig ②la sogs ③pas/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor ma rnams bsgrubadu/ /gzhan yang dus bzhi mnyam rig na/ /dus zhes bya bar ga la rigs/ /dus bzhi mnyam par rab shes na/ /de nyid mnyam pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rdo rje lha mo dus kyi tsotshogs/ /'das dang da ltar byung ba dang / /mi 'byung ma nges yicha rnams la/ /dbang sgyur ⑦mnyam pa'i rgyal mo rnams/ /'jig dang skye dang smin pa dang / /stongs par gyur pa de dag tu/ /rdo rje rnam thar tshad med dang / /sems dang de bzhin mnyam pa yi/ /shes rab 'khor dang dam pa'i dkyil/ /ji ltar rim par rdo rje yi/ /glu gar la sogs yo byad kyisal/ /mchod dang 'jug tshul ji lta ⑨bar/ /cha rnams dus las mi 'da' bar/ /lha yi nyi ⑩ma rnams la'o/ /bde ba chen po la sogs pa/ /tshom bu'am yang na phyag rgya rnams/ /spyir ram re rer sbyar bar 0bya'o/ /'das pa rnam thar tshogs bskrun te/ /da ⑩ltar 'byung dang mi 'byung la/ /tshad med sems dang rnam thar bskrun/ /de ni mnyam pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor byang chub sems/ /rdzogs pa bcu drug zla rgyas tshul/ /snying rje ye shes shar ba na/ /mkha' la nyi shar tshul bzhin du/ /dam pa'i 8rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /yang dag nges 8pa'i sa pa yin/ /bcu gsum la la bgrod pa ni / /rdo rje dus kyi rgyun tshogs sbyar/ /skar tshogs dbus na zla nya ba/ /bcu drug zhag gis rdzogs pa bzhin/ /bcu gsum rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i sa bcu drug tshogs kyis rdzogs pas na/ /brjes pa'i zla ba bcu drug gis/ /nyi gsal 101—623

6 4 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101'od kyi phyag rgya la/ /mdzes par spras pa'i bde ba de/ /bcu drug tshogs kyi ①rdzogs pa bskrun/ /rdzogs pa nyid na mi dmigs pa/ /de bzhin nyid du sbyangs pas na/ /mnyam pas stong par gyur pa la/ /thams cad chos skur rdzogs byang chub / /sdug bsngal byang chub gnyis med de/ /rmad byung sems bskyed las chen spyad / /phra mo drod du gyur pa na/ /dam pa spyad na nyi ma 'char/ /dus 'di rgyun gyi bar chad na/ /snyan ②pa dag gis bzlog par dka'acha/ /bar chad byung na bskang gso dubya/ /mkha' la zla gsal grwa ⑧rgyas bzhin/ /sa la rnal 'byor grwa ①rgyas spyad/ /gang 'di rgyas na bsod nams dang / /bsngo ba chen po'i las rnams bya/ /des ni nyi 0zla zhon 'gro ba'i/ /rig 'dzin sa la gnas phan chadadu / /bde chen bcu gsum sa la 'grub①/ /gzhan yang rgyun du bya ba ni/ /chos kun rgyal ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rgyal ba sku gsung 0thugs su snang / /sku dang gsung thugs phyag rgya dag /yi ge phreng ba nyid la rdzogs/ /yi ge phyag rgya'i ye shes rnams/ /rgyun gyi rgyun du bya ba yin/ /des ni rgyun gyi ⑩ting 'dzin thob//rgyun gyi rgyun du mi gcad pa/ /rdo rje nam dang nyi 'tshod la/ /yi ge'i tshogs ni bskyed sbyar la/ /mchod bsnyen bcas sbyar de bzhin no/ /'di ni don dam nye ba'i lam/ /dam pa bskrun par (nye'agyur phyir phyir7/ /'dir ni rgyun gyi rgyun tshogs des/ /dam pa'i dam par de nyid 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rdo rje dra ba'i dbyings / /thugs kyi yigasang chen gsang ba 'di/ /rdo rje rdo rje yin pas na/ /rdo rje dbang yul 'brel pas ni/ /thams cad 'byung bas dbyings zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma 'dzin rdzogs bcas/ /'khril mnyam pa yang de bzhin te⑩/ /gzugs brnyan 6)ting 'dzin rang bzhin gnas/ /ji ltar rim bzhin sbyar byas 101—624

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/6 5na / /ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar ni/ /'dod pa'i khams ltar mnyam par gsungs / /gzhan yang gang du gang 'brel pa'i/ /gsang chen dam pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin 'di/ /phan tshun dra bas 'brel pa la / /stong nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /sprul pa bye ba cir ①yang snang ②/ /gnyis med dra ba'i tshul du 'breladu/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i yul de nyid/ /rtsal dang ldan pa'i gsang sgo ba/ /'di la gsang sgo dbye bar bya'o/ /gsang 'dir chud pa'i bu rnams ni/ /blo gros chen po ④thabs ldan pas/ /mi skrag dga' ba'i ngo mtshar skye/ /gsang chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /rdo rje rgyal po rgyal mor bcas/ /lnga gnyis zung du 'khril ⑤ba ni/ /g.yas nas g.yon du 'khril 0tshul sbyor/ /g.yas nyid byang chub rdo rje dang / /rang rang mtshan ma 'bar ba'o/ /g.yon nyid sgra brnyan rgyadril bu dang / /rtags kyis mdzes par gsal ba la/ /'phyo nizhing 'dud pa'i mdangs ldan pas/ /chags shing g.yo ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /seng chen g.yo ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /seng chen khyu mchog la sogs pa/ /sems pa 5)dman pa'i lus khri la/ /rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis bsgyings bcas te/ /kha dog lnga yi cha'od 'bar ba/ /bcu gsum cha lugs bsgegs 0pa rnams / /rim gyis sam ni cig car tsobaskyed/ /gang 'dir ti'adod khams chags zhen pa'i/ /dbang po rim par sbyang bar bya/ /de min yab yum yang tsomi dmigs/ /gsang nyid tshogs kyi 'khor rnams kyang / /gnas 'gyur ba yi rdzirang bzhin gyis/ /phyag rgya rgyal po rgyal mor ⑩bcas/ /brgyad gnyis zung sgril 'khril 'byung tsosbyor/ /sa dang nam mkha' spyan rdo rje/ /byams dang rdo rje kun bzang dpal/ /nang dang phyi yi yo byad ni/ /bzhi gnyis dag gis mnyer 8sbyor 101—625

6 6 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101ba / /bsam bya la sogs de bzhin no/ /rdo rje sgo dang bcas par ni/ /rdo rje 'khril 'khyud ①gsang ba'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod cher sbyar bas/ /mnyes nas sbyar phyir rim bzhin dbul/ /gsang ba'i 'jug tshul la sogs kyis//gsang ba'i don rnams bsgrub par bya/ /'jug sgo spyod dang lta ba mthun/ /thams cad gcig par gyur pa yi/ /rgyu dang rkyen ldan phun sum tshogs/ /mdza' ②'phrod rkyen dang dgyes nisbyor ldan/ /lha dang rig 'dzin rnal 'byor ril / /ma lus tshogs pas chos 'di spyad/ /skad cig ༷yud tsam thang cig gam / /yud tsam nyin gcig duzla re 'am/ /lo yi nyi ma bkra shis kyi/ /dus la bab pa'i dus chen dag /byin gyis brlabs ⑥pa'i dus chen yin/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i yo byad rnams/ /dag dang ma dag khyad par gyis/ /gtsang ma kha zas la sogs dang / /rnam rtog nad 'joms bdud rtsi rnams/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs dang 'byung po la/ /ji ltar 'byor ldan nan tan bya/ /bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka ⑦dang / /chos kyi ⑧don du mi 'gyur ba'i/ /skyon bzhi spangs te bzlog tshul sbyar/ /rnal 'byor snying dang mig lta bur/ /gdung ba'i 'du shes nyer gzhag ⑨ste/ /ji bzhin 'dod ltar bde bar sbyar/ /lha rnams mnyes par bya ba dang / /bgegs rnams zhi bar bya ba dang / /don grub shi ba gso ba'i phyir/ /las 'di spyad par 7shin tu gces/ /'di dag blo chung gsar 0zhugs pa'i/ /mdun du brjod par bya ba'i rigs/ /rdzas dang yo byad thams cad kyang / /cis 'dul de ltar rtsal dang sbyaratso/ /des 8na las 'di khyad par yang / /tshogs la tshogs bskyed sgrib 0sbyangs te/ /bsnyen pa dag la goms byas nas/ /bsgrubs 8pas 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'o/ /de skad sems 101—626
