de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/6 7dpa' rdo rje des/ /'dus pa phal mo che la bshad/ /'dus pa kun gyi ①don mthong ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de la gsol/ /sems dpa' chen po bdag cag gis / /chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin ni/ /thabs nyid shes rab nyid ②bkod ②dang ske/ /kun nas mnyam dang bcu drug cha/ /yi ge tshogs dang 'byung ba'i dbyings / /gnyis med dra bar 'brel la sogs/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan du/ /snang bar nges par mthong lags so/ /de skad gsol pas des gsungs pa/ /gang 'dir 'dus pa'i tshogs med byakun/ /ji ltar mthong ba de ltar yin/ /ye nas ma bcos ji bzhin nyid/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor de kho na/ /dgongs pa dam pa lhun grub pa/ /ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor dam pa nyid / /de dag rtsa ba sems nyid pas/ /sems can gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor gsal/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor dul/ /thams cad ye nas zhugs bkod rdzogs/ /de las khyad par skal ldan mi⑥/ /spyod yul gyur pa gzugs brnyan te/ /ras 'jam khod snyoms bzang la sogs/ /kha dog lnga 'am gnyi shu lngas/ /ma mthong rmongs la bsten ②phyir mtshon/ /ma nyams mtshan mas de rangs 'gyur/ /bsten ①zhing des ⑩'jam khang 0bu la/ /kha dog 'bar bar gzugs mtshon te/ /phyag rgya ma nyams mdzes ldan na/ /mtshan ma'i cho 'phrul ston par nus/ /gser dngul 8zangs lcags la sogs la8/ /gang blugs rgyal ba'i sku byas te/ /phyag rgya ma nyams dang ldan na/ /de yang mtshan ma'i rten du 'gyurabya/ /shel rdo dung la sogs pa la/ /'bur las rgyal ba'i sku byas na/ /de bzhin ma nyams rgyas mdzad na/ /mtshan ma 'byung ba'i rten du 'gyur / /blag ⑩sha byang chub shing sogs la/ /mkhas pas bzor bzhogs 101—627

6 8 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (gyi 101 gzugs brnyan ①gyis/ /phyag rgya ma nyams kun rdzogs na/ /'di yang mtshan ma'i rten du 'gyur/ /sa la sogs la phyag rgya byas/ /kha dog mdzes dang ldan byas la②/ /mtshan ma 'byung ba'i rten yin te/ /mtshan mas mtshan ma grol rig pa / /gang dag sa las rgyal ba'i dbyibs/ /kun du lham par byas pa la /tshon ②rtsi lnga yis mdzes bkod ④na/ /rnam grol (5)rig pa'i rten du 'gyur/ /gang gi gzugs brnyan gang yin dang / / de yi 6nyerang bzhin gcig pas na⑦/ /'di la khyad par cung zad med/ /'di yis rnam grol rig par 'gyur/ /bder dugashegs pho brang gang yang rung / /dkyil 'khor tshul du gang byed pa/ /yid 'ong mtshan ldan dben phyogs su/ /kun nas lham par mdzes byas la/ /srad bu brgyad dang ldan ⑨byas te/ /bsdu ba'i bya bas mdzes byas payi/ /de nas srad bu gcig gis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor tshul du gyur pa dang / /nang du lham bu srad 0bu brgyad/ /le'u tshe ldan pa dgur 'gyur te/ /mtha' zad sum char byas pa la/ /kun gyi nang du srad bu gsuma'i/ /phra mo dag gis mdzes par brgyana'o/—snyel/ /dgu yi char ni bgos pa la/ /sgo dang sgo khyud sum cha bya/ /ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes byas la/ /rin chen ka ba'i nang logs su/ /sangs rgyas pho brang dbu rtser bya/ /bsdu ba tshad med rnam thar sgo/ /rim pa gsum gyis mdzes pa la/ /rta babs them skas kyis kyang brgyan/ /dbus kyi pho brang le'u tshe 'am/ /'khor lo dpal be'u pad+ma dang / /④rin chen zur brgyad la sogs pa/ /ji ltar rigs pa de bzhin bri/ /rgyan ni rin chen sna tshogs dang / / pañtsa ra 7ka twa yir na / /phreng ba dang ni dra bas brgyan(1/ /za ra tshags yi dang chun (7'phyang dang / /dril bu g.yer ka gi 〉the'u chung 'phyang / /rol mo sgra sgrogs lha yi bu/ /mang pos phyi 101—628

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/6 9nang nam mkha' las/ /mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba bri/ /theg chen gdung bzhis rab brgyan ①te/ /rin chen kha bad mchod rten dang / /rgyal mtshan rin chen 'od 'bar bas/ / gzhal yas lamadzes par brgyan ①pa ni/ /chos kyi dupho brang ci 'dra bar/ /de 'dra de nyid mtshon par bri/ /gzhal yas khang du gang rgyur ⑤ba/ /kun gyis mdzes dang legs par brgyan/ /mchod pa bla na yod med kun / /ji ltar 'byor ltar nan tan dbul/ /rgyal srid longs spyod bcas pa dang ske/ /glu bro gar dang rol mor bcas/ /dug 'joms sman dang bdud rtsi rnams / /rgyal ba durgya mtsho snyed ⑦la dbul/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi mchod sbyar bas//rgyud byang thams cad mnyam par 'gyur/ /de skad smras pas 'dus ⑧pa kun/ /thams cad rgyud byang rnam grol rig /grogs po dag de dag ni bkod pa'i bya bas yongs su sbyang bar shes par bya'o/ /grogs po dag 'di la me'i bya bas yongs su sbyang ⑨ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad chos nyid du sbyang ba'i phyir dngos po thams cad me'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pas 'dus pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis chos thams cad me'i rang bzhin du snang bar mthong ste / shin tu ngam ⑩nas ngo mtshar du bstod ⑩pa/ /e ma'o sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /che ba'i che ba byin brlabs tsoche/ /ting 'dzin chen po snang ba che/ /cho 'phrul chen po sna tshogs che/ /thabs mchog dpag gis mi lang ste/ /chos kun me dpung 'bar skyobar snang tso/ /de nyid ye shes gsal ba'i klong / /'bar 'phro gsal bar gyur pa ni/ /mun gsal dngos po thams cad bsregs / /bde chen dbyings su kun rdzogs par/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis mdzad pa lags/ /'bar ba chen po a la la/ /gzi brjid zer 'phro a la la/ /mtha' yas kun 101—629

630 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ la 101sdud a la la/ /thams cad sreg byed a la la/ /za byed chen po a la la/ /mtha' dang dbus med a la la/ /thugs rje bde mchog a la la/ /dbang phyug 'jigs ①byed a la la/ /gsang mchog rmad 'byung ②byin brlabs ①kyis/ / me yi durang bzhin chen po dag /bdag cag rnams la bshad du gsol/ /de skad 'dus pas gsol pa las/ /de nyid dgyes pas 'di skad du/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje me yi durang bzhin dag /nges par bshad kyis gus par nyon/ /khyad par bla ma'i lam mchog 'dis/ /rnal 'byor thabs su bde sbyar bas/ /rgyal ba kun mnyes kun bsregs sbyangs⑥/ /don grub las kyi mchog tu sbyangs/ /ji bzhin pa yi ༷hom khung du/ /ji snyed pa yi yam ⑧shing la / /de bzhin nyid kyi me byung bas/ /thams cad thams cad bsregs ①sbyangs thim / /skye med rnam dag hom khung du/ /skye ba rnam bzhi'i yam ⑩shing la/ /ma skyes spros bral me byung bas/ /mtshan ma'i bag chags bsregs 7sbyangs thim/ /bsam du med pa'i hom ⑩khung du/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yam ⑩shing la/ /'od dpag med pa'i me byung bas/ /mtha' yas rdul 8snyed bsregs 0sbyangs thim/ /chos nyid rnam dag hom khung du/ /chos can sna tshogs yam ⑩shing la/ /stong nyid ⑩le shes me 'bar bas/ /dngos po'i bag 4)chags bsregs yisbyangs thim/ /sems nyid rnam dag hom khung du/ /sems can skye 'gro yam ()shing la/ /rang 'byung 0ye shes me 'bar bas/ /'khor ba'i bag chags bsregs 6)sbyangs thim/ /kun gzhi bha ga'i hom khung du/ /nyon mongs lnga yi yam dushing la/ /ye shes lnga yi 6) me byung bas/ /gzung du'adzin rtog pa bsregs (nyasbyangs thim/ /snang srid nam mkha'i (1hom khung du/ /'byung ba bzhi yi yam 69shing la/ /phyag rgya 'bar ba'i 101—630

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/631me byung bas/ /snang srid dngos po bsregs ①sbyangs thimaphyi/ /rnam bzhi las kyi hom khung du/ /bzhi 'am bzhi yi yam ①shing la/ /rigs bzhi 'bar ba'i me byung bas/ /mchod sbyin dngos po bsregs ⑤sbyangs thim/ /'di yang so so'i khyad par gyis/ /phyogs dang kha dog dbyibs dang rdzas/ /gang ltar rigs ⑤pa de ltar sbyar⑥/ /shar lho nub byang dkar ser dmar/ /mthing ga ⑦nag po thal mdog (nyasbyar/ /zlum po pad+ma le'u tshe bzhi/ /'khor lo gru bzhi zur brgyad rgyas/ /zla gam gru chad gzhu dbyibs dbang / /gru gsum bha ga'i mkha' mngon spyod/ /gsum brtsegs 6)mdangs dang ri mor mdzes/ /las kyi yam ⑩shing rdzas kyis brgyan / /ye shes rdo rje las rgyud ldan/ /bla ma gsum gyi 7thabs mchog sbyar/ /dag pa'i 8mtha' mnyes mchog 'dzin patso/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i glu bro gar/ /mchod pa nges pa'i 'byor tsotshogs sbyar/ /rdo rje las kyi 8byin brlabs tsosbyor/ /gsang ba las kyi rgyud ldan pas/ /bsher ⑩btab zhi ba'i lha ()rgyud dang / /rgyasadang dbang bshad rgyud bshad pas/ /lha dang sngags dang phyag yirgya dang / /de bzhin glu kyi yi rgyud 'byor bya/ /rigs kyi rigs rgyud 0lnga rnams ni/ /so so rigs su bsher ()btab ste/ /klong tsoyangs 'khyil pa'i hom khung du/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba yis/ /sbyang dang thob phyir bsreg ④byar 'os/ /dpag med rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /che ba sngags ⑥pa'i yon tan dag /rdo rje glu yis brjod nas kyang / /mnyes par bya ba'i thabs chen brtsamadu/ /mnyes pa'i las rnams rdzogs pa dang / /gang yang ma byang don chen rnams/ /grub dang ma grub de rnams dag /me ( nyel mkhas pas brtag par bya/ /me sgra duganyis dang kha dog gnyis/ /'bar tshul du)gnyis dang dbyibs rnams drug /de dag yongs su 101—631

6 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101shes par bya/ /gal te mtshan la ①mi sdug na/ /yid ②du mi 'ong rtags yin pas / /sreg ①sbyang chen pos rgyas par bya/ /de nas yid 'ong 'dod 'byung ba/ /me la 'dod pa'i mtshan ma rnams/ /rnam ④gsum gang ltar 'grub pa blang / /'dus pa chen po gzhan yang gang / /ro yi ⑤rdzos rnams sreg sbyang khyin/ /ro la sngags kyis btab nas kyang / /shin tu dri zhim sna tshogs kyis/ /ro la byug cing ⑦bkru bar bya/ /bdud rtsi zhun chen khu ba yis/ /ras la byugs ⑧pas ro dkris pasadhi / /ro yi gnas rnams gang yin par/ /sngags kyi 0sbyor ba kun bkod nas / /phyag rgya'i mtshan mas gdab par bya/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa gang —/ / de yi ⑩mtshan pa'i ⑩phyag rgya rnams/ /gang du bkod pa de nyid du/ /snying po grangs kyang de ltar bya/ /snying po dag la so so yiX/ /ma nor rtsa ba'i yig 'bru dag /ras sam shing la bris te dgod/ / ro yi ④sbyor ba rdzogs pa dang —/ /ro yi phyi rgyab thams cad du/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba kun bkod de/ /ras sam shing shun gang dag la/ /'khor ba'i sa bon thams cad dgod/ /nyon mongs lnga dang dug gsum bcas/ /skye bzhi las lnga rgyud 'drug rnams/ /ming ⑩dang gzugs su byas nas ni/ /gnas gnas dag tu dgod par bya/ /sa bon 'du byed dngos po lnga/ /gzung tu 'dzin ming du bcas pa rnams/ /brda (nyeyi tshul du bkod yinas ni/ /ro rnams khyab 6)par dgod par bya/ /de nas ro yi phung po de/ /rten 6nyanas glegs sosnyem stegs bu yi/ /steng du mkhas pas gzhag dupar bya/ /thab 8stekyi cho 6steg bya ba yang / /maṇa ḍal khor lilug ran tsam la/ /brko (medang kha khyer lugs bzhin bya/ /phyag rgya bzhugs pa'i pho brang dag /thig gis yul gcad gi so sor dbye/ /de yi steng du bsreg ( 7shing brtsigs/ /101—632

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'phyor grub pa'i lung kun 'jus rig pa'i mdo/633dbyibs ①ni rigs bzhir ②gtams pa la/ /grwa ②zur ka bas brtan par brten / /sum brtseg ④yang thog ⑤bar khang bcas/ /tha ma yam 0shing brdzongs pas gtamasal/ /bar khang dag gi glegs bam la/ /ro yi bzhin phyogs ro bzhir ⑧bstan/ /ro yi steng khang ⑨yang thog tu/ /ras la sogs la bris pa yi7ske/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal skyobar dgod/ /ro khang glo 8skar bzhi phye la / /rdo rje gzungs kyi rgyud thag bzhisatso/ /btags nas bla ma'i phyag tu phul/ /shing gi bya ba rdzogs pa dang / /de yi tsophyi mtha' stegs bu la/ /rnam bzhi las kyi 8lha rnams dgod/ /stegs bu rdzogs par gyur pa dang / /rdo rje las kyi sgos btab pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po bla ma la/ /'khor ba sreg ⑩par mnga' gsol te/ /mi g.yo me 0chen rtse tsogacig pas/ /me yi 'du 'phro rgyun du bya/ /rdo rje rusngags kyi las sbyar la/ /rnam bzhi las kyi mnga' gsol te/ /las kyi phreng ba rdzogs par bya / /bla ma rdo rje dam pa zhig /ro yi nyes pa'i mtha' bzung nas/ /las kyis tsobasags pa bgrang ⑩zhing gshegs0/ /skabs sbyor rdo rje bla ma yis/ /bla med mchod pa rgyun (nyedu bya/ /bro gar glu tshig stabs byachen gyis/ /mchod pa rol mo sna tshogs dbul/ /rdo rje las kyi cismon lam gdabadu/ /mchod skabs las kyi mjug chatu bya/ /rdo rje las kyi lta 'dzin pas/ /dkar byang las kyi lta byabazung ste / /legs tsomatha' dam pa rnams la dbul0/ /ro ⑥yi nyes 0mtha' gang 'dzin pas/ /mtshan ma nag po bud shing dag /ye shes me yi duklong du sregadu /me sbyor me la gnas pa'i lha/ / me yi byasangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ / me yi ⑥lha mo gos dkar mo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'od yin te/ /'byung ba me la dbang bsgyur du)zhing / /thams cad kun gyi drod bdag yin/ /srid gsum sreg par 101—633

634 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101zhal gyis 'ches6)/ /dngos po sreg pa'i phrin ②las ni/ /thugs dam dbang gis yang ②mi 'da'/ /gang gi sgrib sreg de nyid mkhyen/ /ro yi rnam shes byang ma byang / /me la mkhas pas de bzhin brtag④ /mi sdug tshul 'byung sreg sbyang bya / /gal te legs na me dbang bskur⑤/ /thal ba sku gdung ring bsrel dang / /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor la sogs bya/ /dam pa zhig na gdung btags ⑦te/ /bla ma'i rten du dbul bar bya/ /'di ni sbyor ba kun gyi mchog /de skad sems dpa' mchog des smras/ /grogs po dag de dag ni me'i bya bas yongs su shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje gsang ba chos kyi spun/ / me yi ④bya ba las byung ba/ /gdung zhes grags pa'i sha ri ram(nya/ /dpag med ji srid dus dag nas/ /grangs med sprul pa'i rgyal ba dag /mya ngan 'das par gyur phyi na/ /med pa las byung sku gdung ni/ /sku yi gdung dang ring bsrel 6)zhes/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams rten du grags7/ /rgyal ba rnams ni dngos med pas/ /sku gdung ring bsrel mi srid na/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /med las thugs rje'i ⑩cho 'phrul bzhag /de bzhin gang du gang byung ba'i/ /gang 'dir snang ba sgron ma dag /mya ngan 'das 7pa'i sku gdung yang / /sha ri ram zhes grags par 'gyur / / de yi (nyalas kyang de bzhin no/ /de la 8sogs pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /rang 'byung rjes gnas 'byung bcas rnams/ /tshul mthun gcig par gyur pa yi//sku gdung sa bon byin brlabs kyisnyi/ /yon tan cha las rtsir 'phel ba/ /'dzam gling sa khams khyab ⑩par snang / /gdung las byung phyir sra mkhregs ⑩rlum//tha skad rdo rje rab tu grags/ /lgang bu zur gsum til sgang 'dra/ /gzhon tshe'i (nyamar ram 'o mar snang / /nar son smin (7rtags sra zhing mkhregs( gye/ /tsa na ka 101—634

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/635yi ①'bru bzhin du/ /dkar ②la tsan sridamar kha dog gsal/ /zos 0pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog tu grags/ /de bzhin rig dhi'adzin sems dpa' rnams/ /mi yi ①lus su sprul pa dang / /gang zag sa pa chos mig ldan/ /bsod nams dpal zhing dag pa dag /sdong bu snying por sbyangs phyi ⑦na/ /skal ⑧ba can la snang ba ni/ /la la dag la sha ri ram/ /la la dag la ring bsrel sku/ /skal ngan dag la snang mi 'gyur/ /la la snang bar gyur na yang / /sbyor ba dag la ①yun du rtag /ma dag nub cing 'bros par 'gyurakyil/ /yid du 'ong dang mi 'ong ba'i/ /'byung ba'i ltas ni ston par byed/ /yod par rtag pa ma 7yin la/ /med pa rlag 8par yang 8mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor las dang 'byor ba rnams/ /dag dang ma dag tshul la sbyor/ /de yang bsod nams dag pa yis/ /gang lam rgya cher mos pa dang / /rnal 'byor rtse gcig rmog chabatud na/ /rdo rjes sbrel tsodang las mthun na/ /rgyud rnams yongs su dag la 'bab/ /de yang khyad par rim pas ni/ /rgyal ba'i sku gdung sha ri ram/ /zhing khams kun du khyab ⑩par ni/ /mgar dhidang bzos yini bskums pa bzhin/ /byas pa med las snang ba dag /dkar 'tsher mdog gsal 'dzag 'dra ba/ / tsan dmar (7mdangs su gsal ba yi(kye/ /nam mkha' gang bar char 0bzhin 'bab/ /rig 'dzin sems dpa' sprul pa'i gdung / /dka' ( stegasal 'ga' 'ga' tsam ()du 'byung / /gang zag sa pa'i rtags chen ni//mdog mnyam gcig gsum gnyis gsum gcig /la lar lnga 'am bcu 'byung zhing ske/ /yon tan de ni (stede ltar ro/ /de (geyang sra mkhregs durdo rje 'dra/ /lcags kyi gtun gyis yang ()mi chogs(nye/ /'di dag phebs pa'i yon tan yang / /101—635

636 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101gang dang gang du babs pa yi/ /yul khams de dag thams cad du/ /nad dang mi ngas ①bgegs rnams zhi/ /gnod sbyin srin po ma rungs pa/ /drag po ②gtum po'ang lhan ②der 'gyur/ /rgyal po 'khrugs dang khams 'khrugs dang / /yul khams 'khrugs pa'ang zhi bar 'gyur/ /'bras bu lo tog 'phel smin 0cing / /yid du 'ong ba thams cad 'byung / /yul de dmangs ⑤dang rgyal po yiX sa bon thams cad bu phor 'gyur/ /bder bcas mtshan ldan rigs mthon ni/ /bu pho kun kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'di dag su la 'chad pa ⑦rnams/ /rig 'dzin sa dang skal ba mnyam/ /'jig rten 'di yi bsod nams kyang / /'khor los sgyur ⑧rgyal dag dang mnyam/ / de yi 6)dgongs pa kun du 'grub/ /tshe dang skongs ⑩dang las 'grub 'gyur/ /phyin cad yibla med byang chub ni/ /sa la reg pa'i rtags chen yin/ /gzhan yang yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /de dag rang gi rang bzhin du/ /gnas pa'i yon tan de dag go/ /bsgrubs na yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sems can rnam pa thams cad la/ /byang chub snying po nyid yod pas/ / me yi tshilas kyi bya ba yis/ /lnga phung sbyangs na med mi srid/ /'di dag bsgrub par bya ba yang / /shel gyi za ma tog nang du/ /bsdus te phyag rgya'i rgyas btab nas/ /shel gyi ga'u'i tunyenang du bca'aphya/ /bsgrub 8pas de la smon lam dang / /sgrib sbyang gso la 'phro 'du bya/ /'phro 'du bya ba'i cho ga yang //nam mkha' gang ba'i sha ri ram/ /zhing khams gang ba'i rgyal ba las char ⑩gyi rgyun bzhin de la 'bab/ /rtse gcig bzlas pa gsung gi rgyun/ /ma hā tisha ri ram gyi yi ge yin / /grangs med bar chad med par bzlas/ /mchog tu gsal zhing 'tsher (1ba dang / /'od kyi zer phreng nyi zer bzhin/ /zang zing brang breng 101—636

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor spub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/637snang bar 'gyur/ /za ma tog gi phyi rol na/ /gsal ba de la 'byung bar 'gyur / /'gul zhing mang por 'phel ba dang / / rgyal ba ①sems dpa' ②rig 'dzin gyis/ /gzugs brnyan ①shel dang de las ni/ /gsal bar bdag la ston par 'gyur/ /dang po snod de khengs pa yin/ /gnyis pa phyed dam brgya rtsa brgyad / /tha ma'ang grangs 'gas 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de dag grub pa rtags chen te/ /de tshe dngos grub blang bar bya/ /thob pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /tshe 'dir rig ④'dzin sa la gnas/ /rgyal ba dag dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /zhar las byung ba'i yon tan yang / /'gro ba kun gyi don spyod pa/ /sems dpa' che ltar ⑤'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyun du de la mchod dgos te/ /mchod na yon tan dam pa 'byung / /mchod pa bya ba'i cho ga yang / /sgrib sbyangs bsod nams dpung bskyed de⑥/ /rang rgyud ⑦dag par byas nas ni/ /zla ba dus ni thams cad kyini/ /bcu drug cha la rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid gcig ⑨pu sems yul du/ /gyur par byas nas mchod pa ni/ /za ma tog kyidang bcas pa dag /rgyal mtshan rtse mor btags ⑩byas te/ /ji ltar 'dod par smon lam btabatso / /des ni 'dod pa thams cad skongs/ /de ni rnal 'byor skal ldan gyis / /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog tu/ /ming gis med du mi rung ngo / /ji ltar ro dag gser 8'gyur dang / /de bzhin me yis bsregs sbyangs rdzibazhin/ /dngos por spyod pa ji snyed pa/ /de nyid dam pa la mi g.yos/ /de la sogs pa ⑩mtha' yas spyod/ /dngos po bzhi la gnas spyod pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i chos nyid de/ /spyod pa rmad 'byung tsodam pa yisnyi/ /ji ltar glang po chur zhugs pa/ /thogs chags 'jigs pa yong 101—637

638 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101med par①/ /dga' ba'i longs spyod brod tshul gyis/ /mi ldog pha rol phyin pa ltar / /rnal 'byor nges par spyod (mipa yang / /brtul zhugs rgya mtsho'i chur ③'jug pa/ /rtsal chen sbyong ba'i ④grod tshul gyis/ /thogs chags med par la dor ba'o/ /spyod pa gang bar bya ba'i thabs/ /goms pa klong du gyur pa rjogaces / /grogs po dag de dag ni la dor bar shes par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las rnal 'byor spyod 'jug gi le'u zhes bya ste bdun cu yigacig pa'o// //de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag pos dman pa ⑦rnams la smras pa/ kye grogs po dag gang ④gis gcad 6)par bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ dgongs pa dam pa de kho na nyid do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dgongs pa de kho na nyid gcig bslabs ⑩pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos la bslabs (1pa'o/ /de kho na nyid gcig la mkhas na bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mkhas pa'o/ /de kho na nyid de la goms na bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sgom nyenyapa'o/ /de kho na nyid de 1nyelas ma 'das na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dam pa bsrungs pa'o/ /de kho na nyid de la zhugs na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgor zhugs pa'o/ /de kho na nyid de la spyod na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yo byad la spyod pa'o/ /de kho na nyid mngon du byas na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgya mtsho snyed byas pa'o/ /de kho na nyid de ma nor bar bstan na chos kyi sgo dpag tu med pa bstan pa'o/ /de kho na nyid de phyin ci ma log par thos na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos kyi sgo thos pa'o/ /de kho na nyid de mngon du gyur na/dpag tu med pa'i rgyal ba mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag 101—638

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/639thams cad kyi bcud du bya ba'am snying por bya ba ni de kho na nyid de de las med pa'i phyir ro/ /grogs po dag de bas na 'di ltar/ de bzhin nyid kyi don mthong na/ /mthong bas thams cad sgyu ma yin/ /de nyid go 'phang mchog 'phags na/ /bla med mtho btsun mtha' dag brdzun/ /de bzhin nyid du nges phan chad/ /gang dman spa gong zhum pa med/ /de bzhin nyid du thag chod na/ /'jig rten gnas kyang chos kyi sku/ /dam par nges kyang 'jig rten 'jug /'khor ba'i mtha' la'ang skyo ①ba med/ /mu mtha' yas kyang gcig tu rdzogs/ /bdud kyi ②khams la nyam mi nga / /mi bzang ①khams la bag mi tsha/ /'dod pa'i dngos po dbyings la sbyor/ / cig car rtsinges pa'i don mthong na/ /rim gyis sbyor ba slu 'drid ⑤'dra/ /de la mos pa tsam gyis kyang / /khams gsum zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /klong nyudu gyur pa smos ci dgos/ /dper na seng phrug khyung sgong dag /mig ma bye zhing mar blangs kyang / /kun skrag sgo nga'am mkhar ⑦'gro ltar/ /de nyid nges par gang gyur pa/ /de dag 'jig rten gnas 'jug kyang / /go 'phang (snyedam pa de nyid du/ /nges pa ci la'ang bag mi tsha/ /rim gyis mtshan mar spyod pa dang / /med dang dmigs dang mi dmigs dang / /bsgrub dzi)dang bgrod par byed pa yi/ /bye brag med par rtog 'jug pa/ /blun po de dag stongs ⑩pa ste/ /dam par nges pa ga la yin/ /gcan gzan yitha ma'i phru 7gu 'dra/ /skrag cing dngang ba'i tsorang bzhin no/ /mtha' yas ji snyed chos kun gyi/ /rang bzhin ji ltar gnas pa bzhin/ /ma bcos phyin ci ma log pa / /de bzhin nyid du thag chod pa'o/ /ji ltar khyung chen mkha' lding tsob/ /'dab tsogashog rtsal gyis nam 'phang 'aspyod/ /ri brag chu klung mtha' yas kyang / /101—639

640 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101'phur rlabs 'og tu kun chud ltar/ /rnal 'byor chos nyid mkha' 'gro ba/ /theg pa'i spyod sgo mtha' yas kyang / /ji bzhin ma bcos don gyis na/ /go 'phang rlabs kyis thag bcad pa①/ /'di ni re dang dogs pa yi/ /the tshom ⑧gcod pa'i nges pa ste/ /dam pa nyid la lta ba yi/ /go 'phang gcod pa nges par gces / /grogs po dag de dag ni sa yongs su gcod ①par bgros par shes par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pas/ dman pa durnams re dogs ⑥med par thag gcod pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur (7to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las the tshom g.yongs su gcod pa'i le'u zhes bya ste bdun cu khyaganyis pa'o// //de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag pos dman pa ⑩rnams la smras pa/ kye grogs po dag gang nyam (1rnyed par bya ba ni 'di lta 7ste/ dgongs pa dam pa kun 'dus la/ /'jug pa'i gtsor ni bsam gtan te/ /'khor los dbang sgyur 'ji bzhin du/ /chos kun dbang sgyur cibasam gtan yin/ /rnal 'byor bsam gtan chen po 'di/ /dug dang mun pa 7gser 'gyur bzhin⑩/ /thams cad dbang sgyur ⑩bsam gtan yin/ /des na dam pa'i bsam gtan bya/ /gal te bsam gtan 'di med na/ /rgya mtsho mjing gi yonyepha bong ltar/ /dpag tu med pa'i sgo bcad ()kyang / /don med snying po skams pa yin/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i bsam gtan ni/ /ji bzhin pa yi de nyid la/ /ma bcos pa yi 0blo bzhag ste/ /ma yengs skye 'gag med pa'o/ /rnal 'byor dam pa ji bzhin pa/ /sems kyi chos nyid de nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid ces mi dmigs pa/ /rtsa ba'i 101 —640

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i khyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/641kun shes kun gzhi nyid/ /ci phyir ma byas ma bcos ①pa/ /rang 'byung ②de bzhin nyid ces bshad/ /thams cad kun du snang ba ni/ /'jug pa'i rnam shes yud tsam nyid/ /ci phyir kun du snang 'jug pas/ /phyi nang kun du snang bar bshad/ /rgyu yi rnam par bkod pa ni/ /'jug pa'i rnam shes sgo lnga ①nyid/ /thams cad gang gi rgyur bkod ④pas/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu zhes bshad/ /gang gi dgongs pa dam pa ni/ /stong pa ma yin ther zug med/ /dbu mar mi dmigs kun rig gsal/ /yod min med min las kyang 'das/ /gang 'dir tshor 'gro ma rabs dang / /gang 'gog byis pa'i spyod yul dang / /'di gang nyams pa'i log srid ⑤can/ /yal ba phyal ba dmigs pa gcig /gang 'dir lta bas mdongs pa dag /bdag la brten dunas mtha' sgrub ste/ /med mos des 'gro med snyam nas/ /de ma thag tu ngan 'gror 'gro/ /mos pa chung ngu thams cad ni/ /gang la bdag med rten ⑦bzhin mthong / /gang bkag nirtog yod dpyod med pa/ /bsam gtan dang po kho na'o/ /kun stong phra ba'i stong pa las / /gnas rtog med la dpyod pa gnyis/ /stong pa nyid la nges bzhag ste/ /dga' ba bskyod pa gsum pa'o/ /bdag gam gzhan gyi yonyemathus bstan te/ /skyon med mi g.yo gnas bzhi pa/ /gang yod mthar yang 'gyur srid kyi/ /gang med gnas med mthar mi 'gyur/ /gang med mi mthong mi shes bzhin/ /btsal bas rnyed ⑩par mi 'gyur yang / /de nyid med par mi 'gyur bas/ /rgyu 'bras med kyang don med min/ /dper na lcags bsregs dpal 4nyamed bzhin/ /chen po bzhi med stongs 'gyur kyang / /de dang nam mkha' med min bzhin/ /de nyid mi rlag med min 'gyur/ /drug gi spyod yul mtshan ma ste/ /mtshan ma 101wa 641

64 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101dngos por snang bas na/ /ci dgar ①bzhag pas de bzlog med/ /de stong spang zhing ②bzlog tu med/ /thams cad sems kyi chos nyid du/ /tshig med lta bas thag chod na/ /ma bcos ma yengs yengs thub snyoms/ /rtsol sgrub ①re dogs ga la yod/ /mi mthun gnyen po sgom dumi dgos/ /skyon yon spong len bying rgod ⑤rnams / /gang 'dir dbyer med zung 'brel na/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong sems las byung / /zhig pas nam mkha' med mi 'gyur/ /'khyams pas byang chub sems mi ༅stor/ /spangs pas mi spong stimatha' yas chos/ /bkrus pas mi 'dag stong nyid dbyings/ /gang stong yod pas chad rtag pas/ /thams cad rig pas stong ma yin/ /dngos po med pas rtag ma yin/ /ci yang med pas spyad (8)du med/ /bya ba thams cad yongs btang na/ /ye nas ma bcos der bzhag na/ /de med pas na de yang med/ /de ni dam pa'i nyams rnyed pa'i①/ /'dir ni theg chen dam pa yi/ /nad ni rim gyis 'thob ma yin/ /rim gyis pa yi dug rgod ⑩ni/ /cig (nyacar 'char ba'i de kho na'o/ /des na gang dang gang dag gis/ /ji ltar go dang mos bzhin du/ /bstan pa gang dang gang dag la/ /so so yid brtan 7yul du bya/ /de bas sgron tu ma dpag med kyis/ /dam pa ji snyed gsungs pa rnams/ /gcig tu chad dam 7nges med de/ /ji ltar 8'byung ba de ltar nges/ /'di la gang 'jug par gcod pa/ /le lo bya mang rgod ⑩pa dang —/ /g.yeng dang rmugs dang 'dod pa dang / /gnyid dang re dogs ⑩the tsom 18dang / /'du 'phro spyod dang dga' ba'o/ /de yang rang bzhin de bzhin nyid / /dug lnga la sogs kun 'byung nyid/ /rang 'byung rang zhi yide bzhin nyid / /dam pa'i don la gang sgrib smyo nyapa/ /mi g.yo gsal bde sdug bsngal dang / /101—642

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/643skye ba gsal ba 'byin pa dang / /des dang khyad snyems ①'byung zhi nyid/ /bsam gtan chen por des ①snang ba/ /kun du mi nyams re dogs med/ / dang ba ②mi skye mi g.yo dang / /ma chags mi 'chad len pa med/ /'khrug pa med na rang bzhin nyid/ /rnal 'byor bdud kyi spyod yul ni④/ /dam par 'dun mthong dam par smra/ /sprul pa grangs med 'gyed mthong ⑤dang / /dam pas smras kun gsal mthong dang / /dus kun shes gsal mthong ba dang / /rgyud drug lam nas kun snang yidang / /de la gdung ba'i shugs 'byung dang / /kun snang gsal bar mthong ba dang / /ci la'ang thogs med 'gro ba dang / /mkha' la bya bzhin 'gro 'dug dang / /dam pa'i phyag rgya lung ston dang / /kun gyi skad du chos smra dang / /dngos po bstan ⑦g.yo bste gnas mthong / /thams cad mnyam par bkod pa dang / /de nyid rang bzhin gsal snang dang / /las su rung ba thogs med dang / /dam pa'i don la bsgo ⑧ba dang / /'jig rten gtso bos mchod pa dag /rang bzhin shes na dam pa'i rtags/ /gang mi shes pa log pa'i bdud/ /sgo drug mtshan ma ci skyes dang / /rang 'byung rang zhi ci dgar gzhag⑨ /ma skyes pas na bzlog tu med/ /de yang de bzhin de nyid do/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /nyes dang legs pa gang la yang / /dgal ⑩dang 'gyod ⑩pa'i rtog pa med/ /rang 'byung rang zhi de nyid do/ /'dir ni dam pa gang nges pa/ /rnal 'byor mtshan ma'i snga 8ltas yin/ /chu klung me gser ga na bar/ /'du 'phro 'byung rtsi nges pa bzhin/ /dam par tunyenges na dam par 'byung / /dam par tsom nges thams cad bdud/ /dam par nges na chung ngu tsamali/ /gang 'byung dam pa'i snga ⑩ltas so/ /gang gi dam pa nyid thos na⑩/ /101—643

644 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101mi skrag mi dngang ①dga' ba skyephyi/ /gang zhig dam pa nyid lta ba/ /thams cad dam pa nyid du mthong / /dam pa'i klong ①du gang gyur pa/ /rnam grangs mang po dam par sdud/ /dam pa nges pa mthong ba na/ /tshig lam rjes su de mi 'gro/ /de mthong thams cad dam par gsal/ /snang ba med pa'i dam pa ni/ /snang ba med pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /de nyid kun gyi ④rgyu yin te/ /cho 'phrul rgyu ba thams cad 'byung / /g.yo dang drod thob brtan ⑤pa dang / /gsal dang rtags thob brtan ⑥pa dang / /nyi zer rdul phran smig rgyu gyedang / /mtsho rlabs rlung dang char gyi rgyun/ /sprin lding ta la gang 'phar 'gro/ /sa g.yo 'byung ba'i skye mched snang / /'byung rgyun zug rngu la ⑧sogs pa9)/ /gang gis yongs su nad zhi bske/ /mun pa'i skye mched choms pa dang / /lus kyi ⑩bzod pa thob pa dang / /kun la bde blag ji bzhin pa'o/ /gang min gang du sgyur ba dang / /gang med pa las gang 'byin pa'o/ /yid 'ong 'dod grub rdzas mchog rnyed/ /kun dga' kun 'dud kun yid dang / /kun la dbang sgyur mchog 'grub ltas/ /yud las sngon du 'byung ba'i ltas/ /sgren ()mor byung dang rtag par 'khru'/ /rnam dag chu bor 'bogs dang rkyal(nya/ /char rgyun bum chu 'byung ba dang / /gsog dang g.yeng dang rnam par 'thoraci/ /'di dang 8sbyong ba dag pa'i ltas/ /gang 'dir 'jigs dang bral ba yang / /g.yul 'gyed zhi dang zug rngu byang ⑫/ /tha mar grol dang gshed las thar/ /gdug pa'i tshogs bral dug nad zhi/ /bcing grol btsad (nyeltas bzang po yin/ /khyad par dam pa'i sngon byung (steb/ /khri rkang shing dang ljon shing skas/ /'dzeg 67dang gyen du 'gro ba dang / /ri rtse'i mchod rten nam mkha'i skas/ /gong nas gong du 'phar ba'i ltas/ /gang la gnas 101—644

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i rlu shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/645dang non ①pa yang / /khri mthon la 'dug glang chen zhon/ /seng chen khyung lding 'dab ②chags dang / /mchod rten rtse dang ri bo'i spol/ /nam mkha'i dbyings na 'dug pa dang / /lus las ④spyin byung nyi zla la/ /'dug pa ⑤gang la gnas pa'i rtags/ /dam pa rigs kyi sngon byung dub/ /bka' rtags dbang ①por dbang sgyur byed/ /'jig rten skas la 'bebs pa dang / /dbang sdud g.yul rgyal rgyal bar 'gyur/ /mgo la me tog thod ⑤skyes pa'o/ /chos gang dbang sgyur sngon byung ba/ /glegs bam rnyed dang 'dri ①spyod dang / /gzhan la ston dang gtan la 'bebs/ /me long kyibum gang lta 0rtog 'thung / /nor bu thu dang 'khor lo babs/ /nyi ⑩zla zin dang ri rab skoratso/ /gang la sgra brgyas stong gsum gang / /dngos po tsomatha' dag yi ger mthong / /klags 8pas ngo mtshar kun skyed dang / /mkha' las me tog char 'bab pa'o/ /dam pa mthong ba sngon byung ⑩ba/ /sngon ma mthong ba yul mthong dang / /stong gsum mthong zhing gling rnams bgrod/ /ri rab rtser 0phyin thams cad mthong / /nam mkha' mtha' yas mthong ba dang / /rgya mtsho gting du phyin pa dang / /sgron me tsothogs dang snang srid dpyod/ /nyi ma'i snying po lta bu'o⑩/ /lung chen thob pa sngon byung ba / /rol mo 'brug sgra (gyeseng ge dang / /chos kyi bgro 0ba thos pa dang / /gzugs brnyan zhal 'dzum 'od 'byung dang / /dam pa'i gsung thos sku mi mthong ske/ /lha mo glu (nyedabyangs sgrogs pa dang / /gzhal yas dag la sgra 'byung dang —/ /grogs po dam pa zhes 'byung zhing / /de nyid 'gro bar byed pa'o/ /rig 'dzin dam pa'i ltas shar na/ /byin brlabs mthu yi (nyecho 'phrul yang / /nyi zla zhon nas 'gro ba dang / /ri rab rked (nyenas gsor ba dang / /'jig rten 101—645

646 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101rgyang mar 'phang ba dang / /sreg ①pa'i bskal ②pa gzhil ①ba la④/ /sogs pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad kyang / /khyad par rtsal gyis ston par ⑤nus/ /'dul ba'i 'gro ba thams cad la/ /so so skad du chos mthun paraX/ /'dul ba'i sgo ni sna tshogs su/ /gang la de ltar ston par nus/ /rnal 'byor rtsal gyi 7khyad par gyis/ /'jig rten khams kun g.yos nas kyang ⑧/ /thams cad ngo mtshar cher 'gyur te/ /dga' mgu ⑨rangs pa'i ro myong 'gyur/ /g.yeng ba'i yi ge phreng ba las/ /rdzu 'phrul chos kyi sgra bsgrags ⑩pas/ /yid mthong rnam grangs chos rnams kun/ /sngags snang sngags su ma gyur med/ /rnal 'byor che chung rim pa dag /rtsal gyi khyad ⑩par dag las byung / /rim gyis 'jug dang cig tsocar ba/ /dbugs kyi yul dang tshor ba (snyedang / /thos dang mthong ba la sogs te / /sems kyi yiyul dang nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' ⑫klas par/ /rang bzhin yi ge bsgyur yi ge/ /yan lag yi ge so so yi/ /rtsa ba la sogs gzhi gcig ⑩bcas/ /'phro 'du'i tshad ⑩dang phyag rgya'i khyon/ /tshom bu'i grangs kyang de bzhin no/ /'di ni dang po'i 'jug rims te'/ /mthar gyis 'dris ⑩shing goms byed pa'o/ /yi ge ye shes las bskrun ()te/ /don byed pa 'ang phyag rgyar 'byung / /rgya mtsho gnon dang nam mkha'i skas/ /rlung 'ching ba dang rgyun bzlog pa/ /sreg pa'i bskal pa gzhil ba dang / /nyi zla zhon nas 'jig rten 'phang / /sa la 'dzul dang ri rab 'degs/ /stong gsum yungs 'brur 'jug tshul dang / /gzhig (medang spar ba la 6)sogs te/ /bsam bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /goms pas las su rung ba yi( ste/ /rnal 'byor rtsal chen sbyong bar sostezad/ /bzlas pa mthar phyin grub pa dang / /bcing ( steb yongs 101—646

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/647su rdzogs pa dang / /bsam pa las su rung ba dang / /don mthong ba dang tshig grub pa/ /bya ba yongs su dag pa dag /don gcig ①yul la so sor snang / /des na ting 'dzin khyad par yang / /de nyid gcig la sgom ②mod kyi / /rnal 'byor rtsal gyi khyad par ni/ /bsam pa'i yul ni sna tshogs te/ /dang po sa la gnas pa yi/ /btsal ④ba las ni ⑤rnal 'byor pa⑥/ /⑦'dun pa'i sems pa'i rnal 'byor lal/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnam drug po6)/ /shes rab rtsal 0gyi 'phang dmas pas/ /ting 'dzin rtsal yang chung ba ste/ /de nyid mthong bar mi 'gyur bas/ /rang gi mos pa gang dmigs na/ /de yi sa bon gang yin pa/ /kha dog dbyibs kyis phye yinas ni/ /sna yi dbugs tshul rgyu byas te/ /de yi yul du gyur tshad du/ /'od zer 'bar 'phro gsal ba las/ /'phro 'du gnas su bskyed par bya/ /rang gi chag tshad dang sbyar ba'i/ /sku yi khyon yang de tsam mo/ /gnyis pa'i sa la gnas pa yi/ /bka' 0sdod las kyi ④rnal 'byor la8/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnam bzhi po/ /ting 'dzin rtsal gyi khyad par gyis/ /sa bon rang bzhin 7yi ge la/ /'od zer 'bar ba bcas pa de/ /dri 'byung sgo ni tshun chad du/ /'phro 'du gsal bar bskyed pa las/ /rang gi chag tshad gnyis bsgyur ba'i/ / sku yi 7khyon yang de tsam mo/ /gsum pa'i sa la gnas pa yi/ /rnal 'byor lung gi bka' sgo la(nya/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnam gsum po/ /dmigs pa'i ting 'dzin 'di ltar 'dod/ /lha yi sa bon gang yin pa/ /rang bzhin yi ger bsgyur (7byas te/ /'od zer 'bar dang bcas pa yis thos pa'i yul ni tshun chad du/ /'phro 'du gsal bar byas pa las/ /rang gi chag tshad bzhi 'gyur (1tsam/ /sku yi khyon yang de tsam mo/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor 101—647

648 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101rim pa bzhin/ /lha yi khyad par gang yin pa/ /yi ge'i rim pa bzhin sbyar nas / /'phro 'du tshad kyang de bzhin te/ /rim pa ji bzhin sbyar nas kyang / /'phro 'du gsal bar gyur pa dang / /sems kyi yul 6)ni ji tsam du/ /sku yi khyon gyi khyad par yang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi ②mthas klas pasal/ /sku yi khyon gyis gang ba'o/ /ji ltar gser sbyangs 'tsher ④ba bzhin/ /sems nyid sbyangs pas de nyid gsal/ /'phro 'du sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin 'di/ /rim gyis sbyong la cig ⑤car drod/ /lang ma'i bdag po 'di lta ste/ /chos rgyun chen po 'di 'dzin 'di/ /sems dpa' rdo rje dam pas bshad/ /'di kun 'phro 'du'i rgyun zhes bya/ /nam mkha' don gyi glegs bam la/ /sna tshogs rig pa'i yi ge bris/ /'byung chen bzhi yi (7skra bsgrags pas/ /theg chen gsang sngags rgyun mi 'chad/ /chos so cog gi rang bzhin ni/ /de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos pas/ /thams cad bdud rtsir rgyun mi 'chad / /'khor ba rgya mtsho yo byad nirnams/ /mchod pa rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin te/ /srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod 6)sprin rgyun mi 'chad/ /kun kyi de bzhin nyid dbyings las/ /sems can sangs rgyas snying por shar/ /'gro gang bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /rang 'byung sangs rgyas rgyun mi 'chad/ /dngos po brtan ⑩g.yo la (7sogs pa'i/ /sgra skad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /kun kyang gsang sngags gsang ba'i tshig /bzlas pa rgya mtsho rgyun mi 'chad/ /de dang de yi dbyings nyid la/ /gang dang gang gi thabs sbyor ba/ /ye nas 'du 'bral med pas na/ /sbyor ba chen po rgyun mi 'chad/ /srid gsum bsgral 7ba'i zhing 'di dag /stong tu pa'i mtshon tsobo'i rgyal po yis/ /dngos po med par bsad pas na/ /ye sgrol chen po rgyun mi 101—648

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor spub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/649'chad / /snang srid dag pa'i gzhal yas su/ /kun gzhi dpal gyi maṇ+ḍal la/ /rnam shes thig chen srad bu brgyad/ /ye btab dkyil 'khor rgyun mi 'chad/ /'dod khams rmang gi ri rab la/ /gzugs khams bang rim khri 'phang ①brtan/ /gzugs med bum rten bum par bcas/ /gdung chen chos sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /nam mkha' me chu sa rlung rnams/ /rmang bzhi ②ri rab rten ①du snang / /bang rim ri bdun bcas pa rnams/ /de nyid bang rim khri 'phang brtanadu/ /ri bo bum rten bum par bcas/ /'di yang gdung chen rgyun mi 'chad/ /'dzugs dupa'i yan lag gzhi rmang rten/ /'khor lo tshigs chen khri 'phang brtan⑥/ /yan lag dang po bum rten ⑦bcas/ /lcang lo cod ⑧pan phreng bas bklubasal/ /de bzhin nyid kyi sa gzhi la/ /ji bzhin pa yi gzhal yas khang / /ma nor ma bcos rmang chen brtan⑩/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsig 7chen gtams/ /ye shes lnga yi 8skar mthongs tshugasal/ /bsdu ba tshad med rnam thar sgo0/ /dran pa yang dag them skas tsobargyad/ /rdzu 'phrul rta babs dag gis brgyan/ /mi 'jigs rig pa'i gdung chen la/ /yang dag brgyad kyi ka bas mdzes/ /rang 'byung 0ye shes dbu rtse 'phags/ /bden yiganyis khyams ()kyis nges par mdzes/ /ye shes thugs rje yon tan las/ /byin brlabs ()rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan(gye/ /chos nyid rlabs kyi bla re bres(nya/ /sil snyan sgra sgrogs theg chen sngags/ /ji bzhin chos kyi pho brang 'dir(gye/ /rgyal ba bzhugs pa 'di ltar rim/ /kun bzang ()sems kyi chos nyid las/ /kun gzhi ma 'dres yongs rdzogs yichos/ /sems dpa' yud kyis nges thob pas/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho rgyun mi 'chad/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i skas bgrod (gyenas/ /nam mkha' lidabyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /snang 101—649

650 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101srid mtha' thug med la lta/ /des ni de yul yangs par 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho rdo rjes gtams byas te/ /de la gnas pa'i sems can la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' brtan byas te/ /thams cad dam pa'i rdo rjer byas①/ /nam mkha' ②dbyings kyi ling ga ②la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /myur mgyogs chu zla'i 'phen shugs kyis/ /zhing khams kun du bgrod par bya/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi ling ga ④la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i⑤/ /shin tu nges par gyur pa dang / /mun pa'i gnas rnams thams cad gsal/ /rnal 'byor sdigs mdzub ⑨rtse mo la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od gsal 'bar/ /shin tu brtan par red pa ⑦dang / /chu des sreg pa'i bskal pa gzhil⑤/ /rnal 'byor lag gi dkyil 'khor du/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khor yo)yug bcas//nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phangs nas ni/ /sa nas sar ni sbar ⑩bar bya/ /rnal 'byor sdigs 7pa'i ma/dzub 7mo la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal 8ba las/ /zer las nyi ma 'bum 'phros pas/ /phyi nang mun pa thams cad bsal8/ /rnal 'byor lag snyigi dkyil 'khor las/ /chu zla'i ⑩dkyil 'khor rab gsal bas/ /bdud rtsi chu bo'i rgyun byung 7bas/ /sreg pa'i dmyal ba'i me chen bsad/ /gzhan yang lang ku'i bdag po ting nge 6nya'adzin gyi ()mdo ni 'di kho nar 'dus par gsungs pas/ 'di kho na ltar shes par bya'o/ /sems ni sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ /ji ltar brtags pa de ltar snang / /de ma thag par ma gyur kyang / /de nyid gang brtags )de ltar snang / /gdos bcas ( 1yul na mi snang yang / /yid gzugs mngon shes kun mkhyen snang / /gang so brtags de ltar de 6)ltas nas / /mngon sum 3gsal por red par 'gyur/ /yod med legs nyes rang 101—650

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rno rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/651bzhin rnams/ /chu khams rtas pa lta bur zad/ /thams cad 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /des na ting 'dzin sems nyid gtso0)/ /dper na rgya mtsho nor len mi/ /sbrul dang chu srin sbrang ma la②/ /sogs pa gdug pa'i sdug bsngal kun / /dka' ①bas nyams su blangs pa du'agrub/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor rnal tshol ba/ /rnam rtog bying rmugs 'phyar g.yeng dgra/ /gzhom par dka' ba'i las 'di dag /nyams su blangs na bde thob rnyed/ /'di ni ting 'dzin dam pa yin⑤/ /nyams su blangs pa'i skyobaslab pa ste/ /sems nyid goms par bya ba las / /'dris par byed pa rab tu gces/ /grogs po dag de dag ni nyams rnyed pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pas/ dman pa ⑦rnams gang gi dgongs pa dam pa'i nyam nidrod rnyed par gyur to6)/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las rnal 'byor dbang sgyur 0gyi le'u zhes bya ⑪ste bdun cu 8gsum pa'o// //de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag po des dman pa'i lus kyi tunyesems dpa' rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po dag gang 'di la tshegs chung bar bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ci la yang bya ba med pa nyid do/ /gang la bya ba med pa de gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin nyid do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di lta ste/ sngags kyis yongs su zin pa'i nad gang la'ang gnod par 8byed mi nus / de bzhin nyid kyis zin pa yi/ /dug tsogasum dug lngas gnod mi 'gyur//de bzhin nyid kyis ma zin na/ /lam gyi phyogs rnams kun spyad kyang / /bde 'gro tsam du nges 'byung gi/ /go 'phang dam par ga la 'gyur/ /de bzhin 101—651

65 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101nyid kyis kun gnas ①par/ /gang shes ②nyon mongs rnam par grol/ /gang de zin par ma shes na/ /dam pa'i lam rnams grol mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor de nyid blo ldan pas/ /nyon mongs zin pas gang spyad kyang / /rnam grol rang 'byung mya ngan 'das/ /tshegs med gyin da ③don po che/ /gang 'di blo dang mi ldan pas/ /blo ldan tshul du gang byed pa/ /dam par grol bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /'ching ba thar ram 'khor ba'i dngos/ /thams cad stong par shes pa yi/ /blo can mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /bya ba'i las la sha thang ba'i/ /tshegs chen dka' rjob las dang bral/ /dam pa'i blo gros thabs med de/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams dang ni/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis dman pa'i lus/ /sten ⑤par byed pa'ang ltung bar 'gyur/ /dam pa'i blo gros (7thabs yod na/ /'khor ba dman pa'i dngos po yang / /skyes bu dam par grol 'gyur te/ /grol ba rang 'byung gzhan las min/ /grol dang ma grol la (7sogs pa/ /gnyis su rtog pa duthams cad mtha' / /kun mkhyen rnams ni dbus la'ang min/ /de ni grol med grol ba'o/ /'di ni gsang ba dam pa ste/ /ma rtogs blo chung kun la gsang / /skyon yod nyes pa ma yin te/ /blo chung rnams la phan phyir 6)ro/ /de phyir blo gros thabs ldan la/ /rtsol sgrub yo byad gtsor ma gsungs/ /gal te byas na'ang 'gag pa med / /ma byas na yang de ltar nges/ /de ltar blo gros thabs ldan na/ /mtshams med lnga yi sems can kun/ /byang chub snying rje mtshon gyis bsad/ /dpag med dger 'gyur ma bsad na/ /kun gyis ⑩don du gnyer ba ni/ /gang gi sems kyi 9/medabyings nyid kyi/ /gang gis bskal pa dpag med du/ /srid gsum dkrugs pas de rig min/ /'dir ni blo gros thabs ldan pas/ /bya 101—652

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bskad pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/653med gyin dar phyirang rig pas/ /don chen rnal 'byor nyal mo ②btsun/ /ma bral ②lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /ji ltar mun pa dug ④dang rdzas/ /sman snang gser du gyur pa na/ /'gyur rtsi man ngag med pa'i mis/ /dka' ⑤ba'i las chen sna tshogs pa/ /sdug bsngal spyad kyang mi 'grub ste/ /su zhig man ngag ldan pa'i mis/ ci /tshegs med gyin da'i 0tshul gyis na⑦/ /bsgyur bas sman snang gser 'gyur ltar/ /rnal 'byor chen po don 'grub pa/ /de nyid blo gros thabs dag dang / /gang dang mi ldan pa dag gis/ /dka' ba spyad kyang 'grub min te/ /sems kyi gsang 'di sus mthong ba/ /blo gros thabs dang ldan pa ste//'dod pa'i don mchog gang yin pa/ /de dag tshegs med gyin das ⑧'grub/ /don rnams grub par gang byed pa/ /blo gros thabs kyis grub pa'i phyir/ /don rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba yi/ /bslab pa 'di dag rab tu gces①/ /grogs po dag de dag ni tshegs chung la don che ba tshunyid du zhes bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pas/ dman pa yirnams blo dang ldan gros kyis chod de thabs kyis zin par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las don nges par bsgrub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bdun cu 8bzhi pa'o// //de nas yang gsang ba pa'i (gebadag po des/ lang ma'i bdag po la sogs tsopa dman pa'i lus kyi sems dpa' rnams la shin tu rngom tsobarjid tshul du bos te smras pa/ kye grogs po dag mdo gcig tu bsdus pa ni gang zhe na 'di lta ste/'di skad bdag gis thos pa yidus gcig na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gyur 101—653

654 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101par 'dus nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus par bshad pa/ chos nyid rnam par dag pas na/ /chos kun rang bzhin rnam par dag /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /thugs dam dbyig mchog rab ①nyid do/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag pa las de skad ces 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar na yang 'di lta ste/ /mi phyed rdo rje dam tshig ni/ /rdo rje de bzhin nyid las byung / /chos nyid rdo rje dam tshig ni/ /grub na 'jig pa'i dus med do/ /grogs po dag bcom ldan 'das rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo nyid las de skad ces gsungs so/ /grogs po dag yang 'di lta ste/ rgyal ba kun gyi ②thugs dam ni/ /thams cad dam pa de nyid las/ /mi gzhan gzhan med yod ma yin/ /de las gang yang 'da' ④mi 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdzogs longs spyod pa ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces gsungs so/ /yang grogs po dag 'di lta ste/ dam pa rnams kyis gsungs pa'i tshig /rdo rje go cha dam bcas pa/ /shin tu dam pa'i tha tshig 'di/ /gal te 'das na tshig par 'gyur//bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i sku ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces gsungs so/ /yang grogs po dag 'di lta ste/ rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa 'di/ /gsungs pas dam tshig mtha' yas kun/ /thams cad thams cad bsrungs pa ste/ / bsrung ba ④'di ni rnyed par dka'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyun gyi 'byung ba ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces gsungs so/ /kye grogs po dag 'di lta ste/ zhe sdang ngo bo tha dad pa/ /byang chub sems su mnyam pas na/ /de bzhin nyid las gzhan pa yin / /ma spangs ma dag rdo rje dam/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces gsungs so/ /grogs po dag 'di lta ste/ 'dod 101—654

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/655dang chags pa'i yul nyid ni/ /rang bzhin gang yin de bzhin nyid/ /longs spyod myong tshor rnam par dag /spyod la ma chags rdo rje ①dam/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od mtha' yas ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces gsungs so/ /yang 'di lta ste/ thams cad de bzhin der mtshungs ②pas/ /khyad par bye brag dbyer med pa'i/ /rdo rje nam mkha' 'od gsal bas/ /rmongs pa'i mun nag rnam dag gsal/ /bcom ldan 'das snang mdzad ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /yang 'di lta ste/ rnam dag thug mtha' mu med pas/ /yangs dog tshig ③ni mtha' dang bral/ /kun bzang ④yangs pa'i lam du gcig /bde chen klong duyang rdo rje dam/ /bcom ldan 'das thams cad grub pas de skad ces gsungs so/ /yang 'di lta ste/ de bzhin nyid las med pas na/ /yin ⑥dang ma yin gnyis las 'das/ /bdag med rdo rje de bzhin nyid/ /nga med mi 'gyur rdo rje dam/ /bcom ldan 'das yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas ④ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces gsungs so/ /grogs po dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste/yod mthong snang grags chos so cog /tha dad sna tshogs mtha' yas kyang / /rang bzhin ma bcos de bzhin nyid/ /ma bsgribs 'od gsal rnam dag zhing / /bcom ldan 'das dri med sgra ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin du 'di (kyelta ste0/ kun du bzang po'i ye shes 'di/ /sus kyang ma byas rang 'byung ste/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i rtsa bas na/ /rang las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /bcom ldan 'das dkon mchog sprin ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dgongs pa rnam par bshad pa ni 'di lta ste/ ye nas ma ⑩bcos ji bzhin pa/ /chos so cog gi 9)snying po ste/ /med pa 101—655

656 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101las byung sna tshogs snang / /snang med de bzhin dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /bcom ldan 'das bkod pa'i 'byung gnas ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces ①gsungs so / /gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ rang 'byung rig pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /ma bcos chos nyid dbyings kyi don/ /lhun grub thabs dang shes rab las yang dag rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gsal/ /bcom ldan 'das seng ge sgra ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das mdzes pa'i tog ②ngo bo nyid dudag pas gsungs pa/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yikhyi/ /bde dang mi bde rnam pa kun/ /de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas/ /tshor ba bde sdug gang yang med/ /ces gsungs sophyi/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das mdzes pa'i rgyan ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ de bzhin nyid du don bstan du / /de bzhin nyid du kun gcig pas/ /gang gis ⑥gang la gang zhig ⑦bstan//nyid la nyid gleng dukho nar zad/ /ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid la / /dus gsum dus bzhir mi rigs te/ /ye shes rig pa'i khyad par las/ /skad cig bskal pa de skad cig /ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das snying rje'i rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das rtag 6)pa/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid du/ /ye nas mya ngan 'das pas na/ /rang bzhin lhun grub tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ chos so cog gi rang bzhin ni/ /ma skyes pa las 7thams cad skye/ /skyes pa nyid na skye ba med/ /rigs mchog rdo rje skye gnas dam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das 101—656

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/657yongs su dgongs pa'i rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ de bzhin nyid du kun rig na/ /des khyab gar gnas sangs ①rgyas zhing / /yon tan rin chen sprin bkod pa/ /dgod par bya ba ci yang med/ /ces ②gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das gser gyi 'od zer ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/dpag tu med pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /ji bzhin de bzhin nyid la bzhugs/ /de bzhin nyid dang thams cad kyang / /gnyis dumed de bzhin de 0nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das 'od kyi dpal ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das⑤/ /so sor snang ba ma yin te/ /ji bzhin de bzhin nyid des na/ /de la 'khor ba'i rang bzhin med/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das zhi ba'i dbang po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di bzhin 0du/ de bzhin nyid kyi de nyid ni/ /dpag cing gzhal bar mtha' yas pas / /dpag med rgyal po'i pho brang yin/ /de nas kun bkod der gcig nasag / /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sprin gyi dpal ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ thams cad 'byung ba'i cho 'phrul yang / /cir yang 'gyur ba'i ye shes te/ /gdos par gyur pa'i nichos med pas/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das yid 'ong dbyangs ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i kha brgyud 6)pas/ /ma rig ngo bo de bzhin pa/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i skad cig ma/ /de nyid rig na bde chen gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das me long 'od snang ngo bo nyid dag pas ⑩'di skad du/ nyon mongs ye shes lngar rtog (nyapa/ /ji bzhin de la gnyis ka sgrib/ /rtog 7dang mi rtog gnyis med 101wa 657

658 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101de / /rtog ①pa de nyid yang dag lam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das zla 'od dpal ngo bo nyid dag pas ②'di skad du/ theg pa dpag med bstan pa yang / /ji ltar mos pa tha dad pa/ /khrid pa bya ①ba'i thabs su zad/ /rdo rje theg pa nyid las med/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i snying po rjodapal ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ gang gis de mthong mthong ma thag /mi shes chod ①pa'i dra ba chod/ /khyung ⑥dang seng ge ji bzhin dul/ /mngal ltar lus kyi mngal gyis bsgribs/ /zhes phyagasungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das spos kyi ⑧rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ dbang sgyur 6)thabs kyi ye shes kyis/ /sgyu ma'i chos la dbang thob pas/ /mun la snang 'byung ji bzhin du/ /thams cad dbang sgyur rang rig yin/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sngon spro ba'i ⑩rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du / rnam dag ye shes sgyu ma dang / /log rtog ⑩mtshan ma'i sgyu ma gnyis/ /rang bzhin de nyid dag pas na/ /gnyis su shes pa nyid tshogs rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das rin chen rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ bsam gyis mi khyab 7chos 'di rnams/ /de bzhin nyid du gcig pas na/ /gang gi 8de bzhin de shes pa/ /kun la dbang sgyur thob pa yin/zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das 'od zer dpal ngo bo nyid dag 8pas 'di skad du/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi 7dgongs pa 'di/ /shes nas ⑩de la gang gnas pa/ /rang rig nyid la dbang thob pa'i/ /de bzhin rig pa 'dzin pa nyid / /ces gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das dka' thub rgyal po'i ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ de nyid ji bzhin mngon gyur na/ /med la mi zad ⑩101—658

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/659'byung ba yi/ /che ba'i yon tan rgyun mi 'chad①/ /cir snang kun 'byung rin chen gter/ /zhes ②gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor snying po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ ji bzhin ma bcos de nyid la/ /de bzhin pa yi blo gnas pa/ /de bzhin de nyid ma yin pa'i/ /sgrub dang bsgrub pa ga la yod / /ces gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das nges par gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid dag pas ①'di skad du/ mkha' la glo ④bur sprin 'thibs ltar/ /de bzhin glo 2bur rtog pas bsgribs⑥/ /mkha' dag nang du sprin sangs ltar/ /rnam rtog sangs pas ngang gis sangs/ /zhes ⑦gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das nges par gsungs pa'i ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ ji snyed dag pa'i gsung nibarjod kyang / /rdo rje gsung la spros pa med/ /spros med gsung nyid kun gsal khyab/ /ma gsungs pa nyid rgya nyucher bshad/ /ces gsungs so//yang bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ thams cad yul la 'jug pa yi/ /thogs med ma chags de bzhin blos/ /ji snyed ji bzhin nyid du bsgyur / /zad med gter ldan rin chen 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das me tog dbang po dbyangs ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ji bzhin nyid la bzhugs pas ⑩na/ /'di zhes ⑩tshig tu ma gsungs kyang / /khyab pas gcig pa'i byin brlabs ⑩kyis/ /ji ltar 'dod pa so sor mjal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das grags pa'i dpal ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ sangs rgyas sems can la sogs pa/ /thams cad ma lus lus pa med/ /rang rig ma rig rtog pa nyid/ /kun kyang rang byung ye shes nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sprul ( pa'i rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag 101—659

660 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101pas 'di skad du/ yi ge phyag rgya ye shes kyang / /tshig las 'byung ba'i gzhi yin te / /de nyid dag pas thams cad dag /gsung la gsung nyid mi gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sgra dbyangs mi zad ①pa ②nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ de bzhin nyid kyang rang bzhin du/ /lnga phung nyon mongs rnam par dag /rnam rtog ①rdul bral skye 'gag med/ /thams cad ngo bo nyid du bcom / /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sman gyi rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ dpag med 'jig rten rdul snyed dun/ /'gro ba rdul phran bsam yas la/ /khyad par de bzhin nyid snang bas/ /til 'bru mar gyis khyab ltar gnas/ /zhes ⑤gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das gser gyi 'od 'phro ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ rdul phran gcig tsam gang zag la/ /dgongs te mdun du gsung brjod ⑥pa/ /dpag med mtha' yas rdul snyed tsam//de snyed kun du thos par grol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das bkod pa'i rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ gsung gcig mi zad ⑦mtha' yas gsung / /mtha' dang dbus med kun du khyab/ /khyab dang khyab med rdo rje gsung / /sna tshogs dngos med de bzhin nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das gser gyi gsung ( ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ gang yang ma bcos de nyid la/ /phyogs dang snga 6)phyi dus med de/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /de nyid rang rig rang nyid dobo/ /zhes yigasungs so//yang bcom ldan 'das dpal gyi rgyal po ngo bo nyid 7dag pas 'di skad du/ de nyid de snyed rang bzhin te(rte/ /de snyed de nyid yin pa la/ /byis pa rnams kyis gnyis su bzung / /de la gnyis su dbye yibyar med/ /ces gsungs so/ /101—660

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bskad pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/661yang bcom ldan 'das snang ba brtsegs ①pa'i dpal ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad dul/ stong nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /mi mthun pa dang gnyen po ②gnyis / /ye nas dbyer med gcig pas na/ /gnod pas 'jigs pa ga la yod / /ces gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag pa'i dpal ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rang bzhin te/ /dag pa dag la dag pa nyid/ /rtog pa dag la rtog par snang / /cis 'dul der snang ci yang med/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das dga' mchog dpal ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ rang bzhin rang gis ma bcos pa/yang gis ③'od gsal de bzhin nyid/ /kun gyi snying po de nyid pas/ /cis kyang ma bsgribs nam mkha' chedhi/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das gzi brjid dpal ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ ji bzhin pa nyid sa mchog stephyi / /de rig ye shes bla ma yis/ /ye nas de bzhin nyid la gnas/ /da gdod bgrod du ga la yod/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kun gyi dge ba'i ⑥bshes gnyen ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ stong pa nyid kyi snying po la/ /sna tshogs snang ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sus kyang ma byas rang 'byung ba/ /ji bzhin pa yi dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ces gsang ba'i tshig tu'o / /yang bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad sbyong ba'i ngo bo nyid dag pa gsang bas 'di skad du/ zad med ye shes dngos grub ni/ /de bzhin nyid du dngos grub pas/ /zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/ /da gdod bsgrub gtu ga la yod/ /ces gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /yang bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten kun gyi (kyingo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ chos kun rang bzhin med pa nyid6)/ /mya 101—661

66 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101ngan 'das zhes de la bya/ /stong nyid rang bzhin rnam dag la/ /de nyid mi gnas byang chub sems/ /zhes gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par rgyal ba nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ rnam rtog chu ①bo'i rka mgo ste/ /stong nyid zhing du ma bsgyur ②na/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho g.yeng 'gyur ba/ /de mi shes la de ltar snang / /zhes gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /yang bcom ldan 'das me tog bkod pa'i rgyal po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ ji bzhin pa yi ①de bzhin nyid/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i ma yin pas/ /kun bzang shes rab pha rol phyin/ /sems can sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas/ /zhes gsang ba'i tshig tu'o / /yang bcom ldan 'das thams cad snang ba ④ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ stug po bkod pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /sems can rnam pa thams cad dag /dngos po brtan g.yo la sogs pa/ /de nyid las byung dngos med sku / /zhes gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /yang bcom ldan 'das yid dang ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ rang 'byung ye shes rtsa ba ni/ /byang chub sems nyid yin pas na/ /de yi rtsa ba snying rje ste/ /pha rol phyin par thabs kyis so(snye/ /zhes gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /yang bcom ldan 'das seng ge 'bum gzugs ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ ji snyed ji bzhin nyid kyi don/ /yi ge ming tshogs sgra mtshon pa/ /ming tshogs sgra la ma brten (5)par/ /nyam ༷drod blo yis rig pa med / /ces gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /yang bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po ngo bo nyid dag pas 'di skad du/ chos kun chos kyi rang bzhin ni/ /de bzhin nyid las mi gzhan pas/ /de nyid byang chub lam nyid des(5)/ /lam de stug dzi)po bkod pa'i gnas/ /zhes gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /kye grogs po dag gzhan yang 101—662

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/663de dag la sogs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa'i sgron ma bye 6)ba sa ya snyed ②ngo bo nyid dag pa dang / chos kyi pho brang na bzhugs pa mtha' thug pa med pa'i ngo bo nyid dag pas gsang ba'i tshig 'di skad du/ la la ni 'di ltar/ rtog med rang rig skad cig ma/ /sems can sangs rgyas gnyis kyi dbyings/ /rig dang ma rig gnyis kho na/ /dag dang ma dag gnyis su snang / /zhes gsang ba dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ de nyid smra ③brjod med ④pa las/ /de mtshon phyir na tha dad brjod/ /gang brjod pa nyid de bzhin nyid/ /de nyid spros med rdo rje don/ /zhes gsang ba dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du / de ⑤nyid cir yang mi snang na/ /glo yibur rnam rtog tha dad pa'i/ /rnam rtog de nyid snang bar zad/ /snang ba nyid na snang ba med/ /ces gsang ba dam par bsngags ⑦so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ ji bzhin pa yi de kho na/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang byar med na/ /gang gis bcos te su yis byas/ /byas pa po zhig ga la yod/ /ces gsang ba dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ ye shes can gyi spyod yul ni/ /de bzhin de nyid yin pas na/ /de khyab gang gi ⑧chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin dag pas porabasgribs pa med/ /ces gsang kyib dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ de nyid mtshan nyid med pa las//mtshan nyid sna tshogs par snang bas/ /kun 'byung dbyings kyi rang bzhin pas/ /med la zad mi shes par mdzod/ /ces gsang ba dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ sna tshogs theg pa'i lta ba dang / /sdom pa srung ba'i bya ba kun/ /spyad par bya ba ma yin yang / /kun kyang ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs/ /zhes gsang ba dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ de la phyogs dang dus 101—663

664 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101med par/ /gang gis phyogs dang dus brtags pa'i/ /de nyid de la rnam par snang ske/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni de mi mkhyen/ /zhes gsang ba dam par bsngags so//la la ni 'di ①skad du/ bsam gyis mi khyab kun shes nas/ /bsam du med par de bzhag na/ /dpag tu med pa'i yon tan 'byung / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yin/ /zhes gsang ba dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/bsam gyis mi khyab mi shes par/ /bsam med ngang du gang 'jog pa/ /byis pa de ni blun pa ste/ /mun pa'i skye mched nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes kun nas brtse ②ba dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ bsam med bsam gyis mi khyab chos / /lhag par mthong nas zhi gnas pa/ /rnam rtog spong len gang byed pa/ /de dag sgrib pa mu mtha' yas/ /zhes bshes gnyen dam pa nyid du gdams so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ sna tshogs so so kun rig kyang / /kun grol rnam dag lam med na/ /dam pa nyid las shin tu gol/ /nam yang nges pa rnyed pa min/ /zhes bka' dam par ②gdams so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ sna tshogs rim gyis 'jug pa dang / /bsam spyod blo yi nang du 'gyur/ /bsam med yongs su rdzogs pa'i don/ /rim gyis pa yi dug chen yin/ /zhes khyad par dam par gdams so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ sna tshogs so sor ma rig par/ /de bzhin nyid du nges mi rnyedali/ /de nyid nges pa ma rnyed na/ /sna tshogs smra ba rung ma yin/ /zhes nan tan dam par gdams so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/mkha' la 'ja' snang ji bzhin du/ /bsam yas bsam snang de (snyebazhin no/ /gcig tu nges pa med pa'i gsung / /ji ltar 'byung ba de ltar yin/ /zhes dpag dka' (6)ba dam par gsungs so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ kun gyi rtsa ba 101—664

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bskad pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/665'dir bshad pas/ /'di don gang rig thos pa'i mchog /thams cad 'di las 'byung bas na①/ /'di shes kun shes shes rab mchog /ces shes rab mchog dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ gsang ba'i nang na gsang chen 'di/ /nyid kyis nyid kyang mi mthong bar/ /gzhan gyis mthong bar ga la 'gyur/ /de nyid dam pa rnams kyis bsngags/ /zhes gsang ba dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ chos rnams kun gyi ②snying po 'di/ /gser dang mkha' bzhin mi 'gyur bas/ /mi nub stong ③bral med pa'i phyir/ /chos kyi lidam pa don po mchog /ces dam pa chen por ⑤bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ thog ma med nas bsags pa yi/ /rnam rtog sprin phung dpag med pa/ /stong nyid cig ⑤car rig pa ⑦yis/ /de bzhin nyid du rnam par sgrolani / /zhes gsang ba dam par bsngags yo)so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ ji snyed bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /chos kun stong par rig nges na/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor bsakyi/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i bsam gtan yin/ /zhes rnal 'byor dam par gdams so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ 'khor ba ji srid yod par du/ /bstan pa'i snying po nyi ma shar/ /rang bzhin chos nyid 'khor lo 'di / /mi nub rgyun ⑩mi 'chad par 7bskor/ /zhes gsang ba dam pa'i theg par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ mi 'gyur mi 'jig yirdo rje don/ /sna tshogs kun 'byung rin po che/ /ma chags rnam dag pad+mo nyid/ /thams cad lhun grub mdzad pa che/ /ma nor ma bcos de bzhin nyid/ /ces yang nges pa dam par chabastan to8/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ stong nyid gzugs med chos kyi sku / /smon med yid las 'das pa'i gsung / /mtshan med rtog las 'das 101—665

666 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101pa'i thugs/ /rtog med re skong yon tan mdzod①/ /thabs kyi ②gar thabs phrin las mdzod / /ces cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung bar bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ mi rtog chos kyi me long gsal/ /gnyis su med pas thams cad mnyam / /sna tshogs mtshan nyid ma 'dres mkhyen/ /nan tan chen po khyab grub mdzad / /ye nyid kun gyi rang bzhin mkhyen/ /zhes ye shes rgyun du 'char bar bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ snang stong go 'byed kun khyab ④mkha'/ /theg dbyings la ni kun gnas sa/ /zhi gnas rnam dag chu chen po/ /lhag mthong ye shes 'od 'bar me/ /shes bya thogs med 'thor ba'i rlung / /zhes thams cad 'byung bar bsngags (5)so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs gsal stong gzugs/ /khyab gsal rang bzhin 'gro ba'i sgra/ /dang bas sim byed chos kyi dri/ /don bcu nyams su myong ba'i ro/ /bde mchog don la reg pa nyid/ /ces yon tan dam par bsngags (6)so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ci yang mi sems gti mug la/ /dngos po kun bcom zhe snang nyid/ /ye 'byam nga rgyal bdag nyid che/ /bde chen rang bzhin rjes (7chags pa/ /gang du ma 'gyur gzhan phrag dog /ces blang dor med par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ kun gyi rang bzhin gcig shes pas/ /de nyid dbang du thams cad 'dus / /kun la dbang sgyur thos pas na/ /ye dbang chen po rdzogs pa'o/ /zhes dbang dam par bsngags (7so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ thams cad kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/ /kun (9)la khyab gnas brtag dka' ba/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul yin/ /rdo rje kun bkod rnal 'byor lung / /zhes 7bka' dam par bsngags 11so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ de nyid der ni kun gcig (stepas/ /101—666

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/667bdag dang gzhan du snang ba med/ /stong ①nyid rnam dag nam mkha' la/ /gtsang smer dbye ba rdul yang med/ /ces bdud rtsi phyidam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ byang chub snying po dam pa tshul/ /rnam rtog rdul gyis ga la 'go / /de nyid chen por 'ub chung bas④/ /cis kyang mi bskyod ⑤nyam mi nga / /zhes re dogs med par bsngags ⑥so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ rnam rtog mtshan ma'i ri bo 'disti/ /seng ge'i khog pa rang zhig ltar/ /stong nyid rang nyid ma zhig na/ /gzhan gyis 'jig (kyepar smo la 'gyur/ /zhes rang bzhin dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ bde chen rnam dag rtog byed pas/ /legs nyes gnyis ka kyi)rnam par rtog /bde chen nges pa'i rlung zhugs na/ /gang 'dir rnam par rtog pa med/ /ces yongs su rtog pa las 'das par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ de nyid phyin ci ma log par/ /bsrung bya mi rtog mi gnas patshu/ /le lo g.yeng ba'i dgra bsrung ste/ /de bzhin de las 'da' mi bya/ /zhes dam tshig 4)dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/dpag tu med pa'i 'jig rten tsodu/ /sgron ma bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /ji snyed pa yi chos bstan pa/ /mtha' yas don ni gcig tu 'dus/ /zhes par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ de nyid de las ma nyams na/ /dran bsam sgyu ma med pa yi/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab nyid/ /bslab pa rnam (snyegasum yongs su rdzogs/ /zhes skibaslab pa dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ de nyid las mtha' zhi gnas dang / /lhag pa'i don mthong 'dres pa yisnyi/ /sde gsum nges par rdzogs pa na/ /'bum phrag mtha' yas ke brjod mi lang / /zhes bkri drang brgyud pa dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di 101—667

668 bka' 'thur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101skad du/ tshig la dbang bas tshig bsgyur 6)na/ /tshig mtha' yas pas bsdus na 'dusal/ /tshig gcig ②rnam par spros gyur na/ /brjod pas de ni zad mi 'gyur / /zhes gsung mi ②zad pa dam par bsngags ④so/ /la la ni 'di skad du / smra brjod tshig la gang dag pas/ /gang gis dgongs pa dpog mi nus/ /tshig tshogs rgya dumatsho thos pa min/ /tshig gcig thos pa duthos pa'i mchog /ces thos pa rgya mtsho'i dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ khyab dang mi gnas rnam ⑦mi rtog /ma bral mi g.yo ma chags pa/ /de nyid las ni gzhan med de/ /pha rol phyin pa de kho na/ /zhes mthar son pa dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ 'don brjod 'dri (7klog don byed pa/ /dmus long dmu rgod rgyug khapa 'dra/ /dbyings kyis dbyings la bris pa'i don/ /gang rig 'don brjod 'dri 7klog mchog /ces spyod pa dam par bsngags so/ / la la ni ⑩'di skad du/ mtshan mar byas dang snang ba'i mchogatso /ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /mkha' dang 'ja' ltar rnam rig pa/ /bsngo ba bla med byang chub nyid / /ces bsngo 'ab dam par bsngags chaso/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ chos gang sems kyi de nyid la/ /gnyis dang mtha' ru gang lta ba/ /ma rig 'khrul pas phyin 7ci log /theg chen gsang sngags lam las log /ces gdams ngag dam par gsungs so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel rim gyis pa//blo chung rmongs pas khrid pa'i thabs/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid 'di la/ /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras 7rim gyis med/ /ces nges par dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ ma bcos de bzhin nyid 'di 'a// /yid bzhin cir yang 'byung ba yi/ /cho 'phrul 'byung bas sems can rnams/ /ji ltar 'dul ba 101—668

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i da rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/669mthong thos snang / /zhes thams cad rgyu med pa la bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /gsang ba'i dbyings na gnas pa yi / /thams cad gsang ba'i snying po nyid/ /mthong bas 'gro don rgya mtshor rdzogs / /zhes ①thams cad lhun gyis grub par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /de mthong ngo bo nyid mi dmigs/ /dran med bya dang byed med pa/ /gnas gsum mnyam nyid rjes su dran/ /zhes ting nge 'dzin dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ gnas gsum dmigs pa'i 'du shes med/ /ming med tshig gi ②lam dang bral/ /bla med 'dus ma byas pa yi/ /mchod pa yang dag mchog tu bshadabya/ /ces mchod pa dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ bskal pa bye ba dpag med du/ /log cing zhen pa'i mun pa gsum/ /de nyid tshul bzhin skad cig ma/ /kun gsal gcig gis yongs su sangs/ /zhes ④gsang ba dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ mun pas 'thibs pa de dag gis/ /mi g.yo mi rtog ⑤de nyid blta77/ /de mthong mun pa rnam dag sangs/ /'gyod sangs kun gyi ⑦mchog tu bshad / /ces tshangs pa dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ /mi mthun gnyen po mi dmigs pa(kye/ /stong pa nyid kyi 6)chos nyid la/ /gnas pa gang yin de dag gis/ /gnyen po bstan du ci ⑩yang med/ /ces la gcad (nyepa dam par bsngags so/ /la la ni 'di skad du/ thams cad rang bzhin ma bcos patso/ /ji bzhin pa yi de bzhin du/ /rang rig bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'o/ /zhes tsosems bskyed ④pa rnam par bsngags so / /la la ni 'di skad du/ ci yang mi sems mi g.yo zhing / /mi rtog rnam 101—669

de bzhin gshegs pa mas cad kyi gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/671su bcad de smras pa/ dper na kun du rgyu ba'i mi/ /'dod pa'i yul du gang 'gro ba/ /yul gyi rnam pa mtha' yas kyang / /bgrod yo)yul lam gnas gcig las med/ /de bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /rnam grangs chos sgo ②ji snyed kyang / / bkrid pas ③drang ba'i tshig yin te/ /bsam pa'i yul ni gcig pa'o//don rnams gcig tu bsdus pa yi/ /bslab par bya ba dam pa ste/ /nges par gcig las med pa'i phyir/ /kun 'dus dam pa'i ④bslab par gcesadu/ /dam pa 'dir ⑥'dus kun shes ⑦na/ /de yi ye shes mtha' yas te/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid pas/ /mdo don gcig tu bsdus par gsungs/ /grogs po dag de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgongs pa de kho na nyid gcig tu 'dus par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus nas bshad pa ste/ thams cad kyi ⑧mdo de kho na nyid du 'dus par shes par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pas/dman pa ⑨rnams gcig tu nges pa dam pa yirnyed par gyur to/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po nyid la dman pa ⑩rnams yi tsorangs te/ mngon par bstod pa/e ma ho skyes tsochen gsang ba'i bdag /rtsal chen smra ba seng ge'i sgra/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi 'thugs/ /sangs rgyas kun sngon 8ye nas byung / /khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi mes/ /che tsomachog rje btsan tsodam pa'i sku/ /bde gshegs kun gyi bshes gnyen mchog /sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /kun gyi 'byung gnas me long gsal/ /phyogs kun gsal 'grel nges pa'i mdo/ /theg chen rmad grags ngo mtshar che/ /gsang chen byung tshul ngo mtshar che sa ho zhes nges pa (snyedam par mngon par bstod/ de nas cang mi dmigs par gyur (shete / gang du nges par bgros pa'i gsang ba dam pa dag lha dang mi'i 'jig rten 101—671
