brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 753snyed dang mnyam pa/ thub pa chen po lha'i dbang po dang / thub pa chen po lha ma yin gyi dbang po dang / thub pa chen po mi'i dbang po dang / thub pa chen po dud 'gro'i dbang po dang / thub pa chen po yi dgas ①kyi dbang po dang /thub pa chen po dmyal ba'i dbang po dang / de dag la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po sras kyi tshogs grangs med pa dang / yang thabs cig ②tu bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang khrag 'thung rol pa'i chadapal he ru ka btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'di lta ste/ khrag 'thung chen po dpal bud+dha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / khrag 'thung chen po dpal badz+ra he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / khrag 'thung chen po dpal rat+na 0he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / khrag 'thung chen po dpal pad+ma he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / khrag 'thung chen po dpal kurma he ru ka zhes bya ba dang /btsun mo bud+dha kro dhidhi zhes bya ba dang / btsun mo badz+ra kro yisnyi zhes bya ba dang /btsun mo rat+na kro rtsisnyi zhes bya ba dang / btsun mo pad+ma kro dhi zhes bya ba dang /btsun mo kurma kro dhi zhes bya ba dang / gzhan yang gsang ba chen po 'khor btsun mo dang bcas pa gsang ba chen po rak+ṣa nihe ru ka zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba chen po yak+ṣa he ru ka ponyezhes bya ba dang / gsang ba chen po bi shwa 0te ru ka zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba chen po sa ma ya he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba chen mo rak+ṣa tunyegro dhi zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba chen mo yak+ṣa kro dhi zhes bya ba dang /gsang ba chen mo bi shwa 8gro dhi zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba chen mo sa ma ya gro dhi zhes bya ba dang / gzhan yang phra 5)men ma nyi shu'i tshogs kyi 'khor dkar mo'i tshogs zhes tsobya ba dang / rkun 8mo'i tshogs yizhes bya ba dang / sbos tshumo'i tshogs zhes bya ba dang / gtum mo'i tshogs zhes bya ba dang / rmongs mo'i tso101—753

754 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101tshogs zhes bya ba dang / thal byed ma'i tshogs zhes bya ba dang / sme sha can gyi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / ma ①tshogs zhes bya ba dang / seng gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / stag ②gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / wa gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / khyi gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / bzhad chagadong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / gang duka'i gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / dur bya'i (snyegadong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / bya rog gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang /lug pa'i gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / rta (6)gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang /phag gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang / seng gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba dang /spre gdong gi tshogs zhes bya ba la sogs pa/ phra ⑦min ma'i tshogs shin tu mang ba dang ske/ gzhan yang rdo rje srin po khro bo'i tshogs rdo rje srin po khro bo rnam par rgyal ba (8)zhes bya ba dang / dbyug pa sngon po zhes bya ba dang / gshin rje gshed 6)ces bya ba dang / mi g.yo mgon po zhes bya ba dang / rta mgrin zhes bya ba dang /gzhan gyis 7mi thub pa zhes bya ba dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhes bya ba dang /khams gsum rnam (nyapar rgyal ba zhes bya ba dang / hūṃ kā tsor zhes bya ba dang /stobs po che zhes bya ba dang / gzhan yang rdo rje srin mo'i khro mo'i 'khor rdo rje srin mo snyems tsom zhes bya ba dang / sder mo zhes bya ba dang / dur khrod ma zhes bya ba dang / gtun ⑩khung ma zhes bya ba dang / gtum mo zhes bya ba dang /mda' snyems snyim zhes bya ba dang / sgra 'byin ma zhes bya ba dang / gsod ma zhes bya ba dang / bskyod ma zhes bya ba dang / rlung 'byin ma zhes bya ba la sogs pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i 'khor rigs 7'dzin 'bum phrag bsam gyis yi mi khyab pa dang / gzhan yang gsang sngags kyi mthu tunyedang / ston pa'i ngo mtshar rmad du 101—754

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 755byung ①ba'i cho ②'phrul gyis rang dbang med par 'khor du 'dus pa'i dbang phyug dang glu/ dbang phyug ma ③nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa kun bran dang yang bran/g.yog dang yang g.yog dang bcas pa rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs kyi 'khor 'dus pa rnams ni bdag dang gzhan gyi shes pa'i rgyud ni thams cad zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang dbang dang drag po dang dgug pa dang bcing ba dang gtang ba dang dgrol dub dang drang ba dang rengs ⑤pa dang rmugs pa dang dbral ba dang bza' ba dang btung ba dang 'jib pa dang nyams pa dang gsad pa ⑥dang / gnon ⑦pa dang spar ba dang pham pa dang / rgyal ba la sogs pa byed cing thabs cig ⑧ku rdo rje gsang ba'i gral du 'khod do/ /de nas yang dpal 'bar yum kro dhi'i rgyal mo yang ⑨bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po'i sku la 'khril te bzhugs sol/ /bcom ldan 'das byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang po dang / btsun mo bya ba mo kun du bzang mo yang yiganyis su med par mdun gyis bltas te bka' nod ⑩pa'i tshul du gnas so/ /'phags pa rgyud kyi rgyal po ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo'i (stemado zhes bya ba las gleng tsogazhi'i le'u ste dang po'o⑨// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po dpal kun du bzang po ye shes rngam pa'i rgyal pos 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la rnam par gzigs so/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la gzigs nas phyi snod kyi khams nam mkha' dang sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung dang ri dang /tshal la 7sogs pa thams cad la rnam par gzigs so/ /de dag thams cad la rnam par gzigs nas yang nang bcud kyi khams sems dang sems las byung ba'i 101—755

756 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101g.yo ba dang / 'gul ba dang / dmyal ba dang / yi dgas ①dang / byol song dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / lha'i rigs so so'i khams dang /bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i khams dang —/ mu stegs kyi khams dang / bdud chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang /ru tra ②dang / ru tra can la sogs pa'i khams la rnam par gzigs so/ /de dag thams cad la rnam par gzigs nas yang nyan thos kyi sa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sa dang / rig ②'dzin sa ④pa'i bsti ⑤gnas dang / phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas thams cad sa ⑥la rdzu 'phrul gyi spyan ⑦gyis rnam par gzigs nas smra bsam las 'das pa de bzhin nyid stong pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs gte cang mi mdzad / rnam par mi mdzad/ mdzad ⑨pa mi 'gogati /mdzad pa rnam par yang mi 'gog /mi mdzad pa yang 4)mi gnas/ cang mi gsung ⑫/ rnam par mi gsung turtemi sgrogasatso/ gsungs pa yang 7mi 'gog / gsungs pa ⑩rnam par yang mi 'gog /mi gsung 6)mi 'gog pa la yang 8mi gnas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / snod kyi khams thams cad dang / sa'i khyad par thams cad la yang 7mi gzigs mi dgongs/ gzigs shing dgongs pa la yang 6)mi 'gog /rnam par yang mi 'gog /mi 'gog pa la yang (memi gnas so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag dang /snod kyi khams de dag dang / bcud kyi khams de dag dang / sa'i khyad par de dag thams cad kyang sgyu (nyama'i mtshan nyid tsam du yang so dmigs su med do/ /101—756

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 757dper na nam mkha' ni chos thams cad kyi rjes su yang ①song la ji lta bu'i ngo bor yang gdags su med pa de ②bzhin du don dam pa byang chub sems de yang ③chos thams cad la yang byakhyab la smra bsam las kyang 'das so/ /de ltar chos kyi sku'i ngo bor brjod du med pa la brnal ⑤bzhin du yum kun du bzang mo rngam pa'i kro dhi'i rgyal mos stong nyid kyi ngang las glu du'adis bskul lo/ /oṃ ⑦snang stong stong pa'i rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /smra bsam las 'das don dam byang chub sems/ /stong nyid ngang las mi 'da'i (snyedam tshig gis/ /snying rje nam mkha'i 0ngo bo bstan du gsol/ /zhes bskul ⑩bas/ bskul ⑩bar thugs su chud nas stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang las rig (nyepa'i ye shes snying rje chen po yis kun du klong ⑫bdal bar khyab ste/ snying rje chen po des 8'khor gyi dkyil 'khor kun du khyab par mdzad do/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor kun du khyab par mdzad nas yang snod kyi khams kun la khyab par mdzad nas yang bcud kyi khams kun la khyab par mdzad do/ /bcud kyi khams kun la khyab par mdzad nas sa'i khams tsokun la khyab par mdzad ⑩do/ /dper na nyi ma bar 8snang la shar ba'i 'od kun la snyoms pa bzhin du rig pa'i nyi ma snying rjes byang chub kyi sems kyis kyang stong nyid kyi ngang kun la snyoms par khyab bdal to8/ /de'i tshe gsang ba mchog gi bdag po de nyid yang ting nge 'dzin las langs nas ()snying rje nam mkha'i ngo bo kun du snang ba ()zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /zhugs ma thag tu snying rjes kun la khyab par gyur pa ni ting nge 'dzin de'i mthu yin no(nyu/ /de nas yum kun du bzang mo rngam pa kro dhi'i khri)rgyal mos yang glu 'dis bskul lo/ /ma ltar byams pa'i thugs rjes kun du khyab/ /mkha' ltar go 'byed cho 'phrul 101—757

758 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101'byung gnas las/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang thugs rje yo)sprul pa'i sku/ /'bar ba'i sku mchog bdag la bstan du gsol/ /a la la ho zhes gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des chos thams cad don dam pa byang chub sems la shar bar mkhyen nas mi dmigs nam mkha'i dbyings nas rdo rje'i ②mngon du phyung (kyeste/ dper na zla ba dri ma med pa nam mkha' dang ba la ④shar ba bzhin no/ /rdo rje'i sku de las rig pa'i cho 'phrul gyi 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba ni dper na nyi 'od kyi 'od zer dus gcig shar ba lta bu'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des ting nge 'dzin las langs nas 'dod chags chen po'i tshul rdo rje rnam par bsgyings ⑤pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te zhugs 6)nas kyang yum kro dhi'i rgyal mo la gzigs te 'dzum pa rnam par mdzad do/ /de nas yum gro dhi'i ⑦rgyal mos kyang spyan zim bag gi tshul gyis gzigs nas lan stong du brkyang (8)phyag btsal yo)te g.yon ⑩pa slong ba'i glu 'dis rnam par bskul lo/ /e ma'o yid bzhin sku mchog tshogs chen mngon rdzogs lha/ /rdo rje gar gyi (metshul gyis snyigar mdzad cing / /dga' mchog rdo rje'i byang chub sems chen de/ /'dzum zhing 'khyil pa'i pad+ma'i gnas su phob kyi)ho/ /e ma'o/ /dkar la 'tsher ba'i byang chub sems sprin dang —/ /chags pa dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin du/ /gnyis med 'phros pa'i byin brlabs kha)bsam yas las/ /ye shes lha tshogs sprul sku bsam yas 'thon/ /ma rig mun pas ldongs pas don gyis snyiphye/ /dgon gdungs yiganas nas byang chub myu 7gu skyed/ /zhi ba 'gog pa'i sa las rnam par slong 6she/ /zhes rnam par bskul bas gnyis su med pa'i rnam par rol pas rol zhing brjid pa dang bcas 101—758

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 759nas gar mdzad pa dang / zhal 'dzum pa dang / 'dor ba dang / skum ①pa dang ske/ 'gying ba ②dang / spyan mdzes pa'i smin ring bskyod ①cing sgyur ba dang ske/ dung gi 'phur pas g.yan ⑤pa slong ba dang / 'dor zhing skum pa rjodang /'jog ⑦cing 'deg ⑧pa dang / rnam par 'dor ba'i rol pa'i gar gyis nam mkha'i khams kun du khyab par mdzad do/ /rnam par rol pa des 'byung ba dang /'byung ba las gyur pa ⑨thams cad la khyab par mdzad do/ /des sems dang sems las byung ba 0kun la khyab par mdzad pas bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi sems zhi zhing 'khyil bas rol pa'i char mngon par phab pas snod kyi khams dang ske/ bcud kyi khams dang / bsam gtan pa yidang / 'gog pa pa tsodang /sa'i khyad par thams cad dang / byang chub kyi rol pa sna tshogs sgeg 8pa dang /steg 0pa dang / sbyor spyob dang / 'khyud pa dang / sdom pa dang / bstim pa dang / mnyes pa dang / gsol ba dang / myang ba dang / bca' ba tsodang /bde ba dang / sprod ⑩pa dang / 'jog pa la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das kun du 4)bzang po'i rdo rje 'dzin gyis kun du rgyas par byas te yang dag par gnas so//de nas de'i tshe thugs rnam par dag pa'i mkha' klong nas rig pa byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer brjod kyis 4)mi lang ba 'byam klas pa shar ba de las gsung gi yig 'bru 'khor lo'i tshogs su yang zhu snang ngo / /yig 'bru de nyid thugs phyag mtshan du yang (nyagyur/ thugs dam tshig gi phyag rgya 'od du 'phros shing rnam par 'du ba'i tshul gyis rnal 'byor gyi (gyedabang phyug gi 'khor rgyal ba yab yum dang /sems dpa' dang / sems ma dang / thub pa dang / 'joms pa dang /'joms pa zhu rnams kyi ( steskur yang rang rang gi 'dam tshig gi phyag rgya las snang 101—759

760 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101bar byas te gsang ba mchog gi ①bdag po la mdun gyis bltas ②nas rdo rje gsang ba'i gral du 'khod de/ de ltar re re la'ang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor zhabs 'bring chadang bcas pa 'byam klas pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' ༷klas pa lhun gyis grub po/ /yang 'od zer de dag re re las he ru ka mang po'i tshogs kyang shar to/ /he ru ka re re la yang ⑤sangs rgyas 'bum phrag gi 'khor so so'i zhabs 'bring ⑥dang bcas pa lhun gyis grub par mdzad do/ /he ru ka re re las rig pa'i nyi ma'i char mngon par phab ste mun nag gi klong ⑦gsal bar mdzad do//chos kyi glu dang gar dang / chos kyi char dang / mchod pa dang / chos kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ⑧ba rngam pa'i cho ⑨'phrul yan ⑩man dang 'asnrel zhi tsothams cad du ling long phyad 8do/ /de'i tshe he ru ka 'od kyi phreng ba des ru tra ④can dang ske/ bdud dang srin po dang / gnod tsosbyin dang / dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa rang rang gi che ba'i nga rgyal rab tu ston pa rnams zhi zhing dul bar gyur te⑩/ rang rang gi dbang phrogs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di la dad par gyur nas 'dus rab tu 'dus so/ /de'i tshe na byang chub sems ⑩kyi 'od zer kun du khyab pa des 'du shes med pa dang 'gog pa la gnas pa'i mur lhung ba rnams sa bon mes tshig pa dang 'dra ba de yang (nyadri ma med pa'i byang chub sems rin po che'i chu des dbang bskur bas byang chub sems kyi dbang (7thob ste ⑥'gro ba'i don byed par gyur to/ /gzhan yang sa'i khyad par la gnas pa rnams kyang rang rang gi ⑥sa la skyo sems skyes (9te las kyi tshe bkag nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan so pa 'di ( )la rab tu dad do/ / de nas sa 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams ngo mtshar du gyur rmad du gyur te 'dus nas shin tu skrag ste (lhagasol ba btab pa/101—760

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes jam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 761e ma'o e ma'o ①ya mtshan che/ /gnyis med rol pa ya mtshan che/ /'od zer 'phro 'du ②ya mtshan che/ /byang chub char sprin ya mtshan che/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ya mtshan che/ /sprul pa 'byung ba ya mtshan che/ /khro bo 'byung ba ya mtshan che/ /byin brlabs ①cho 'phrul ya mtshan che/ /dgon gdungs spangs ①pa ya mtshan che/ /'gog pa gsos ⑤pa ya mtshan che/ /bdag cag 'khor tshogs 'dus pa rnams/ /dam tshig can du byin brlabs dumadzod/ /bla 'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i gral du 'khodagye/ /ces gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po ⑧des sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas 'khor rnam par sbyor ba'i rdo rje'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang po la gzigs nas zhal 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang po des bskul bar rnam par rig nas btsun mo bya ba mo kun du bzang mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor zhing rang gi stan ⑨las rnam par langs te byang chub sems kyi mtshan ma gnas lngar btab nas lce pad+mo'i steng du las kyi rdo rje bzhag ste0/ brkyang phyag btsal nas mi 'jigs pa'i lta bas ston pa'i zhal du bltas yinas don bsdu bar 8gsol ba btab pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po yab yum dgongs su gsol/ /'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs mang po dgongs su gsol/ /gsang tsomadzod ④ye shes glog 8gi 'khor lo 'di/ /chos kyi rgyal po chen pos bshad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos byed pa po kun du bzang po rdo rje las kyi tsobaka' bar byin gyis brlabs ()pa'i phyir thugs gsang ba'i mkha' las byang chub sems sprin ( spros pas las kyi 'khor lo yirdo rje rgya gram gcig lag tu bzhag 101—761

76 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101stel / las kyi dbang bskur nas ming yang las kyi ②sems dpa' ③byed pa po kun du bzang por btags ①te las kyi dbang thob par gyur to/ /chos kyi 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad ⑤pa lce stengs su skyobazhag ste/ smra ba'i seng ge chos kyi sems dpa' zhes ming du dbang bskur te chos smra ba'i dbang thob bo/ /de nas smra ⑦ba'i seng ge byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang po de btsun mo bya ba mo ⑧kun du bzang mo 6)la 'jug cing spobs pa can du gyur to/ /de nas smra ba'i seng ge kun du bzang po des 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams snod du rung bar byin gyis brlabs 7pa'i phyir las kyi 'khor lo dang chos kyi tunya'akhor lo rnam pa bcu kyiganyis kyi tshul du bskor te 'cho 'phrul 'di yidag rnam par bstan te/ zhing khams mtha' dag kyang g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/7 ldeg rab tu ldeg /'khrugs8/ rab tu 'khrugasatunye/ yan man dang snrel zhi'i (nyezhing khams mtha' dag kyang ling long phyad par gyur 9/)to/ /de nas byang chub sems kyi mtshan mas 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams kyi gnas lngar reg ( 3 par byas so/ /hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya/ gu h+ya sa ma ya kro dha sa ma ya/ rdo rje 'du bar 0'dus pa yi/ /'dus pa chen po'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /gong 'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i gral du gnosatsho nya/ /bskal zhunyabazang dam tshig chen po ste/ /de las 'das na brlag par 'gyur ste/ /zhes bsgo (3stobs 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams rang rang gi sems rangs par byas te dam tshig thob nas rdo rje gsang ba'i gral du 'khod rnam par 'khod do/ /de nas byed pa po kun du bzang po las kyi bka' ba des bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po la gtsug gis 'dud 69phyag rnal 'byor gyi lugs su byas te phyi dang / nang dang / gsang ba mchod pa 101—762

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 763de kho na nyid kyis mchod de gsol ba btab bo/ /'di ltar rmad byung ①ngo mtshar khyod / /sangs rgyas yab gyur rgyal ba'i sras/ /ya mtshan chen po ston par spyod/ / bka' yi ②'khor lo dam pa de/ /smra brjod yul las rab 'das kyang / /ngag gi lam nas rab brjod cing cha/ /dpes mtshon tshig gi lde mig gis/ /gsal bar mtshon te go bar mdzod/ /a la la ho ④zhes gsol ba btab po/ /de nas gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des gsol ba btab par mkhyen nas brjod du med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs duso/ /de nas 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs kyis smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po kun du bzang po de la lugs su btud de brkyang phyag btsal nas rmad du byung ⑥ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs byas nas gsol ba btab pa/ smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang po khyod la bdag cag zhu bar spobs gan gnang ⑧ba'i skabs dbye bar gsol / smra ba'i seng ge kun du bzang pos bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa bdag la zhus shig /bdag gis gnang ba'i skabs dbye'o/ /'dus pa'i 'khor rnams kyis gsol pa/ smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po dang kun du bzang po khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yab byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rje btsanakyishe/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi lha ⑩phud/chos thams cad kyi mdzod lags na/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bdag cag 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ gsang ba'i tshig lam gyis ston par mi snang ba'i rgyu dang rkyen bdag cag rnams la bstan du gsol/smra ba'i seng ge legs par bstan du gsol zhes zhus pa dang / smra ba'i seng ges bka' stsal pa/ oṃ (1āḥ8rgyu a /7shel la ho/ rgyal ba'i sras po cang mi gsung / /101—763

764 bka' 'a ra/ sring rgyud/ sgo 101mi gsung ba nyid rgya cher bshad①/ /bshad du med pa'i don de ni②/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bshad de/ /de ltar ③ston pa rgyal mchog kyang / /rnam par brjod par mi dumadzad de/ /bka' mi stsal bar dgongs pa'o/ /'dus pa'i 'khor rnams nyon cig /de bas na gsang ba don dam pa'i byang chub kyi snying po de smra bsam las 'das 0shing brjod du med pas de la tshig tu smra ba legs pa ma yin te/ tshig tu smos pa'i dus nyid na dugol ba yin par phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang bshad de/ da ltar ston pa nyid kyang don de nyid dgongs nas ma gsungs so/ /'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams de bas na ma skyes pa'i snying po byang chub sems tshig tu spros pa dang bral gyis kyang kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i dbang du mtshan ma'i tshig gi rnal 'byor pa rnams tshig gi phyir ⑦'brang ba'i phyir don rtogs pa'i bkri ba'i phyir rgyal ba rnams kyi ③tshig gi sgo nas gsungs pa yin no/ /'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams kyis gsol yo)pa/ smra ba'i seng ge de ⑩ltar na bdag cag dang ma 'ongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i ⑩tshig gi 8rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi don du/ rdo rje tshig gi lam du brjod pas don gsal bar byed pa de smra 8ba'i seng ge las kyi bka' ba khyod nyid kyis zhu bar 0spobs shig /smra ba'i seng ge dbang bas na bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po la zhus shig dang / de nas smra 8ba'i seng ge byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang pos 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams ⑩kyi rnam par rtog pa ⑩mkhyen nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po la (smelan stong du bskor (7ba byas te rmad du byung 6)ba'i mchod pa rgyas pa de kho na nyid kyis mchod nas 'di (7skad gsol ba btab po//e ma ho ston pa'i ngo mtshar khyod/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /101—764

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 765byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid de/ /tshig ①tu brjod pa ma lags ②na'ang / /mtshan ma'i rjes 'brang rnal 'byor pa/ /don la rtsing la tshig la zhib/ /tshig gis bsam pa ②rangs bya'i phyir/ /snying po byang chub don 'di la/ /dpes mtshon tshig gi lde mig gis/ /gsang ba de nyid bshad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa las bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po smra ba'i seng ges gsol ba btab pa yang ④mkhyen/ 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams kyi sems kyi rtog pa yang dumakhyen pa dang ⑥/ tshig gi rjes su 'brang ba'i rnal 'byor yang thugs su chud nas rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum phyung ste/ ye shes kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa yang nas yang du gsor zhing rmad du byung ⑦ba'i chos kyi sgra duchen po rab tu bsgrags ①so/ /oṃ āḥkyis swā hā/ bo dhi tsit+ta yig h+ya tsos ma ya/ 'di ni gsungs 8ma thag tu yang / /sangs rgyas grags pa chen po kun/ /rab tu sngangs te brgyal skyobar gyur8/ /'khor tshogs gzhan la 0smos ci dgos8/ /de nas gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig /gang tshig gis brjod du rung ba thams cad ni kun rdzob kyi ⑫bden pa'o/ /ji srid brjod du rung ba ma yin pa'i chos gang yin pa de yini don dam pa'i bden pa'o/ /gang tshig dang yi ge las 'das pa gang yin pa de ni chos kyi sku'o/ /gang tshig dang yi ges brjod du rung ba thams cad ni gzugs kyi sku'o// rigs kyi bu dusngags kyi lta ba dang spyod pa yang 0de nyid yin te/ gang don dam pa'i bden pa dang / chos kyi sku gang yin pa de (nyeni sngags kyi lta ba yin dupar shes par (nyebya'o/ /de nyid rgyu'i tshul du gnas pa las/ 'bras bu'i tshul du kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang / gzugs kyi skur snang ste/ ji (nyeltar spyad pa dang spyad 101—765

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 771rnams gsang sngags kyi don zab mo mi ①thos par dka' na thos nas de'i don la gnas par dka' ste phal gyi thun mong du ma gyur pa'o/ /'phags pa rgyud kyi rgyal po ye shes rngam pa glog gi ②'khor lo'i mdo zhes bya ba las sngags kyi mdo bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po de snying po byang chub la ①nges par 'grel ④pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /zhugs nas yang 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs la bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu rnams chos thams cad ni byang chub sems su 'dus shing byang chub kyi sems nyid ⑤snang ba shes par (7gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni lus dang ngag dang sems su 'dus la/ lus dang ngag dang sems nyid chos thams cad kyi rnam par snang ngo / /'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams kyis gsol pa/ lus dang ngag dang sems bdag cag rnams kyis ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu rnams lus dang ngag dang sems kyi mtshan nyid (7ni sems kyang (gelus dang ngag gi rnam pa lta bu/ ngag kyang lus dang sems kyi rnam pa lta bu/ lus kyang tshig tu brjod pa dang sems kyi rnam pa lta bur rang rang gi 5)lus dang ngag dang sems rtogs ⑩shig /'on tang 4)byang chub tu sems bskyed kepar 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o dngos po thams cad dang bral bzhan/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /101—771

77 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdod ①nas ma skyes pa②/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar ya mtshan gyi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ①ba'i thugs/ /chos kun skye ba med pa las/ /skye ba 'di ni rab grags pa/ /skye dang mi skye gnyis med pa/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang me long lta bu gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs ④sol/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar ya mtshan gyiX/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i thugs/ /chos kun 'gag pa med pa las/ /'gag pa 'di ni rab tu bsgrags/ /'gag dang mi 'gag med pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar ya mtshan gyi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i thugs/ /chos kun gnas pa med pa las/ /gnas pa 'di ni rab tu bsgrags⑥/ /gnas dang mi gnas med pa ste / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang chos thams cad so so kun du stirtogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar ya mtshan gyi(8)ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang 6)ba'i thugs/ /chos kun dmigs pa med pa las / /dmigs pa 'di ni rab tu bsgrags7/ /dmigs dang mi dmigs med pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang 101—772

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes jam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 773chos thams cad bya ba la ①nan tan du sgrub ②pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar ya mtshan gyi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i thugs/ /chos kun spro bsdu med pa las/ /spros dudang bsdus par rab tu grags/ /spros bsdus yod dang med pa ste / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang pos a la la ho zhes sgra phyung ste byang chub sems la bstod pa/ e mtho dubade chen kun du bzang / /e ma'o stong nyid byang chub sems/ /e ma'o dag pa dri ma med/ /e ma'o mi sgrib gsal ba che/ /e ma'o mnyam nyid dbyer med chos/ /e ma'o so sor rang rig sems⑤/ /e ma'o byang sems ༅lhun gyis grub/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod deX/ bcom ldan 'das nyid khyad par du gyur pa yang nibyang chub sems nyid yin zhing byang chub kyi sems thugs su chud pa'o/ /bdag cag rig 'dzin gyi tshogs su gyur pa rnams kyang ⑨byang chub sems la smon ⑩par 'tshal/ 'jug par 'tshal/ ldang bar 'tshal/ gnas par 'tshal te(te/ bdag cag kyang rang rang gi tisems g.yos par bgyi/ reg par bgyi/ nye bar bgyi/ nyams su myong bar bgyi bar 'tshal na/ bdag cag de 'dra ba'i bsam pa can la snying rje chen por dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa dgongs pa (she mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa las gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos gsol ba btab par thugs su chud nas snying rje byang chub tso'abyung ba ⑩zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs yite gnyis su med par mngon par 'du mdzad do/ /gnyis tsos med par mngon par 'du mdzad pas byang chub sems kyi 101—773

774 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101sprin kyis thams cad rgyas par khyab pa ni til 'bru mar gyis khyab pa bzhin no/ /de nas yang 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o ye shes rnam dag chos/ /sna tshogs snang yang rtog ①par gsang / /ngo bo nyid ni brjod du med/ /snod ma yin la bstan pa dka'o②/ /e ma'o srid gsum ye nas rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin la/ /bdag tu rtog 8)pa srid rtsa'i ④nyes dmigs kyis/ /yun rings ⑤dus nas 'khyams 6)pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /mi mthun ⑦bde sdug gnas rnams so sor gzung ⑧/ /log rtog nor ba'i dbang gis kun brtags kyang / /rang bzhin nyid las mnyam 99)pa rdul tsam 7med/ /e ma'o yun rings (medus nas rmongs pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /ye nas don gyis (nyesangs rgyas yin mod kyang ()/ /rmongs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khyams/ /log rtog 8nyid la dngos med byang chub sems/ /'khrul 'khor nyid kyang mi zad rgyan du che/ /snyigs ma lnga nyid bde ldan gnas su gsal/ /phung po lnga nyid mngon par rdzogs pa'i sku/ /srid rtsa'i nyes dmigs nyid kyang byang chub snying por gnas/ /phyi nang snod bcud yab yum ngang du gsal/ /zhes gsungs pas chos thams cad byang chub sems su gnas so/ /'phags pa rgyud kyi rgyal po ye shes rngam pa'i 7glog gi 'khor lo'i mdo 7las byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag nyid sku dang gsung (nyathugs rdo rje las dkyil 'khor thams cad 'byung bar bzhed (stenas btsun mo dang gnyis su med par 'du mdzad do/ /mngon par 'du mdzad nas yang dkyil 'khor thams cad 'byung ba rdo rje'i rgyan 17zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs 101—774

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 775te / dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi mdo 'di gsungs so/ /'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams nyon cig /gsang sngags byin brlabs ①bsam yas la/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas brjod mi lang / /mdor bsdus rnam pa gsum yin te/ /rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor dang / /ting 'dzin gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ske/ /bkri drang rdul tshon ②dkyil 'khor te/ /gsum po chadag tu rgyal bas gsungs / /zhes ched du gleng ④ngo / /de nas smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po ⑤kun tu bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams kyis chos thams cad ni dkyil 'khor gsum du brjod par mthong lags ⑥so/ / de yang ⑦'di skad ces gsol ba btab bo/ /e ma'o gsang ⑧mchog bde ba chedhi/ /ye nas lhun grub dag pa'i bdag /dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas ⑩gtso/ /rdo rje rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /rang bzhin lhun grub zab mo'i yidon/ /bcom ldan snying pos bshad du gsol/ /a la la ho/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des gsol ba btab pa'i don thugs su chud nas lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i 8rdo rje rgyan tunyezhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /zhugs nas yang rang bzhin don dam ④pa'i dkyil 'khor spros pa dang bral ba 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs 'gyur ba'i8/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ⑩yo shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying po yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des rang bzhin don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni spyir bsdus pa'o/ /sems can 101—775

776 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med/ /phung po lnga don sangs rgyas lnga/ /'byung ba lnga don dbyings phyug yum/ /khams dang skye mched mang po kun/ /sems dpa' sems ma'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /des na srid gsum dkyil 'khor che/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la phung po lnga ①sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin du gsungs pa yang / /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ②gzugs rnams kun/ /chos kyi dbyings las byung bas na③/ /dbyer med don gyi gti mug pas/ /rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin yin/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /bde sdug tshor ba'i phung po kun/ /mnyam nyid dbyings la ①snang bas na/ /nga rgyal chen po'i rang bzhin pas/ /myong ba rin chen 'byung ba yin/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /yul dang shes pa ⑤phya rags kyi/ /byed pa'i phung po thams cad kun/ /ma 'dres dbyings la snang bas na/ /shes rab rlabs ⑥kyi 'dod chags pas/ /snang ba mtha' yas rang bzhin no/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /dge dang mi dge gnyis ka ⑦min/ /sems las byung dang ma byung ba'ini/ /'du byed phung po thams cad kun/ /spro bsdu 'byedabyings las byung bas natso/ /rnam par grol ba'i phrag dog pas/ /don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /rnam smin rang sems rnam (nyarig pa'i/ /shes brgyad rnam shes phung po kun/ /rig pa'i dbyings la shar bas na/ /zhe snang chen po'i ye shes pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni chen po lnga dbyings phyug lnga'i 7rang bzhin du gsungs pa(snye/ snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /gsal stong mi sgrib go 101—776

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 777'byed yo)pa'i/ /snang stong nam mkha'i khams rnams kun/ /stong nyid dbyings la shar bas na②/ /thams cad gnas pa'i klong ①yin pas/ /bde gshegs dbyings phyug rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /sra brtan skyed bskrun ༷rten rnams kun/ / sa yi ⑤khams su grags pa rnams/ /mi 'gyur dbyings la shar bas na/ /thams cad skyed 0pa'i rten yin pas/ /rdo rje dbyings phyug rang bzhin yin/ /snod ⑦bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /gyes sdud gsher ba'i mtshan nyid kun/ / chu yi nikhams su grags pa ste/ /kun sdud dbyings su shar bas na/ /yon tan tshogs chen kun sdud pas/ /rin chen dbyings phyug rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /gsal dro'i ①ngo bo thams cad kun/ / me yi ⑩khams su grags pa rnams/ /snang gsal dbyings la shar bas na/ /gsal dro sreg ⑩pa'i rang bzhin pas/ /pad+ma'i dbyings phyug rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /yang g.yo 'degs bskyod 8thams cad kun/ /rlung gi khams su grags pa ste/ /bskyod chen dbyings la shar bas na/ /thogs med shugs bskyod rang bzhin pas//las kyi dbyings phyug rang bzhin yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rnam par shes pa bzhi byang chub sems dpa' bzhi'i (nyerang bzhin du gsungs pa/srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /kha dog dbyibs la spyod 8pa kun/ /mig gi rnam shes zhes su grags/ /mthong ba'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ / sa yi ⑫snying po'i rang bzhin yin/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /sgra rnams kun la spyod ⑩pa kun/ /rna ba'i rnam shes zhes su grags/ /thos ⑩pa'i ye shes yin pas na/ /lag na rdo rje'i rang bzhin yin/ /srid gsum sems can 101—777

778 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101thams cad kyi/ /dri rnams kun la spyod ①pa kun/ / sna yi ②rnam shes zhes su grags / / tshor ba'i ①ye shes yin pas na/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i rang bzhin yin / /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /ro rnams kun la spyod ④pa kun / / lce yi ⑤rnam shes zhes su grags/ /myong ba'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi rang bzhin yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la yul bzhi byang chub sems ma ⑥bzhi'i rang bzhin du gsungs pa/ snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /kha dog dbyibs dang mtshan ma kun/ /gzugs kyi skye mched nyid du grags/ /mthong bar bya ba'i yul yin pas/ /gzugs mdzes lā ⑨sri'i rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /zin dang ma zin gnyis ka 78)las/ /byung ba'i sgra yi khams su grags/ /thos par bya ba'i yul yin pas/ / grir t+ya 6)ma yi rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi / /lhan cig skyes ⑩dang sbyar dang gyur/ /zhim dang nga dang de bzhin gzhan/ /dri yi khams dang skye mched de/ /bsnam (1par bya ba'i yul yin pas/ / mā le ⑫nyid kyi rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /kha mngar la sogs ro rnams kun/ / ro yi (steskye mched nyid du grags/ /myang yibar bya ba'i yul yin pas/ / gī ti 7nyid kyi rang bzhin yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni dbang po bzhi 17byang chub sems dpa' bzhi'i rang bzhin du gsungs pa/srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /mthong byed dang ba'i bdag nyid de/ /mig gi khams zhes bya bar grags/ /mthong ba'i bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ /byams pa mi tri 9/nyerang bzhin yin/ /srid gsum sems can yi thams cad kyi/ /thos par byed pa'i 17bdag nyid de/ /rna ba'i khams zhes bya bar grags/ /thos pa'i 101—778

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 779bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ /sgrib pa kun sel rang bzhin yin/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /snom tu)byed dang ba'i bdag nyid de/ / sna yi ②khams zhes bya bar grags/ /tshor bar bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal nyid kyi rang bzhin yin/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /myong byed dag pa'i bdag nyid de/ / lce yi ①khams zhes bya bar grags/ /myong ba'i bya ba byed pa'i phyir / /kun du bzang po'i rang bzhin yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la dus bzhi ④mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi'i rang bzhin du gsungs pa/ snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /rgyu 'bras kun du rnam par spyad/ /sngon 'das dus su rnam par grags/ /sngon 'das dpyid kyi rang bzhin yin⑤/ /spos me'i rang bzhin nyid yin no/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /rgyu spyad 'bras bu ma spyad kun / /da (7ltar dbyar gyi rang bzhin yin/ /me tog nyid kyi rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /rgyu 'bras yongs kyis ma spyad pa/ /ma 'ongs dus su rnam par grags/ /'ong ma rag ston ⑦rang bzhin ni/ /ā lo ke ⑧yi rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /rgyu 'bras nges par ma tshogs pa/ /'byung bar ma nges dus zhes grags/ /ma 'ongs dgun 7gyi rang bzhin ni/ /gan dhe'i rang bzhin yin par nges/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni lus kyi dbang po dang / rnam par shes pa dang / yang de'i yul dang de las byung yiba'i byang chub sems khro bo bzhi'i rang bzhin du gsungs pa/ srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /reg byed dang ba'i bdag nyid de/ /lus kyi khams zhes bya bar grags/ /reg /nyebyed bya ba byed tu pas na/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i rang bzhin no/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /reg bya 101—779

780 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ sgo 101kun la spyod ①pa kun/ /lus kyi rnam shes zhes su grags/ /reg pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir②/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rang bzhin yin/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur ①reg bya rnams/ /reg bya'i skye mched nyid du grags/ /reg par bya ba'i yul yin pas/ /rta mchog dpal gyi rang bzhin no/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /tshogs drug 'gags pa'i ④de ma thag /go 'byed gsal ba'i bdag nyid de/ /yid kyi khams zhes bya bar grags/ /des spyod dubya ba byed pa'i phyir/ / bdud rtsi 'khyil duba'i rang bzhin yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni phyin ci ma log pa bzhi lha mo ⑦bzhi'i rang bzhin du gsungs pa/ snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /'jig dang skad cig mi rtag pa/ /rtag par ma yin zhes su grags/ /sgyu nim lta bu yin pa'i ①phyir/ /lcags kyu ma yi rang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi / /kun rtog gzhan dbang med min pa/ /chad par ma yin zhes su grags/ /rmi lam lta bur ⑩sems snang phyir/ /zhags pa ma yi rang bzhin yin/ /snod ⑪bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /gzung 'dzin dngos por ma grub 8pa/ /mtshan mar ma yin zhes su grags/ /smig rgyu lta bur sems snang phyir/ /lcags sgrog ma yi tirang bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /skyes bu byed pa ⑫ma grub pa/ /bdag tu ma yin zhes su grags/ /sgra brnyan lta bu'i sems snang phyir / /dril bu ma yi rang bzhin yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni yid dang chos gtso gzungs gnyis kyi rang bzhin du bstan te/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /chos rnams kun la des spyod 7pa'i/ /yid kyi rnam shes zhes su grags/ /rtog pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ /kun du bzang po'i rang 101—780

brtul zhugs chen po ba ba pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 781bzhin yin/ /snod bcud 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /'dus byas ①ma byas ②chos rnams kun/ /chos kyi skyed byed yin par grags/ /rnam par shes pa'i yul yin pas/ /kun du bzang mo'i phyirang bzhin yin/ /de la ④sogs te mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dukhams kyi mtha' 0klas pa/ /ji snyed rnam grangs ⑦yod pa'i chosani/ /kun kyang phyag rgya'i ⑨rang bzhin pas/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor chen po yi0/ /rnam grangs yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes ched 0du brjod pa gsungs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po 8des rang bzhin kun rdzob 8kyi dkyil tso'akhor 'di gsungs so/ /kun rdzob mtshan ma'i gnas chen kyang / /'og min bla med tsoganas mchog gam/ /lcang lo can nam bde ba can/ /pad+ma can la tsosogs pa yi/ /rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor de⑩/ /mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor ngo la snang / /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /mkha' 'am yid kyi nam mkha' la/ /'byung chen brtsegs 8pa'i lhun gyis grub/ /de steng rin chen sna bzhi las()/ /lhun gyis grub pa tshad dpag med/ /de la brten pa'i sa gzhi ⑥ni / /rin chen sna tshogs gcal 0du bkram/ /mnan rnam bteg 'phar mdzes pa'i gzhi/ /de la pho brang gzhal med khang / /gru bzhi lham pa dumadzes par snang ske/ /rin chen sna bzhi'i rgyu ( nyelas grub/ /glo 'bur chabazhi yang mkhar byathabs tshul/ /bum pa'i rtse mo chos kyi togaci /rma bya'i mdongs dudang ldan pa'o//sgo bzhi sgo khyud bzhi dang ldan/ /rta babs brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /dbus na 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs rten ldan/ /gru chad bar khyams tsomadzes par ldan/ /rin chen 'od zer 'bar bas 'khrigs/ /101—781

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 783'byung ldan te/ / be+e ḍūr+ya yi 6)kha dog 'dra/ /rang rtags rin chen zur ②brgyad 'dzin/ / rgyab na ①snang ba mtha' yas gtso/ /pad+ma rā ④ga'i mdog 'dra zhing / /rang rtags pad+ma dmar po 'dzin/ /g.yon du don yod grub pa ste/ / yin tra nī la ⑧ljang gu'i ⑥mdog /rang rtags phyag na ral gri 'dzin/ /kun kyang zhi ba'i cha lugs te/ /thor tshugs rigs lnga ⑦dbu la brgyanani/ /rdzogs pa'i skyil krung 8tshul du bzhugs/ /do shal dpung rgyan se mo ⑩do/ /phyag gdub snyan chas kun la mdzes/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag rdzogs/ /de dag gi ni g.yon rol na/ /kun du bzang dang lo tsa na/ / mā ma yigos dkar sgrol ma rnams/ /g.yas pas 8thabs kyi gtso la 'khyud8/ /g.yon pas rang rtags dril bu 'dzin/ /sku mdog cha lugs yab dang 'dra/ /'khor lo rtsibs la lhun gyis grub/ /spyan snga'i glo 'bur tsomadzes pa la/ /lag na rdo rje sngo skya'i mdog /rang rtags rdo rje rtse gsum 'dzin/ /g.yas na sa yi tsosnying po ste/ /ljang sngon rin chen myu yig 'dzin/ /rgyab tu nam mkha'i snying po ste/ /mthing ga ⑩rang rtags tsoral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon du mdzes pa'i glo 'bur 7la/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dmar ru )skya ste/ /rang rtags pad+ma dkar po 'dzin/ /thor tshugs ye shes sems dpas ( nyabargyan/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung ( nyedu bzhugs/ /rgyan dang cha lugs kun gyis brgyan/ /de dag gi ni g.yon rol na/ /gar dang sgeg mo phreng (steb dbyangs/ /g.yas pas thabs kyi gtso la 'khyud/ /g.yon pa ④gar dang me long phreng ru / /pi wang soga'adzin cing cha lugs gzhan/ /gtso bo nyid kyang mthun (rtepa yin/ /mdzes pa'i gru chen rnams la ni/ /byams pa be+e ( tri dkar ba ste/ /mdzes pa'i klu shing 'gudhe gyubasnams/ /shar lho mtshams ( )kyi gru 101—783

798 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ () 101 rin chen dril gsil chos la brtan/ /6)'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas pa ni/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i phyag rgya yin/ /rin chen khu tshur snying gar brtan②/ /mi bsgreng rtse la dril gsil 'bar/ /rdo rje thal mo las la 'khril/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas pa ni/ /rin chen dbyings phyug phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rje khu tshur snying gar ji brtan/ /oṃ ④bsgreng rtse la pad+mo 'bar/ /rin chen dril gsil (snyechos la brtan/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas pa ni/ /snang ba mtha' yas phyag rgya ('u yin/ /rin chen khu tshur snying gar ⑦brtan/ /baṃ bsgreng rtse la dril gsil 'bar/ /rdo rje thal mo las la 'khril/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas pa ni/ /pad+ma dbyings phyug phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rje khu tshur snying gar ⑧brtan/ /hai bsgreng rtse la ral gri 6)'bar/ /rin chen dril gsil chos la brtanakyi/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas pa ni/ /don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /rin chen khu tshur snying gar (7brtan/ /rta bsgreng rtse la dril gsil 'bar/ /rdo rje thal mo las la 'khril/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas pa ni/ /las kyi dbyings phyug phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rje khu tshur thugs ka na/ /rin chen dril gsil chos la brtan7/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta ba ni/ /lag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya yin / /rin chen gar thabs bskor (nyenas su/ /rdo rje thal mo las la 'khril/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis 'dud pa'i 8tshul/ /gar gyi phyag rgyar tsodapa' bos bshad / / rdo rje thugs kur rin chen 'dzin/ /7rin chen dril gsil chos la brtan7 / /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta 1steb ni/ / sa yi 67snying po'i phyag rgya yin / /rdo rje khu tshur bcangs pa ni/ /dku )yi thad (1kar 'dzin pa dang / /'dzum 82pa'i mdangs kyis 'dud pa ni/ /sgeg mo'i phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /101wa 798

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 799rdo rje ral gri thugs ka 6)na/ /rin chen dril gsil chos la brtan/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta ba ni(snye/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rje rin chen rna lhag ①gzhag /rin chen phreng ba bzung ④nas su/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis 'dud pa ni/ /phreng ba'i phyag rgya yin par grags/ /rdo rje pad+ma thugs ka ⑤na / /rin chen dril gsil chos la brtan4)/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis ⑦lta ba ni / /spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag rgya yin/ /rin chen pi bang ⑧'dzin pa la/ /rdo rje len par byas nas ni/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis 'dud pa ni/ /dbyangs kyi phyag rgya yin par grags/ /rdo rje klu 6)shing thugs ka ⑩na/ /rin chen dril yigasil chos la brtan/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta ba ni⑩/ /byams pa mi yitri'i phyag rgya yin/ /rin chen bdug spos thugs mar cha'adzin/ /rdo rje las la rab tu 'khril/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis 'dud pa ni/ /bdug pa'i phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /rdo rje po ti 8thugs kur tso'adzin/ /rin chen dril gsil chos la brtan(rte/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta ba ni/ /sgrib pa kun sel phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rje rin chen rna ltag tunyetu/ /me tog snod bcas 'dzin pa la/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs (7kyis 'dud pa ni/ /me tog phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /rdo rje ut+pal thugs ka (3 na/ /rin chen dril gsil chos la brtan/ /'dzum ⑥pa'i mdangs kyis lta ba ni/ /'jam dpal gyi ( )ni phyag rgya yin/ /rin chen mar me thugs ka na(nye/ /rdo rje thal mo las la 'khril/ /'dzum (9pa'i mdangs kyis soge'adud pa ni/ /mar me'i phyag rgyar dpa' bos bshad/ /rdo rje snye dum thugs ka ( zhen/ /rin chen dril gsil chos la brtan( nye/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta ba ni/ /kun du bzang po'i phyag rgya yin/ /rin chen dbyug pa thugs ka 101—799

800 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101na / /rdo rje thal mo las la 'khril/ /rdo rje nyug par byed pa ni/ /dri yi phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /nir mgo gdengs ①ka gshed po'i rgya/ /rdo rje gnon pa stobs po che/ /thod sbrul gnon pa rta yi rgya/ /rgya gram gnon pa bdud rtsi 'khyil②ske/ /mdzub ②gnyis 'khyud 0pa lcags kyu'i rgya/ /mdzub ⑤gnyis rtse sprad zhags pa'i rgya/ /mdzub duganyis 'khyud pa lu gu rgyud/ /bskyod par gyur pa 'bebs ma'o/ /pi bang ༅len pa lha yi rgya/ /mi yi gseg ⑧par 'dzin pa ste/ /lha min phyag rgya go cha yin/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor byol song rgya/ /za ma tog ①ni yi dgas ⑩rgya/ /me chu gnyis ni dmyal ba'i rgya/ /yab kyi spyi rgya kun bzang gi'o / /yum gyi spyi rgya ⑩bzang mor bshad/ /yang na kun bzang yab yum gyi8—/ /rdo rje thal mo gnyis su bshad/ /bder 'gashegs rnams la rdzogs dkyil 8lo/ /sems dpa' rnams la sems dpa'i dkyil/ /'joms dang thub pa langs te bcing / /zhes gsungs so/ /'phags pa rgyud kyi rgyal po ye shes rngam pa glog tshugi 'khor lo'i mdo zhes bya ba las phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid bshad pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po he ru ka rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ji lta bu lags pa bdag cag rnams la bshad du gsol/ gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bshad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa las/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi ⑩bdag po des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo rnam par 'phro ba'i rgyal po ye shes rngam pa glog zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 101—800

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 801snyoms par zhugs te/ nyid kyi sku khro bo chen por 'du mdzad de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten na dregs pa chen po la sogs pa gdug pa'i dbang du 'gro ba rnams gyur te/ khams gsum 'di na de bzhin gshegs pa gsung rab zer ①bar ston pa dang / 'jug pa dang / bstan pa la gnas shing dkon mchog gsum la 'jug pa ni 'ga' yang med/ khros pas gtum po rab tu gdug pa'i sems dang / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis bsgribs ②pa gtum zhing 'khrug pa dang / gzhan gyi srog dang sems 'phrog pa dang / mi dge ba ⑧bcu'i las kyis nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pas gzhan la gtses pa dang /gcig sha ④gcig gis gza ba dang / log pa'i lam la gnas pa'i 'jig rten gsum po 'di brlag go zhes sngon gyi smon lam la gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / gsang ba mchog gi bdag po chen pos rnam par gzigs nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang (5)thugs rdo rje las khro bo'i dkyil 'khor glog ⑦rnam par 'phro ba 'di phyung ngo / /o badz+ra ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa (shesarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha yonyen da ha pa tsa/bi shwa kro dha dz+wa la timaṇ+ḍa la/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la/ 'di phyung ma thag tu khro bo chen po'i mthus khams gsum 'di dag thams cad g.yos (merab tu g.yos/kun du rab tu g.yos sokyi/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur ro6)/ /shig shig /rab tu shig shig /kun du rab tu shig shigaci /gtor gtor/ rab tu gtor gtor/ kun du rab tu gtor gtor ro/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / nam mkha' 'alding dang /srin po la sogs pa rnams 'khrugs 7pa chen por gyur to()/ /de nas 'jigs pas nyen pa de dag brgya byin la skyabs su song / brgya byin yang 'jigs pas 101—801

80 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ () 101nyen te tshangs pa'i thad du phyin/ tshangs pa yang khyab 'jug thad du song /khyab 'jug kyang dbang phyug chen po'i thad du song / dbang phyug chen po rang gi mthu yod 6)yod pa ston cing lha rnams ma skrag /klu rnams dang gnod sbyin rnams dang ②/ lha ma yin dang / 'khor du gtogs ( nyepa rnams ma skrag cig④ /nga'i mthu 'di la gzhan gang gis kyang brdzi bar mi nus so zhes spro (ge ba srings soyi / /kwa brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug rnams khyed gakyang 'jig rten na mthu che ba'i chen po yin pas rang rang gi mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ci yod pas rang rang gi 'khor gdug pa de dag dbugs dbyung bar mdzod cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas brgya ⑤byin dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug rnams de ma thag tu rang rang gi mthu ci yod pa ston cing rdo rje'i skad dang gad mo drag po 'byin cing rang 6)rang gi 'khor rnams la ma skrag ma dngangs shig /bdag cag gi mthu 'di lta bu gzhan gang gis kyang zil gyis gnon par mi nus rme zhes spro bsring kyingo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes rngam pa'i rgyal po des de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nas yum rngam pa'i kro dhi'i rgyal mo ⑩mngon par phyung ste/ hi hi dgyes pa'i gzi mdangs kyi rol pa'i dgyes pas thim par mdzad nas/ byang chub sems kyi ⑫sprin las phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra gro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la ha la ha la zhes pas stong gsum khro bo chol pas gang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po nyid ni dbu dgu phyag bcwa (stebargyad zhabs rnam pa brgyad kyi rnam par snang ngo / /de nas dgyes te hūm̐ hūm̐ rtsu zhes brjod pas dbu dgu phyag bcwa yibargyad las 'dul ba'i dbang gis dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir gyur te/ khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrug ⑫pa'i dkyil na keng rus kyi steng na rnam par gnas so/ /khro bo chol pa de dag 101—802

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 803gis kyang phyogs bcu'i dregs pa ji snyed pa kun bsgral te slar 'dus nas/ la la ni rdo rje ༷khrag 'thung chen por gyur nas brgya byin 'khor dang bcas pa bsgral/la la ni rin chen khrag 'thung (snyedu gyur te tshangs pa 'khor dudang bcas pa bsgral/la la ni pad+ma khrag 'thung chen por gyur te/ ma hā de ba 'khor dang bcas pa bsgral / la la ni las kyi khrag 'thung chen por gyur te/ khyab 'jug 'khor dang bcas pa bsgral/ khro bo de dag gis dregs pa can de dag gi nang ༷grol kun drangs⑤te/ khrag 'thungasayi/ rus pa kun 'chos so/ /de nas dgyes te oṃ ru lu ru lu dza dza zhes brjod pas/ dbang phyug chen po bcu gnyis dang brgyad kyi 'khor tshogs ma lus pa yud tsam cig ⑦gis dbang du 'dus par gyur pa ni dper na rdo khab len la lcags 'du ba'i tshul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po'i sku nil rnam pa brgyad kyis 'khril ba'i tshul du gnas so/ /khrag 'thung bzhi 6)la rnam pa lnga lngas 'khril ba'i tshul gyis rnam par gnas pa dang / dgyes te ha ha zhes brjod pas byang chub sems las ⑩dkar mo'i tshogs dang / rgan ⑫mo'i tshogs dang / spos 7mo'i tshogs dang / gtum mo'i tshogs dang / rmongs mo'i 4)tshogs dang / thal byed ma'i tshogs dang / sme sha can gyi tshogs dang /ma mo'i tshogs rnams 'thon to/ /de nas yang dgyes te he he ④zhes brjod pas byang chub sems las seng gdong gi tshogs dang / stag gdong gi tshogs tsodang /wa gdong gi tshogs dang / khyi gdong gi tshogs dang / bzhad gdong yigi tshogs dang / dur bya'i gdong gi tshogs dang / bya rog gi dhigadong gi tshogs dang —/ 'ug pa'i gdong gi tshogs rnams 'thon tunyeto/ /de nas yang dgyes te phaṭa ces brjod pas byang chub sems las rta 4)gdong gi tshogs dang / phag 101—803

804 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101gdong gi tshogs dang / seng gdong gi tshogs dang / sbrul gdong gi tshogs 'thon ①nas nyi shu rtsa brgyad ②'khor dang bcas pa rnams rang rang gi gdan ga la ba der yud tsam gyis phyin par phaṭa ces spros so/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa rnams na lidregs pa gang ji snyed yod pa thams cad tshul ji ltar 'dul ba dang / thabs cis sti'adul ba sna tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus btul (5)bar gyur toskyo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khro bo de dag la dregs pa'i tshogs slar gsol cig ( )ces bka' stsal pas/ khro bo de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gso bar gsol zhes pa dang /bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis khro bo de dag gcig tu r+ghaṃ zhes pas bsdus ②te/dbu dgu phyag bcwa dzi)brgyad pa'i tshul du rnam par gnas so/ /de nas ye shes rngam pa'i rgyal po des phyag bco ⑩brgyad bsnol te btsir bas mi gtsang ba'i 'dam chen por 'khyil to/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'byung 67ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs nas bdud rtsi 'byung zhes bya ba gnam nas rnam par phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ⑫ ta ma hā 'gro dhi yishwa ri u spri dza8/ badz+ra a mṛ ⑩ta hūṃ a/ de nas khro mo bdud rtsi chen mo de smin ma sgyur zhing shin tu rngam ⑩pa'i bzhad 6nyepas ru lu ru lu khā hi khā hi zhes bdud rtsir bsgrubs 17te gsol bas gdug pa can thams cad snga ma bzhin du rang rang gi lus sos par gyur te sems dran nas dpal chen ye shes rngam pa'i rgyal po'i sku dbu dgu brgya 6nyaphyag stong brgyad brgya(nya/ zhabs brgyad brgyar gnas shing yab la khro bo brgya rtsa brgyad lhun gyis grub par mthong ngo / /phra so men ma nyi shu'i — tshogs kyang shin tu rngam pa'i gzugs rang rang gi stan sosnyedang lag char gnas pa sostomathong nas/ shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur nas zhum pa'i nga tso'os gsol 101—804

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 805ba btab pa/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rngam chen rgyal po'i ①'bangs su mchi/ /'bangs su nan tan ma bgyis na/ /mgo lus rnying ②yang rul nas ni/ /btso bsreg ①gnas su 'bod sgrogs shog /bdag cag rnams kyi ma dang sring / /mchis brang ④dang ni bu mo rnams/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhes su gsol/ /bdag cag rnams kyi mgo bcad la/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyan du bzhes/ /bdag cag rnams kyi snying phyung la/ /dpal chen nyid kyi zhal du gsol/ /bdag cag rnams kyi lpags dushus la/ /dpa' bo chen po sku la gsol/ /a la la ho zhes gsol ba btab ste/ la las ni rang gi lus gdan khrir phul/ la las ni rang gi mgo bcad nas 'bar ba'i tshogs kyi ༷zhal bur phul/ la las ni rang gi snying phyung nas zhal du gsol/ la la ⑦ni rang gi pags ⑧pa bshus te sku la g.yang gzhi ⑨gsol to/ /dbang phyug chen po rnams dpal tsochen po'i sku la sbrul ltar 'khril bas des dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyang shes bya'i sgrib pa byang ste/ bden pa mthong nas dam tshig dang ldan par mthong bar gyur te/ de'i tshe 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs kyang rab tu spro ba'i sems kyis rdzu 'phrul rnam pa du ma dang ldan te(7/ la la ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgyang tsom ring du 'phanati/ la la ni ri rab klad la skor8/ la la ni nyi zla zhabs 'og ⑫gnon / la la ni 'jig rten rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul rnam pa du ma ston cing a la la zhes pa'i sgra rnam par 'byin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des 'jigs byed tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang 7thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas chen du/ /rak+ta'i ṇirba rlabs 'khrug yinyepa'i dkyil/ /keng rus ri 101—805

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 809gang gnas ①pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang skrag 'gyur na/ /dregs pa'i tshogs lta smos ci dgos/ /lag gnyis thal sbyar spyi gtsug bzhag /rkang gnyis mthil ②sprad rtse mo btsugasani/ /mgo mtshan rdo rje snying por bsgom/ /rtse gcig rtse dugasum rtse lnga dang / /rtse dgu ⑤bcu gcig rdo rje bsgom/ /sa stengs ⑥kun du mchod tsobyas pa/ /'jigs byed chen po'i phyag rgya yin/ /de nyid g.yon gyi ⑧phyogs nas mchong yonye/ /'jigs byed ma yi ⑩phyag rgya yibashad/ /lag g.yas gung mo snying por bya/ / gung mdzub srin lag rtse gsum tshul/ /mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan par bya/ /lhag ma rnams ni rdo rje'i tshul/ /tsogayon pa ban dha ltar byas nas0/ /dkrugs nas zhal du gsol ba ni/ /rdo rje khrag 'thung phyag rgya yin / /g.yas pa gtso la 'khyud tshul du8/ / g.yon pa rak+ta stobs pa ni/ /⑫rdo rje gro dhi kun gyi rgya/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang byas te/ /g.yon pa dung dmar rak+ta ⑩'thung / /'di ni rin chen khrag 'thung rgya/ /de nyid 8gung 'dzub ⑫srin lag gzhibs/ /ral gri 'degs yipa ltar byas pa/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung phyag rgya yin/ /de nyid g.yas pa dukhu tshur bcangasadu/ /mthe bo gung mdzub mthe'u chung rnams/ /so sor brkyang dub rgya gram tshul/ /las kyi khrag 'thung phyag rgyar dubashad / /khrag 'thung g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum tshul/ /kro dhi g.yon brkyang ⑥g.yas bskum tshul/ /stabs su mchod par dudapa' bos bshad/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur bcangs nas bsgreng / /g.yon pa 'dzin pa ltar byas pa/ /g.yas tsodang g.yon du lta zhing sgyur/ /gi sonari tshogs kyi phyag rgya tsoyin/ /mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i tshul du ni/ /'bur 0tshugs mi 'gyur lta byed pa/ /rkun mo'i tshogs kyi phyag rgya yin/ /g.yas pas khu tshur bcangs pa ni/ /mthe bo du )mthe'u chung brkyang 101—809

810 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101bar byas/ /g.yon pas 'dzin pa'i khro tshul lta/ /pra ①mo'i phyag rgya ②dpa' bos bshad / /g.yas pa'i gung mo rtse mo brkyang / /sor bzhi rtse bsdus nirdo rje 'phyar/ /g.yon pa dku ru brten pa ni/ /'bur ④tsags lta ba be ②ta'i rgya/ /g.yon pas nyon mongs mnan 6)tshul la/ /g.yas pas rgyu 'dren za ba'i tshul/ / pu ma'i ⑦phyag rgyar ⑧bshad pa yin/ /g.yon pa dung khrag 'dzin pa la/ /g.yas pas 'khrug cing 6)rngam tshul ston/ /gasma tshuri yi phyag rgya 7yin/ /g.yon pas byis pa'i lus tsomanan nas/ /g.yas pas snying 'dren za tshul du/ /sgrol tshul lta ba sma tsosha'i rgya/ /g.yas pas mgo bcad phyir yinas kyang / /g.yon pas lus 'dzin stobs pa ltar8/ /tsaṇ+ḍa li yi phyag rgya yin/ /lag gnyis brang la bsnol ⑫nas ni⑩/ /kha na ro thogs ral gsigs pa/ /seng gdong tshogs kyi phyag rgya yin / /lag gnyis thur 'du bsnol ()nas ni/ /zhing la 'bur 0tshugs mche ba bsnyer / /stag gdong tshogs kyi phyag rgya yin/ /lag gnyis zhing khong kha phye nas/ /lce (7yis ldag pa ltar byed na(nya/ /wa gdong tshogs kyi phyag rgya yin/ /lag gnyis zhing khong kha phye nas/ /'bur sgo)tshugs lta ba shwa sogena'i rgya/ /lag gnyis spu gri thogs tshul du/ /g.yon pas rgyu ma gzung sonazhing za/ / bzhad gdong 9 nyatshogs kyi phyag rgya yin/ /zhing chen phrag la bkal sanyanas ni/ /keng rus thogs pa ltar byas pa/ /dur bya'i tshogs kyi (3phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pas ban da phyogayas pa gri / /glo snying 'dren pa ltar byed pa/ /khwa kha )ma yi phyag rgya yin/ /g.yas pa rdo rje khu tshur la/ /lcags kyu 'dzin pa hu 7lu'i rgya/ /mdzub 6nyaganyis lcags kyu'i tshul du byas/ /rta skad 'tsher 8nyab ltar byas pa 3/ /rta gdong tshogs kyi phyag rgya (steyin / /mdzub nyaganyis rtse sbyar phag gdong gis/ /tha rgod rlog pa'i tshul bstan 101—810

8 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101de la thim pa dang / /zos sam mig la rtag bskus ①na/ /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi/ /spyod yul ji snyed yod pa kun/ /shing thog ②lag tu bzhag ③pa bzhin/ /rdo rje mig gi snyugasal bar mthong / /cho ga gong ma'i tshul gyis ni/ /rna ba'i dbang po thams cad la/ /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi/ /rna ba'i mngon shes kun bsdus nas/ /zos sam rna ba'i nang bzhag na / /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi/ /sgra rnams thams cad ji snyed pa/ /rna ba'i drung du 'dod pa bzhin/ /snying gi bye brag thams cad la/ /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi/ /dran pa'i mngon shes kun bsdus nas/ /zos sam snying gar (gebazhag na ni/ /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi/ /thugs dang sems kyi rgyud dag ni/ /mkhyen yicing rig pa kun shes 'gyur/ /yum gyi ⑦mkha' las byung ba yi/ /rak+ta (kyedag ni thams cad la/ /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi/ /gnas rnams ma lus kun bsdus nas6)/ /zos sam snying gar bzhag ⑩na ni/ /sngon gyi gnas kyi gtan tshigs tunyernams/ /zhag gsum lon bzhin gsal bar 'gyur/ /snying gar 7ye shes sems dpa' bsgom/ /phyogs bcur gnas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bkug nas de dag rdzu 'phrul rnams / /phrogs nas snying gar (stebasdu byas naphyi/ /sangs rgyas dag ni lithams cad kyi/ /rdo rje rdzu 'phrul thams cad kun/ /'grub par 'gyur bar gdon mi za / /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje bsrung ba bsgrub pa'i thabs so/ /sku gsung thugs ni rnams 7bsgoms la/ /snying gar tu 7nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor las/ /khro bo 'od kyi phreng ba yis1nya/ /bsrung bar bya ba'i zug rngu rnams/ /phyung ste med par bsams nas ni/ /lha rnams dag ni thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya dag ni 101—822

brtul zhugs chen po ba ba pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 8 3thams cad dam/ /yang na rdo rje rgya ①gram mamaphyi/ /rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya niyis/ /lus dang ngag sems rab bsrungs dun/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi tshugs na/ /phal pa rnams kyis smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /las 'di sbyar bar bya ba yang / /ljongs sam grong khyer grong dag tu/ /sngags kyi bdag por durab gnas la/ /nad kun spong ⑥ba'i las 'di bya/ /rdo rje rtse lnga 'od 'phro ba/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin bsams nas su/ /spros pas nad rnams bsregs nas ni/ /slar yang rdo rje nyid la bsdug/ /de nas rdo rje de nyid las/ /'od zer ser po spros pa yis/ /nad rnams stong ⑧pa'i gnas de dag /bskal pa ⑦yun du gang bsams te/ /goms par yang dang yang bsams na/ /nad rnams thams cad sel bar byed/ /de na 'khor ba'i skye bo rnams/ /sprul pa'i bde ba thob par 'gyur / /bde gshegs rnams kyis ⑩byin gyis rlobaskyo/ /tshe ring lang tsho 8bde bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni zhi ba bsgrub pa'i thabs so/ /rab tu dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ /rnam par snang mdzad bsgom pa ni/ /nam mkha'i dbus su zla ba la/ /dkyil 'khor zlum po bsams nas su/ /rnam par snang mdzad dkyil 'khor bskyed(nye/ /snying gar 8zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bud dha lo tsa'i snying po bsam/ /de las lha mo'i skur spros pas/ /mkha' dbyings yongs su gang bar bsgom8/ /slar 'dus 'od kyi thig ler gsal/ /de nyid bdag gi lus la dbab/ /bdag gi ba 8spu'i bu ga nas/ /sangs rgyas sprin chen rab 'phros te()/ /'dod pa'i lus nang gang bar bya/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis de lus la/ /dbang bskur 5nyeb ni rab tu stsol67/ /de yis skad cig de yi sum̐ )tshe/ /drag po gtum po'ang lhan ner 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 101—823

8 4 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101'di ni rgyas pa'i bsgrub ①pa'i thabs so/ /nam mkha'i dbus su zla ba la/ /chos kyi sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /snying gar ⑤zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gos dkar can gyi snying po bsam/ /de las gos dkar nyid 'phros pas/ /mkha' dbyings yongs su gang bar bsgom / /de las 'od kyi gong bu ni/ /gru bzhi lam par gsal bar bsdu/ /ba duspu rnams kyi bu ga nas/ /rin chen sprin chen rab spros pas/ /rdo rje chos su bsgoms ⑤nas su/ /'dod par bya ba'i lus nang dgang / /yang nas yang du 'di byas na/ /bar snang ci 'dod rgyas par 'gengs/ /nor bu rin chen bzhin 'drar 'gyur/ /dgos pa phra mo smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje dbang du bsdu ba bsgrub pa'i thabs so/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor zla gam ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su bsam / /rdo rje chos mchog gzugs su bsam/ /snying gar ༷zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /nyid kyi snying po bsam par bya/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyisaXske/ /mkha' dbyings thams cad gang bar bsgomani/ /'od zer sna lnga 'phros pa yis/ /'dod pa la ni dbab par bya/ /de nas bsdus te bdag nyid kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin bsdus na/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang dbang 'du na/ /'gro ba dbang med smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje yo)drag po bsgrub pa'i thabs so/ /nam mkha' yidabyings kyi dbus su ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /khros pa'i gzugs rnams bsgom (nyabya ste/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'phros pa las/ /khros pa'i rdo rje srin po dang / /sna tshogs wa ⑫dang bya rog dang / /bya rgod khyi la sogs pa yiyi/ / phra men cibasam yas 7mi bzad pas7/ /mkha' dbyings gang bar bsgoms nas su/ /sangs rgyas kun 101—824

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 8 5la gnod byed na/ /dngos sam yang na bsams nas kyang / /mtshon cha thogs pa de dag gis/ /snying dang nang grol dbang po kun/ /drangs te zos par rab bsgoms na/ /dgra rnams 'chi ①bar nges pa ste/ /de ltar rab tu bsgoms na ni / /rgyal ba rdo rje 'dzin pa yang / /zla ba phyed kyis 'chi ②'gyur na/ /dam tshig nyams pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni skye 'gro 'dul ba'i phur bu bsgrub ①pa'i thabs so/ /sdig pa byed dam gnod byed pa/ /rdo rje phur bus gdul bar bya/ /dur khrod gnas sam rkang gcig tu/ /bdud durtsi 'khyil pa'am ki li'am⑤/ /gang yang rung bar gnas byas la/ /rdo rje phur bu rab tu bsgom/ /me stag 'phro ba'i 'od 'phro bas/ /ri rab gling bzhi'i gzugs byas la/ /rang gi sngags kyis gdab par bya/ /de ltar rab tu gdab byas na/ /'gro dang mi 'gro thams cad kun/ /dul bar gyur par dugadon mi za / /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni gzhan gyi rig ⑦sngags gnon ⑧pa bsgrub pa'i thabs so/ /nam mkha' ⑨dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor bsgoms yinas ni/ /las kyi sems dpar ⑩bdag gnas la/ /g.yas pa ⑫rdo rje rtse lnga bzhag /rig sngags byed pa bsams nas ni/ /las kyi rdo rje'i ⑫rkang pa dag /de yi spyi nas mnan par bsgom/ /rig sngags nyid kyang mnan par bsam/ /des ni mu stegs can dag dang / /phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kun / /mnan par 'gyur te the tshom ④med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni gzhan gyi dpung mnan pa bsgrub pa'i thabs so/ /nam mkha' chadabyings kyi dbus su ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /gzhan gyis mi thub khro bo che/ /pad+ma dmar ser mdog 'dra ba/ /shin tu che zhing brjid pa tsobasgom/ /101—825

8 6 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ mus 101pha rol dmag dpung 'og dag tu/ /rlung dang mtsho dang sa skyed la①/ /de la gnas pa'i dpung rnams kyis/ /steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de steng rdo rje rgya gram gyi/ /steng du ri rab rnam par bsgom/ / de yi steng du mnan bsams na/ /②sangs rgyas dpung yang ①gnon par nus/ /mi rgyal dpung la smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni dgra'i dpung rmongs par bya ba bsgrub rjopa'i thabs so/ /dgra 'am dpung gi gzugs brnyan dag /bsams (snyesam gzugs su byas nas ni/ /rdo rje phur bu tshad ldan la/ /hūṃ las khro bo'i skur bskyed nas/ /rang gi rig sngags rab bzlas te/ /snying gar (7btab par rab bsgoms nas/ /khros pas ༷byas na sangs rgyas kyi9kye/ /dpung yang myos par gdon mi za/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni chu la 'bying ba med pa bsgrub 6)pa'i thabs so/ /nam mkha' yidabyings kyi dbus su ni/ /sngags kyi bdag po rab tu bsgom/ /chu yi steng ni thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas dag gis gtams ⑩par bsgom/ /steng nas dal gyis bcag par bsam/ /sangs rgyas dag ni thams cad kyi/ /spyi bo'i steng du rkang pa bsgom/ /de ltar 7rab tu goms 8pa dang / /sa la 'gro bzhin nus par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni thogs med rlung gi dngos grub bsgrub 7pa'i thabs so/ /nam mkhar tsordo rje yidabus su ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ / lha yi ⑩rnal 'byor bsgom tu par bya/ /'og gi phyogs su yo las ni/ /rlung gis rab tu bteg 6)par bsgom/ /de ltar rab tu bsgom ( nyabyas na( nya/ /mkha' la bya bzhin 'gro bar nus/ /zhing khams kun du bgrod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nyi ma gsal ba 8gezhes bya ba'i dngos grub bsgrub so pa'i thabs so/ /101—826

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 8 7sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje yi/ /snying gar ①nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de las 'od du 'phros pa las/ /mun pa'i gnas rnams bsal ②bar nges/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rlung bcad pa bsgrub pa'i thabs so/ /bdag nyid rlung gi phyogs song la/ /stegs bu gru bzhi lham par bya/ /spos ②kyi thig le bdun byas te/ /yo dulas rlung bdun bskyed par bya/ /rlung lha dgug pa dubyas yinas su/ /kham phor gyis ni dgab byas te/ /de steng lo ⑦las ri rab bsgom / /ri rab rtse la khro bo ni/ /'bar ba dag shegis mnan par bsgom/ /des ni 'jig ⑨pa'i rlung rnams kyang / /bcings par 'gyur bar tshugadon mi za//zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni char pa yidabab pa'i thabs so/ /nam mkha' ⑫dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsgom/ /dbus su khro bo stobs po che/ /'dab ma la ni klu brgyad po/ /bsgoms sam yang na bris kyang rung ske/ /khro bo'i zhabs kyi mthil gyis ni/ /klu rnams rab tu mnan nas su/ /hūṃ gnyis bar du klu rnams kyi/ /snying po spel cing gzir nas su/ /klu rnams gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /rtsu zhes bya ba bzlas brjod bya/ /khro bos mnan pa'i ⑫klu rnams kyi/ /kha nas char pa skyugs bsams na/ /'jig dus lta bu'i char pa'ang 8'bab/ /ces gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni char pa dang ser ba gcad ⑫pa'i thabs so/ /nam mkha'i tsodabyings kyi dbus su ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rta mchog dpal ni rnam par bsam/ /nyi ma'i mdog 'dra 'od bzang 8zhal/ /nam mkha' khyab par rnam par gdangs(nye/ /lce yi steng du rtsu bzhag ste/ / me ri tu 'od dang bcas pa yis/ /char chus gang ba'i sprin rnams kun/ /bskam duzhing lce yis blangs bsams na/ /skam par 'gyur bar 101—827
