846 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101ma de yis 6)'degs/ /lha mi yongs kyi 'dren ston yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas zhal mthong yin/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i srog shing yin/ /yon tan kun gyi gter mdzod yin/ /gal te yon tan mi ldan yang / /bla mar bzung nas spang byas na/ /kun gyi slob dpon brnyas pa yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas skur (gepa yin / / de yi gnyams pa brjod mi lang / /yon tan ldan pa'i bla ma de/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rgyal sras dang ni mthu chen rnams/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing bkur sti byed/ /'jig rten 'di na mthu chen kun/ /de yi dgongs pa skong gi)ba dang / /khur zhing bran du khas len na/ /rdo rje slob mas smos ci dgos/ /rdo rje spun (gyel gdung sems kyang / /'dres dang ma 'dres yongs kyi spun/ /yang dag lam du zhugs pa la/ /mngan (6)dang dpyas kyis (77sems tsam yang / /rtag tu spang bar bya ba yin/ /brtse zhing gdung ba'i shugs phyung la/ /gcig la gcig ni mig bzhin blta(9/ /mdor na srog la mi chags par/ /spun dang ming sring dzi)dgos pa sgrub7/ /ci phyir rdo rje spun rnams ni37ske/ /'di nas 7byang chub thug pa ru/ /mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i grogs mchog ste / /mar me 'od dang sdong bu 1)'dra'o/ /dper na 'jig rten mi rnams kyang / /mang po 'dus na dka' 7ba'ang 'grub/ /de bzhin rdo rje ming sring spun/ /dngos grub sgrub 7pa'i grogs mchog yin/ /dper na grogs dang ldan pa'i mi/ /'tshe ba rnams kyis mi tshugs bzhin/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor grogs ldan yang / /rgol ba rnams kyis 7mi tshugs shing / /'bras bu myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan bskyed de bsrung / /de yang sku tsho yi dam tshig ste/she/ /bsrung ba yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /mdor na snang (11srid thams cad ni/ /gzugs 101—846

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 847su snang ba mtha' yas kun/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /gzugs sku 'ja' 6)tshon tshul du gsal/ /de nyid don las mi 'da' bar/ /rtogs pa sku yi (midam tshig ces/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis phyirab tu gsungs/ /gsung gi dam tshig ces bya ba/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor gral gi)sgo bas/ /phyag rgya bzhi ru rnam gsal nas/ /rdo rje sngags rnams rgyun mi gcad/ /bsgom dang bzlas dang 'phro 'du'i sngags/ /ting 'dzin me dang 'dra ba la/ /bzlas brjod rlung dang 'dras bskyod nas/ /sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg par bya/ /bzlas brjod sngags kyis ⑤brtul zhugs kyang / /sgra chen (6)ma yin chung bar (7)min/ /mgyogs par ma yin bul bar min/ /drag par ma yin dal bar min/ /yig 'bru yan lag nyams ma yin/ /yengs min glal sogs bar gcod min/ /rgyu ba'i sems rnams spangs pa dang / /bzlas pa'i skyon bcu spangs nas ni/ /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma yi(9/ /bsnyen pa (9)rab tu rdzogs pa gces/ /ye shes lha rnams nye ba dang / /dbyings dang rnam thar 'dzom dzopa dang / /dngos grub rnam (spregasum thob pa dang / /'phro 'dus 'gro don bya ba dang / /de 7yis lha rnams mnyes pa dang / /las de myur du 'grub pa'i phyir/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig yin par gsungs / /mdor na snang srid thams cad kun/ /skye med gsung yinalas ma g.yos kyang / /gsung gi bye brag nyid yin par/ /rtogs 7shing slar yang dbyings su thimatso/ /rtogs 7pa gsung du rgyal zhanabs gsungs/ /thugs kyi dam tshig ces bya ba/ /spyir gsang bzhi dang bar gsang bzhi/ /gsang bar 'os dang gnyer gtad pa'i/ /gsang sngags gsang ba'i don rnams kun/ /bum pa'i nang gi me mar bzhin/ /snod ma yin pa'i gang zag la/ /dus dang gnas 101—847

848 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101skabs ①kun du gsang / /snod dang ldan pa rnams la yang / /dbang ma thob par bshad pa min/ /ci phyir gsang don de nyid la/ /ma rtogs pa rnams skur pa 'debs/ /log par rtogs pa ltung ②bar 'gyur/ /don ma rtogs na yid ches ①med/ /khams gsum skye bo'i ④bcas kur 'gyur/ /dngos grub bar gcod bgegs su du'agyur/ /de bas gzhan du bstan pa min/ /mdor na thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /srid gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /sems rtog ⑥rnam pa thams cad kun/ /skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /so sor rtogs pa thugs nyid snang / /snang nyid dbyings ⑦las mi 'da' bar/ /rtogs pa thugs su rgyal ⑧bas gsungs/ /de ni rtsa ba'i dam tshig gi/ /mdo nyid rgyas par bshad pa yin/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig gi mdo rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /mi spong ⑨dam tshig ces bya ba/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti yimug dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog lnga rnams ni/ /rigs lnga'i yisangs rgyas ngo bo ste/ /ye shes lnga yi tsorang bzhin pas/ /spangs na 8rnal 'byor don dang 'gal/ /mi dor dang du 8blang ba ni/ /dri chen dri chu rak+ta 'dang / /mo sa dang ni zil pa lnga/ /'bras bu lnga yis bsdus pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor pas ni yirtag tu bza'/ /'di yang dam tshig rmad po che/ /spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ /sbyor dang sgrol dang (1ma byin len / /brdzun dang ngag rtsub smra dang lnga/ /don dam dzisteskyes bus spyad par bya/ /shes par bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ /dbang po yul lnga kha dog lnga/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga nyid du/ /don ldan skyes bus shes par bya/ /lung dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /grub par bya ba'i don chen yang / /sangs rgyas lnga tunyelas gzhan mi bsgrub( nya/ /grub par bya ba'i dam tshig ste/ /'di 101—848

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 849dag bsrung bar rab tu gces/ /de yang ci phyir bsrung zhe na/ /'dod chags rang dang spyir snang ba/ /chags shing zhen pa thams cad kun/ /pad+ma ①rigs kyi ngo bo yin/ /zhe sdang de bzhin rdo rje'i rigs/ /gti mug sangs rgyas yin par gsungs / /nga rgyal yid (snyebazhin nor bu ste/ /phrag dog zhes bya las su bshad/ /de bas spang bar bya ba min/ /dri chen snang mdzad gtso bo yin/ /dri chu gdon mi za grub pa/ /rak+ta ①snang ba mtha' yas sku/ /mo lis rin chen 'byung ldan gtso / /byang chub sems ni rdo rje sems/ /des na dang du blang bar gsungs/ /sems can thams cad gsad bya ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig ⑤yin/ /bud med rnams la chags bya ba/ /snang ba mtha' yas dam tshig ste/ /gzhan gyi nor 'phrog rnam snang gisayi/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i brdzun ⑦gra ma/ /ngag rtsub ⑧ gdon mi za 'grub pa'i/ /dam tshig yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /de bas spyad par bya ba'o/ /gzugs su snang ba (1)rnam snang mdzad⑩/ /tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan gtso/ /'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te/ /'du byed gdon mi za grub pa(me/ /rnam shes rdo rje 8sems dpa'osnyi/ /sa ni rdo rje zhes su bshad/ /rin chen chu ste pad+ma me/ /thogs med rlung gi rang bzhin te/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam snang mdzad/ /mig gi dbang po rnam lisnang mdzad/ /rna ba rin chen 'byung ba'i tshul/ /snang ba mtha' yas sna 8zhes grags/ /lce ni gdon mi tso za grub pa/ /lus ni mi bskyod 7pa ru bshad/ /gzugs ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul/ /sgra ni rin chen 'byung ba ste/ /dri ni snang ba mtha' yas so ro ni don yod grub pa yin/ /reg rnams mi bskyod pa ru bshad/ /de bzhin dkar po rdo rje'i rigs/ /ser po bder /shegashegs rigs su bshad/ /mthing 101wa 849

850 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101ga 0)rin chen dmar po chos/ /ljang gu ②las kyi rigs su bshad/ /de phyir shes par bya ba yi/ /dam tshig yin par dpa' bos gsungs/ /bsgrub ⑧par bya ba'i 'bras bu yang / /rigs lnga nyid du grub pas na/ /de grub pa yi dam tshig yin/ /dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ /yan lag dam tshig 'da' ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /yan lag gi dam tshig mdo rgyas pa'o/ /de la 'di ni dbye ba'o/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams/ /bsrung ba rtog pa gnyis su dbye/ /de dag dngos su bsrung bas na/ /mi 'da' bsrung ba'i sdom bcas yin/ /rnam par dag pa'i ngang nyid du/ /de dag rtogs pas (gakhyad par du/ /rtogs pa'i dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /de la 'di ni dam tshig nyams pa ltung (nyaba'i gnas so/ /rtsa ba nyams pa'i skyon chen yang / /bskal pa grangs med bgrangs par (5)yang / /dmyal ba'i gnas su ltung ⑦bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje bla ma'i sku smad (gun/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas brnyas 6)pa yin/ /byang chub sems la skur 7pas na/ / de yi 1)sdig pa brjod mi lang / /dper na 'jig rten sa yi /tsho rdul/ /grangs kyis bgrang bar shes kyang srid/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu thigs tu kyang / /grangs kyis skibagrang zhing shes su rung / /'di yi sdig pa brjod mi nus/ /shin tu mi bzad snyi sdug bsngal las/ /thar bar nams kyang 7mi 'gyur te/ /srid gsum sems can gsad pas 7ni/ /bla ma'i bka' bcag char mi phod/ /rdo rje spun la smad (shepa ni/ /nyams pa'i skyon yang brjod par dka'/ /bskal pa gcig ()gi bar ( )dag tu/ /dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir bsgrub pa log pa dang —/ /'bad pa'i 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /dbyings dang rnam par thar pa yi/ /sgo rnams nyams par gyur pas 101wa 850

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 851na / /bsgrub 6)pa thams cad log par 'gyur/ /yi dgas ②gnas su yun ring ste / /lkugs ③pa'i gnas su gyur pa yin/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /yi dgas ④kyi ni lus su skye/ /thong gshol 'bar ba lnga brgya yis/ /de yi lce la gshog par byed/ /bskal pa du mar myong ba dang / /dngos grub 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /mdor na rtsa ba nyams gyur na/ /'bras bu med cing ngan song ltung / /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid kyang / /de yi snying khrag 'thung bar nges / /mi spong (5dam tshig nyams gyur yin/ /dngos grub thams cad spangs par 'gyur(pe/ /mi dor dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /dngos grub 'bras bu mi 'thob cing / /yi dgas (2)spre'u'i ⑨gnas su skye/ /spyad pa'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /'du shes med pa'i 'gog par ltung / /shes pa'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /'du shes med pa'i khros pas ltung / /grub pa'i dam tshig nyams gyur na / /bdud kyi khams su ltung bar 'gyurakyi/ /rtogs (7pa'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /ru tra chen po'i gnas su ltung / /de la sogs te bsam mi khyab/ /ces gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nyams pa bskang ba'i tshad do/ /dam tshig nyams par gyur pa na/ /mgon btsun mnyam pa'i don rtogs na/ /de nyid skongs pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /bla ma tsho spun la smad tunyegyur na/ /tshe 'di nyid la mnyes byas te/ / mthol bshags 7drag pos 'gyod byas na/ /de ni skongs pa'i las su 'gyur/ /gal te bdag gam bla ma spun8/ /ma bskangs bar du tshe 'phos nas/ /de ni bskang ba'i tshad las 'das/ /gsung gi tha tshig ral gyur na / /rdo rje chos su bdag bsgoms la/ /tha tshig gang tsho brlag 'bum 'bum /shegadon / /thugs kyi tha tshig ral gyur na/ /rdo rje sems dpar bsgoms tsho/pa la /101—851

85 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101lo gsum bar du mi smra bar/ /bsam gtan sbyor bar ①rab tu bya/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /so so'i rigs kyis ②de bzhin bskong ③/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de skad ces gsungs pas 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams kyis rjogasang sngags kyi dam tshig ni/ rang rang gi snying la gnas par mthong nas/ a la la zhes pa'i sgra phyung nas rang rang gi dam tshig la (snyedamigs so/ /'phags pa rgyud kyi rgyal po yiye shes rngam pa glog ⑦gi 'khor lo'i mdo zhes bya ba las dam tshig rnam par bkod (9pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos brtul zhugs rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /zhugs nas kyang gsang khrisngags thams cad kyi brtul zhugs rnam par rol pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang 7thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /gsang sngags rgya mtsho chen po yi/ /brtul zhugs ngo mtshar (/nyarmad byung btunye/ /chos kun rol par snang ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar spyad kyang brtul zhugs te/ /dka' thub dka' ba spyad ()mi dgos/ /dka' thub sdom la rten 7pa'i mis/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub 7par mi 'gyur te/ /dka' thub sdom la mi gnas shing / /'dod pa'i longs spyod rab bsten ⑩pas/ /bsgrubs na 7myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /rigs ngan dang ni sme sha can/ /rtag tu gsod la brtson pa dang / /ma byin len dang mi tshangs spyod/ /brdzun du smra la dga' ba dang / /rtsub pa'i ngag la dga' ba ni/ /gsang lho sngags bsgrub 4)pa'i snod du 'gyur/ /pha dang khu bo mes po la/ /zhe sdang (1sems kyis bsgral byas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos grub thob/ /ma dang bu mo sring mo la/ /101—852

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 863lo rlung gis sa/tsubs ①pa la/ /mtshan ma ming du bcas par bya/ /ming nas drag tu bskul bya zhing / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i khro bo yis/ /gshin rje'i drung du khrid pa dang / /bgegs kyi drung du mnan ②byas na/ /des kyang bskrad pa'i las su 'gyur/ /yang na dgra yi sgo ga garu/ /thod pa ma gas ma chag par/ /rdo rje sngags kyi tshig bris te/ /rdo rje mi 'chi rnam par bsgom/ /dgra yi sgo ru bzhag na ni/ /bskrad ④par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /gal te dbye ba'i las byas na/ /khro bo'i sngags dang ming spel ⑤te/ /'ug pa'i sgro la bris nas ni0/ /bram ze'am dge sbyong spas dkris te/ /lam gyi bzhi ⑦mdor brkos 0te gzhug⑨ /de la rdo rje khro bo gnyis/ /'thab cing rtsod par rnam bsams na/ / gsad de ⑩dbye bar gdon mi za/ /gal te mnan ⑩pa'i las byas 8na/ /dgug pa de ⑫nyid sbyar byas te/ /mngon sum khugs par gyur pa dang / /de steng tsodabang chen rim 8par bskyed/ /ri rab steng du bsgom pa ni⑩/ /las kyi lha ste ⑩don yod grub/ /rdo rje rgya gram tsobarjid ldan pas/ /bskal pa yun du gnon yipar bsamadul/ /gzugs brnyan thod pa gang bar gzhug 0 /lam gyi bzhi mdor de bzhin bya/ /des ni rab tu mnan ⑥par 'gyur/ /gal te bcing bar 'dod pa ⑫na / /dgug pa de nyid cisbyar byas te/ /mtshan ma ming du bcas pa de/ /tshon tsoskud sna lngas mgo lus dkri/ /rdo rje sgrog gis bcings bsams nas/ /thod pa ma nyams nang du tsogazhug /lam gyi ⑥bzhi mdo'am dur khrod ⑤du/ /sbas na nges par bcings par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang gsad pa'i brtul 0zhugs ni/ /khrag dang dri chu bshang gci 6 )yis/ /gsher bar byas pa'i gos gyon (nyete/ /khro bo'i rgyal por ()sbyar byas nas/ /rkang pas gzugs brnyan mnan nas ni/ /101—863

864 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101khros pas gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ /rdzogs par bzlas ①na nges par 'chi/ /thal ba'i skyo ma spangs pa 'am/ /skra bshig gcer ①bur phud pa'ang rung / /de lta bu yi (1sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang 'chi 'gyur na/ /khams gsum skye bo smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad 'jigs skrag ste/ rang rang gi stan las ④langs nas lus sa la brdabs ⑤pa'i phyag rnal 'byor gyi lugs su byas te/ cho 'phrul rnam pa du ma bstan nas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rdo rje'i yitshig gis ⑦bstod pa/ e ma'o ngo mtshar ya mtshan gyi/ /cho 'phrul kun gyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /ngo mtshar kun gyi bdag po mchog /rdo rje rgyal la niphyag 'tshal 'dud6)/ /byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor dang / /phyag rgya bsnyen sgrub ⑩bsgrub pa dang / /sdom dang gsal zhugs las rnams dang / /nan tur bdag po khyod la 'dud7/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi yab/ /de bzhin rgyal 6)sras snying por 'gyur/ /bdag cag rnams kyis rten 8pa'i gnas/ /ma rungs 'dul gtso khyod la 'dud/ /e ma'o snang dang mi snang brtan g.yo la sogs chos kun nyid kyi sgyu dhi'aphrul dra ba 'khrul la snang / /bsam yas bsam dpag las 'das chos kun ngo mtshar rmad 'byung cho 'phrul sna tshogs kun du snang / /rtog 7med mnyam nyid dbyings las ji 0srid 'phrul kyang dbyings las urnyagayos pa rdul (7gyi cha tsam med/ /don dam bden pa'i cho 'phrul ( )kun rdzob gsang sngags che ba'i khyad par rmad 'byung ( nyam ma'o ngo sa mtshar che/ /zhes mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab ( nyaste/ 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams la la ni byang chub sems kyi mtshan zhi )nyid la sems shing cang mi smra bar 'khod do/ /la la ni dkyil 'khor rnams rim gyis ( sridagod/ la la ni lhun gyis grub pa'i 101—864

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'imado/ 865gar dang phyas rgya ①nye bar ston/ la la ni gsang sngags kyi sgo zab mo bsnyen sgrub ②rnam pa bzhir 'jug cing mi ldog /la la ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i che ba dag ston / la la ni gsang ④sngags kyi dam tshig snying la gnas par sdom/ la la ni brtul zhugs zab mo la 'jol nyag ⑤tu rol/ la la ni gdug pa'i tshogs nyen cing tshar gcod⑥/ la la ni rmugs pa dang / rengs pa dang / 'dod gzir dang —/ dregs pa rnams dang / sbyor ba'i las kyi rol pas dgyesasti/ la la ni nan tur gyi che ba ston cing ling long phyadag/ thams cad bla 'khyal ⑨ba'i spyod pa can du gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po ni yum rngam pa kro dhi'i rgyal mo dang gnyis su med par de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings la dgongs shing cang mi gsung ⑩bar gyur to/ /'phags pa rgyud kyi rgyal po ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo'i mdo zhes bya ba las nan tur 7gyi las rim par phye ba'i le'u ste bcu drug pa 8rdzogs sto.a// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra bi shwa mi tra dang zhu (hechen gyi lots+tsha ba pa gor bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ⑩tas bsgyur ⑩cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o()// //de nas yang smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang pos bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchoge gi bdag po de hunyede bzhin nyid 5)kyi ngang la ( )mi g.yo bar brnal ⑥bzhin du cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i glu 'dis rnam par bskul lo( nye/ /e ma'o mi dmigs chos dbyings dag pa las/ /'bar ba'i sku mchog bdag la bstan du gsol / /rol pa'i cho snyena'aphrul mi zad rgyan du che/ /don la rngam pa'i spyod pas rol du gsol/ /a la la ho zhes bskul bas bskul bar thugs su chud nas sku nyi 101—865

866 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ mi 101ma'i snying po lta bu mngon du phyung ste cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pas ①snod bcud dang sa'i khyad par thams cad la snang bar mdzad pa'o/ /de nas smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po (snyerdo rje kun du bzang pos mchod pa rgyas pa de kho na nyid kyis mngon par mchod de ①brkyang phyag 'tshal rgyanas gsol ba btab pa/ e ma'o gsang mchog dag pa'i bdag /ye shes shes bgyi ⑤ji ltar lags/ /rngam pa zhes ni gang la bgyi/ /glog phreng ⑥zhes pa ji ltar lags/ /'khor lo zhes pa ji lta bu/ / mdo yi ( )don ni ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pag/ gsang 6)ba mchog gi ⑩bdag pos gsol ba btab pa thugs su chud nas ye shes snying po can rnams nyon cig /ye shes ye shes zhes bya ba / /shes dang shes bya tha dad min/ /rig pa'i ngo bo rnam ⑩pa lnga/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas/ /byang chub sems su rgyal bas gsungs/ /dregs pa 'dul zhing nan thur 8gyis/ /thogs chags med pa'i brtul zhugs pas/ /sngags spyod rngam pa'i khyad par de/ /rngam pas rngam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /glog ni myur du 'jug pa'i phyir/ /'jug pa'i yan lag bzhi dag dang / /sdom dang las bzhi'i khyad par gyis/ /dngos grub las la myur 'jug pa'o/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan ()dang / /phyag rgya dngos grub 'brel chabacas ni / /'khor lo zhes su rgyal bas gsungs/ /de bas ming ni don mthun ⑫grags / /rig 7cing gsal ba'i ngo bo pas(rte/ /ye shes zhes su brjod pa yin/ /rngam pa zhes pa drag shul spyod/ /myur zhing bar chad med pas na/ /glog gi phreng ba zhes su bya/ /skor lho dang gcod dang rgyun mi gcad67/ /'khor lo lta bu'i rnam pa der/ /gsang ba kun 'dus mdo bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas smra 101—866

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 867ba'i seng ge byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang pos gsol pa/ rgyud ces ①bgyi ba ji lta bu/ mdo 'di 'brel pa ji ltar lags/ /de bzhin dgos dang yang dgos ci / /brjod pa ji ltar shes par bgyi/ /bcom ldan gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ 'brel dang ma tshang med pa dang / /phun sum tshogs phyir rgyud ces bya/ /'di don rig pa'i skyes bu yis/ /gsang ba kun don shes pa'i phyir / /phyogs bcu kun du rab grags pa'i/ /rgyud kun dang ni 'brel par bshad / /gsang ba'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor pa/ /byang chub sems dang dkyil 'khor dang / /phyag rgya bsnyen dang dngos grub dang / /sdom dang brtul ②zhugs ma rungs mnyes/ /las dang nan tur ①bya ba'i rnams/ /mchog tu dgos pas dgos pa yin/ /bden ④gnyis rtogs nas bdag (5)gzhan don/ /grub pa yang dgos yin par bshad/ /dgos pa'i don yang rjod yibyed pa'i/ /don bsdus mdo 'di brjod pa yin/ /de bas rnam pa bzhi po yis/ /bde blag ⑦tu ni rtogs ⑧par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang smra ba'i seng ges gsol pa/dbang mchog dam pa ma thob par/ /sgrub yinyepa ci yang mi 'grub ⑩pa/ /ji ltar dbang bskur mtshan nyid lags/ /snod ni ji lta bu 4)dag lags/ / go rims ji lta bu dag lags/ /tsho rnam grangs dag gi mtshan nyid ci/ /dbang thob rtags dang mtshan ma ci/ /bcom ldan snying pos tu bshad du gsol/ /gsang yib mchog gi bdag pos libaka' stsal pa/ gsang yiba'i tshig la gsal 'dris shing / /don la gzhol zhing yid ches kyang / /dbang bskur bka' thonartags ma byin par/ /nor bu blon bral bskos kyi pa ltar/ /sa rnams thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /sems kyis chos la dbang thob na/ /rdzas tshig gang zag dbang rnams kun/ /ma 101—867

868 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ (sdi 101bskur 0sten yang thob par 'gyur/ /bskur na'ang nyes pa med par bshad/ /rig pa rang dbang thob gyur (nyan/ /bskur ba'i dbang la thogs pa med/ /de ni dbang gi mtshan nyid yin/ /ras ②chod byed cing tshul 'chos ༷pa'i/ /dad dang mi ldan brtson 'grus chung / /blo zhan nges med 'phyar la g.yeng / /bla ma spun la sri zhu chung / /de ni dbang gi snod ma yin/ /dad dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus che/ /mnyan bsam slob la mi skyo ba/ /bla ma spun la bkur sti byed/ /gsang ba nyan pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /rnam bzhi las kyi dgos pa tshang /bya ba'i las la ma rmongs na/ /kur ⑤ma las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /lta bas dumanyam pa'i don rtogs na/ /rgyal 'theb 'chad ⑦cing ston pa'i dbang / /tshad ⑧ma gsum dang rab ldan zhing / /rkyen thub rdo rje slob dpon dbang / /theg pa'i rim pa thams cad la/ /phyogs ris med cing ma rmongs na6)/ /rab 'byam ⑩rgyal po'i dbang thob pa'o/ /rkyen thub brtul zhugs che ba dang / /skyon rnams spangs shing dam tshig ldan/ /gsang ba sgrub 7pa'i dbang thob pa'o⑩/ / dang por lho gsang ba nyan pa'i dbang / /rin chen rigs kyis yin ba la'o/ /de nas rdo rje las kyi dbang / /las kyi rigs kyis 7yan lag la'o/ /de nas gsang ba sgrub 7pa'i dbang / /rdo rje rigs kyis yinasnying gar 9/nyaro/ /de nas rgyal 'theb ⑩rgyal po'i dbang / /sangs rgyas rigs kyis rdo )spyi bo la'o/ /de nas gsang ba 'chang ba'i gistodabang / /pad+ma'i rigs kyis tsho nyalce la bskur/ /de nas rab 'byam ()rgyal po'i dbang / /yan lag rigs lngas dbang bskur ro/ /dang po gsum pa bdag gi don/ /gnyis pa bzhi pa gnyis ka )ste/ /lnga pa drug pa gzhan don du / /dbang mchog bskur ba'i go rims nayin/ /rnam grangs go rims tso101 —868

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 869mtshan nyid ni/ /dang por phyi yi dbang bcu bskur/ /de nas nang dbang bcu dang gcig /de nas sgrub ①pa'i bcu dang gsum/ /tha mar gsang ba rnam pa gnyis / /bcu phrag gsum ②dang drug dag gis/ /dbang mchog dam pa bskur ba yin/ /dang po bka' rtags phyag rgya'i sridabang / /gnyis pa rtags kyi mtshan ma'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab gzugs kyis te/ /bzhi pa bkra shis bum pa'i dbang / /lnga pa bkra shis rdzas kyi dbang / /drug pa rin chen snisna bdun dbang —/ /bdun pa gdan mchog dam pa'i dbang / /brgyad pa mdzes pa rgyan ⑤gyi dbang / /dgu pa gsang ba ming gi dbang / /bcu pa rgyal rtags 'khor lo ste / /phyi dbang bcu po rdzogs pa dang / /rdo rje nang du gzhug par bya/ /dang po gsang ba nyan cing slob pa'i dbang / /gnyis pa glegs bam zab zhumo gtad par bya/ /gsum pa rnam bzhi las kyi rdzas kyang sbyin/ /bzhi pa rgyal tshab rgyadam pa'i mdzod gsum sbyin/ /lnga pa slob dpon bzhi yi nitheg chen rtags/ /drug pa nyi zla pad+ma sems can gdan/ /bdun pa rgyal po gsang ba'i rin chen bdun//brgyad pa gzugs brnyan spyi bor gzhagakhyi /dgu pa sku gsum ye shes sbyin/ /bcu pa bkra shis dam rdzas dbang / /de nas lag tu rdo rje sbyin/ /bcu dang gcig gis nang bcug yinas/ /sgrub tunyepa'i dbang mchog sbyin par bya/ /dang por sems kyi gtan tshigs 7sbyin/ /gnyis pa snying rje'i dbang bskur sbyin/ /gsum pa yi ge (ste'akhor lo sbyin/ /bzhi pa thong 8gshol 'bar ba sbyin/ / bhan dha tsogang ba sbyin dang lnga/ /drug pa mtshon cha sna tshogs te/ /bdun pa skyon med pad+ma sbyin/ /brgyad pa sti ra'i tsodabyug pa sbyin/ /dgu pa sbrul nag chun po sbyin//bcu pa ( dri med lha mo sbyin/ /gcig pa 'dod pa'i longs tunyespyod kun/ /gnyis 101—869

870 bka' 'a ra/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101pa sgrub 2rdzas rab tu sbyin/ /gsum pa rdo rje gsang mi sbyin/ /bcu dang gsum pa tshirdzogs pa dang / /gsang ba dam pa sbyin pa yang / /dkar dmar 'dres pa'i byang chub sems/ /bu mchog de yi galce la gzhag /snying po don dam byang chub sems/ /de yi blo la gzhag ④par bya/ /dbang mchog thob pa'i ltas rnams kyang ske/ /blo rtsal che ba'i bdag nyid dang / /snang ba ①lus kyi snga ⑥ltas dang / /ngo mtshar che ba'i rdzas rnyed ⑦dang / /mtshan ma pra yi rmi ltas 'byung ⑧/ /blo rtsal che ba'i khyad par du/ /yang dag 6)bden pa'i don rnams la/ /mi skrag dga' mgu ⑩skye bar 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i chos la skyo sems 'byung / /rnam grangs chos la dad mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar snang ba'i mtshan ma kun/ /sgyu ma bzhin du shes par 'gyur / /'jig rten pa yi yimathu chen tshul/ /'jigs shing nyam ting med par 'gyur / /de la sogs te mtha' yas mchog /snang ba lus kyi snga ltas ④kyang / /lus kyis bzod pa thob pa dang / /'du ba'i nad dang bral ba dang / /kham 8kyi zas dang bral ba dang / /dbang po'i gzi mdangs gsal ba dang / /bar snang dag la lding ba dang / /shing bal lta bur yang ba dang / /chu la mi 'bying mes mi 'tshigayi /rlung gis khyer bar nus mi 'gyur/ /de ⑩la sogs te mtha' yas mchog /ngag gis nyunyeji snyed brjod pa bzhin/ /'gyur ba yin par shes par bya//rdzas kyi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /rnyed tho)cing thob pa dag tu 'gyur/ /nyams dang rmi lam dag tu yang / /dbang mchog ji ltar bskur ba bzhin/ / de dag nus pa'i rnam pa 'byung / /so)de dag dbang bskur thob pa'i rtags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol ba btab po/ /ye shes rnal 'byor can rnams kyis/ /101—870

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 871gsang ba sbas pa'i thabs tshul du/ /sbas pas grub ①pa'ang myur ba dang / /gsang ba'i dam la gnas bya dang / /brda la dga' ba'i mi rnams kun/ /nye ②zhing gdung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /lus dang ngag gi brda rnams kun/ /gsang niba'i bdag pos ④bshad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / gsang duba'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba sbas pa'i thabs tshul du/ /brda duyi dam tshig bshad par bya/ /'dus pa'i 'khor rnams legs par nyon/ /lus brda dam tshig phyag rgya ni⑦/ /lag pa g.yas pas bya ba kun/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bya ba'i brda/ /g.yon pas bya ba ma yis nibarda/ /spyi bor nyug ⑨pa'i lag brda ni/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi ⑩brda yi rgya/ /dpral bar reg pa ⑩phyag lan ⑫yin / /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang tsobyas te/ /mgo bo btud par byas pa ni/ /khams bde 'am zhes 'dri ba'i brda/ /lag pa g.yon pa brkyang nas ni/ /g.yon du 'dud pa bde ba'i lan8/ /mig gnyis dag la reg pa na/ /gzugs mdzes ston cig ces pa'i brda/ /g.yas pa skyes pa mdzes pa yin/ /g.yon pa bud med bzang mor bshad/ /rna ba dag la reg pa'i brda/ /g.yon pa legs pa'i glu snyan brda/ /g.yas pa tshig snyan ⑩smra ba'i brda/ /sna phug tsoganyis la reg pa ni/ /g.yas pa bdug dzopa 'dod pa ste/ /g.yon pa dri dag slong 4)ba'i brda/ /lces ni ldag par byed pa'i brda/ /g.yas su ldag pa yisha 'dod pa'o/ /g.yon du chang 'dod brda ru bshad/ /mche bas ma mchu mnan pa ni/ /g.yon pa bud med reg bya 'dod/ /g.yas pa skyes pa de bzhin no/ /lkog ( )mar reg pa gsang ba ( )yi/ /theg mchog gsang ()ba smra ba'i brda/ /ske la reg par byed pa ni / /bdag nyid dbyangs ( nyesnyan len pa'i brda(ste/ /snying ga'i (snyedakyil du reg 101—871

brtul zhugs chen po bskub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 875phyi zhes bya/ /lhun grub bde chen zab mo de/ /ming gi rnal 'byor phal dag gis / /rtogs shing khong du chud par dka'/ /de ni nang gi sbas pa yin/ /phyi ①nang gnyis su tha dad min/ /bden pa gnyis su dbyer med pa/ /rgyal ba sangs rgyas spyod yul de/ /ma nges ①sbas par rgyal bas gsungs/ /sbas pa'i don rnams gsal 'byin pa/ /bla ma rdo rje'i thugs la gnas/ /des dun sbas zhes nges par gsungs/ /thabs dang shes rab zhes bya ba/ /gnyis su med pa'i byang chub sems/ /de nyid thig le rnam gsum ste/ /thabs mchog yab kyi mkha' nyid dang / /shes rab yum gyi klong nyid dang / /gnyis med bde chen ngang ④nyid du/ /chos kun 'dus shing gcig pa dang / /spros med thig ler gnas pa'i phyir/ /thig le zhes su rgyal bas gsungs/ /mnyam pa ⑤nyid kyang rnam gsum ste/ /don dam dbyings su mnyam pa dang / /kun rdzob sgyu mar mnyam pa dang / /dbyer med gcig par mnyam pa ste/ /ma skyes ma grub dbyer med par/ /chos kun mnyam par gnas pas na/ /mnyam pa zhes su brjod pa yin / /snod dang bcud dang rgyud rnams kun/ /dag pas dag pa phyogasum yin te / /yum gyi dbyings dang yab kyi mkha'/ /ye shes lnga yi rtsirang bzhin du/ /snod bcud rgyud kun dag pa'i phyir/ /dag pa (kyegasum du rgyal bas gsungs/ /rtogs pa 6)yang ni ⑩rnam pa bzhir(nye/ /rnal 'byor nang pa bzhed pa kyiste/ /rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum (nyapas /rdzogs chen don la 'jug 'gyur te/ /rgyu ni bden gnyis gcig pa ru/ /gcig pas gcig pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge ru/ /chos kun rang bzhin rtogs pa dang / /skye yimed dbyings kyi byin brlabs las8 /101—875

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 877su grub pa'i blo gsal na/ /de bzhin nyid du rnam par grags/ /kun snang snying rje'i ①ngo bo dang / /yig ②'bru kha dog gsal ba ①yi/ /rgyu yi ting 'dzin ④gsal ba ni/ /bskyed pa gzhan gyi ⑤dbang yin te/ /de nyid log rtog kun brtags pa'o/ /des na rnal 'byor skyes bu yis/ /mtshan med ngang yil gnas bcas nas/ /mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom ⑦par bya'o/ /mtshan ma med dang mtshan ma yang / /tha dad med par shes par bya/ /de ltar rig pa'i rnal 'byor pal / /de nyid nga yin sa thob yin/ /sangs rgyas zhes kyang de la bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang mchod pa (9)byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' smos ci dgos/ /'jig rten lha klu yimathu chen yang / /de la mchod cing bkur 47ste byed/ /phyi bzhin 'breng zhing dgos pa skong / /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams kyis rang rang gi lus sa la brdabs nas a la la zhes bya ba'i sgra phyung ste shin tu ngo mtshar to/ /de nas smra ba'i seng ge byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das the tshom 7thams cad gcod pa'i bdag po mchog rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'di nyid ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo'i mdo chen po zhes bya yinab 'argyud kyi 'grel pa/ rtags kyi yirol pa/don gyi bkod yipa rdo rje rnam par rol pa'i gzhung tu chen po 'di yi bla ma rdo rje slob dpon skyes bu dam pas ma nor bar /shertogs shing gzhan dag la yang (nyam nor bar ston pa de la bdag cag ( rnams kyis ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ ji lta bu'i rang bzhin du 'tshal bar bgyi/2gle bcom ldan 'das lung bstan du gsol/bde bar gshegs pas (2gelung bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ( geb mchog gi bdag pos gsol pa btab pa de mkhyen nas 'di skad ces 101—877

878 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ la 101gsungs so/ /smra ba'i seng ge nga la zhu bar spobs pa legs/ rab tu legs kyis ༅nyon cig /gzhung 'di bla ma rdo rje slob dpon de ni skyes bu dam pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de②/ de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du blta bar bya'o①/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang / dbyer med cing tha mi dad deX/ bla ma de ni bskal pa chen po grangs med pa'i pha mtha' yi yang pha ⑤mtha' 'das pa nas rgyal ba sangs rgyas brjod du med pa yi yang brjod pa rnams la tshogs ⑥thams cad yongs su rdzogs par sbyangs shing rang gi sems kyi rgyud ⑦rnam par sbyangs pa'i nus mthus gsang ba 'di'i don la yid ches shing gsang ba'i don 'di lta bu'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon chen po nyid du rig par bya ste/ de ni sangs rgyas nyid dang tha mi dad cing byang chub kyi sems nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /de la 'di ni phyogs bcu ⑧dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa rnams kyang spyi bo gtsug gis khur zhing phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa byed cing rjes su 'breng ponyen gzhan byang chub sems dpa' dang rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa ci zhig smos te/ 'jig rten gyi mthu bo 7che rnams kyang de'i bran du khas len cing 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yang skyong zhing ci bsgo ba ⑩thams cad kyang bsam pa yid bzhin du grub par byed do/ /de bas na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /de ni snyide bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur (nyab/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten chalas 'das pa'i ston pa chen po yin par blta'osnyi/ /sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang / rten dang / gling dang / ded dpon dang / 'dren pa 101 —878

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 879dang ske/ sgrol ba'i gru ①lta bu yin par shes par bya'o/ /de ni ye shes kyi sgron ma chen po 'dzin pa ste de bas na sangs rgyas nyid du blta'o/ /de bas na bla ma de dang phrad pa'i gang zag rnal 'byor pa des kyang yang dag par rdzogs ②pa'i sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad par rig par bya'o/ /smra ba'i seng shes gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bla ma rdo rje slob dpon de'i rjes su 'brang zhing gsang ba 'di lta bu la mos shing 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i dbang pos nyan cing gzhung bzhin ①du sgrub ④pa'i gang zag rnal 'byor pa de'i rnam par smin pa ni ⑤ji lta bu zhig ⑥bdag cag rnams kyis ⑦ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ bla ma de'i rjes su 'breng duzhing gsang ba 'di la mos shing 'dzin pa dang / rna ba'i dbang pos nyan cing gzhung bzhin dhidu sgrub pa'i gang zag rnal 'byor pa de ni gang zag 'ba' zhig ma lags te/ sa la bsnyen pa dang /sa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ste/ rigs kyi bu khyed ⑩rnams kyis kyang spun dang grogs po lta bur shes par bya'o/ /gang phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas ji snyed pa rnams kyang rnal 'byor pa de la nye ba'i sras dam par dgongs shing byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang zag gsang ba 'di ni thos shing mos pa'i skal (spreb dang ldan pa yang 8bskal pa grangs med pa'i pha mtha' nas tshogs bsags shing sbyangs pa'i mthus des ⑩ltar 'gyur bar rig par bya'o//de bas na smra ba'i seng ge khyod nyid la sogs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams dang tha mi dad par rig par ④bya'o/ /de dag gi dngos grub kyang tshe 'di nyid la 'grub cing gzhan 'jig rten gyi 7mthu chen rnams kyang bka' nyan cing las byed par 'gyur ro/ /yang smra ba'i seng ges gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bla ma rdo rje 101—879

880 bka' 'byur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101slob dpon chen po rnal 'byor gyi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gsang ba'i ①thog pa 'di nyid la mos shing dad pa'i sems kyis (migayo sgyu dang / gsog 'jog ①spangs pa'i phyi rabs kyi dad pa can gyi skye bo de'i rnam par smin pa cir 'gyur/bdag cag la sogs pa rnams kyis ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dad pa can gyi skye bo bla ma 'khor dang bcas pa gsang ba'i theg pa 'di nyid (hol mos shing dad (5)pa dang rna ba'i dbang pos nyan cing g.yo sgyu dang gsog 'jog spangs pa de'i rnam par smin pa'i legs pa'i yon tan yang brjod cing tshad gzung (6)bar rab tu dka'o/ /la la dag gis so so skye bo sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su gang ba la sbyin pa byin pa'am/ srog bton pa'am 7dge ba bcu dang / tshad med pa bzhi (8)dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis rgyu'i theg pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don byas pa (9)bas ni bla ma 'khor dang bcas pa khodang gsang ba'i theg pa 'di'i nyamasgo nas skad cig tsam 'gro ba gcig gi 62don byas pa'i bsod nams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'bum gyi cha 4 yang mi phod 'do/ /rigs kyi bu la la dag gis 1ltasangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su gang ba'i nyan thos sam/rang sangs rgyas sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i ⑩theg pa de snyed la rim gro (nyebakur sti tshul bzhin du bskal pa grangs med pa'i yun du byas pa'i bsod nams kyis ni gsang ba'i theg pa 'di la gnas pa'i gang zag rnal 'byor pa gcig la tha na dro gcig gam/ skad cig yud tsam du bkur sti tsho tshul bzhin du byas pa'i bsod 19nams kyi 'bum gyi char yang mi phod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni gsang ba'i theg pa 'di nyid las nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa rnams 2 'byung zhing gsang ba'i theg pa nyid la 'gro 101—880

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 881ba gzud pa'i ①thabs su bsti (snyeba'i gnas su gsungs pa yin gyi gtan du gzhag (dpa'i sa ni ma yin no/ / de bas phyin nga nyid kyi sprul pa bas (gekyang chos rnam pa sna tshogs ji ltar 'dul bar ston pa yin no/ /de bas na gsang 4)sngags kyi yon tan ni bsam (7gyis kyang mi khyab po/ /rigs kyi bu gang zag la la dag gis bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par rgyu'i theg pa'i sgo nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyas par spyad pa bas ni gsang ba'i theg pa 'di'i don skad cig tsam yid la byas pa'i bsod nams khyad par du 'phags te 'bum gyi char yang mi phod do / /rigs kyi bu gang zag la la zhig gis bskal pa gang gā'i niklung gi bye ma snyed du so so'i skye bo'am/ nyan thos sam/ rang rgyal ba'am/ byang chub sems dpas 6)sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su gang ba snyed la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / byug spos dang / bla bre dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /lhab lhub dang / rol mo'i khyad par mang po la sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su gang bar ⑩byas te phul ba bas tha na gsang yonyeba'i theg pa la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig tsam la'ang tu g.yo sgyu (3dang / gsog tso'ajog spangs pa'i sgo nas 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi 7tshogs skad cig tsam bteg cing longs spyad tsopa'i bsod nams khyad par du 'phags te 'bum gyi char yinayang mi phod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ so so'i skye bo'am/ nyan thos sam/ rang sangs rgyas sam/byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi phung po de dag pas gsang 4sheba'i theg pa la gnas pa gcig gi ba spu'i cha gcig gi bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi phung po khyad par du 'phags /7te 'bum gyi char yang mi phod do/ /de bzhin du gang zag la la zhig gis me tog la sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs 101—881

88 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ 0 101su gang ba'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi phung po gang yin pas 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs chen po gcig gi rdul phra rab kyi cha tsam gyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi phung po gang yin pa de bas 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs chen po gcig gi rdul phra rab kyi cha tsam gyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi phung po khyad par du 'phags te 'bum gyi char 3)yang mi phod do/ /rigs kyi bu de bas na dad pa can gyi skye bo gsang ba'i theg pa nyid dang / gsang ba'i theg pa la gnas pa'i bla ma 'khor dang bcas pa la dad pa'i sems kyis g.yo sgyu dang / gsog 'jog spangs pa'i ②de'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi phung po ni tshad med do/ /de ②bsod nams dang ye shes kyi phung po ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ④kyis kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /de nas smra ba'i seng ges 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /bde bar gshegs pa tshad ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'on kyang bdag cag la sogs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba rnams drang ba'i ⑤slad du sngon 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi gtan tshigs yirnams zhu 9)bar 'tshal na gnang ba'i skabs dbye bar gsol/ gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ smra ba'i seng ge khyod nga la zhu bar spobs kyis tshanyaci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /de nas smra ba'i seng shes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i theg pa 'di rna ba'i dbang pos thos pa'i yon tan dang rnam par smin pa 〈snaji lta bur 'gyur/ gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig /gsang ba'i theg pa 'di rna ba'i dbang pos thos pa'i yon tan ni ming tsam thos pas kyang ngan 'gro las skyob par 'gyur ro/ /de yang 101 —882

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 883ji ltar yongs su shes zhe ①na/ sngon 'das pa'i dus dran pa thog ma'i tshe gsang ba'i theg pa'i lha'i gnas rim ②pa gsum na tshul bzhin du spyod pa las 'od ldan zhes bya ba'i lha'i bu zhig mi rtag pa'i dus la bab ste 'chi ba'i snga ltas nirnams byung bar gyur / de ④rab tu mi dga' ba'i 'du shes su gyur nas tshe phyi ma la gang du skye snyam pa'i 'du shes 'ba' zhig skyes pa las/ lha'i bu de nyid mngon par shes pa las mi gtsang ba za ba'i byol song gi rigs su skye bar dumathong ste shin tu 'jigs pa'i sems skyes nas mgon skyabs gzhan med par mthong ste gsang ba'i theg pa'i mtshan thos nas de bzhin du yid la dran par byas so/ /de'i tshe 'od ldan zhes bya ba lha'i bu de ngan 'gro'i lam de las grol 4)te gsang rtsiba'i theg pa 'dzin pa'i gnas ga la ba der skyes so/ /der skyes nas kyang tshogs chen po la longs spyod pa niskal ba can du gyur pa de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /yang gsol pa / gsang ba mchog gi bdag po gsang ba'i theg pa 'di la dga' zhing mos pa dang ske/ 'dun pa skyes pa'i gang zag de ni rnam par smin pa'i yon tan ji lta bur 'gyur / lung bstan du gsol/ gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bka' stsal pa/gsang ba'i theg pa 'di la dga' zhing / mos pa dang 'dun pa skyed (7pa'i gang zag dam pa de ni rig ⑩'dzin rgyal ba'i sras dam par 'gyur bar gdon mi za'o//de yang ji ltar yongs su shes zhe ⑩na/ sngon 'das pa'i dus nga dran pa thog ma'i tshe bram ze rgyal byed ces bya ba'i bu byams ldan zhes bya ba zhig gsang tiba'i theg pa 'di la dga' zhing mos nas 'dun pa skyes te gsang ba'i theg pa 'di kun du btsal bas rang gi sgrib pa'i bag chags stug 4 pos gegs byas nas/ rnyed par ma gyur te sa phyogs shin tu yang yidaben pa cig tu 'dug tsonas gsang ba la rab (7101—883

884 bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ () 101tu gdung ba'i shugs kyis ngu zhing smre sngags kyi tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye ma'o bdag gi 0)las 'di shin tu pham/ /thog ma skyes nas rgas ②bar du/ /'bad de gsang ba'i don btsal yang / /gsang ba ma rnyed las re ngan/ /da yang 57ji ltar btsal na rnyed/ /btsal yang rnyed par mi 'gyur na/ /thugs rje ④bdag la skyabs mdzod cig /ces (nyasmras nas nam mkha' stong pa las cho 'phrul gyi sgra 'di skad ces grag go/ /bram ze'i bu ni skal ldan khyod/ /yid ⑥dam ri brtan pa shin (8)tu legs/ /khyod ni don gyi skal ba can/ /phyogs bcu 6)dus 7bzhi'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /khyod la byin gyis rlob pa mdzod/ /rang nyid lta ba ma yengs par/ /bag chags sbyangs pa'i thabs dag la/ /mkhas shing brtson par bya dgos te/ /rang gi khrag rnams drangs nas su/ /dad cing gtsang ba tsan+dan chur31/ /dmigs nas rgyal ba kun mchod na/ /myur du gsang don rnyed par 'gyur/ /zhes bar snang las 6)lung bstan pa thos nas rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis lus kyi rtsa rnams 1stekhrag drangs nas 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa de nyid du gsang ba'i don mthong sten)/ rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras dam 7par gyur pa de bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de nas yang smra ba'i seng ges gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos gsang ba'i theg pa 'di'i sgor zhugs shing tshogs 7kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa mthong ba'i gang zag dam pa de'i 'bras bu 7ji ltar 1 lags/ lung bstan du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan du gsol/ gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba'i theg pa'i sgor zhugs shing tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa mthong ba'i gang zag de ni dngos grub tu gyur to 'tshal 19thams cad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin thob 101—884

brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 885par 'gyur ro/ /de na yang ①ji ltar yongs su shes zhe ②na/ sngon 'das pa'i dus nga dran pa thog ma'i tshe lha'i gnas rim pa gsum na rdzigasang ba khyispyod pa las dge ba'i rgyal po bkod pa zhes bya ba'i lha'i bu zhig tshom bu 'bum dang bcas nas gsang ba rgya cher spyod 5)pa las rin chen 'od ldan zhes bya ba'i lha'i bu zhig gsang sngags rgya cher spyod pa de nyid la 4)shin tu dad pa skyes (7pa las yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa gsang ba'i gnas der phyin te gsang ba'i sgor zhugs nas tshogs kyi dkyil (8)'khor chen po yang 6)mthong bar byas te de nyid kyi dus kyi tshe dag 7tu dngos grub tu gyur to 'tshal ba thams cad ji ltar bsams tunyepa bzhin du thob par gyur pa/ de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de nas smra ba'i seng ges gsol pa/ gsang ba'i theg pa 'di mngon du spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa gang zhig la dga' ba'i yid kyis mngon du phyogs pa de'i 'bras bu ji lta bur 'gyur ba 5)lung bstan du gsol/ gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ smra ba'i seng ge gzhan yang gsang ba'i theg pa hunyaspyod pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i gang zag de'i rnam par smin pa ni gsang ba dngos su spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa de dang 'dra bar thob par 'gyur ro/ / de yang yiji ltar yongs su shes zhe yin/ sngon 'das pa'i dus nga dran pa thog ma'i tshe rgyal po dbang phyug 'od ldan zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig tshom bu 'bum dang bcas nas sngags kyi spyod pa la rgya cher zhugs te 'bras bu ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba 69thob par kun du grags pa las/gzhan gyi sde pa bram ze dge slong bya ba zhig shin tu dga' ba'i sems skyes nas 'byor pa'i yo byad mang po dang bcas nas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor de nyid du 'jug yi tshopar gsol ba btab /shepa las rgyal pos yi ma gnang ste gsang sgo bsdams 101—885
